namespace Infragistics.Win
{
	[SuppressUnmanagedCodeSecurity]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[SecurityCritical]
	internal class KeyboardHookManager
	{
		private delegate IntPtr HookProcCallback(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

		private bool hookfailed;

		private IntPtr hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;

		private HookProcCallback hookProc;

		private static KeyHookEventHandler keyHookDelegate;

		private static KeyboardHookManager keyHookManager;

		internal const int WH_KEYBOARD = 2;

		internal const int HC_ACTION = 0;

		internal const int HC_NOREMOVE = 3;

		internal const int KF_ALTDOWN = 8192;

		internal const int KF_DLGMODE = 2048;

		internal const int KF_EXTENDED = 256;

		internal const int KF_MENUMODE = 4096;

		internal const int KF_REPEAT = 16384;

		internal const int KF_UP = 32768;

		internal const int VK_CONTROL = 17;

		internal const int VK_SHIFT = 16;

		internal static event KeyHookEventHandler KeyHook
		{
			add
			{
				lock (typeof(KeyboardHookManager))
				{
					if (keyHookDelegate == null)
					{
						keyHookDelegate = value;
					}
					else
					{
						keyHookDelegate = (KeyHookEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(keyHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (keyHookManager == null)
					{
						keyHookManager = new KeyboardHookManager();
					}
					keyHookManager.SetHook();
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (typeof(KeyboardHookManager))
				{
					if (keyHookDelegate != null)
					{
						keyHookDelegate = (KeyHookEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(keyHookDelegate, value);
					}
					if (keyHookDelegate == null && keyHookManager != null)
					{
						keyHookManager.ReleaseHook();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, ExactSpelling = true)]
		private static extern IntPtr CallNextHookEx(IntPtr hook, int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

		private static bool UnhookWindowsHookExApi(IntPtr hook)
		{
			return UnhookWindowsHookEx(hook);
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, ExactSpelling = true)]
		[return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
		private static extern bool UnhookWindowsHookEx(IntPtr hook);

		private static IntPtr SetWindowsHookExApi(int id, HookProcCallback hookProc, IntPtr hmod, int dwThreadId)
		{
			return SetWindowsHookEx(id, hookProc, hmod, dwThreadId);
		}

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern IntPtr SetWindowsHookEx(int id, HookProcCallback hookProc, IntPtr hmod, int dwThreadId);

		[DllImport("user32", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern short GetKeyState(int nVirtKey);

		private static int GetCurrentThreadIdApi()
		{
			try
			{
				return GetCurrentThreadIdApiUnsafe();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return AppDomain.GetCurrentThreadId();
		}

		private static int GetCurrentThreadIdApiUnsafe()
		{
			return GetCurrentThreadId();
		}

		[DllImport("kernel32")]
		private static extern int GetCurrentThreadId();

		private KeyboardHookManager()
		{
			hookProc = HookProc;
		}

		private void SetHook()
		{
			if (hookfailed || hookHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				hookHandle = SetWindowsHookExApi(2, hookProc, IntPtr.Zero, GetCurrentThreadIdApi());
			}
			catch
			{
				hookfailed = true;
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseHook()
		{
			if (hookfailed || hookHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UnhookWindowsHookExApi(hookHandle);
				hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
		{
			if (ncode >= 0)
			{
				Keys keys = (Keys)wParam.ToInt64();
				int num = (int)lParam.ToInt64();
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | (((num & 0x2000) != 0) ? 262144 : 0));
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | ((GetKeyState(17) < 0) ? 131072 : 0));
				keys = (Keys)((int)keys | ((GetKeyState(16) < 0) ? 65536 : 0));
				KeyEventType keyEventType = (((num & 0x8000) != 0) ? KeyEventType.KeyUp : KeyEventType.KeyDown);
				keyEventType = ((((num >> 31) & 1) != 0) ? KeyEventType.KeyUp : KeyEventType.KeyDown);
				KeyHookEventArgs e = new KeyHookEventArgs(ncode, keys, keyEventType);
				RaiseKeyHookEvent(e);
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					return (IntPtr)1;
				}
			}
			return CallNextHookEx(hookHandle, ncode, wParam, lParam);
		}

		private static void RaiseKeyHookEvent(KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (keyHookDelegate != null)
			{
				keyHookDelegate(null, e);
			}
		}
	}
	internal delegate void KeyHookEventHandler(object sender, KeyHookEventArgs e);
	internal enum KeyEventType
	{
		KeyDown,
		KeyUp
	}
	internal class KeyHookEventArgs : KeyEventArgs
	{
		private KeyEventType eventType;

		private int hookCode;

		public KeyEventType EventType => eventType;

		public int HookCode => hookCode;

		internal KeyHookEventArgs(int hookCode, Keys keyData, KeyEventType eventType)
			: base(keyData)
		{
			this.eventType = eventType;
			this.hookCode = hookCode;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock

	public class UltraDockManagerRole : ComponentRole
	{
		private UltraDockManager dockManager;

		protected override ISynchronizeInvoke SynchronizingObject => dockManager.HostControl;

		public UltraDockManagerRole(UltraDockManager dockManager)
			: base((Component)(object)dockManager, "UltraDockManager")
		{
			this.dockManager = dockManager;
			((ComponentRole)this).PropertiesCacheCount = 24;
		}

		protected override string[] GetRoleNames()
		{
			return StyleUtils.GetRoleNames();
		}

		protected override void OnStyleChanged()
		{
			dockManager.OnAppStyleChanged();
		}
	}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraDockManager manager, CachedProperty prop, object styleValue, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			ComponentRole val = ((manager != null) ? ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole : null);

			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
		}

		private static object ResolveValueHelper(object val, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (defVal != resolveVal && object.Equals(val, defVal))
			{
				return resolveVal;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraDockManager manager, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			ComponentRole val = ((manager != null) ? ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole : null);
			if (val != null)

				string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(prop);
				object obj = null;
				if (val.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
				{
					obj = val.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
				}
				return val.CachePropertyValue(obj, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal, (int)prop);
			}
			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
		}

		}

		internal static void OutputUnsetCachedProps(ComponentRole role, int indexBeingSet)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			object obj = default(object);
			for (int i = 0; i < role.PropertiesCacheCount; i++)
			{
				if (i != indexBeingSet && !role.GetCachedProperty(i, ref obj))
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(",");
					}
					object value = ((i <= 7) ? ((object)(CustomProperty)i) : ((object)(CachedProperty)i));
					stringBuilder.Append(value);
				}
			}
			_ = stringBuilder.Length;
			_ = 0;
		}

		}

		internal static void DirtyCachedPropertyVals(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			ComponentRole val = ((manager != null) ? ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			}
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			manager.DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.PropertyCache);
			foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in manager.ControlPanes)
			{
				DirtyCachedPropertyVals(controlPane);
			}
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in manager.DockAreas)
			{
				DirtyCachedPropertyVals(dockArea);
			}
		}

		internal static void DirtyCachedPropertyVals(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			pane.PropertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			if (!(pane is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
			{
				DirtyCachedPropertyVals(pane2);
			}
		}

		{
			ComponentRole val2 = ((manager != null) ? ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole : null);

		}

		internal static object GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraDockManager manager, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (!GetCachedPropertyVal(manager, prop, out var val))
			{
				return CachePropertyValue(manager, prop, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
			}
			return val;
		}

			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRole componentRole = ((UltraStylableComponent)manager).ComponentRole;

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea)
		{

			return GetRole(unpinnedTabArea, out resOrder);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea, out ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder)
		{
			return GetRole(role: ((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Dock switch
			{
				DockStyle.Left => Role.UnpinnedTabAreaLeft, 
				DockStyle.Right => Role.UnpinnedTabAreaRight, 
				DockStyle.Top => Role.UnpinnedTabAreaTop, 
				DockStyle.Bottom => Role.UnpinnedTabAreaBottom, 
				_ => Role.UnpinnedTabAreaLeft, 
			}, manager: unpinnedTabArea.Manager, resOrder: out resOrder);
		}

		internal static string[] GetRoleNames()
		{
			object[] roleInfo = GetRoleInfo();
			string[] array = new string[roleInfo.Length / 5];
			for (int i = 0; i < roleInfo.Length; i += 5)
			{
				string text = (string)roleInfo[i + 1];
				array[i / 5] = text;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static object GetWindowStyle(ISupportAppStyling stylableObj, CustomProperty windowStyleProp)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			ComponentRole componentRole = stylableObj.ComponentRole;
			object obj = null;
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(windowStyleProp);
				if (componentRole.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
				{
					obj = componentRole.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
				}
				if (obj == null || object.Equals(obj, WindowStyle.Default))
				{
					ViewStyle viewStyle = componentRole.ViewStyle;
					switch (viewStyle - 4)
					{
					case 0:
						obj = WindowStyle.Office2003;
						break;
					case 1:
						obj = WindowStyle.VisualStudio2005;
						break;
					case 2:
						obj = WindowStyle.Office2007;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	[Designer("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.Design.AutoHideContainerDesigner, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(IDesigner))]
	public class AutoHideControl : DockControlBase, IDockingAreaEx, IDockingArea, ILayoutItem
	{
		private AutoHideControlUIElement controlElement;

		private DockableControlPane currentFlyoutPane;

		private UnpinnedTabArea tabArea;

		private DockStyle dockLocation;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer hideTimer;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer animationTimer;

		private EventHandler tabAreaResizeHandler;

		private EventHandler animationTimerTickHandler;

		private EventHandler hideTimerTickHandler;

		private int modalCounter;

		protected override ControlUIElementBase ControlUIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (controlElement == null && ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner is UltraDockManager)
				{
					controlElement = new AutoHideControlUIElement(this, ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner as UltraDockManager);
				}
				return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)controlElement;
			}
		}

		internal DockStyle DockLocation => dockLocation;

		internal UltraDockManager Manager => ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner as UltraDockManager;

		internal bool IsVertical
		{
			get
			{
				DockStyle dockStyle = DockLocation;
				if (dockStyle == DockStyle.Left || dockStyle == DockStyle.Right)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DockableControlPane FlyoutPane => currentFlyoutPane;

		internal UnpinnedTabArea TabArea => tabArea;

		internal FlyoutState State => state;

		private bool IsMouseOverControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)this).Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
				mousePosition = ((Control)(object)this).PointToClient(mousePosition);
				return ((ScrollableControl)(object)this).DisplayRectangle.Contains(mousePosition);
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle DisplayRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((ScrollableControl)(object)this).DisplayRectangle;
				UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = TabArea;
				if (unpinnedTabArea == null || Manager == null)
				{
					return displayRectangle;
				}
				int splitterBarWidthResolved = Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				switch (DockLocation)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					displayRectangle.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					displayRectangle.X += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					displayRectangle.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
					displayRectangle.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					displayRectangle.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					displayRectangle.Y += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				}
				return displayRectangle;
			}
		}

		private bool IsMouseOverTab
		{
			get
			{
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					UIElement val = Manager.ElementFromPoint(Control.MousePosition);
					if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(TabItemUIElement)) != null)
					{
						object context = val.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase));
						return context == currentFlyoutPane;
					}
					return false;
				}
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(hotTrackTabPane) as DockableControlPane;
				return currentFlyoutPane == dockableControlPane;
			}
		}

		private bool IsFlyoutPaneActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (currentFlyoutPane != null)
				{
					if (currentFlyoutPane.IsActive)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return UltraDockManager.ContainsOwnedForm(currentFlyoutPane.Control);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private Control CurrentActiveControl => Utilities.ActiveForm?.ActiveControl;

		protected internal override bool HasControlUIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (controlElement != null)
				{
					return ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private Control PreviousActiveControl
		{
			get
			{
				return Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(previousActiveControl) as Control;
			}
			set
			{
				previousActiveControl = ((value == null) ? null : new WeakReference(value));
			}
		}

		int IDockingArea.PriorityLevel => 1000;

		DockingAreaPosition IDockingAreaEx.Position => (DockingAreaPosition)1;

		bool ILayoutItem.IsVisible => false;

		Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize => Size.Empty;

		Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize => Size.Empty;

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			StopHideTimer();
			StopAnimationTimer();
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void OnTabAreaResize(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncControlBounds();
		}

		internal void SyncControlBounds()
		{
			Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = Manager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
			switch (DockLocation)
			{
			default:
				((Control)(object)this).Bounds = new Rectangle(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.X, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Y, ((Control)(object)this).Size.Width, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height);
				break;
			case DockStyle.Right:
				((Control)(object)this).Bounds = new Rectangle(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Right - ((Control)(object)this).Size.Width, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Y, ((Control)(object)this).Size.Width, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height);
				break;
			case DockStyle.Top:
				((Control)(object)this).Bounds = new Rectangle(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.X, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Y, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width, ((Control)(object)this).Size.Height);
				break;
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
				((Control)(object)this).Bounds = new Rectangle(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.X, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Bottom - ((Control)(object)this).Size.Height, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width, ((Control)(object)this).Size.Height);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnHideTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if ((Manager != null && Manager.IsDropDownOpen) || modalCounter > 0 || IsPropertyGridDropDownOpenOnActivePane())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = checkActiveState && IsFlyoutPaneActive;
			if (!isFirstHideTick && !checkActiveState && PreviousActiveControl != CurrentActiveControl)
			{
				checkActiveState = true;
				flag = IsFlyoutPaneActive;
				PreviousActiveControl = CurrentActiveControl;
			}
			isFirstHideTick = false;
			switch (State)
			{
			case FlyoutState.Hidden:
				StopHideTimer();
				break;
			case FlyoutState.Closing:
				if (IsMouseOverTab || IsMouseOverControl || flag)
				{
					state = FlyoutState.OpeningMouseHover;
				}
				break;
			case FlyoutState.OpeningMouseHover:
				if (!IsMouseOverTab && !IsMouseOverControl && !flag)
				{
					state = FlyoutState.Closing;
				}
				break;
			case FlyoutState.Displayed:
				if (!flag && !IsMouseOverTab && !IsMouseOverControl)
				{
					mouseLeaveTime = DateTime.Now;
					state = FlyoutState.DisplayedPotentialHide;
					if (!checkActiveState)
					{
						PreviousActiveControl = CurrentActiveControl;
					}
				}
				break;
			case FlyoutState.DisplayedPotentialHide:
				if (!checkActiveState && PreviousActiveControl != CurrentActiveControl)
				{
					checkActiveState = true;
					flag = IsFlyoutPaneActive;
				}
				if (IsMouseOverTab || IsMouseOverControl || flag)
				{
					state = FlyoutState.Displayed;
				}
				else if (Manager.DragManager.IsDragging || ((Control)(object)this).Capture)
				{
					state = FlyoutState.Displayed;
				}
				else if (DateTime.Now.Subtract(mouseLeaveTime).TotalMilliseconds >= (double)Manager.AutoHideDelay)
				{
					HideFlyoutPane(Manager.AnimationEnabled);
				}
				break;
			case FlyoutState.Opening:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnAnimationTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Manager.DragManager.IsDragging)
			{
				Size size = stepOffsetSize;
				int num = 1;
				switch (State)
				{
				default:
					StopAnimationTimer();
					return;
				case FlyoutState.Closing:
				case FlyoutState.ForceClosing:
					size.Width *= -1;
					size.Height *= -1;
					num = -1;
					break;
				case FlyoutState.Opening:
				case FlyoutState.OpeningMouseHover:
					break;
				}
				Rectangle bounds = ((Control)(object)this).Bounds;
				switch (DockLocation)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					bounds.Width += size.Width;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					bounds.Width += size.Width;
					bounds.X -= size.Width;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
					bounds.Height += size.Height;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					bounds.Height += size.Height;
					bounds.Y -= size.Height;
					break;
				}
				currentAnimationStep += num;
				if (currentAnimationStep <= firstStep)
				{
					HideFlyoutImmediately();
				}
				else if (currentAnimationStep >= lastStep)
				{
					ShowFlyoutImmediately();
					StopAnimationTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)this).BringToFront();
					((Control)(object)this).Visible = true;
					((Control)(object)this).Bounds = bounds;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationEnterThreadModal(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			modalCounter++;
		}

		private void OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			modalCounter--;
		}

		private void StartHideTimer()
		{
			if (hideTimer == null)
			{
				isFirstHideTick = true;
				hideTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				int autoHideDelay = Manager.AutoHideDelay;
				hideTimer.Interval = ((autoHideDelay <= 0) ? 1 : autoHideDelay);
				hideTimer.Tick += HideTimerTickHandler;
				Application.EnterThreadModal += OnApplicationEnterThreadModal;
				Application.LeaveThreadModal += OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal;
				hideTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void StopHideTimer()
		{
			if (hideTimer != null)
			{
				Application.EnterThreadModal -= OnApplicationEnterThreadModal;
				Application.LeaveThreadModal -= OnApplicationLeaveThreadModal;
				hideTimer.Stop();
				hideTimer.Tick -= HideTimerTickHandler;
				hideTimer.Dispose();
				hideTimer = null;
			}
		}

		private void StartAnimationTimer()
		{
			if (animationTimer == null)
			{
				animationTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				animationTimer.Interval = animationStepInterval;
				animationTimer.Tick += AnimationTimerTickHandler;
				animationTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimationTimer()
		{
			if (animationTimer != null)
			{
				animationTimer.Stop();
				animationTimer.Tick -= AnimationTimerTickHandler;
				animationTimer.Dispose();
				animationTimer = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPaneDisplayed(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			return pane == currentFlyoutPane;
		}

		internal void MouseEnterAutoHideTab(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			hotTrackTabPane = new WeakReference(pane);
		}

		internal void MouseLeaveAutoHideTab(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			hotTrackTabPane = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (currentFlyoutPane.Closed)
			{
				HideFlyoutPane(slide: false);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowFlyoutPane(DockableControlPane pane, UnpinnedTabArea tabArea, bool slide, DefaultableBoolean honorActiveState)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsPaneDisplayed(pane))
			{
				return;
			}
			HideFlyoutPane(slide: false);
			if (pane != null)
			{
				CancelableControlPaneEventArgs e = new CancelableControlPaneEventArgs(pane);
				Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforeShowFlyout, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			checkActiveState = pane.IsUnpinned && !pane.IsActive;
			switch ((int)honorActiveState)
			{
			case 2:
				checkActiveState = false;
				break;
			case 1:
				checkActiveState = true;
				break;
			}
			PreviousActiveControl = CurrentActiveControl;
			if (PreviousActiveControl is WindowDockingArea)
			{
				PreviousActiveControl = pane.Control;
			}
			if (pane.IsUnpinned && pane.IsActive && (int)honorActiveState == 0)
			{
				checkActiveState = false;
				PreviousActiveControl = null;
			}
			state = FlyoutState.Opening;
			this.tabArea = tabArea;
			currentFlyoutPane = pane;
			dockLocation = ((Control)(object)tabArea).Dock;
			TabManagerBase owningTabInfo = Manager.GetOwningTabInfo(pane);
			if (owningTabInfo == null)
			{
				HideFlyoutImmediately();
				return;
			}
			((TabManager)owningTabInfo).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)pane;
			((TabManager)owningTabInfo).Dirty(true, false, true);
			((Control)(object)tabArea).Resize += TabAreaResizeHandler;
			((Control)(object)tabArea).LocationChanged += TabAreaResizeHandler;
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged += ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			UpdateFlyoutSizeFromPane();
			bool isVertical = IsVertical;
			int splitterBarWidthResolved = Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
			((Control)(object)this).Size = Size.Empty;
			SyncControlBounds();
			if (isVertical)
			{
				flyoutSize.Width += splitterBarWidthResolved;
			}
			else
			{
				flyoutSize.Height += splitterBarWidthResolved;
			}
			PrepareAnimationInfo();
			currentAnimationStep = firstStep;
			pane.InitializePinnedState(pinnedState: false);
			pane.VerifyIsInViewState();
			((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = true;
			if (slide)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Visible = true;
				StartAnimationTimer();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowFlyoutImmediately();
			}
			StartHideTimer();
		}

		private void ShowFlyoutImmediately()
		{
			state = FlyoutState.Displayed;
			if (currentFlyoutPane != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)currentFlyoutPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			}
			((Control)(object)this).Size = flyoutSize;
			SyncControlBounds();
			((Control)(object)this).Visible = true;
			((Control)(object)this).BringToFront();
		}

		private void PrepareAnimationInfo()
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = currentFlyoutPane;
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				if (dockableControlPane.Container == null)
				{
					HideFlyoutImmediately();
				}
				Size size = flyoutSize;
				int splitterBarWidthResolved = Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					size.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					size.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				switch (DockLocation)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.Right;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.Left;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.Top;
					break;
				}
				((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Size = size;
				int val = (IsVertical ? flyoutSize.Width : flyoutSize.Height);
				int num = 5;
				switch (Manager.AnimationSpeed)
				{
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedPlus5:
					num = 40;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedPlus4:
					num = 31;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedPlus3:
					num = 25;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedPlus2:
					num = 19;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedPlus1:
					num = 14;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeed:
					num = 10;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedMinus1:
					num = 8;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedMinus2:
					num = 6;
					animationStepInterval = 10;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedMinus3:
					num = 5;
					animationStepInterval = 12;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedMinus4:
					num = 3;
					animationStepInterval = 20;
					break;
				case AnimationSpeed.StandardSpeedMinus5:
					num = 2;
					animationStepInterval = 30;
					break;
				}
				val = Math.Max(num, val);
				lastStep = val / num + 1;
				stepOffsetSize = new Size(num, num);
			}
		}

		internal void HideFlyoutPane(bool slide)
		{
			HideFlyoutPane(slide, force: false);
		}

		internal void HideFlyoutPane(bool slide, bool force)
		{
			if (!slide || currentFlyoutPane == null)
			{
				HideFlyoutImmediately();
				return;
			}
			PrepareAnimationInfo();
			if (force)
			{
				state = FlyoutState.ForceClosing;
			}
			else
			{
				state = FlyoutState.Closing;
			}
			currentAnimationStep = lastStep;
			StartAnimationTimer();
		}

		internal void HideFlyoutImmediately()
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = currentFlyoutPane;
			UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = TabArea;
			state = FlyoutState.Hidden;
			StopAnimationTimer();
			StopHideTimer();
			if (Manager == null || Manager.ActivePane == null || Manager.ActivePane.Container == null || !((Control)(object)this).Contains((Control)(object)Manager.ActivePane.Container))
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Visible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Size = Size.Empty;
			}
			currentFlyoutPane = null;
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				dockableControlPane.SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (((Control)(object)this).Contains((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container))
				{
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.None;
					if (!dockableControlPane.IsActive)
					{
						((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Visible = false;
						dockableControlPane.HideControls();
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Left = -10000;
					}
				}
			}
			tabArea = null;
			if (unpinnedTabArea != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Resize -= TabAreaResizeHandler;
				((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).LocationChanged -= TabAreaResizeHandler;
			}
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				ControlPaneEventArgs e = new ControlPaneEventArgs(dockableControlPane);
				Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.AfterHideFlyout, e);
			}
			dockableControlPane?.VerifyIsInViewState();
		}

		protected override void OnControlRemoved(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnControlRemoved(e);
			if (!((Control)(object)this).Disposing && !((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && currentFlyoutPane == null && Manager != null && !Manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).PerformLayout();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSizeChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (State == FlyoutState.Displayed || State == FlyoutState.DisplayedPotentialHide)
			{
				state = FlyoutState.Displayed;
				if (currentFlyoutPane != null)
				{
					Size newFlyoutSize = currentFlyoutPane.FlyoutSize;
					if (IsVertical)
					{
						newFlyoutSize.Width = ((Control)(object)this).DisplayRectangle.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						newFlyoutSize.Height = ((Control)(object)this).DisplayRectangle.Height;
					}
					currentFlyoutPane.InternalSetFlyoutSize(newFlyoutSize);
					flyoutSize = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
				}
			}
			((Control)(object)this).OnSizeChanged(e);
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.DelayInvalidateOverlayControl();
			}
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			currentFlyoutPane = null;
			state = FlyoutState.Hidden;
			hotTrackTabPane = null;
			mouseLeaveTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
			stepOffsetSize = Size.Empty;
			currentAnimationStep = 0;
			lastStep = 10;
			flyoutSize = Size.Empty;
			animationStepInterval = 0;
			checkActiveState = true;
			previousActiveControl = null;
			isFirstHideTick = false;
		}

		private void UpdateFlyoutSizeFromPane()
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = currentFlyoutPane;
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				Size size = dockableControlPane.FlyoutSize;
				bool isVertical = IsVertical;
				int splitterBarWidthResolved = Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				if (isVertical && size.Width < 0)
				{
					size.Width = dockableControlPane.DisplaySize.Width;
				}
				else if (!isVertical && size.Height < 0)
				{
					size.Height = dockableControlPane.DisplaySize.Height;
				}
				Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = Manager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					size.Height = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					size.Width = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width;
				}
				if (isVertical && size.Width > innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width - splitterBarWidthResolved)
				{
					size.Width = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width - splitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				else if (!isVertical && size.Height > innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height - splitterBarWidthResolved)
				{
					size.Height = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height - splitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				flyoutSize = size;
			}
		}

		internal void ResynchronizeFlyoutSize()
		{
			if (currentFlyoutPane != null)
			{
				UpdateFlyoutSizeFromPane();
				ShowFlyoutImmediately();
			}
		}

		private bool IsPropertyGridDropDownOpenOnActivePane()
		{
			if (currentFlyoutPane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Form activeForm = Utilities.ActiveForm;
			if (activeForm == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = activeForm.GetType();
			if (type.FullName != "System.Windows.Forms.PropertyGridInternal.PropertyGridView+DropDownHolder")
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				FieldInfo field = type.GetField("gridView", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
				if (field == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (Control control = field.GetValue(activeForm) as Control; control != null; control = Utilities.GetParent(control))
				{
					if (control == currentFlyoutPane.Control)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideControlUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		public UltraDockManager Manager => ((ControlUIElementBase)this).UltraControl as UltraDockManager;

		internal AutoHideControl AutoHideControl => ((UIElement)this).Control as AutoHideControl;

		public override RightToLeft RightToLeft => ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;

		public AutoHideControlUIElement(AutoHideControl control, UltraDockManager manager)
			: base((Control)(object)control, (IUltraControl)(object)manager)
		{
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			DockableControlPane flyoutPane = AutoHideControl.FlyoutPane;
			if (flyoutPane != null && Manager != null)
			{
				Rectangle workRect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				PositionSplitterBar(ref workRect, flyoutPane, childElements);
			}
		}

		private void PositionSplitterBar(ref Rectangle workRect, DockableControlPane pane, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			int splitterBarWidthResolved = pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
			if (splitterBarWidthResolved != 0)
			{
				bool isVertical = AutoHideControl.IsVertical;
				AutoHideSplitterUIElement autoHideSplitterUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(AutoHideSplitterUIElement), true) as AutoHideSplitterUIElement;
				if (autoHideSplitterUIElement == null || autoHideSplitterUIElement.IsVerticalSplitterBar != isVertical)
				{
					autoHideSplitterUIElement = new AutoHideSplitterUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, isVertical);
				}
				Size size = new Size(splitterBarWidthResolved, splitterBarWidthResolved);
				Point location;
				switch (((Control)(object)AutoHideControl.TabArea).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					location = workRect.Location;
					size.Width = workRect.Width;
					workRect.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					workRect.Y += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Left:
					location = new Point(workRect.Right - splitterBarWidthResolved, workRect.Y);
					size.Height = workRect.Height;
					workRect.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					location = workRect.Location;
					size.Height = workRect.Height;
					workRect.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					workRect.X += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				default:
					location = new Point(workRect.X, workRect.Bottom - splitterBarWidthResolved);
					size.Width = workRect.Width;
					workRect.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)autoHideSplitterUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(location, size);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)autoHideSplitterUIElement);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideSplitterUIElement : PaneSplitterUIElementBase
	{
		private AutoHideControl AutoHideControl => ((UIElement)this).Control as AutoHideControl;

		private DockableControlPane Pane => AutoHideControl?.FlyoutPane;

		protected override DockablePaneBase[] Panes => new DockablePaneBase[1] { Pane };

		internal override StyleUtils.SplitterRole Role
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
				{
					return StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterHorz;
				}
				return StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterVert;
			}
		}

		public AutoHideSplitterUIElement(UIElement parent, bool verticalSplit)
			: base(parent, verticalSplit)
		{
		}

		public override void GetAdjustmentRange(Point point, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range)
		{
			((SplitterUIElement)this).GetAdjustmentRange(point, ref range);
			if (((DisposableObject)(object)this).Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = base.UltraDockManager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
			Size minimumSizeResolved = Pane.MinimumSizeResolved;
			Size maximumSizeResolved = Pane.MaximumSizeResolved;
			Size flyoutSize = Pane.FlyoutSize;
			if (base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
			{
				range.leftRightAdjustmentBar.Width = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width;
				if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Right)
				{
					range.maxDeltaLeft = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Left - ((UIElement)this).Control.Left;
					range.maxDeltaRight = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Right - ((UIElement)this).Control.Left;
					if (maximumSizeResolved.Width > 0 && flyoutSize.Width - range.maxDeltaLeft > maximumSizeResolved.Width)
					{
						range.maxDeltaLeft = Math.Min(0, -maximumSizeResolved.Width + flyoutSize.Width);
					}
					if (range.maxDeltaRight > -minimumSizeResolved.Width + flyoutSize.Width)
					{
						range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Max(0, -minimumSizeResolved.Width + flyoutSize.Width);
					}
				}
				else if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Left)
				{
					range.maxDeltaLeft = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Left - ((UIElement)this).Control.Right + ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width;
					range.maxDeltaRight = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Right - ((UIElement)this).Control.Right;
					if (flyoutSize.Width + range.maxDeltaLeft < minimumSizeResolved.Width)
					{
						range.maxDeltaLeft = Math.Min(0, minimumSizeResolved.Width - flyoutSize.Width);
					}
					if (maximumSizeResolved.Width > 0 && range.maxDeltaRight > maximumSizeResolved.Width - flyoutSize.Width)
					{
						range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Max(0, maximumSizeResolved.Width - flyoutSize.Width);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			range.upDownAdjustmentBar.Height = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height;
			if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Bottom)
			{
				range.maxDeltaDown = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Bottom - ((UIElement)this).Control.Top;
				range.maxDeltaUp = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Top - ((UIElement)this).Control.Top;
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Height > 0 && flyoutSize.Height - range.maxDeltaUp > maximumSizeResolved.Height)
				{
					range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Min(0, -maximumSizeResolved.Height + flyoutSize.Height);
				}
				if (range.maxDeltaDown > -minimumSizeResolved.Height + flyoutSize.Height)
				{
					range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Max(0, -minimumSizeResolved.Height + flyoutSize.Height);
				}
			}
			else if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Top)
			{
				range.maxDeltaDown = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Bottom - ((UIElement)this).Control.Bottom;
				range.maxDeltaUp = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Top - ((UIElement)this).Control.Bottom + ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height;
				if (flyoutSize.Height + range.maxDeltaUp < minimumSizeResolved.Height)
				{
					range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Min(0, minimumSizeResolved.Height - flyoutSize.Height);
				}
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Height > 0 && range.maxDeltaDown > maximumSizeResolved.Height - flyoutSize.Height)
				{
					range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Max(0, maximumSizeResolved.Height - flyoutSize.Height);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			DockableControlPane pane = Pane;
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if (control == null || pane.Manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
			{
				if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Right)
				{
					control.Width -= delta.X;
					AutoHideControl.SyncControlBounds();
				}
				else
				{
					control.Width += delta.X;
				}
				pane.InternalSetFlyoutSize(new Size(((UIElement)this).Control.Width - ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width, pane.FlyoutSize.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				if (AutoHideControl.DockLocation == DockStyle.Bottom)
				{
					control.Height -= delta.Y;
					AutoHideControl.SyncControlBounds();
				}
				else
				{
					control.Height += delta.Y;
				}
				pane.FlyoutSize = new Size(pane.FlyoutSize.Width, ((UIElement)this).Control.Height - ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height);
				pane.InternalSetFlyoutSize(new Size(pane.FlyoutSize.Width, ((UIElement)this).Control.Height - ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height));
			}
			if (((UIElement)this).ControlElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)((UIElement)this).ControlElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			base.UltraDockManager.VerifyPaneControlElements(((UIElement)this).Control);
			((UIElement)this).Control.Update();
			base.ApplyAdjustment(delta);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class DockableControlPane : DockablePaneBase, ISerializable
	{
		private DockableWindow container;

		private Control control;

		private WeakReference oldControl;

		private static readonly Size FlyoutSizeDefault = new Size(-1, -1);

		private Size flyoutSize = FlyoutSizeDefault;

		private Rectangle originalControlBounds = Rectangle.Empty;

		private const bool PinnedDefault = true;

		private bool pinned = true;

		private string controlName;

		private EventHandler containerEnterHandler;

		private EventHandler containerLeaveHandler;

		private EventHandler controlFocusChangeHandler;

		private bool enteredContainer;

		private Control previousContainer;

		private const bool IsMdiChildDefault = false;

		private bool isMdiChild;

		private Icon mdiChildIcon;

		private int serializedCtrlPaneIndex = -1;

		private bool lastIsInViewState;

		private bool isUnpinning;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableControlPane_P_Control")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[MergableProperty(false)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ControlPaneControlConverter))]
		public Control Control
		{
			get
			{
				if (oldControl != null)
				{
					return Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(oldControl) as Control;
				}
				if (control == null && controlName != null && base.Manager != null)
				{
					control = base.Manager.GetControlFromName(controlName, allowInternal: false);
					if (control != null)
					{
						controlName = control.Name;
						HookContainedControl();
					}
				}
				return control;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Control != value)
				{
					oldControl = null;
					bool flag = value != null && !base.IsBeingRepositioned;
					if (flag)
					{
						base.IsBeingRepositioned = true;
					}
					UnhookContainedControl();
					control = value;
					if (value != null)
					{
						controlName = value.Name;
						originalControlBounds = value.Bounds;
					}
					else
					{
						controlName = null;
						originalControlBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						base.IsBeingRepositioned = false;
					}
					HookContainedControl();
					PropertyChanged(PropertyIds.Control);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public override bool IsActive
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = Control;
				if (control == null || control.Disposing || base.Manager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Manager.IsActivePane(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsUnpinned => !Pinned;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				DockableGroupPane parent = base.Parent;
				if (parent == null || base.Manager == null || Closed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = base.DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane == null || dockAreaPane.Closed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Docked && (IsUnpinned || IsMdiChild))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !base.IsAncestorClosed;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableControlPane_P_FlyoutSize")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public Size FlyoutSize
		{
			get
			{
				return flyoutSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == flyoutSize))
				{
					InternalSetFlyoutSize(value);
					if (base.Manager != null)
					{
						base.Manager.OnFlyoutSizeChanged(this);
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FlyoutSize);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public Rectangle OriginalControlBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return originalControlBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				originalControlBounds = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsFlyoutPaneDisplayed
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Manager.IsFlyoutPane(this);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableControlPane_P_Pinned")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool Pinned
		{
			get
			{
				return pinned;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pinned != value)
				{
					if (base.Manager == null)
					{
						pinned = value;
					}
					else if (value)
					{
						Pin();
					}
					else
					{
						Unpin();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableControlPane_P_IsMdiChild")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsMdiChild
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					return isMdiChild;
				}
				if (!base.Manager.CanCreateMdiChildForms)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return isMdiChild;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == IsMdiChild)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					isMdiChild = value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!base.Manager.CanCreateMdiChildForms)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("The owning 'UltraDockManager' must be associated with a Form whose 'IsMdiContainer' is set to true");
					}
					isMdiChild = base.Manager.ToggleMdiChildState(this, value);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsMdiChild);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableControlPane_P_MdiChildIcon")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public Icon MdiChildIcon
		{
			get
			{
				return mdiChildIcon;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mdiChildIcon != value)
				{
					mdiChildIcon = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MdiChildIcon);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsInView => base.IsInViewInternal;

		protected internal override Size ActualMaximumSize

					return Control.MinimumSize;
				}
				return base.MinimumSize;
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsFloatingDockAreaCaption
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (base.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)base.SettingsResolved.ShowCaption == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (DockableGroupPane parent = base.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					switch (parent.ChildPaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
					case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
						if (parent.Panes.Count > 1)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal DockableWindow Container
		{
			get
			{
				return container;
			}
			set
			{
				if (container != value)
				{
					UnhookContainer();
					container = value;
					HookContainer();
					HookContainedControl();
				}
			}
		}

		internal string ControlName
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = Control;
				if (control != null)
				{
					if (control.Site != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(control.Site.Name))
					{
						return control.Site.Name;
					}
					return control.Name;
				}
				return controlName;
			}
		}

		protected internal override DockControlBase ContainingControl => Container;

		internal bool IsUnpinning
		{
			get
			{
				return isUnpinning;
			}
			set

				isUnpinning = value;
			}
		}

		internal int SerializedControlPaneIndex => serializedCtrlPaneIndex;

		internal bool ShowInNavigator

			get
			{
				if (base.Manager == null || Closed || base.IsAncestorClosed || base.DockAreaPane == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsMdiChild)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override UIRole UIRoleContentArea => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.Manager, StyleUtils.Role.ControlPaneContent);

			: this(string.Empty, control)
		{
		}

			: base(key)

			: this(key, string.Empty, control)

			: base(key, text)

		}

		public DockableControlPane(string key, string text, Control control)
			: base(key, text)
		{
			this.control = control;
			if (control != null)
			{
				controlName = control.Name;
				originalControlBounds = control.Bounds;
			}
		}

		protected DockableControlPane(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "ControlName":
					controlName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), controlName);
					break;
				case "FlyoutSize":
					flyoutSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), flyoutSize);
					break;
				case "OriginalControlBounds":
					originalControlBounds = (Rectangle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Rectangle), originalControlBounds);
					break;
				case "Pinned":
					pinned = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), pinned);
					break;
				case "IsMdiChild":
					isMdiChild = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isMdiChild);
					break;
				case "MdiChildIcon":
					mdiChildIcon = (Icon)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Icon), mdiChildIcon);
					break;
				case "ControlPaneIndex":
					serializedCtrlPaneIndex = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), serializedCtrlPaneIndex);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeFlyoutSize()
		{
			return flyoutSize != FlyoutSizeDefault;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetFlyoutSize()
		{
			FlyoutSize = FlyoutSizeDefault;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeOriginalControlBounds()
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return controlName != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Activate()
		{
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.Manager.ActivatePane(this, force: true);
		}

		public void Flyout()
		{
			Flyout(slide: true, activate: true);
		}

		public void Flyout(bool slide)
		{
			Flyout(slide, activate: true);
		}

		public virtual void Flyout(bool slide, bool activate)
		{
			if (Pinned)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_1"));
			}
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_2"));
			}
			base.Manager.ShowFlyoutPane(this, activate, slide);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ControlName != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ControlName", ControlName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFlyoutSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FlyoutSize", flyoutSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeOriginalControlBounds())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "OriginalControlBounds", originalControlBounds);
			}
			if (!pinned)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Pinned", pinned);
			}
			if (isMdiChild)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsMdiChild", isMdiChild);
			}
			if (mdiChildIcon != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MdiChildIcon", mdiChildIcon);
			}
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ControlPaneIndex", base.Manager.ControlPanes.IndexOf(this));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			Control = null;
			Pinned = true;
			FlyoutSize = FlyoutSizeDefault;
			IsMdiChild = false;
			MdiChildIcon = null;
		}

		public override void Pin()
		{
			bool isActive = IsActive;
			base.Pin();
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.PinPane(this);
			}
			pinned = true;
			DockableGroupPane parent = base.Parent;
			if (parent != null && !parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(base.Tab))
			{
				parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Add(base.Tab);
			}
			VerifyIsInViewState();
			if (!Closed)
			{
				Show();
			}
			if (parent != null)
			{
				parent.SyncPaneSize();
				DockControlBase containingControl = parent.ContainingControl;
				if (containingControl != null)
				{
					UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)containingControl).MainUIElement;
					if (mainUIElement != null)
					{
						mainUIElement.VerifyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
			if (isActive)
			{
				Activate();
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Pinned);
		}

		public override void Unpin()
		{
			base.Unpin();
			if (IsMdiChild)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("A pane whose 'IsMdiChild' is true cannot be unpinned.");
			}
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.UnpinPane(this);
			}
			pinned = false;
			VerifyIsInViewState();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Pinned);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			bool flag = !Pinned;
			bool flag2 = Key != null && Key.Length > 0;
			Control control = Control;
			bool flag3 = control != null;
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (flag)
			{
				text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockableControlPaneUnpinnedState");
			}
			if (flag3 && flag && flag2)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane ({control.Name}) - {Key} [{text}]";
			}
			if (flag3 && flag2)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane ({control.Name}) - {Key}";
			}
			if (flag3 && flag)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane ({control.Name}) [{text}]";
			}
			if (flag2 && flag)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane - {Key} [{text}]";
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane ({control.Name})";
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return $"DockableControlPane [{text}]";
			}
			return "DockableControlPane";
		}

		protected internal override void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != base.Manager)
			{
				base.InitControl(manager);
				if (base.DockAreaPane != null && base.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
				{
					Pinned = true;
					isMdiChild = false;
				}
				if (base.Manager != null)
				{
					HookContainedControl();
				}
				else
				{
					UnhookContainedControl();
				}
				if (IsActive)
				{
					base.Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanParent(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void DirtyUIElement()
		{
			base.DirtyUIElement();
			IUltraControlElement val = (IUltraControlElement)(object)Container;
			if (val != null && val.MainUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)val.MainUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateUIElement()
		{
			base.InvalidateUIElement();
			IUltraControlElement val = (IUltraControlElement)(object)Container;
			if (val != null && val.MainUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)val.MainUIElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void HideControls()
		{
			if (Container != null && Pinned)
			{
				if (base.Manager != null && base.Manager.HideDockableWindowsNotInView)
				{
					base.Manager.SetControlVisibility((Control)(object)Container, isVisible: false);
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)Container).Left = -10000;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override DockablePaneBase CreateNewPane()
		{
			return new DockableControlPane();
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(DockablePaneBase source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (categories != 0)
			{
				base.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
				if (source is DockableControlPane dockableControlPane && (categories & PropertyCategories.General) != 0)
				{
					controlName = dockableControlPane.ControlName;
					flyoutSize = dockableControlPane.FlyoutSize;
					originalControlBounds = dockableControlPane.originalControlBounds;
					pinned = dockableControlPane.Pinned;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializePinnedState(bool pinnedState)
		{
			pinned = pinnedState;
		}

		internal void InternalSetFlyoutSize(Size newFlyoutSize)
		{
			flyoutSize = newFlyoutSize;
		}

		internal override void OnIsInViewChanged()
		{
			FireIsInViewEventIfNecessary();
		}

		internal void FireIsInViewEventIfNecessary()
		{
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			if (lastIsInViewState != IsInView && ultraDockManager != null && !ultraDockManager.AreIsInViewEventsSuspended)
			{
				lastIsInViewState = IsInView;
				if (IsInView)
				{
					ultraDockManager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.PaneDisplayed, new PaneDisplayedEventArgs(this));
				}
				else
				{
					ultraDockManager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.PaneHidden, new PaneHiddenEventArgs(this));
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool CalculateIsInView()
		{
			if (base.Manager == null || !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)base.Manager).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsMdiChild)
			{
				return base.IsVisibleInMdiChild;
			}
			if (IsUnpinned)
			{
				return IsFlyoutPaneDisplayed;
			}
			return base.CalculateIsInView();
		}

		private void OnControlFocusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
		}

		private void OnContainerEnter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			enteredContainer = true;
			if (base.Manager != null && !base.Manager.PreventPaneSelectionOnFocus)
			{
				base.Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
		}

		private void OnContainerLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			enteredContainer = false;
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
		}

		private void HookContainer()
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				if (base.Manager == null || !base.Manager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					((Control)(object)container).Enter += ContainerEnterHandler;
					((Control)(object)container).Leave += ContainerLeaveHandler;
				}
				container.ControlPane = this;
			}
		}

		private void UnhookContainer()
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				if (base.Manager == null || !base.Manager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					((Control)(object)container).Enter -= ContainerEnterHandler;
					((Control)(object)container).Leave -= ContainerLeaveHandler;
				}
				UnhookContainedControl();
				if (container != null)
				{
					container.ControlPane = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyChanged(PropertyIds propId)
		{
			switch (propId)
			{
			case PropertyIds.Closed:
			{
				Control control = (Control)(object)Container;
				if (control != null && !IsMdiChild)
				{
					if (base.Manager != null)
					{
						base.Manager.SetControlVisibility(control, IsVisible);
					}
					else
					{
						control.Visible = IsVisible;
					}
				}
				if (Closed)
				{
					Pinned = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case PropertyIds.Pinned:
				if (!Pinned && Closed)
				{
					Closed = false;
				}
				break;
			}
			base.PropertyChanged(propId);
		}

		private void HookContainedControl()
		{
			Control control = Control;
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			if (control != null && ultraDockManager != null && Container != null)
			{
				Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(control);
				if (!(parent is DockControlBase))
				{
					previousContainer = parent;
				}
				ultraDockManager.ReparentControl(control, (Control)(object)Container);
				if (IsActive)
				{
					ultraDockManager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				}
				if (!ultraDockManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					control.GotFocus += ControlFocusChangeHandler;
					control.LostFocus += ControlFocusChangeHandler;
					control.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookContainedControl()
		{
			Control control = Control;
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraDockManager == null || !ultraDockManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				control.GotFocus -= ControlFocusChangeHandler;
				control.LostFocus -= ControlFocusChangeHandler;
				control.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
			}
			if (ultraDockManager != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing && (!ultraDockManager.IsDisposing || ultraDockManager.IsDesignMode))
			{
				if (previousContainer != null)
				{
					ultraDockManager.ReparentControl(control, previousContainer);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraDockManager.ReparentControl(control, ultraDockManager.HostControl);
				}
				if (!originalControlBounds.IsEmpty && !ultraDockManager.IsLoadingFromStream)
				{
					control.Bounds = originalControlBounds;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (control != null)
			{
				oldControl = new WeakReference(control);
				control = null;
			}
			if (base.Manager != null && !base.Manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				base.Manager.ControlPanes.Remove(this);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[Editor(typeof(DockablePanesCollectionEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PanesCollectionConverter))]
	public class DockableControlPanesCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IEnumerable, IDeserializationCallback
	{
		private class SerializedControlPaneComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = x as DockableControlPane;
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane2 = y as DockableControlPane;
				if (dockableControlPane == null && dockableControlPane2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (dockableControlPane == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (dockableControlPane2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return dockableControlPane.SerializedControlPaneIndex.CompareTo(dockableControlPane2.SerializedControlPaneIndex);
			}
		}

		[NonSerialized]
		private UltraDockManager manager;

		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public DockableControlPane this[int index] => GetItem(index) as DockableControlPane;

		public DockableControlPane this[string key] => GetItem(key) as DockableControlPane;

		public DockableControlPane this[Control control]
		{
			get
			{
				DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
						if (current.Control == control)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal UltraDockManager Manager => manager;

		internal int SerializablePaneCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (Manager == null || !Manager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return Count;
				}
				int num = 0;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (ShouldSerializePane(this[i]))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		internal event EventHandler BeforeClear;

		internal event EventHandler AfterClear;

		internal DockableControlPanesCollection()
		{
		}

		protected DockableControlPanesCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is DockableControlPane)
				{
					DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = (DockableControlPane)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockableControlPane), null);
					if (dockableControlPane != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(dockableControlPane);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(Control control)
		{
			DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.Control == control)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AddRange(DockableControlPane[] panes)
		{
			foreach (DockableControlPane pane in panes)
			{
				InternalInsertPane(pane, Count);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ControlPaneAdded);
		}

		public int Add(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			int result = InternalInsertPane(pane, Count);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ControlPaneAdded);
			return result;
		}

		public DockableControlPane Add()
		{
			return Add(null, null);
		}

		public DockableControlPane Add(string key)
		{
			return Add(key, null);
		}

		public DockableControlPane Add(Control control)
		{
			return Add(null, control);
		}

		public DockableControlPane Add(string key, Control control)
		{
			return Add(key, string.Empty, control);
		}

		public DockableControlPane Add(string key, string text, Control control)
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = new DockableControlPane(key, text, control);
			Add(dockableControlPane);
			return dockableControlPane;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			OnBeforeClear(EventArgs.Empty);
			if (manager != null)
			{
				{
					DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
							current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
							manager.ControlPaneRemoved(current);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ControlPaneClear);
			OnAfterClear(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void Insert(DockableControlPane pane, int index)
		{
			InternalInsertPane(pane, index);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ControlPaneInsert);
		}

		public void Remove(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				manager.ControlPaneRemoved(pane);
			}
			InternalRemove(pane);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ControlPaneRemoved);
		}

		public void Remove(Control control)
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = null;
			DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.Control == control)
					{
						dockableControlPane = current;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				Remove(dockableControlPane);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			Remove(this[key]);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		public DockableControlPaneEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DockableControlPaneEnumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (manager != null && manager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return new SerializableDockableControlPaneEnumerator(this);
			}
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager == this.manager)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.manager = manager;
			DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
					current.InitControl(manager);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SortSerializedControlPanes()
		{
			List.Sort(new SerializedControlPaneComparer());
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializePane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (Manager == null || !Manager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Manager != null && Manager.IsSerializing && Manager.IsInheritedPane(pane))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !pane.HasParent;
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new DockableControlPane[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source is DockableControlPane)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockableControlPane, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		private int InternalInsertPane(DockableControlPane pane, int index)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_4"));
			}
			if (Contains(pane))
			{
				return IndexOf(pane);
			}
			if (pane.Manager != null && manager != null && pane.Manager != manager)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_5"));
			}
			if (index > Count)
			{
				index = Count;
			}
			else if (index < 0)
			{
				index = 0;
			}
			InternalInsert(index, pane);
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				pane.InitControl(manager);
			}
			return index;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = this[i];
				if (!dockableControlPane.HasParent)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), dockableControlPane);
				}
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		internal void OnBeforeClear(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.BeforeClear != null)
			{
				this.BeforeClear(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void OnAfterClear(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.AfterClear != null)
			{
				this.AfterClear(this, e);
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			DockableControlPaneEnumerator dockableControlPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockableControlPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockableControlPane current = dockableControlPaneEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockableControlPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DockableControlPaneEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
	{
		public DockableControlPane Current => (DockableControlPane)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

		public DockableControlPaneEnumerator(DockableControlPanesCollection collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}
	}
	public class SerializableDockableControlPaneEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private int index = -1;

		private DockableControlPanesCollection collection;

		object IEnumerator.Current => collection[index];

		private DockableControlPane Current => ((IEnumerator)this).Current as DockableControlPane;

		public SerializableDockableControlPaneEnumerator(DockableControlPanesCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.collection = collection;
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			int num = index;
			while (num < collection.Count)
			{
				num++;
				if (num >= collection.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				DockableControlPane pane = collection[num];
				if (collection.ShouldSerializePane(pane))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < collection.Count)
			{
				index = num;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			index = -1;
		}
	}

				}
				return null;

		[Browsable(false)]

					DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = Panes[num];
					if (dockablePaneBase.IsVisible)
					{
						return dockablePaneBase;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

				if (panes == null)

					panes = new DockablePanesCollection(this);
					if (base.Manager != null)
					{
						panes.InitControl(base.Manager, this);
					}
					panes.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}

					if (base.Manager != null)
					{
						defaultPaneSettings.InitControl(base.Manager);
					}
					defaultPaneSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return defaultPaneSettings;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableGroupPane_P_GroupSettings")]

		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockableGroupPane_P_ChildPaneStyle")]

				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ChildPaneStyle), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ChildPaneStyle));
					}
					childPaneStyle = value;
					SyncPaneSize();
					PropertyChanged(PropertyIds.ChildPaneStyle);
				}
			}
		}
