		protected internal override Size ActualMinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				int visibleCount = Panes.GetVisibleCount();
				Size actualMinimumSize = base.ActualMinimumSize;
				if (visibleCount == 0)
				{
					return actualMinimumSize;
				}
				Size empty = Size.Empty;
				ChildPaneStyle childPaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (!pane.IsVisible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Size actualMinimumSize2 = pane.ActualMinimumSize;
					if (actualMinimumSize2.IsEmpty)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (childPaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
						empty.Height += actualMinimumSize2.Height;
						if (empty.Width < actualMinimumSize2.Width)
						{
							empty.Width = actualMinimumSize2.Width;
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
						empty.Width += actualMinimumSize2.Width;
						if (empty.Height < actualMinimumSize2.Height)
						{
							empty.Height = actualMinimumSize2.Height;
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
					case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
						if (empty.Width < actualMinimumSize2.Width)
						{
							empty.Width = actualMinimumSize2.Width;
						}
						if (empty.Height < actualMinimumSize2.Height)
						{
							empty.Height = actualMinimumSize2.Height;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (empty.IsEmpty)
				{
					return actualMinimumSize;
				}
				if (actualMinimumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return empty;
				}
				if (actualMinimumSize.Width < empty.Width)
				{
					actualMinimumSize.Width = empty.Width;
				}
				if (actualMinimumSize.Height < empty.Height)
				{
					actualMinimumSize.Height = empty.Height;
				}
				return actualMinimumSize;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Size ActualMaximumSize
		{
			get
			{
				int visibleCount = Panes.GetVisibleCount();
				Size actualMaximumSize = base.ActualMaximumSize;
				if (visibleCount == 0)
				{
					return actualMaximumSize;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				Size empty = Size.Empty;
				ChildPaneStyle childPaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (!pane.IsVisible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Size actualMaximumSize2 = pane.ActualMaximumSize;
					switch (childPaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
						if (actualMaximumSize2.IsEmpty)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						empty.Height += actualMaximumSize2.Height;
						if (empty.Width > actualMaximumSize2.Width || empty.Width == 0)
						{
							empty.Width = actualMaximumSize2.Width;
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
						if (actualMaximumSize2.IsEmpty)
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
						empty.Width += actualMaximumSize2.Width;
						if (empty.Height > actualMaximumSize2.Height || empty.Height == 0)
						{
							empty.Height = actualMaximumSize2.Height;
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
					case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
						if (empty.Width > actualMaximumSize2.Width || empty.Width == 0)
						{
							empty.Width = actualMaximumSize2.Width;
						}
						if (empty.Height > actualMaximumSize2.Height || empty.Height == 0)
						{
							empty.Height = actualMaximumSize2.Height;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				Size actualMinimumSize = ActualMinimumSize;
				if (!actualMaximumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (actualMaximumSize.Width < actualMinimumSize.Width)
					{
						actualMaximumSize.Width = actualMinimumSize.Width;
					}
					if (actualMaximumSize.Height < actualMinimumSize.Height)
					{
						actualMaximumSize.Height = actualMinimumSize.Width;
					}
				}
				if (empty.Width == 0)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (empty.Height == 0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!empty.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (empty.Width < actualMinimumSize.Width)
					{
						empty.Width = actualMinimumSize.Width;
					}
					if (empty.Height < actualMinimumSize.Height)
					{
						empty.Height = actualMinimumSize.Width;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					empty.Height = 0;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					empty.Width = 0;
				}
				if (actualMaximumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return empty;
				}
				if (empty.IsEmpty)
				{
					return actualMaximumSize;
				}
				if (actualMaximumSize.Width > empty.Width && !flag2)
				{
					actualMaximumSize.Width = empty.Width;
				}
				if (actualMaximumSize.Height > empty.Height && !flag)
				{
					actualMaximumSize.Height = empty.Height;
				}
				return actualMaximumSize;
			}
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase ActivePane
		{
			get
			{
				if (panes != null)
				{
					foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
					{
						if (pane.IsActive && (!(pane is DockableControlPane) || ((DockableControlPane)pane).Pinned || !((DockableControlPane)pane).IsMdiChild))
						{
							return pane;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DefaultValue(0)]
		public int SelectedTabIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedTabIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == selectedTabIndex)
				{
					return;
				}
				selectedTabIndex = value;
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = SelectedTabPane;
				((TabManager)TabInfo).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)selectedTabPane;
				((TabManager)TabInfo).Dirty(true, false, true);
				ChildPaneStyle childPaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle;
				if (childPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup && childPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
				{
					return;
				}
				SyncPaneSize();
				UIElement element = (UIElement)(object)base.Element;
				if (element == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				element.DirtyChildElements();
				if (!base.Manager.IsResumingLayout && !base.Manager.IsLayoutSuspended && element.Control is DockControlBase dockControlBase)
				{
					ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = ((IUltraControlElement)dockControlBase).MainUIElement;
					if (mainUIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)mainUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase SelectedTabPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (panes == null || panes.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (selectedTabIndex < 0)
				{
					return FirstVisiblePane;
				}
				if (selectedTabIndex >= panes.Count)
				{
					selectedTabIndex = panes.Count - 1;
				}
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = Panes[selectedTabIndex];
				if (!dockablePaneBase.IsVisible || dockablePaneBase.IsBeingRepositioned || (dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane && ((DockableControlPane)dockablePaneBase).IsUnpinning))
				{
					DockablePaneBase nextVisiblePane = GetNextVisiblePane(dockablePaneBase);
					dockablePaneBase = ((nextVisiblePane == null) ? GetPreviousVisiblePane(dockablePaneBase) : nextVisiblePane);
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase != null)
				{
					selectedTabIndex = Panes.IndexOf(dockablePaneBase);
					try
					{
						if (dockablePaneBase.Tab != ((TabManager)TabInfo).SelectedTabItem)
						{
							((TabManager)TabInfo).SelectedTabItem = dockablePaneBase.Tab;
							((TabManager)TabInfo).Dirty(true, false, true);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return dockablePaneBase;
			}
			set
			{
				DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = SelectedTabPane;
				if (selectedTabPane != null && selectedTabPane != value)
				{
					ContainerControl containingControl = (ContainerControl)(object)selectedTabPane.ContainingControl;
					if (containingControl.ContainsFocus && !containingControl.ValidateChildren(ValidationConstraints.Selectable | ValidationConstraints.Visible))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				SelectedTabIndex = Panes.IndexOf(value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override DockControlBase ContainingControl => base.Parent?.ContainingControl;

		internal DockablePaneBase MaximizedChild
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (pane.IsVisible)
					{
						num2++;
						if (pane.Minimized)
						{
							num++;
						}
						else if (pane.Maximized)
						{
							return pane;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == num2)
				{
					foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in Panes)
					{
						if (pane2.Maximized)
						{
							return pane2;
						}
					}
					return FirstVisiblePane;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Margins ContentsMargins
		{
			get
			{
				Margins contentsMargins = base.ContentsMargins;
				if (ChildPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup && Panes.GetVisibleCount() > 1)
				{
					GroupSettingsResolved groupSettingsResolved = GroupSettingsResolved;
					Size tabAreaSize = ((TabManager)TabInfo).TabAreaSize;
					switch (groupSettingsResolved.TabLocation)
					{
					case Location.Left:
						contentsMargins.Left += tabAreaSize.Width;
						break;
					case Location.Right:
						contentsMargins.Right += tabAreaSize.Width;
						break;
					case Location.Top:
						contentsMargins.Top += tabAreaSize.Height;
						break;
					case Location.Bottom:
						contentsMargins.Bottom += tabAreaSize.Height;
						break;
					}
				}
				return contentsMargins;
			}
		}

		public DockableGroupPane(Guid internalId, Guid floatingParentId, int floatingIndex, Guid dockedParentId, int dockedIndex)
			: base(internalId, floatingParentId, floatingIndex, dockedParentId, dockedIndex)

		{
		}

		public DockableGroupPane(string key)
			: base(key)
		{
		}

		public DockableGroupPane(string key, string text)
			: base(key, text)
		{
		}

		protected DockableGroupPane(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Panes":
					panes = (DockablePanesCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockablePanesCollection), panes);
					break;
				case "DefaultPaneSettings":
					defaultPaneSettings = (PaneSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(PaneSettings), defaultPaneSettings);
					break;
				case "GroupSettings":
					groupSettings = (GroupSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(GroupSettings), groupSettings);
					break;
				case "ChildPaneStyle":
					childPaneStyle = (ChildPaneStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ChildPaneStyle), childPaneStyle);
					break;
				case "SelectedTabIndex":
					selectedTabIndex = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), selectedTabIndex);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasChildPanes()
		{
			if (panes != null)
			{
				return panes.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePanes()
		{
			if (panes != null)
			{
				return panes.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetPanes()
		{
			if (panes != null)
			{
				panes.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeDefaultPaneSettings()
		{
			if (HasDefaultPaneSettings)
			{
				return defaultPaneSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetDefaultPaneSettings()
		{
			if (HasDefaultPaneSettings)
			{
				defaultPaneSettings.Reset();
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeGroupSettings()
		{
			if (HasGroupSettings)
			{
				return groupSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetGroupSettings()
		{
			if (HasGroupSettings)
			{
				groupSettings.Reset();
			}
		}

		internal bool HasChildControlPane(bool recursive)
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableControlPane)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (recursive && pane is DockableGroupPane && ((DockableGroupPane)pane).HasChildControlPane(recursive))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (ShouldSerializePanes())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Panes", panes);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDefaultPaneSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DefaultPaneSettings", defaultPaneSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupSettings", groupSettings);
			}
			if (ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ChildPaneStyle", childPaneStyle);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SelectedTabIndex", SelectedTabIndex);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetPanes();
			ResetDefaultPaneSettings();
			ResetGroupSettings();
			ChildPaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit;
			SelectedTabIndex = -1;
		}

		public override void Close(bool closeChildPanes)
		{
			if (closeChildPanes)
			{
				UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
				try
				{
					ultraDockManager?.BeginGroupClose(this);
					foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
					{
						if (!pane.IsUnpinned && !pane.IsVisibleInMdiChild)
						{
							pane.Close(closeChildPanes);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					ultraDockManager?.EndGroupClose(this);
				}
			}
			base.Close(closeChildPanes);
		}

		public DockablePaneBase GetNextVisiblePane(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return FirstVisiblePane;
			}
			int num = Panes.IndexOf(pane);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = num + 1; i < Panes.Count; i++)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = Panes[i];
				if (dockablePaneBase.IsVisible)
				{
					return dockablePaneBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DockablePaneBase GetPreviousVisiblePane(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return LastVisiblePane;
			}
			int num = Panes.IndexOf(pane);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = Panes[num2];
				if (dockablePaneBase.IsVisible)
				{
					return dockablePaneBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Pin()
		{
			base.Pin();
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			ultraDockManager?.BeginGroupPin(this);
			try
			{
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (!pane.Closed && (!(pane is DockableControlPane) || !((DockableControlPane)pane).IsMdiChild))
					{
						pane.Pin();
					}
				}
				DockableGroupPane parent = base.Parent;
				if (parent != null && !parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(base.Tab))
				{
					parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Add(base.Tab);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraDockManager?.EndGroupPin(this);
			}
		}

		public override void Unpin()
		{
			base.Unpin();
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			ultraDockManager?.BeginGroupUnpin(this);
			try
			{
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					if (!pane.Closed && (!(pane is DockableControlPane) || !((DockableControlPane)pane).IsMdiChild))
					{
						pane.Unpin();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraDockManager?.EndGroupUnpin(this);
			}
		}

		public virtual void ShowChildPanes()
		{
			ShowChildPanes(pinChildPanes: false);
		}

		public virtual void ShowChildPanes(bool pinChildPanes)
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableControlPane)
				{
					if (pinChildPanes)
					{
						((DockableControlPane)pane).Pinned = true;
					}
					pane.Closed = false;
				}
				else if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					((DockableGroupPane)pane).ShowChildPanes(pinChildPanes);
				}
			}
			Closed = false;
			SyncPaneSize();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Key != null && Key.Length > 0)
			{
				return $"DockableGroupPane ({ChildPaneStyle.ToString()}) - {Key}";
			}
			return $"DockableGroupPane - {ChildPaneStyle.ToString()}";
		}

		public override bool Activate()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ChildPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup || ChildPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
			{
				DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = SelectedTabPane;
				if (selectedTabPane != null && selectedTabPane.Activate())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane.IsVisible && pane.Activate())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(DockablePaneBase pane, bool recursive)
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in Panes)
			{
				if (pane == pane2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (recursive && pane2 is DockableGroupPane && ((DockableGroupPane)pane2).Contains(pane, recursive))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != base.Manager)
			{
				base.InitControl(manager);
				if (panes != null)
				{
					panes.InitControl(manager, this);
				}
				if (defaultPaneSettings != null)
				{
					defaultPaneSettings.InitControl(manager);
				}
				if (groupSettings != null)
				{
					groupSettings.InitControl(manager);
				}
				SyncPaneSize();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void HideControls()
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane.IsVisible)
				{
					pane.HideControls();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanParent(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == this || pane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.Parent.CanParent(pane);
		}

		internal bool CanMaximizePane(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (!Panes.Contains(pane))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Panes.GetVisibleCount() < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChildPaneStyle childPaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle;
			if (childPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup || childPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsPaneMinimized(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_6"));
			}
			if (!Panes.Contains(pane))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_7"));
			}
			DockablePaneBase maximizedChild = MaximizedChild;
			if (pane == maximizedChild)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (maximizedChild != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return pane.Minimized;
		}

		internal int GetVisibleIndexOf(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in Panes)
			{
				if (pane2.IsVisibleInDockArea || pane2 == pane)
				{
					if (pane2 == pane)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected internal override DockablePaneBase CreateNewPane()
		{
			return new DockableGroupPane();
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(DockablePaneBase source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (categories == (PropertyCategories)0)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
			if (!(source is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.GroupSettings) != 0)
			{
				if (dockableGroupPane.HasGroupSettings && dockableGroupPane.ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
				{
					GroupSettings.InitializeFrom(dockableGroupPane.GroupSettings);
				}
				else if (ShouldSerializeGroupSettings())
				{
					GroupSettings.Reset();
				}
			}
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.DefaultPaneSettings) != 0)
			{
				if (dockableGroupPane.HasDefaultPaneSettings && dockableGroupPane.ShouldSerializeDefaultPaneSettings())
				{
					DefaultPaneSettings.InitializeFrom(dockableGroupPane.DefaultPaneSettings);
				}
				else if (ShouldSerializeDefaultPaneSettings())
				{
					DefaultPaneSettings.Reset();
				}
			}
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.General) != 0)
			{
				childPaneStyle = dockableGroupPane.childPaneStyle;
				selectedTabIndex = dockableGroupPane.selectedTabIndex;
			}
		}

		internal int GetVisibleControlPaneCount()
		{
			return GetVisibleControlPaneCount(this);
		}

		private int GetVisibleControlPaneCount(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableControlPane && pane.IsVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (pane is DockableGroupPane && pane.IsVisible)
				{
					num += GetVisibleControlPaneCount(pane as DockableGroupPane);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void DirtyTabInfo(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType changeType, bool recursive)
		{
			if (tabInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ChildPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup)
			{
				TabInfo.DirtyTabInfo(changeType);
			}
			if (!recursive)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					((DockableGroupPane)pane).DirtyTabInfo(changeType, recursive: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnIsInViewChanged()
		{
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = base.Manager;
			try
			{
				ultraDockManager.SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				for (int i = 0; i < Panes.Count; i++)
				{
					DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = Panes[i];
					if (dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane dockableControlPane && (dockableControlPane.IsMdiChild || dockableControlPane.IsUnpinned))
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (ChildPaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
					case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
						if (SelectedTabPane == dockablePaneBase)
						{
							dockablePaneBase.SetIsInView(base.IsInViewInternal);
						}
						else
						{
							dockablePaneBase.SetIsInView(isInView: false);
						}
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
					case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
						dockablePaneBase.SetIsInView(base.IsInViewInternal);
						break;
					default:
						dockablePaneBase.SetIsInView(base.IsInViewInternal);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraDockManager.ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: false);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyTabInfoCollection()
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					((DockableGroupPane)pane).VerifyTabInfoCollection();
				}
				if (!pane.IsUnpinned && !TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(pane.Tab))
				{
					TabInfo.Tabs.Add(pane.Tab);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == panes)
			{
				PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
				if (propChange == propChangeInfo)
				{
					SyncPaneSize();
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds && propChangeInfo.Source is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase && Panes.Contains(dockablePaneBase))
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.Maximized:
						if (dockablePaneBase.Maximized)
						{
							foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
							{
								if (pane.IsVisible && pane != dockablePaneBase)
								{
									pane.Maximized = false;
								}
							}
						}
						SyncPaneSize();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.Closed:
					case PropertyIds.IsSelectedTab:
					case PropertyIds.Minimized:
					case PropertyIds.MinimumSize:
					case PropertyIds.MaximumSize:
					case PropertyIds.Size:
						SyncPaneSize();
						break;
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Panes, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == defaultPaneSettings)
			{
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
				DirtyTabInfo(Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings, propChange), recursive: false);
				DirtyUIElement();
				ProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: true, base.Size);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == groupSettings)
			{
				base.PropertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
				DirtyTabInfo(Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings, propChange), recursive: false);
				DirtyUIElement();
				ProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: true, base.Size);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupSettings, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		protected override void PropertyChanged(PropertyIds propId)
		{
			if (propId == PropertyIds.ChildPaneStyle)
			{
				SyncPaneSize();
				DirtyUIElement();
			}
			base.PropertyChanged(propId);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ItemAdded(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && base.DockAreaPane != null)
			{
				if (base.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
				{
					pane.SetParentFloating(this);
				}
				else
				{
					pane.SetParentDocked(this);
				}
				pane.InitControl(base.Manager);
			}
			if (!pane.IsUnpinned && !TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(pane.Tab))
			{
				TabInfo.Tabs.Add(pane.Tab);
			}
			SynchronizeChildPaneInfo(ensureActiveTabIsSelected: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ItemRemoved(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			TabInfo.Tabs.Remove(pane.Tab);
			pane.ResetTabItemTag();
			SynchronizeChildPaneInfo();
		}

		internal void ItemRemoving(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = pane as DockableControlPane;
			if (base.Manager != null && dockableControlPane != null && !dockableControlPane.Pinned)
			{
				base.Manager.GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(dockableControlPane)?.RemoveUnpinnedPane(dockableControlPane);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureActiveTabIsSelected()
		{
			DockablePaneBase activePane = ActivePane;
			if (activePane != null && SelectedTabPane != activePane)
			{
				SelectedTabIndex = activePane.Index;
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeChildPaneInfo()
		{
			SynchronizeChildPaneInfo(ensureActiveTabIsSelected: false);
		}

		private void SynchronizeChildPaneInfo(bool ensureActiveTabIsSelected)
		{
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TabInfo.Tabs.SortTabs(TabItemComparer);
			if (ensureActiveTabIsSelected)
			{
				EnsureActiveTabIsSelected();
			}
			if ((object)((TabManager)TabInfo).SelectedTabItem != SelectedTabPane)
			{
				((TabManager)TabInfo).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)SelectedTabPane;
				((TabManager)TabInfo).Dirty(true, false, true);
			}
			ITabItem firstDisplayedTabItem = ((TabManager)TabInfo).FirstDisplayedTabItem;
			if (firstDisplayedTabItem == null || !firstDisplayedTabItem.Visible)
			{
				ITabItem firstVisibleTabItem = ((TabManager)TabInfo).FirstVisibleTabItem;
				if (firstVisibleTabItem != null)
				{
					((TabManager)TabInfo).FirstDisplayedTabItem = firstVisibleTabItem;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateParent(DockedState stateChanging)
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (stateChanging == DockedState.Docked)
				{
					pane.SetParentDocked(this);
				}
				else
				{
					pane.SetParentFloating(this);
				}
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					((DockableGroupPane)pane).UpdateParent(stateChanging);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAddedToCollection(KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase primaryCollection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(primaryCollection);
			if (base.DockAreaPane != null)
			{
				UpdateParent(base.DockedState);
			}
		}

		{
			base.DeserializationCallback(parentPane);
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				pane.DeserializationCallback(this);
			}
		}

		{

			int num2 = (flag ? maximumSizeResolved.Width : maximumSizeResolved.Height);
			int num3 = (flag ? minimumSizeResolved2.Width : minimumSizeResolved2.Height);
			int num4 = (flag ? maximumSizeResolved2.Width : maximumSizeResolved2.Height);
			int num5 = (flag ? size.Width : size.Height);

			if ((num >= num2 && num2 != 0) || (num3 >= num4 && num4 != 0))
			{
				afterExtent = (beforeExtent = 0);
				return;
			}
			if (num2 != 0 && num5 >= num2)
			{
				afterExtent = 0;
			}
			else if (num6 <= num3)
			{
				afterExtent = 0;
			}

			}
			else

		private void SetSlidingGroupItemsSize(Size availableSize)
		{
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = SelectedTabPane;
			if (dockablePaneBase == null)
			{
				dockablePaneBase = FirstVisiblePane;
				if (dockablePaneBase == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			bool hasVerticalSlidingGroupButton = dockablePaneBase.HasVerticalSlidingGroupButton;
			Size newSize = availableSize;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (pane.IsVisible && pane != dockablePaneBase)
				{
					Size slidingGroupSize = pane.Metrics.SlidingGroupSize;
					if (hasVerticalSlidingGroupButton)
					{
						slidingGroupSize.Height = newSize.Height;
					}
					else
					{
						slidingGroupSize.Width = newSize.Width;
					}
					pane.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: false, slidingGroupSize, slidingGroupSize);
					if (hasVerticalSlidingGroupButton)
					{
						newSize.Width -= slidingGroupSize.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						newSize.Height -= slidingGroupSize.Height;
					}
				}
			}
			newSize.Width = Math.Max(newSize.Width, 0);
			newSize.Height = Math.Max(newSize.Height, 0);
			dockablePaneBase.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: false, newSize, newSize);
		}

		protected internal override void InternalProcessPaneSize(bool enforceMinMax, Size newSize, Size displaySize)
		{
			if (base.IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
			{
				if (!pane.IsUnpinned && (!(pane is DockableControlPane) || !((DockableControlPane)pane).IsUnpinning) && !TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(pane.Tab))
				{
					TabInfo.Tabs.Add(pane.Tab);
				}
			}
			SynchronizeChildPaneInfo();
			TabInfo.AvailableSize = newSize;
			base.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax, newSize, displaySize);
		}

		protected override void AdjustChildPaneSize()
		{
			Size size = base.ContentsAreaSize;
			switch (ChildPaneStyle)
			{
			case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
				SetSlidingGroupItemsSize(size);
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
			{
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in Panes)
				{
					pane.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: false, size, size);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
			case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
				AdjustSplitGroupPaneSize(size);
				break;
			}
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			ITabItem val = (ITabItem)((x is ITabItem) ? x : null);
			ITabItem val2 = (ITabItem)((y is ITabItem) ? y : null);
			if (val == null && val == val2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = val as DockablePaneBase;
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase2 = val2 as DockablePaneBase;
			if (dockablePaneBase == null && dockablePaneBase == dockablePaneBase2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase.Manager == null && dockablePaneBase.Manager == dockablePaneBase2.Manager)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase == null || dockablePaneBase.Manager == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase2 == null || dockablePaneBase2.Manager == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return dockablePaneBase.Index.CompareTo(dockablePaneBase2.Index);
		}

		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.Repaint)]
		public virtual bool Closed
		{
			get

				return closed;
			}

				{
					ultraDockManager?.SuspendIsInViewEvents();

					}
					closed = value;
					if (!value)
					{
						ultraDockManager?.UpdateControlPaneVisibility(this);
					}
					ultraDockManager?.OnPaneClosed(this);
					if (closed)

				}

					ultraDockManager?.ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: false);
				}
				PropertyChanged(PropertyIds.Closed);
			}
		}

					if (HasVerticalSlidingGroupButton)
					{
						if (actualMinimumSize.Width < slidingGroupSize.Width)
						{
							actualMinimumSize.Width = slidingGroupSize.Width;
						}
					}
					else if (actualMinimumSize.Height < slidingGroupSize.Height)
					{
						actualMinimumSize.Height = slidingGroupSize.Height;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Size captionSize = Metrics.CaptionSize;
					if (HasVerticalCaption)
					{
						if (actualMinimumSize.Width < captionSize.Width)
						{
							actualMinimumSize.Width = captionSize.Width;
						}
					}
					else if (actualMinimumSize.Height < captionSize.Height)
					{
						actualMinimumSize.Height = captionSize.Height;
					}
				}
				return actualMinimumSize;
			}
		}

		public virtual Size MaximumSizeResolved => ActualMaximumSize;

		internal Location CaptionLocation
		{
			get
			{
				GroupSettingsResolved parentGroupSettingsResolved = ParentGroupSettingsResolved;
				if (parentGroupSettingsResolved == null)
				{
					return Location.Default;
				}
				if (Parent == null)
				{
					return parentGroupSettingsResolved.CaptionLocation;
				}
				if (IsUnpinned)
				{
					return Location.Top;
				}
				switch (PaneStyle)
				{
				case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
					if (MinimizedResolved)
					{
						return Location.Left;
					}
					break;
				case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
					if (MinimizedResolved)
					{
						return Location.Top;
					}
					break;
				}
				return parentGroupSettingsResolved.CaptionLocation;
			}
		}

		internal StyleUtils.CachedProperty PropCaptionBorder
		{
			get
			{
				bool hasVerticalCaption = HasVerticalCaption;
				if (manager != null && manager.IsFloatingDockAreaCaption(this))
				{
					if (!hasVerticalCaption)
					{
						return StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderFloatingCaptionHorz;
					}
					return StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderFloatingCaptionVert;
				}
				if (!hasVerticalCaption)
				{
					return StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderCaptionHorz;
				}
				return StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderCaptionVert;
			}

		internal bool IsTabVertical
		{
			get
			{
				bool result = false;
				if (IsUnpinned)
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
					if (dockAreaPane != null)
					{
						DockedLocation dockedLocation = dockAreaPane.DockedLocation;
						result = dockedLocation == DockedLocation.DockedLeft || dockedLocation == DockedLocation.DockedRight;
					}
				}
				else if (this is DockableControlPane && ((DockableControlPane)this).IsMdiChild)
				{
					result = false;
				}
				else
				{
					GroupSettingsResolved parentGroupSettingsResolved = ParentGroupSettingsResolved;
					if (parentGroupSettingsResolved != null)
					{
						Location tabLocation = ParentGroupSettingsResolved.TabLocation;
						result = tabLocation == Location.Left || tabLocation == Location.Right;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal StylePropertyCache PropertyCache => propertyCache;

		internal DockAreaPane TopLevelParent
		{
			get
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = null;
				while (true)
				{
					dockableGroupPane = dockAreaPane.Parent;
					if (dockableGroupPane == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					dockAreaPane = dockableGroupPane.DockAreaPane;
				}
				return dockAreaPane;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract DockControlBase ContainingControl { get; }

		internal bool DisplaysButtons
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsUnpinned)
				{
					if (!ShowButton(PaneButton.Close))
					{
						return ShowButton(PaneButton.Pin);
					}
					return true;
				}
				switch (DockedState)
				{
				case DockedState.Docked:
					if (!ShowButton(PaneButton.Close) && !ShowButton(PaneButton.Maximize) && !ShowButton(PaneButton.Minimize))
					{
						return ShowButton(PaneButton.Pin);
					}
					return true;
				case DockedState.Floating:
					if (this is DockAreaPane)
					{
						return ShowButton(PaneButton.Close);
					}
					if (!ShowButton(PaneButton.Close) && !ShowButton(PaneButton.Maximize))
					{
						return ShowButton(PaneButton.Minimize);
					}
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

				return false;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				Size defaultPaneSize = size;
				if (defaultPaneSize.Equals(DefaultSize))
				{
					defaultPaneSize = DefaultPaneSize;
				}
				return defaultPaneSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value.Width < -1)
				{
					value.Width = 0;
				}
				if (value.Height < -1)
				{
					value.Height = 0;
				}
				bool flag = ShouldUpdateSizeField;
				ShouldUpdateSizeField = true;
				ProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: true, value);
				ShouldUpdateSizeField = flag;
				PropertyChanged(PropertyIds.Size);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual Margins ContentsMargins
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0104: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Margins result = default(Margins);
				PaneSettingsResolved paneSettingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				if ((int)paneSettingsResolved.ShowCaption == 1)
				{
					if (PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
					{
						Size slidingGroupSize = Metrics.SlidingGroupSize;
						if (HasVerticalSlidingGroupButton)
						{
							result.Left += slidingGroupSize.Width;
						}
						else
						{
							result.Top += slidingGroupSize.Height;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Size captionSize = Metrics.CaptionSize;
						switch (CaptionLocation)
						{
						case Location.Left:
							result.Left += captionSize.Width;
							break;
						case Location.Right:
							result.Right += captionSize.Width;
							break;
						case Location.Top:
							result.Top += captionSize.Height;
							break;
						case Location.Bottom:
							result.Bottom += captionSize.Height;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				UIElementBorderWidths borders = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(paneSettingsResolved.BorderStylePane);
				result.Inflate(borders, Border3DSide.All);
				result.Left += paneSettingsResolved.PaddingLeft;
				result.Right += paneSettingsResolved.PaddingRight;
				result.Top += paneSettingsResolved.PaddingTop;
				result.Bottom += paneSettingsResolved.PaddingBottom;
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected DockablePaneBase(Guid internalId, Guid floatingParentId, int floatingIndex, Guid dockedParentId, int dockedIndex)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (internalId == Guid.Empty)
			{
				this.internalId = Guid.NewGuid();
			}
			else
			{
				this.internalId = internalId;
			}
			serializedFloatingParentId = floatingParentId;
			serializedDockedParentId = dockedParentId;
			floatingParentIndex = floatingIndex;
			dockedParentIndex = dockedIndex;
		}

		protected DockablePaneBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Closed":
					closed = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), closed);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (PaneSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(PaneSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Maximized":
					maximized = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), maximized);
					break;
				case "Minimized":
					minimized = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), minimized);
					break;
				case "MaximumSize":
					maximumSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), maximumSize);
					break;
				case "MinimumSize":
					minimumSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), minimumSize);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), text);
					break;
				case "TextTab":
					textTab = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), textTab);
					break;
				case "ToolTipCaption":
					toolTipCaption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipCaption);
					break;
				case "ToolTipTab":
					toolTipTab = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipTab);
					break;
				case "Id":
					internalId = (Guid)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Guid), internalId);
					break;
				case "FloatingParentId":
					serializedFloatingParentId = (Guid)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Guid), serializedFloatingParentId);
					break;
				case "DockedParentId":
					serializedDockedParentId = (Guid)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Guid), serializedDockedParentId);
					break;
				case "Size":
					size = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), size);
					break;
				case "FloatingSize":
					floatingSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), floatingSize);
					break;
				case "DockedSize":
					dockedSize = (Size)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Size), dockedSize);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetIsInView(bool isInView)
		{
			if (this.isInView != isInView)
			{
				this.isInView = isInView;
				OnIsInViewChanged();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnIsInViewChanged()
		{
		}

		internal virtual bool CalculateIsInView()
		{
			if (closed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MinimizedResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Manager == null || !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)Manager).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockableGroupPane parent = Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (parent.MaximizedChild != null && parent.MaximizedChild != this)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (parent.ChildPaneStyle)
				{
				case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
				case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
					return parent.IsInViewInternal;
				case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
				case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
					if (parent.IsInViewInternal)
					{
						return this == parent.SelectedTabPane;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return IsVisible;
		}

		internal void VerifyIsInViewState()
		{
			VerifyIsInViewState(recursive: false);
		}

		internal void VerifyIsInViewState(bool recursive)
		{
			SetIsInView(CalculateIsInView());
			if (recursive && this is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = this as DockableGroupPane;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = dockableGroupPane.Panes.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					dockableGroupPane.Panes[i].VerifyIsInViewState(recursive);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			initialized = true;
		}

			Closed = false;

			ToolTipTab = null;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		public virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_12"));
			}
			if (closed)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Closed", closed);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (maximized)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Maximized", maximized);
			}
			if (minimized)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Minimized", minimized);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaximumSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximumSize", maximumSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinimumSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumSize", minimumSize);
			}
			if (!string.Empty.Equals(Text))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", Text);
			}
			if (!string.Empty.Equals(TextTab))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TextTab", TextTab);
			}
			if (!string.Empty.Equals(ToolTipCaption))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipCaption", ToolTipCaption);
			}
			if (!string.Empty.Equals(ToolTipTab))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipTab", toolTipTab);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Size", size);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Id", internalId);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedParentId", ParentDockedId);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FloatingParentId", ParentFloatingId);
			if (!FloatingSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FloatingSize", FloatingSize);
			}
			if (!DockedSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedSize", DockedSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
		}

		public void ToggleDockState()
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				CancelablePaneEventArgs e = new CancelablePaneEventArgs(this);
				Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforeToggleDockState, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
			ultraDockManager?.SuspendLayout();
			switch (DockedState)
			{
			case DockedState.Floating:
				if (this is DockableControlPane && !DockedSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					size = DockedSize;
				}
				Dock(maintainPreviousState: true);
				break;
			case DockedState.Docked:
				if (this is DockableControlPane && !FloatingSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					size = FloatingSize;
				}
				Float(maintainPreviousState: true);
				break;
			}
			ultraDockManager?.ResumeLayout();
			Activate();
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				Parent.VerifyIsInViewState(recursive: true);
			}
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				PaneEventArgs e2 = new PaneEventArgs(this);
				Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.AfterToggleDockState, e2);
			}
		}

		public DockAreaPane Dock(DockedSide side)
		{
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
			}
			return Manager.DockPane(this, toggleState: false, side, DisplaySize);
		}

		public void Dock(bool maintainPreviousState)
		{
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
			}
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
			DockableControlPane activePane = ultraDockManager.ActivePane;
			DockedSide side = DockedSide.Right;
			if (DockAreaPane != null && DockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
			{
				side = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockedSide(DockAreaPane.DockedLocation);
			}
			Manager.DockPane(this, maintainPreviousState, side, DisplaySize);
			if (activePane != null && ultraDockManager.ControlPanes.Contains(activePane))
			{
				activePane.Activate();
			}
		}

		public void Float()
		{
			Float(maintainPreviousState: false);
		}

		public void Float(bool maintainPreviousState)
		{
			Float(maintainPreviousState, DockAreaPane.FloatingLocationDefault);
		}

		public void Float(bool maintainPreviousState, Point point)
		{
			Size size = DisplaySize;
			if (this is DockableGroupPane && !FloatingSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				size = FloatingSize;
			}
			Size minimumSizeResolved = MinimumSizeResolved;
			if (size.Height < minimumSizeResolved.Height)
			{
				size.Height = minimumSizeResolved.Height;
			}
			if (size.Width < minimumSizeResolved.Width)
			{
				size.Width = minimumSizeResolved.Width;
			}
			Float(maintainPreviousState, new Rectangle(point, size));
		}

		public void Float(bool maintainPreviousState, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_14"));
			}
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
			DockableControlPane activePane = ultraDockManager.ActivePane;
			ultraDockManager.FloatPane(this, maintainPreviousState, rect);
			if (activePane != null && ultraDockManager.ControlPanes.Contains(activePane))
			{
				activePane.Activate();
			}
		}

				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_15"));
			}
		}

			}
		}

		[Obsolete("When option explicit is off, using this method causes an overload resolution failure in VB.Net. This method has been replaced by the RepositionToGroup method. This method will be removed in a future version of the control. The new method is 'RepositionToGroup( DockableGroupPane )'.", false)]

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		public void RepositionToGroup(DockableGroupPane newGroup)
		{
			if (newGroup == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_58"));
			}
			RepositionToGroup(newGroup, newGroup.Panes.Count);
		}

		public void RepositionToGroup(DockableGroupPane newGroup, int newIndex)
		{
			if (this is DockAreaPane)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_59"));
			}
			if (newGroup == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_58"));
			}
			if (!CanParentTo(newGroup))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_60"));
			}
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
			if (ultraDockManager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
			}
			ultraDockManager.SuspendLayout();
			try
			{
				ultraDockManager.MovePanes(this, newGroup, newIndex, flatten: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraDockManager.ResumeLayout();
			}
		}

		public void RepositionToPane(DockablePaneBase relativePane, PanePosition relationship)
		{
			if (relativePane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_61"));
			}
			if (relationship == PanePosition.Child)
			{
				if (!(relativePane is DockableGroupPane))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_62"));
				}
				RepositionToGroup((DockableGroupPane)relativePane);
			}
			else if (relativePane is DockAreaPane || this is DockAreaPane)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_63"));
			}
			DockableGroupPane parent = relativePane.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_64"));
			}
			switch (relationship)
			{
			case PanePosition.First:
				RepositionToGroup(parent, 0);
				break;
			case PanePosition.Last:
				RepositionToGroup(parent);
				break;
			case PanePosition.Next:
			case PanePosition.Previous:
			{
				int num = parent.Panes.IndexOf(relativePane);
				if (relationship == PanePosition.Next && (Parent != parent || Index >= num))
				{
					num++;
				}
				RepositionToGroup(parent, num);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public abstract bool Activate();

		protected internal virtual void InitializeFrom(DockablePaneBase source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (categories == (PropertyCategories)0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.Settings) != 0)
			{
				if (source.HasSettings && source.ShouldSerializeSettings())
				{
					Settings.InitializeFrom(source.Settings);
				}
				else if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
				{
					settings.Reset();
				}
			}
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.General) != 0)
			{
				closed = source.closed;
				maximized = source.maximized;
				maximumSize = source.maximumSize;
				minimized = source.minimized;
				minimumSize = source.minimumSize;
				size = source.size;
				text = source.text;
				textTab = source.textTab;
				toolTipCaption = source.toolTipCaption;
				toolTipTab = source.toolTipTab;
				displaySize = source.displaySize;
				floatingSize = source.floatingSize;
				if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
				{
					tagValue = source.Tag;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract DockablePaneBase CreateNewPane();

		protected internal abstract void HideControls();

		internal void ProcessButtonClick(PaneButton button, PaneCaptionButtonUIElement buttonElem)
		{
			UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
			CancelablePaneButtonEventArgs e = new CancelablePaneButtonEventArgs(this, button);
			ultraDockManager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforePaneButtonClick, e);
			if (!e.Cancel && !base.Disposed && !ultraDockManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				try
				{
					ultraDockManager.SuspendIsInViewEvents();
					ProcessButtonClickImpl(button, buttonElem);
				}
				finally
				{
					ultraDockManager.ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
				}
				PaneButtonEventArgs e2 = new PaneButtonEventArgs(this, button);
				ultraDockManager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.AfterPaneButtonClick, e2);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessButtonClickImpl(PaneButton button, PaneCaptionButtonUIElement buttonElem)
		{
			switch (button)
			{
			case PaneButton.Close:
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = ((Parent == null || (Parent.ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup && Parent.ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup) || ParentGroupSettingsResolved == null || ParentGroupSettingsResolved.CloseButtonBehavior != CloseButtonBehavior.CloseTabGroup) ? this : Parent);
				dockablePaneBase.Close(closeChildPane: true);
				break;
			}
			case PaneButton.Minimize:
				Minimized = !Minimized;
				break;
			case PaneButton.Maximize:
				if (Minimized && Maximized)
				{
					Minimized = false;
				}
				else
				{
					Maximized = !Maximized;
				}
				break;
			case PaneButton.Pin:
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase2 = ((Parent == null || (Parent.ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup && Parent.ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup) || ParentGroupSettingsResolved == null || ParentGroupSettingsResolved.PinButtonBehavior != PinButtonBehavior.PinTabGroup) ? this : Parent);
				if (IsUnpinned)
				{
					dockablePaneBase2.Pin();
					break;
				}
				switch (DockedState)
				{
				case DockedState.Floating:
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_16"));
				case DockedState.Docked:
					dockablePaneBase2.Unpin();
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			case PaneButton.Menu:
				if (buttonElem != null && ((UIElement)buttonElem).Control != null && Manager != null && Manager.ContextMenu != null && !Manager.IsDisposing)
				{
					UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = Manager;
					Rectangle drawingRect = ((UIElement)buttonElem).DrawingRect;
					Point point = new Point(drawingRect.Left, drawingRect.Bottom);
					ultraDockManager.ContextMenu.Show(((UIElement)buttonElem).Control, point);
				}
				break;
			case PaneButton.TabClose:
				Close();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != this.manager)
			{
				this.manager = manager;
				if (settings != null)
				{
					settings.InitControl(this.manager);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract bool CanParent(DockablePaneBase pane);

		internal bool CanParentTo(DockableGroupPane pane)
		{
			return pane?.CanParent(this) ?? false;
		}

		internal bool ShowButton(PaneButton button)
		{
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Manager.ShowDisabledButtons && !IsButtonEnabled(button))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (button)
			{
			case PaneButton.Close:
				if (Manager.ShowCloseButton)
				{
					return ParentGroupSettingsResolved.CloseButtonLocation.HasFlag(CloseButtonLocation.Caption);
				}
				return false;
			case PaneButton.Maximize:
				if (Manager.ShowMaximizeButton)
				{
					return !IsUnpinned;
				}
				return false;
			case PaneButton.Minimize:
				if (Manager.ShowMinimizeButton)
				{
					return !IsUnpinned;
				}
				return false;
			case PaneButton.Pin:
				if (Manager.ShowPinButton)
				{
					return DockedState != DockedState.Floating;
				}
				return false;
			case PaneButton.Menu:
				if (Manager.ShowMenuButtonResolved)
				{
					return DockedState != DockedState.Floating;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsButtonEnabled(PaneButton button)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ef: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_011f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (button)
			{
			case PaneButton.Menu:
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					return Manager.ContextMenu != null;
				}
				return false;
			case PaneButton.Close:
				return (int)SettingsResolved.AllowClose == 1;
			case PaneButton.Pin:
				if (DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (int)SettingsResolved.AllowPin == 1;
			case PaneButton.Maximize:
			{
				DockableGroupPane parent2 = Parent;
				if (parent2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)SettingsResolved.AllowMaximize == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Maximized)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!parent2.CanMaximizePane(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in parent2.Panes)
				{
					if (pane != this && pane.IsVisibleInDockArea && !pane.Minimized)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			case PaneButton.Minimize:
			{
				DockableGroupPane parent = Parent;
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parent.Panes.GetVisibleCount() < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)SettingsResolved.AllowMinimize != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in parent.Panes)
				{
					if (pane2 != this && pane2.IsVisibleInDockArea && pane2.Maximized)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (!Minimized)
				{
					foreach (DockablePaneBase pane3 in parent.Panes)
					{
						if (pane3 != this && pane3.IsVisibleInDockArea && !pane3.Minimized)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return Minimized;
			}
			case PaneButton.TabClose:
				return (int)SettingsResolved.AllowClose == 1;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHotTracking(HotTrackPaneArea area)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Manager.IsHotTracking(this, area);
		}

		internal void StoreCurrentIndexes()
		{
			if (DockAreaPane != null && DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
			{
				floatingParentIndex = Index;
				floatingSize = size;
			}
			else if (Parent != null)
			{
				dockedParentIndex = Index;
				dockedSize = size;
			}
			if (!(this is DockableGroupPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in ((DockableGroupPane)this).Panes)
			{
				pane.StoreCurrentIndexes();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (Closed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsVisible && !IsUnpinned)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsUnpinned)
			{
				return Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, TextTabResolved);
			}
			if (PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup)
			{
				return Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, TextTabResolved);
			}
			if (PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
			{
				return Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, Text);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!IsMnemonic(charCode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Activate();
			return true;
		}

		internal void SuspendPaneLayout()
		{
			suspendPaneLayout = true;
		}

		internal void ResumePaneLayout()
		{
			suspendPaneLayout = false;
		}

		internal void DirtyContainingTabInfo(PropertyIds property, PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (Manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Utilities.TabManagerChangeType tabChangeType = Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			if (tabChangeType != Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.None)
			{
				if (Parent != null)
				{
					Parent.DirtyTabInfo(tabChangeType, recursive: false);
				}
				if (IsUnpinned)
				{
					Manager.GetOwningTabInfo(this)?.DirtyTabInfo(tabChangeType);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == Settings)
			{
				PropertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
				DirtyContainingTabInfo(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
				InvalidateUIElement();
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyChanged(PropertyIds propId)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(propId);
		}

			UIElement element = (UIElement)(object)Element;

				element.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}

			}
		}

			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = CreateNewPane();
			PropertyCategories categories = PropertyCategories.General | PropertyCategories.Settings | PropertyCategories.GroupSettings | PropertyCategories.DefaultPaneSettings;
			dockablePaneBase.InitializeFrom(this, categories);

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSize()
		{
			return Size != DefaultSize;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetSize()
		{
			Size = DefaultSize;
		}

		protected virtual Size EnforceMinMax(Size requestedSize)
		{
			bool width = true;
			bool height = true;
			switch (PaneStyle)
			{
			case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
				height = false;
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
				width = false;
				break;
			default:
				return requestedSize;
			}
			return EnforceMinMax(requestedSize, width, height);
		}

		protected Size EnforceMinMax(Size requestedSize, bool width, bool height)
		{
			Size result = requestedSize;
			Size size = MinimumSize;
			Size size2 = MaximumSize;
			if (size.Width >= 0 && result.Width < size.Width)
			{
				result.Width = size.Width;
			}
			if (size2.Width >= 0 && size2.Width > size.Width && result.Width > size2.Width)
			{
				result.Width = size2.Width;
			}
			if (size.Height >= 0 && result.Height < size.Height)
			{
				result.Height = size.Height;
			}
			if (size2.Height >= 0 && size2.Height > size.Height && result.Height > size2.Height)
			{
				result.Height = size2.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal void SyncPaneSize()
		{
			if (synchronizingPaneSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				synchronizingPaneSize = true;
				InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: false, Size, DisplaySize);
			}
			finally
			{
				synchronizingPaneSize = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal void ProcessPaneSize(bool enforceMinMax, Size newSize)
		{
			if (shouldUpdateSizeField)
			{
				size = newSize;
			}
			displaySize = newSize;
			contentsAreaSize = newSize;
			if (!IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				if (Parent != null)
				{
					Parent.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax, Parent.Size, Parent.DisplaySize);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax, newSize, newSize);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void InternalProcessPaneSize(bool enforceMinMax, Size newSize, Size displaySize)
		{
			this.displaySize = displaySize;
			contentsAreaSize = displaySize;
			if (IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				if (shouldUpdateSizeField)
				{
					size = newSize;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (enforceMinMax)
			{
				this.displaySize = EnforceMinMax(newSize);
				if (shouldUpdateSizeField)
				{
					size = this.displaySize;
				}
			}
			else if (shouldUpdateSizeField)
			{
				size = newSize;
			}
			Margins contentsMargins = ContentsMargins;
			contentsAreaSize.Width -= contentsMargins.Left + contentsMargins.Right;
			contentsAreaSize.Height -= contentsMargins.Bottom + contentsMargins.Top;
			AdjustChildPaneSize();
		}

		protected virtual void AdjustChildPaneSize()
		{
		}

		internal void InitializeSize(Size size)
		{
			this.size = size;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		{
			tabItemTagValue = null;
		}

		void ITabItem.ResolveAppearance(TabState state, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SettingsResolved.ResolveTabAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state, resolveDefaults: true);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			OnDeserializationCallback();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializationCallback()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			displaySize = size;
		}

	public struct Margins
	{
		private int left;

		private int top;

		private int right;

		private int bottom;

		public int Left
		{
			get
			{
				return left;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_19"));
				}
				left = value;
			}
		}

		public int Right
		{
			get
			{
				return right;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_19"));
				}
				right = value;
			}
		}

		public int Top
		{
			get
			{
				return top;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_19"));
				}
				top = value;
			}
		}

		public int Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_19"));
				}
				bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
		{
			this.left = (this.top = (this.right = (this.bottom = 0)));
			Left = left;
			Top = top;
			Right = right;
			Bottom = bottom;
		}

		public void Inflate(UIElementBorderWidths borders, Border3DSide sides)
		{
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Left) == Border3DSide.Left)
			{
				left += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Left;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Top) == Border3DSide.Top)
			{
				top += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Top;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Right) == Border3DSide.Right)
			{
				right += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Right;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Bottom) == Border3DSide.Bottom)
			{
				bottom += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Bottom;
			}
			EnforceMinimumValues();
		}

		public void Deflate(UIElementBorderWidths borders, Border3DSide sides)
		{
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Left) == Border3DSide.Left)
			{
				left -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Left;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Top) == Border3DSide.Top)
			{
				top -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Top;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Right) == Border3DSide.Right)
			{
				right -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Right;
			}
			if ((sides & Border3DSide.Bottom) == Border3DSide.Bottom)
			{
				bottom -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borders)).Bottom;
			}
			EnforceMinimumValues();
		}

		private void EnforceMinimumValues()
		{
			if (left < 0)
			{
				left = 0;
			}
			if (top < 0)
			{
				top = 0;
			}
			if (right < 0)
			{
				right = 0;
			}
			if (bottom < 0)
			{
				bottom = 0;
			}
		}
	}

					typeof(Guid),
					typeof(Guid),
					typeof(int),

				});

			if (pane is DockAreaPane)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_24"));
			}
			if (Contains(pane))
			{
				return IndexOf(pane);
			}
			if (pane.Manager != null && manager != null && pane.Manager != manager)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_5"));
			}
			if (pane.Parent != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_25"));
			}
			if (!ownerPane.CanParent(pane))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_26"), pane, ownerPane));
			}
			if (index > Count)
			{
				index = Count;
			}
			else if (index < 0)
			{
				index = 0;
			}
			InternalInsert(index, pane);
			ownerPane.ItemAdded(pane);
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				pane.InitControl(manager);
				manager.PaneAdded(pane);
			}
			return index;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			DockablePaneBaseEnumerator dockablePaneBaseEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockablePaneBaseEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockablePaneBase current = dockablePaneBaseEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockablePaneBaseEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (manager != null && manager.IsSerializing)
			{
				return new SerializablePaneEnumerator(this, manager);
			}
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

			: base(collection)

		}
	}
	public class PanesCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
			if (value is SubObjectsCollectionBase { Count: >0 } subObjectsCollectionBase)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[subObjectsCollectionBase.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < subObjectsCollectionBase.Count; i++)
				{
					if (subObjectsCollectionBase.GetItem(i) is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase)
					{
						string name = dockablePaneBase.GetType().Name + $"[{i}]";
						array[i] = new DockablePanePropertyDescriptor(dockablePaneBase, name);
					}
				}
				result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		internal DockableControlPane ControlPane
		{
			get
			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pane != value)
				{
					if (pane != null)
					{
						pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					pane = value;
					if (value == null)
					{
						paneId = null;
					}
					else
					{
						paneId = pane.InternalIdString;
					}
					if (ControlPane != null)
					{
						pane.SubObjectPropChanged += ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					if (controlElement != null)
					{
						controlElement.Initialize(pane);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ControlUIElementBase ControlUIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (controlElement == null && ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner != null)
				{
					controlElement = new DockableWindowUIElement(this, ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner as UltraDockManager);
					controlElement.Initialize(ControlPane);
				}
				return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)controlElement;
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle DisplayRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((ScrollableControl)(object)this).DisplayRectangle;
				if (Pane != null)
				{
					Margins contentsMargins = Pane.ContentsMargins;
					displayRectangle.X += contentsMargins.Left;
					displayRectangle.Width -= contentsMargins.Left + contentsMargins.Right;
					displayRectangle.Y += contentsMargins.Top;
					displayRectangle.Height -= contentsMargins.Top + contentsMargins.Bottom;
				}
				return displayRectangle;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasControlUIElement
		{
			get

				{
					return ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasControlUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayout(LayoutEventArgs levent)
		{
		}

	public class DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private DockableControlPane pane;

		public override bool IsElementDrawn => false;

		public DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement(DockableControlPane pane, UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
			Initialize(pane);
		}

		internal void Initialize(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = pane;
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			if (pane != null && pane.Container != null && ((UIElement)this).Control.Contains((Control)(object)pane.Container))
			{
				Rectangle drawingRectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).DrawingRectInsideBorders;
				((Control)(object)pane.Container).Bounds = drawingRectInsideBorders;
				if (drawingRectInsideBorders.Width > 0 && drawingRectInsideBorders.Height > 0)
				{
					((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = true;
				}
				ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = ((IUltraControlElement)pane.Container).MainUIElement;
				if (mainUIElement != null && !((UIElement)mainUIElement).IsDrawing)
				{
					((UIElement)mainUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).PositionChildElements();
		}
	}
	public class DockableWindowUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private PaneUIElement paneElement;

		public DockablePaneBase Pane => ((DockableWindow)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).ControlPane;

		private PaneUIElement PaneElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (paneElement == null)
				{
					paneElement = new PaneUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				return paneElement;
			}
		}

		public override RightToLeft RightToLeft => ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;

		public DockableWindowUIElement(DockableWindow control, UltraDockManager dockManager)
			: base((Control)(object)control, (IUltraControl)(object)dockManager)
		{
		}

		private void EnsureParentControlElementsVerified()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control is DockableWindow { Pane: { Parent: { ContainingControl: { HasControlUIElement: not false } containingControl } } } && containingControl.ControlElement.ElementsChanged && !(containingControl.ControlElement is WindowDockingAreaUIElement { IsBeingVerified: not false }))
			{
				((UIElement)containingControl.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(DockablePaneBase context)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = context;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			if (Pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			if (((UIElement)this).Rect == Rectangle.Empty && ((UIElement)this).Control.Size != Size.Empty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (rectInsideBorders.Width <= 0 || rectInsideBorders.Height <= 0)
			{
				if (!(Pane is DockableControlPane) || !((DockableControlPane)Pane).IsMdiChild)
				{
					Pane.HideControls();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)PaneElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
				PaneElement.Initialize(Pane);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)PaneElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void VerifyChildElements(ControlUIElementBase controlElement, bool recursive)
		{
			EnsureParentControlElementsVerified();
			((UIElement)this).VerifyChildElements(controlElement, recursive);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DockAreaPaneConverter))]
	public class DockAreaPane : DockableGroupPane, ISerializable

		private DockedLocation dockedLocation = DockedLocation.DockedTop;

		private WindowDockingArea container;

		private Point floatingLocation = FloatingLocationDefault;

		private GroupSettingsResolved parentGroupSettingsResolved;

		private static readonly Size UnfilledSizeDefault = new Size(-1, -1);

		private Size unfilledSize = UnfilledSizeDefault;

		private Guid dockedBefore;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockAreaPane_P_DockedLocation")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public DockedLocation DockedLocation => dockedLocation;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_DockAreaPane_P_FloatingLocation")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public Point FloatingLocation
		{
			get
			{
				return floatingLocation;

			}

		public override Size MinimumSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Size actualMinimumSize = base.ActualMinimumSize;
				if (actualMinimumSize.IsEmpty)

					return new Size(20, 20);

			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Guid DockedBefore

			get

				return dockedBefore;

			}
		}

		protected internal override GroupSettingsResolved ParentGroupSettingsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentGroupSettingsResolved == null)
				{
					parentGroupSettingsResolved = new GroupSettingsResolved(null);

				return parentGroupSettingsResolved;

		protected internal override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.Manager, StyleUtils.Role.DockAreaPane);

		protected internal override UIRole UIRoleContentArea => StyleUtils.GetRole(base.Manager, StyleUtils.Role.DockAreaPaneContent);

		[Browsable(false)]
