		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Manager.IsFillPane(this);
			}
		}

		internal bool RequiresSplitterBar => base.DockedState != DockedState.Floating;

		private bool RightToLeft => base.Manager?.IsHostRightToLeft ?? false;

		public DockAreaPane(DockedLocation location, Guid internalId)
			: base(internalId, Guid.Empty, -1, Guid.Empty, -1)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DockedLocation), location))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("location", (int)location, typeof(DockedLocation));
			}
			dockedLocation = location;
		}

		public DockAreaPane(DockedLocation location, string key)
			: base(key)
		{
			dockedLocation = location;
		}

		public DockAreaPane(DockedLocation location)
			: this(location, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		internal DockAreaPane(DockedLocation location, UltraDockManager manager)
			: this(location)
		{
			if (manager != null)
			{
				InitControl(manager);
			}
		}

		protected DockAreaPane(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "DockedLocation"))
				{
					if (name == "FloatingLocation")
					{
						floatingLocation = (Point)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Point), floatingLocation);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dockedLocation = (DockedLocation)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockedLocation), dockedLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeFloatingLocation()
		{
			return floatingLocation != FloatingLocationDefault;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetFloatingLocation()
		{
			FloatingLocation = FloatingLocationDefault;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeDockedBefore()
		{
			if (dockedBefore != Guid.Empty)
			{
				return dockedBefore != DockAreasCollection.SentinalEnd;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeUnfilledSize()
		{
			return unfilledSize != UnfilledSizeDefault;
		}

		internal void ResetUnfilledSize()
		{
			UnfilledSize = UnfilledSizeDefault;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (dockedLocation != DockedLocation.DockedTop)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DockedLocation", dockedLocation);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFloatingLocation())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FloatingLocation", floatingLocation);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetFloatingLocation();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Key != null && Key.Length > 0)
			{
				return $"DockAreaPane ({DockedLocation.ToString()}) - {Key}";
			}
			return $"DockAreaPane - {DockedLocation.ToString()}";
		}

		protected internal override bool CanParent(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == this || pane is DockAreaPane || pane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static DockStyle DockedLocationToDockStyle(DockedLocation location)
		{
			return location switch
			{
				DockedLocation.DockedBottom => DockStyle.Bottom, 
				DockedLocation.DockedLeft => DockStyle.Left, 
				DockedLocation.DockedRight => DockStyle.Right, 
				DockedLocation.DockedTop => DockStyle.Top, 
				_ => DockStyle.Fill, 
			};
		}

		internal static DockedLocation DockStyleToDockedLocation(DockStyle style)
		{
			return style switch
			{
				DockStyle.Bottom => DockedLocation.DockedBottom, 
				DockStyle.Left => DockedLocation.DockedLeft, 
				DockStyle.Right => DockedLocation.DockedRight, 
				DockStyle.Top => DockedLocation.DockedTop, 
				_ => DockedLocation.Floating, 
			};
		}

		internal static DockedLocation DockedSideToDockedLocation(DockedSide side)
		{
			return side switch
			{
				DockedSide.Left => DockedLocation.DockedLeft, 
				DockedSide.Right => DockedLocation.DockedRight, 
				DockedSide.Bottom => DockedLocation.DockedBottom, 
				DockedSide.Top => DockedLocation.DockedTop, 
				_ => DockedLocation.Floating, 
			};
		}

		internal static DockedSide DockedLocationToDockedSide(DockedLocation location)
		{
			return location switch
			{
				DockedLocation.DockedLeft => DockedSide.Left, 
				DockedLocation.DockedRight => DockedSide.Right, 
				DockedLocation.DockedBottom => DockedSide.Bottom, 
				DockedLocation.DockedTop => DockedSide.Top, 
				_ => DockedSide.Right, 
			};
		}

		protected internal override DockablePaneBase CreateNewPane()
		{
			return new DockAreaPane(dockedLocation);
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeFrom(DockablePaneBase source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (categories != 0)
			{
				base.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
				if (source is DockAreaPane dockAreaPane && (categories & PropertyCategories.General) != 0)
				{
					floatingLocation = dockAreaPane.FloatingLocation;
					unfilledSize = dockAreaPane.unfilledSize;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			if (HasChildPanes() && propChange.Source == base.Panes)
			{
				Control containingControl = (Control)(object)ContainingControl;
				if (containingControl != null)
				{
					containingControl.Visible = IsVisible;
					SyncPaneSize();
					DirtyUIElement();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyChanged(PropertyIds propId)
		{
			if (propId == PropertyIds.Closed)
			{
				Control containingControl = (Control)(object)ContainingControl;
				if (containingControl != null)
				{
					containingControl.Visible = IsVisible;
				}
			}
			base.PropertyChanged(propId);
		}

		protected override void OnDeserializationCallback()
		{
			if (unfilledSize != UnfilledSizeDefault)
			{
				InitializeSize(unfilledSize);
			}
			base.OnDeserializationCallback();
		}

		protected override Size EnforceMinMax(Size requestedSize)
		{
			bool width = DockedLocation != DockedLocation.DockedBottom && DockedLocation != DockedLocation.DockedTop;
			bool height = DockedLocation != DockedLocation.DockedLeft && DockedLocation != DockedLocation.DockedRight;
			return EnforceMinMax(requestedSize, width, height);
		}

		protected internal override void InternalProcessPaneSize(bool enforceMinMax, Size newSize, Size displaySize)
		{
			if (!base.IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				base.InternalProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax, newSize, displaySize);
				if (ContainingControl is IDockAreaContainer dockAreaContainer)
				{
					dockAreaContainer.UpdateSize(base.Size);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResumeLayout()
		{
			ProcessPaneSize(enforceMinMax: true, base.Size);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		internal DockedLocation GetResolvedDockedLocationForRightToLeft()
		{
			DockedLocation dockedLocation = DockedLocation;
			if (!RightToLeft)
			{
				return dockedLocation;
			}
			switch (dockedLocation)
			{
			case DockedLocation.Floating:
			case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
			case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
				return dockedLocation;
			case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
				return DockedLocation.DockedRight;
			case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
				return DockedLocation.DockedLeft;
			default:
				return dockedLocation;
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class DockAreaPaneConverter : PaneBaseConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_20"));
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is DockAreaPane)
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = (DockAreaPane)value;
				ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(DockedLocation),
					typeof(Guid)
				});
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { dockAreaPane.DockedLocation, dockAreaPane.InternalId }, isComplete: false);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[Editor(typeof(DockablePanesCollectionEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]

	public class DockAreasCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IDeserializationCallback, IEnumerable
	{
		private UltraDockManager manager;

		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		internal static Guid SentinalEnd = new Guid("ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff");

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public DockAreaPane this[int index] => GetItem(index) as DockAreaPane;

		public DockAreaPane this[string key] => GetItem(key) as DockAreaPane;

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		internal DockAreasCollection()
		{
		}

		protected DockAreasCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is DockAreaPane)
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = (DockAreaPane)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(DockAreaPane), null);
					if (dockAreaPane != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(dockAreaPane);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(DockAreaPane pane)
		{
			int result = InternalInsertPane(pane, Count);
			RepositionBasedOnDockedBefore();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockAreaAdded);
			return result;
		}

		public void AddRange(DockAreaPane[] panes)
		{
			foreach (DockAreaPane pane in panes)

			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockAreaAddRange);

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (manager != null)
			{
				{
					DockAreaPaneEnumerator dockAreaPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (dockAreaPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							DockAreaPane current = dockAreaPaneEnumerator.Current;
							current.DockedBefore = Guid.Empty;
							current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
							manager.PaneRemoved(current);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = dockAreaPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();

					}
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockAreaClear);

		public void Remove(DockAreaPane pane)
		{
			if (!Contains(pane))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_22"));
			}
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			pane.DockedBefore = Guid.Empty;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				manager.PaneRemoved(pane);
			}
			InternalRemove(pane);
			UpdateDockAreaPositions();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockAreaRemove);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)

		}

		public DockAreaPaneEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DockAreaPaneEnumerator(this);
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager == this.manager)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.manager = manager;
			DockAreaPaneEnumerator dockAreaPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockAreaPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockAreaPane current = dockAreaPaneEnumerator.Current;
					current.InitControl(this.manager);
					if (this.manager != null)
					{
						this.manager.PaneAdded(current);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockAreaPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new DockAreaPane[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{

			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DockAreaPane, propChange);
			}

		private int InternalInsertPane(DockAreaPane pane, int index)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_27"));
			}
			if (Contains(pane))
			{
				return IndexOf(pane);
			}
			if (manager == null || manager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				{
					DockAreaPaneEnumerator dockAreaPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (dockAreaPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							DockAreaPane current = dockAreaPaneEnumerator.Current;
							if (pane.InternalIdString == current.InternalIdString)
							{
								return IndexOf(current);
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = dockAreaPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (pane.Manager != null && manager != null && pane.Manager != manager)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_5"));
			}
			if (index > Count)
			{
				index = Count;
			}
			else if (index < 0)
			{
				index = 0;
			}
			InternalInsert(index, pane);
			pane.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				pane.InitControl(manager);
				manager.PaneAdded(pane);
			}
			return index;
		}

		private static DockAreaPane FromId(Guid id, IList collection)
		{
			if (id != Guid.Empty)
			{
				foreach (DockAreaPane item in collection)
				{
					if (item.InternalId == id)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RepositionBasedOnDockedBefore()
		{
			int count = Count;
			if (count == 0 || (manager != null && !manager.IsInitializing))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(All);
			ArrayList collection = arrayList.Clone() as ArrayList;
			InternalClear();
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane2 = null;
				for (int num = arrayList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane3 = arrayList[num] as DockAreaPane;
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane4 = FromId(dockAreaPane3.DockedBefore, collection);
					if (dockAreaPane4 == null || dockAreaPane4 == dockAreaPane)
					{
						dockAreaPane2 = dockAreaPane3;
						break;
					}
					if (dockAreaPane2 == null)
					{
						dockAreaPane2 = dockAreaPane3;
					}
					else if (dockAreaPane2 != null && dockAreaPane2.DockedBefore != SentinalEnd)
					{
						dockAreaPane2 = dockAreaPane3;
					}
				}
				InternalInsert(0, dockAreaPane2);
				arrayList.Remove(dockAreaPane2);
				dockAreaPane = dockAreaPane2;
			}
			UpdateDockAreaPositions();
		}

		private void UpdateDockAreaPositions()
		{
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = null;
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane2 = this[num];
				dockAreaPane2.DockedBefore = dockAreaPane?.InternalId ?? SentinalEnd;
				dockAreaPane = dockAreaPane2;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			DockAreaPaneEnumerator dockAreaPaneEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (dockAreaPaneEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockAreaPane current = dockAreaPaneEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockAreaPaneEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (manager != null && manager.IsSerializing)
			{
				return new SerializablePaneEnumerator(this, manager);
			}
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class SerializablePaneEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private int index = -1;

		private SubObjectsCollectionBase collection;

		private UltraDockManager manager;

		object IEnumerator.Current => collection.GetItem(index);

		internal SerializablePaneEnumerator(SubObjectsCollectionBase collection, UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			this.manager = manager;
			this.collection = collection;
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			int num = index;
			while (num < collection.Count)
			{
				num++;
				if (num >= collection.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				DockablePaneBase pane = collection.GetItem(num) as DockablePaneBase;
				if (!manager.IsInheritedPane(pane))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < collection.Count)
			{
				index = num;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			index = -1;
		}
	}

		}

	public abstract class DockControlBase : ManagedContainerControlBase, IReceiveMouseMessage, IReceiveKeyMessage, ISupportTouchMetrics
	{
		private DragManager dragManager;

		private bool dragStarted;

		private IAsyncResult pendingVerifyChildElements;

		internal bool skipDestroyComponent;

		internal bool suspendOnFontChanged;

		private ITouchProvider touchProvider;

		private int touchProviderListVersion = -1;

		internal bool IsInDrag
		{
			get
			{
				DragManager dragManager = DragManager;
				if (dragManager != null)
				{
					if (!dragManager.IsDragPending)
					{
						return dragManager.IsDragging;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDockManagerInDrag
		{
			get
			{
				DragManager dragManager = ((DockManager == null) ? null : DockManager.DragManager);
				if (dragManager != null)
				{
					if (!dragManager.IsDragPending)
					{
						return dragManager.IsDragging;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private UltraDockManager DockManager => ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner as UltraDockManager;

		private DragManager DragManager => dragManager;

		protected internal abstract bool HasControlUIElement { get; }

		internal ControlUIElementBase ControlElement => ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement;

		internal bool IsVerifyChildElementsPending
		{
			get
			{
				if (pendingVerifyChildElements != null)
				{
					return !pendingVerifyChildElements.IsCompleted;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool AreTouchMetricsEnabled => DockManager?.AreTouchMetricsEnabled ?? false;

		protected DockControlBase()
		{
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
		}

		internal bool PotentialStartDrag(DragManager dragManager)
		{
			return PotentialStartDrag(dragManager, preventPaneSelectionOnFocus: false);
		}

		internal bool PotentialStartDrag(DragManager dragManager, bool preventPaneSelectionOnFocus)
		{
			bool preventPaneSelectionOnFocus2 = DockManager.PreventPaneSelectionOnFocus;
			try
			{
				DockManager.PreventPaneSelectionOnFocus = preventPaneSelectionOnFocus;
				this.dragManager = dragManager;
				if (DockManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
				((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: true);
				if (Utilities.IsClr1)
				{
					Utilities.SetActiveControl((IContainerControl)this, null);
				}
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)this);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				this.dragManager = null;
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				DockManager.PreventPaneSelectionOnFocus = preventPaneSelectionOnFocus2;
			}
		}

		internal void DelayedMouseCapture()
		{
			((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(InternalCapture));
		}

		private void InternalCapture()
		{
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement);
			}
		}

		internal bool StartDrag()
		{
			try
			{
				((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement);
				dragStarted = ((Control)this).Capture;
				return dragStarted;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void EndDrag()
		{
			try
			{
				dragManager = null;
				if (dragStarted)
				{
					((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.TerminateCapture();
				}
				dragStarted = false;
				if (!DockManager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.KeyDown(e);
			}
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.KeyUp(e);
			}
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				((Control)this).OnKeyUp(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInDrag && !DockManager.IsDesignMode)
			{
				DragManager.LostFocus(e);
			}
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnLostFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.MouseDown(e);
			}
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
			DragManager dragManager = DragManager;
			if (dragManager != null && dragManager.IsDragPending && (Control.MouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) == 0)
			{
				dragManager.CancelDrag(((Control)(object)this).Focused);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.MouseMove(e);
			}
			else if (IsDockManagerInDrag)
			{
				DockManager.DragManager.MouseMove(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnMouseUp(e);
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.MouseUp(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetVisibleCore(bool value)
		{
			bool flag = value != ((Control)this).Visible;
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				((Control)this).SetVisibleCore(value: true);
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)this).SetVisibleCore(value);
			}
			if (flag && DockManager != null)
			{
				DockManager.VerifyFillPane(reset: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInDrag)
			{
				DragManager.Click();
			}
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnClick(e);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnDoubleClick(e);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessTabKey(bool forward)
		{
			return false;
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (DockManager != null)
			{
				return DockManager.ProcessMnemonic(charCode, (Control)(object)this);

		protected override void OnDragOver(DragEventArgs drgevent)
		{

				DockManager.ProcessDragDropAction(this, drgevent, DragDropAction.DragOver);

		protected override void OnDragEnter(DragEventArgs drgevent)
		{

			}

		protected override void OnDragLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (DockManager != null)
			{
				DockManager.ProcessDragDropAction(this, null, DragDropAction.DragLeave);
			}
			((Control)this).OnDragLeave(e);
		}

		protected override void OnDragDrop(DragEventArgs drgevent)
		{
			if (DockManager != null)
			{
				DockManager.ProcessDragDropAction(this, drgevent, DragDropAction.DragDrop);
			}
			((Control)this).OnDragDrop(drgevent);
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnResize(e);
			if (((Control)this).Created && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated && !((Control)this).Disposing && !((Control)this).IsDisposed)
			{
				WaitToVerifyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void DelayVerifyChildElements()
		{
			if (!((Control)this).Disposing && !((Control)this).IsDisposed && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated && ((Control)this).HasChildren && ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null && ((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ChildElementsDirty && ((Control)this).Visible)
			{
				((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayout(LayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			((ContainerControl)this).OnLayout(e);
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && HasControlUIElement)
			{
				if (((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Rect != ((Control)this).ClientRectangle)
				{
					((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Rect = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
				}
				WaitToVerifyChildElements();
			}
		}

		internal void WaitToVerifyChildElements()
		{
			if (!IsVerifyChildElementsPending && !((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && ((Control)this).HasChildren && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated && DockManager != null && !DockManager.IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				pendingVerifyChildElements = ((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(DelayVerifyChildElements));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnControlAdded(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnControlAdded(e);
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && HasControlUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				WaitToVerifyChildElements();
			}
			e.Control.VisibleChanged += OnChildControlVisibleChanged;
		}

		protected override void OnControlRemoved(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnControlRemoved(e);
			e.Control.VisibleChanged -= OnChildControlVisibleChanged;
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && HasControlUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				WaitToVerifyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void OnChildControlVisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && HasControlUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				WaitToVerifyChildElements();
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if ((keyData & Keys.Escape) == Keys.Escape && IsInDrag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

				((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnFontChanged(e);
			}
		}

			}
			else

				((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ContainerControl, value: false);
			}
			((Control)this).UpdateStyles();
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OwnerChanged();
		}

	internal abstract class DockingIndicatorDefinition
	{
		private DockingIndicatorImageCache imageCache = new DockingIndicatorImageCache();

		public abstract bool SupportsTransparency { get; }

		internal bool RightToLeft { get; set; }

		public abstract Region CreateIndicatorRegion(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form);

		public abstract void DrawIndicator(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics);

		public virtual void DrawAlphaMap(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics)
		{
			graphics.Clear(Color.Black);
		}

		public virtual Size GetIndicatorSize(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			return GetDisplayImage(GetCorrespondingPortion(form.Position))?.Size ?? Size.Empty;
		}

		public DockTarget GetDockTarget(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			return GetDockTarget(form, form.PointToClient(form.CurrentMousePosition));
		}

		protected virtual Bitmap CreateDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected Bitmap GetDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPosition position)
		{
			return GetDisplayImage(position, isActive: false);
		}

		protected Bitmap GetDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPosition position, bool isActive)
		{
			return GetDisplayImage(GetCorrespondingPortion(position), isActive);
		}

		protected Bitmap GetDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			return GetDisplayImage(portion, isActive: false);
		}

		protected Bitmap GetDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive)
		{
			return imageCache.GetImage(portion, isActive, CreateDisplayImage);
		}

		protected virtual DockTarget GetDockTarget(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Point currentMouseLocation)
		{
			if (!form.ClientRectangle.Contains(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				return DockTarget.Floating;
			}
			if (form.Region != null && !form.Region.IsVisible(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				return DockTarget.Floating;
			}
			switch (form.Position)
			{
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom:
				return DockTarget.Bottom;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Left:
				if (RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Right;
				}
				return DockTarget.Left;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Right:
				if (RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Left;
				}
				return DockTarget.Right;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Top:
				return DockTarget.Top;
			default:
				return DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren;
			}
		}

		private static DockingIndicatorPortion GetCorrespondingPortion(DockingIndicatorPosition position)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom => DockingIndicatorPortion.Bottom, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Left => DockingIndicatorPortion.Left, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Right => DockingIndicatorPortion.Right, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Top => DockingIndicatorPortion.Top, 
				_ => DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed, 
			};
		}
	}

		internal void ProcessMouseMove()
		{

			if (prevDockTarget != dockTarget)
			{
				prevDockTarget = dockTarget;

				Invalidate();
				if (indicatorDefinition.SupportsTransparency)
				{
					UpdateTransparency();
				}
				if (manager.DockManager.DragManager.UseReversibleFrame)
				{
					Update();
				}
				manager.AfterIndicatorFormPaint();
			}
		}

		private static Bitmap CombineImageWithAlphaMap(Bitmap image, Bitmap alphaMap)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image.Width, image.Height, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
			try
			{
				BitmapData bitmapData = image.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, image.Size), ImageLockMode.ReadOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
				BitmapData bitmapData2 = alphaMap.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, alphaMap.Size), ImageLockMode.ReadOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
				byte[] array = new byte[bitmapData.Height * bitmapData.Stride];
				byte[] array2 = new byte[bitmapData2.Height * bitmapData2.Stride];
				Marshal.Copy(bitmapData.Scan0, array, 0, array.Length);
				Marshal.Copy(bitmapData2.Scan0, array2, 0, array2.Length);
				for (int i = 0; i < bitmapData.Height; i++)
				{
					int num = i * bitmapData.Stride;
					int num2 = i * bitmapData2.Stride;
					int num3 = 0;
					int num4 = 0;
					while (num3 < bitmapData2.Stride)
					{
						Buffer.BlockCopy(array, num + num4, array2, num2 + num3, 3);
						num3 += 4;
						num4 += 3;
					}
				}
				BitmapData bitmapData3 = bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, alphaMap.Size), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
				Marshal.Copy(array2, 0, bitmapData3.Scan0, array2.Length);
				bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData3);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < image.Width; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < image.Height; k++)
					{
						Color pixel = alphaMap.GetPixel(j, k);
						Color pixel2 = image.GetPixel(j, k);
						bitmap.SetPixel(j, k, Color.FromArgb(pixel.A, pixel2));
					}
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

	internal delegate Bitmap CreateImageCallback(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive);
	internal class DockingIndicatorImageCache
	{
		private bool applicationExitHooked;

		private object imagesSyncLock = new object();

		private Dictionary<DockingIndicatorPortion, Bitmap> activeImages = new Dictionary<DockingIndicatorPortion, Bitmap>();

		private Dictionary<DockingIndicatorPortion, Bitmap> inactiveImages = new Dictionary<DockingIndicatorPortion, Bitmap>();

		public Bitmap GetImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive, CreateImageCallback createImageCallback)
		{
			if (activeImages == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lock (imagesSyncLock)
			{
				if (!applicationExitHooked)
				{
					applicationExitHooked = true;
					Application.ApplicationExit += OnApplicationExit;
				}
				Dictionary<DockingIndicatorPortion, Bitmap> dictionary = (isActive ? activeImages : inactiveImages);
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(portion, out var value))
				{
					value = (dictionary[portion] = createImageCallback(portion, isActive));
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationExit(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (activeImages == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (imagesSyncLock)
			{
				foreach (Bitmap value in activeImages.Values)
				{
					value?.Dispose();
				}
				foreach (Bitmap value2 in inactiveImages.Values)
				{
					value2?.Dispose();
				}
				activeImages = null;
				inactiveImages = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DockingIndicatorManager
	{
		internal class DockingIndicatorInfo
		{
			private DockTarget dockTarget;

			private DockingIndicatorPosition position;

			private DockablePaneBase paneUnderCursor;

			private DockedLocation dockedLocation;

			internal DockTarget DockTarget => dockTarget;

			internal DockedLocation DockedLocation => dockedLocation;

			internal DockingIndicatorPosition Position => position;

			internal DockablePaneBase PaneUnderCursor => paneUnderCursor;

			internal bool IsCenterIndicator => position == DockingIndicatorPosition.Center;

			internal DockingIndicatorInfo(DockTarget dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPosition position, DockablePaneBase paneUnderCursor, DockedLocation dockedLocation)
			{
				this.dockTarget = dockTarget;
				this.position = position;
				this.paneUnderCursor = paneUnderCursor;
				this.dockedLocation = dockedLocation;
			}
		}

		private class DockingIndicatorComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted = x as DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted;
				DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 = y as DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted;
				if (dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted == dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return ((int)dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Position).CompareTo((int)dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Position);
			}
		}

		private UltraDockManager dockManager;

		private DragManager dragManager;

		private ArrayList indicators = new ArrayList(5);

		private Control prevControlUnderCursor;

		private bool isCursorOverSplitterBar;

		private DockingIndicatorComparer comparer;

		internal static readonly Point DefaultCurrentMousePosition = new Point(-10000, -10000);

		private Point currentMousePosition;

		internal DockingIndicatorInfo ActiveIndicatorInfo
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
				{
					if (indicator.Visible)
					{
						DockTarget dockTarget = indicator.DockTarget;
						if (dockTarget != DockTarget.Floating)
						{
							return new DockingIndicatorInfo(dockTarget, indicator.Position, PaneUnderCursor, GetDockedLocation(indicator, dockTarget));
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal Control ControlUnderCursor
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = null;
				UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)PaneUnderCursor?.Element;
				if (val != null)
				{
					control = val.Control;
				}
				if (control == null && !isCursorOverSplitterBar)
				{
					control = dockManager.HostControl;
				}
				if (prevControlUnderCursor != control)
				{
					prevControlUnderCursor = control;
				}
				return control;
			}
		}

		internal Point CurrentMousePosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (currentMousePosition == DefaultCurrentMousePosition)
				{
					return Control.MousePosition;
				}
				return currentMousePosition;
			}
			set
			{
				currentMousePosition = value;
			}
		}

		internal DockingIndicators DockingIndicatorsToDisplay
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockManager.HostControl == null)
				{
					return DockingIndicators.None;
				}
				Point pt = dockManager.HostControl.PointToClient(CurrentMousePosition);
				DockablePaneBase paneUnderCursor = PaneUnderCursor;
				if (dockManager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Contains(pt))
				{
					if (IsCursorOverHostControl || paneUnderCursor != null)
					{
						return DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral;
					}
					return DockingIndicators.Global;
				}
				if (paneUnderCursor != null && paneUnderCursor.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
				{
					return DockingIndicators.Central;
				}
				return DockingIndicators.None;
			}
		}

		internal UltraDockManager DockManager => dockManager;

		internal DockablePaneBase PaneUnderCursor
		{
			get
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
				WindowDockingArea controlToIgnore = null;
				if (dragManager.DragPane is DockAreaPane)
				{
					controlToIgnore = ((DockAreaPane)dragManager.DragPane).Container;
				}
				PaneLocator paneLocator = new PaneLocator(dockManager);
				paneLocator.IncludeControlPanes = true;
				paneLocator.IncludeAutoHideControl = false;
				paneLocator.IncludeUnpinnedTabAreas = false;
				paneLocator.IncludeSplitterBars = false;
				paneLocator.FindPaneElement(CurrentMousePosition, (Control)(object)controlToIgnore, dragManager.DragPane);
				isCursorOverSplitterBar = paneLocator.IsCursorOverSplitterBar;
				UIElement element = paneLocator.Element;
				if (element == null || isCursorOverSplitterBar)
				{
					return null;
				}
				dockablePaneBase = element.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;
				if (dockablePaneBase != null && dockablePaneBase.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup && !dockablePaneBase.IsSelectedTab && dockablePaneBase.Parent != null)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = dockablePaneBase.Parent.SelectedTabPane;
				}
				if ((element is TabGroupUIElement || element is TabLineUIElement || (dockablePaneBase is DockableGroupPane && dockablePaneBase != dragManager.DragPane)) && dockablePaneBase is DockableGroupPane { SelectedTabPane: not null } dockableGroupPane)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = dockableGroupPane.SelectedTabPane;
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase != null && dockablePaneBase == dragManager.DragPane && dockablePaneBase.PaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = null;
				}
				return dockablePaneBase;
			}
		}

		private IComparer IndicatorsComparer
		{
			get
			{
				if (comparer == null)
				{
					comparer = new DockingIndicatorComparer();
				}
				return comparer;
			}
		}

		private bool IsCursorOverHostControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockManager.HostControl == null || !dockManager.HostControl.IsHandleCreated || dockManager.HostControl.IsDisposed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Point pt = dockManager.HostControl.PointToClient(CurrentMousePosition);
				if (dockManager.InnerDockAreaBounds.Contains(pt))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DockingIndicatorManager(UltraDockManager dockManager, DragManager dragManager)
		{
			this.dockManager = dockManager;
			this.dragManager = dragManager;
		}

		internal void AfterIndicatorFormPaint()
		{
			if (dockManager != null)
			{
				dockManager.UpdateHostAndOwnedForms();
			}
			dragManager.UpdateDragOutline();
		}

		internal void BeforeIndicatorFormPaint()
		{
			dragManager.UpdateDragOutline();
		}

		internal bool CanIndicatorParticipate(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator)
		{
			//IL_013f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0145: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_0177: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
