			//IL_0190: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dd: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (indicator == null || dragManager == null || dragManager.DragPane == null || !dragManager.IsDropLocationValid)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (indicator.IsCenterIndicator)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				switch (GetDockedLocation(indicator))
				{
				case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
					flag = (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockBottom == 1;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
					flag = (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockLeft == 1;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
					flag = (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockRight == 1;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
					flag = (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockTop == 1;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.Floating:
					flag = (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowFloating == 1;
					break;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (indicator.DockTarget == DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren)
				{
					if (PaneUnderCursor == null)
					{
						return dragManager.CanDragPaneDisplayAsMdiChild;
					}
					return dragManager.CanDragPaneBeDockedAsTab;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return indicator.Position switch
			{
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom => (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockBottom == 1, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Left => (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockLeft == 1, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Right => (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockRight == 1, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Top => (int)dragManager.DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockTop == 1, 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		internal void DestroyDockingIndicators()
		{
			DestroyDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral);
		}

		internal void DestroyDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators indicatorsToDestroy)
		{
			if (indicatorsToDestroy == DockingIndicators.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeIndicatorFormPaint();
			for (int num = indicators.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (indicators[num] is DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted && (indicatorsToDestroy == DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral || ((indicatorsToDestroy & DockingIndicators.Central) != DockingIndicators.None && dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.IsCenterIndicator) || ((indicatorsToDestroy & DockingIndicators.Global) != DockingIndicators.None && !dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.IsCenterIndicator)))
				{
					dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Close();
					dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Dispose();
					indicators.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			AfterIndicatorFormPaint();
			prevControlUnderCursor = null;
		}

		internal void HideDockingIndicators()
		{
			HideDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral);
		}

		internal void HideDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators indicatorsToHide)
		{
			if (indicatorsToHide == DockingIndicators.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeIndicatorFormPaint();
			for (int num = indicators.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (indicators[num] is DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted && (indicatorsToHide == DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral || ((indicatorsToHide & DockingIndicators.Central) != DockingIndicators.None && dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.IsCenterIndicator) || ((indicatorsToHide & DockingIndicators.Global) != DockingIndicators.None && !dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.IsCenterIndicator)))
				{
					dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Hide();
				}
			}
			AfterIndicatorFormPaint();
			prevControlUnderCursor = null;
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayingIndicators()
		{
			if (indicators != null)
			{
				return indicators.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayingIndicators(DockingIndicators indicatorType)
		{
			if (!IsDisplayingIndicators())
			{
				return indicatorType == DockingIndicators.None;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
			{
				if (indicator.Visible)
				{
					if (indicator.IsCenterIndicator)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return indicatorType switch
			{
				DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral => flag && flag2, 
				DockingIndicators.Global => flag2, 
				_ => flag, 
			};
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseMove()
		{
			foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
			{
				if (indicator.Visible)
				{
					indicator.ProcessMouseMove();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ReshowDockingIndicators()
		{
			indicators.Sort(IndicatorsComparer);
			BeforeIndicatorFormPaint();
			foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
			{
				if (indicator.Visible)
				{
					dragManager.ShowForm(indicator.Location, topmost: true, indicator);
				}
			}
			AfterIndicatorFormPaint();
		}

		internal void ShowDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators indicatorsToShow)
		{
			Control hostControl = dockManager.HostControl;
			if (hostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control controlUnderCursor = ControlUnderCursor;
			Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = dockManager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
			DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted = CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition.Center, null);
			if ((indicatorsToShow & DockingIndicators.Global) != DockingIndicators.None)
			{
				DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 = CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition.Left, dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted);
				int num = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width - dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Width;
				int num2 = 12;
				int num3 = 2;
				while (hostControl == controlUnderCursor && num2 * num3 + dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Width * num3 > num && 0 < num2--)
				{
				}
				innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = hostControl.RectangleToScreen(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds);
				Point location = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Location;
				location.Offset(num2, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height / 2 - 1);
				location.Offset(0, -dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Height / 2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Location = location;
				indicators.Add(dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 = CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition.Right, dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted);
				location = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Location;
				location.Offset(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width - num2, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height / 2 - 1);
				location.Offset(-dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Width, -dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Height / 2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Location = location;
				indicators.Add(dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 = CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition.Top, dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted);
				int num4 = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height - dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Height;
				int num5 = 12;
				int num6 = 2;
				while (hostControl == controlUnderCursor && num5 * num6 + dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Height * num6 > num4 && 0 < num5--)
				{
				}
				location = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Location;
				location.Offset(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width / 2 - 1, num5);
				location.Offset(-dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Width / 2, 0);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Location = location;
				indicators.Add(dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2 = CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom, dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted);
				location = innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Location;
				location.Offset(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Width / 2 - 1, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Height - num5);
				location.Offset(-dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Width / 2, -dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Height);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2.Location = location;
				indicators.Add(dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted2);
			}
			if ((indicatorsToShow & DockingIndicators.Central) != DockingIndicators.None && controlUnderCursor != null)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle;
				Point location;
				if (controlUnderCursor == hostControl)
				{
					rectangle = hostControl.RectangleToScreen(dockManager.InnerDockAreaBounds);
					location = rectangle.Location;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle = controlUnderCursor.DisplayRectangle;
					location = controlUnderCursor.PointToScreen(rectangle.Location);
				}
				location.Offset(rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Height / 2);
				location.Offset(-dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Width / 2, -dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Height / 2);
				dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted.Location = location;
				indicators.Add(dockingIndicatorFormUntrusted);
			}
			indicators.Sort(IndicatorsComparer);
			BeforeIndicatorFormPaint();
			foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
			{
				DockingIndicators dockingIndicators = ((indicator.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center) ? DockingIndicators.Global : DockingIndicators.Central);
				if ((dockingIndicators & indicatorsToShow) != DockingIndicators.None)
				{
					dragManager.ShowForm(indicator.Location, topmost: true, indicator);
				}
			}
			AfterIndicatorFormPaint();
		}

		internal bool ShouldRecreateDockingIndicators(DockingIndicators indicators)
		{
			if (prevControlUnderCursor == ControlUnderCursor && IsDisplayingIndicators(DockingIndicatorsToDisplay))
			{
				if (indicators != DockingIndicators.None && indicators != DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral)
				{
					return IsDisplayingIndicators(indicators ^ DockingIndicators.GlobalAndCentral);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted CreateDockingIndicator(DockingIndicatorPosition position, DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted centerIndicatorForm)
		{
			if (indicators != null)
			{
				foreach (DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator in indicators)
				{
					if (indicator.Position == position)
					{
						return indicator;
					}
				}
			}
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				return CreateDockingIndicatorUnsafe(position, centerIndicatorForm);
			}
			catch
			{
				return new DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted(this, position, centerIndicatorForm);
			}
		}

		private DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted CreateDockingIndicatorUnsafe(DockingIndicatorPosition position, DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted centerIndicatorForm)
		{
			return new DockingIndicatorForm(this, position, centerIndicatorForm);
		}

		private DockedLocation GetDockedLocation(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator)
		{
			return GetDockedLocation(indicator, indicator.DockTarget);
		}

		private DockedLocation GetDockedLocation(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted indicator, DockTarget dockTarget)
		{
			DockablePaneBase paneUnderCursor = PaneUnderCursor;
			if (indicator.IsCenterIndicator && paneUnderCursor != null && paneUnderCursor.DockAreaPane != null)
			{
				return paneUnderCursor.DockAreaPane.DockedLocation;
			}
			return dockTarget switch
			{
				DockTarget.Bottom => DockedLocation.DockedBottom, 
				DockTarget.Left => DockedLocation.DockedLeft, 
				DockTarget.Right => DockedLocation.DockedRight, 
				DockTarget.Top => DockedLocation.DockedTop, 
				_ => DockedLocation.Floating, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition : DockingIndicatorDefinition
	{
		protected enum CenterIndicatorHPortion
		{
			Left,
			Center,
			Right
		}

		protected enum CenterIndicatorVPortion
		{
			Top,
			Middle,
			Bottom
		}

		private static readonly DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition instance = new DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition();

		private Point[] centerBottomHotTrackingPoints;

		private Point[] centerLeftHotTrackingPoints;

		private Point[] centerRightHotTrackingPoints;

		private Point[] centerTabbedHotTrackingPoints;

		private Point[] centerTopHotTrackingPoints;

		public override bool SupportsTransparency => false;

		public static DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition Instance => instance;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart => 29;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorHImageEnd => 88;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorHLeftPortionStart => 0;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart => 58;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart => 58;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorVImageEnd => 88;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart => 29;

		protected virtual int CenterIndicatorVTopPortionStart => 0;

		private Point[] CenterBottomHotTrackingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (centerBottomHotTrackingPoints == null)
				{
					centerBottomHotTrackingPoints = new Point[4]
					{
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart + 6),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVImageEnd - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVImageEnd - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart + 6)
					};
				}
				return centerBottomHotTrackingPoints;
			}
		}

		private Point[] CenterLeftHotTrackingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (centerLeftHotTrackingPoints == null)
				{
					centerLeftHotTrackingPoints = new Point[4]
					{
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 6, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHLeftPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHLeftPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 6, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart - 1)
					};
				}
				return centerLeftHotTrackingPoints;
			}
		}

		private Point[] CenterRightHotTrackingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (centerRightHotTrackingPoints == null)
				{
					centerRightHotTrackingPoints = new Point[4]
					{
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart + 6, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHImageEnd - 1, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHImageEnd - 1, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart + 6, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart - 1)
					};
				}
				return centerRightHotTrackingPoints;
			}
		}

		private Point[] CenterTabbedHotTrackingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (centerTabbedHotTrackingPoints == null)
				{
					centerTabbedHotTrackingPoints = new Point[8]
					{
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 6, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 6),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 6),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart + 5, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 1),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart + 5, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart + 5),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart + 5),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart - 6, CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart)
					};
				}
				return centerTabbedHotTrackingPoints;
			}
		}

		private Point[] CenterTopHotTrackingPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (centerTopHotTrackingPoints == null)
				{
					centerTopHotTrackingPoints = new Point[4]
					{
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 6),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart, CenterIndicatorVTopPortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVTopPortionStart),
						new Point(CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart - 1, CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart - 6)
					};
				}
				return centerTopHotTrackingPoints;
			}
		}

		protected DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition()
		{
		}

		protected override Bitmap CreateDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive)
		{
			string text = null;
			switch (portion)
			{
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Bottom:
				text = "DockingIndicator_Bottom.bmp";
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed:
				text = "DockingIndicator_Center.bmp";
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Left:
				text = "DockingIndicator_Left.bmp";
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Right:
				text = "DockingIndicator_Right.bmp";
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Top:
				text = "DockingIndicator_Top.bmp";
				break;
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Utilities.CreateImageFromResource(text);
		}

		public override Region CreateIndicatorRegion(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(form.Position);
			if (displayImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ImageRegion val = new ImageRegion((Image)displayImage, displayImage.GetPixel(0, 0));
			try
			{
				return val.Region.Clone();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override void DrawIndicator(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics)
		{
			Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(form.Position);
			if (displayImage != null)
			{
				graphics.DrawImage(displayImage, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, displayImage.Size));
			}
			if (GetDockTarget(form) != DockTarget.Floating)
			{
				DrawHotTrackingLines(form, graphics);
			}
		}

		protected override DockTarget GetDockTarget(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Point currentMouseLocation)
		{
			DockTarget dockTarget = base.GetDockTarget(form, currentMouseLocation);
			if (dockTarget != DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren)
			{
				return dockTarget;
			}
			if (GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Left, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle).Contains(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				if (base.RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Right;
				}
				return DockTarget.Left;
			}
			if (GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Right, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle).Contains(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				if (base.RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Left;
				}
				return DockTarget.Right;
			}
			if (GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Top).Contains(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				return DockTarget.Top;
			}
			if (GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Bottom).Contains(currentMouseLocation))
			{
				return DockTarget.Bottom;
			}
			return DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren;
		}

		private void DrawHotTrackingLines(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics grfx)
		{
			if (!form.IsHottrackingAllowed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point[] hotTrackingPoints = GetHotTrackingPoints(form);
			if (hotTrackingPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using Pen pen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(65, 112, 202));
			if (hotTrackingPoints.Length == 4)
			{
				grfx.DrawLines(pen, hotTrackingPoints);
			}
			else if (hotTrackingPoints.Length == 8)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < hotTrackingPoints.Length; i += 2)
				{
					grfx.DrawLine(pen, hotTrackingPoints[i], hotTrackingPoints[i + 1]);
				}
			}
		}

		private Point[] GetHotTrackingPoints(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			if (form.Position == DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				return GetDockTarget(form) switch
				{
					DockTarget.Left => CenterLeftHotTrackingPoints, 
					DockTarget.Right => CenterRightHotTrackingPoints, 
					DockTarget.Top => CenterTopHotTrackingPoints, 
					DockTarget.Bottom => CenterBottomHotTrackingPoints, 
					DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren => CenterTabbedHotTrackingPoints, 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}
			Rectangle clientRectangle = form.ClientRectangle;
			Point location = clientRectangle.Location;
			Point point = new Point(clientRectangle.Width - 1, 0);
			Point point2 = new Point(0, clientRectangle.Height - 1);
			Point point3 = new Point(clientRectangle.Width - 1, clientRectangle.Height - 1);
			return form.Position switch
			{
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom => new Point[4] { location, point2, point3, point }, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Left => new Point[4] { point, location, point2, point3 }, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Top => new Point[4] { point3, point, location, point2 }, 
				DockingIndicatorPosition.Right => new Point[4] { point2, point3, point, location }, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected Rectangle GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion hSection, CenterIndicatorVPortion vSection)
		{
			int left = 0;
			int top = 0;
			int right = 0;
			int bottom = 0;
			switch (hSection)
			{
			case CenterIndicatorHPortion.Left:
				left = CenterIndicatorHLeftPortionStart;
				right = CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart;
				break;
			case CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center:
				left = CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart;
				right = CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart;
				break;
			case CenterIndicatorHPortion.Right:
				left = CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart;
				right = CenterIndicatorHImageEnd;
				break;
			}
			switch (vSection)
			{
			case CenterIndicatorVPortion.Top:
				top = CenterIndicatorVTopPortionStart;
				bottom = CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart;
				break;
			case CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle:
				top = CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart;
				bottom = CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart;
				break;
			case CenterIndicatorVPortion.Bottom:
				top = CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart;
				bottom = CenterIndicatorVImageEnd;
				break;
			}
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom);
		}
	}
	internal class DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition : DockingIndicatorDefinition
	{
		private const int InactiveAlpha = 191;

		private static readonly Point centerLeftPosition;

		private static readonly Point centerRightPosition;

		private static readonly Point centerBottomPosition;

		private static readonly Point centerTopPosition;

		private static readonly Point centerTabbedPosition;

		private static readonly DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition instance;

		private static Bitmap arrowImage;

		public override bool SupportsTransparency => true;

		public static DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition Instance => instance;

		static DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition()
		{
			centerLeftPosition = new Point(0, 35);
			centerRightPosition = new Point(71, 35);
			centerBottomPosition = new Point(36, 69);
			centerTopPosition = new Point(36, 0);
			centerTabbedPosition = new Point(15, 15);
			instance = new DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition();
			Application.ApplicationExit += OnApplicationExit;
			arrowImage = Utilities.CreateImageFromResource("Graphics.DockingIndicator_Arrow_VS2008_Vista.png");
		}

		protected DockingIndicatorVS2008VistaDefinition()
		{
		}

		protected override Bitmap CreateDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive)
		{
			string text = null;
			switch (portion)
			{
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Top:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Bottom:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Vertical_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Vertical_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Left:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Right:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Horizontal_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Horizontal_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Left_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Left_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Right_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Right_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Top_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Top_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Bottom_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Bottom_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed:
				text = (isActive ? "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Active_VS2008_Vista.png" : "Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Normal_VS2008_Vista.png");
				break;
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Utilities.CreateImageFromResource(text);
		}

		public override Region CreateIndicatorRegion(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(form.Position);
				if (displayImage == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ImageManager.CreateBitmapRegion(displayImage, Color.Empty);
			}
			Region region = new Region(Rectangle.Empty);
			UnionCenterPortionRegion(region, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed);
			UnionCenterPortionRegion(region, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft);
			UnionCenterPortionRegion(region, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight);
			UnionCenterPortionRegion(region, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom);
			UnionCenterPortionRegion(region, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop);
			return region;
		}

		public override void DrawAlphaMap(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics)
		{
			DockTarget dockTarget = GetDockTarget(form);
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				Color color = Color.Black;
				if (dockTarget == DockTarget.Floating)
				{
					color = Color.FromArgb(191, color);
				}
				graphics.Clear(color);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed);
				DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft);
				DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight);
				DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom);
				DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop);
			}
		}

		public override void DrawIndicator(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics)
		{
			DockTarget dockTarget = GetDockTarget(form);
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(form.Position, dockTarget != DockTarget.Floating);
				if (displayImage != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(displayImage, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, displayImage.Size));
					DrawArrowImage(form.Position, graphics);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DrawCenterPortionIndicator(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed);
				DrawCenterPortionIndicator(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft);
				DrawCenterPortionIndicator(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight);
				DrawCenterPortionIndicator(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom);
				DrawCenterPortionIndicator(graphics, dockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop);
			}
		}

		protected override DockTarget GetDockTarget(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Point currentMouseLocation)
		{
			DockTarget dockTarget = base.GetDockTarget(form, currentMouseLocation);
			if (dockTarget != DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren)
			{
				return dockTarget;
			}
			if (IsOverCenterPortion(currentMouseLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft))
			{
				if (base.RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Right;
				}
				return DockTarget.Left;
			}
			if (IsOverCenterPortion(currentMouseLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight))
			{
				if (base.RightToLeft)
				{
					return DockTarget.Left;
				}
				return DockTarget.Right;
			}
			if (IsOverCenterPortion(currentMouseLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom))
			{
				return DockTarget.Bottom;
			}
			if (IsOverCenterPortion(currentMouseLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop))
			{
				return DockTarget.Top;
			}
			if (IsOverCenterPortion(currentMouseLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed))
			{
				return DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren;
			}
			return DockTarget.Floating;
		}

		public override Size GetIndicatorSize(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			if (form.Position == DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				return new Size(107, 105);
			}
			return base.GetIndicatorSize(form);
		}

		private void DrawArrowImage(DockingIndicatorPosition position, Graphics graphics)
		{
			DrawArrowImage(position, graphics, Point.Empty, null);
		}

		private void DrawArrowImage(DockingIndicatorPosition position, Graphics graphics, Point offset, ImageAttributes attributes)
		{
			Size size = arrowImage.Size;
			Size size2 = GetDisplayImage(position).Size;
			Point point;
			switch (position)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Left:
				point = new Point(21, (size2.Height - size.Height) / 2);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Right:
				point = new Point(5, (size2.Height - size.Height) / 2);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Top:
				point = new Point((size2.Width - size.Width) / 2 - 1, 21);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom:
				point = new Point((size2.Width - size.Width) / 2 - 1, 5);
				break;
			}
			point.Offset(offset);
			Point point2;
			Point point3;
			Point point4;
			switch (position)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Left:
				point2 = new Point(point.X + size.Width, point.Y + size.Height);
				point3 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + size.Height);
				point4 = new Point(point.X + size.Width, point.Y);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Right:
				point2 = point;
				point3 = new Point(point.X + size.Width, point.Y);
				point4 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + size.Height);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Top:
				point2 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + size.Width);
				point3 = point;
				point4 = new Point(point.X + size.Height, point.Y + size.Width);
				break;
			case DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom:
				point2 = new Point(point.X + size.Height, point.Y);
				point3 = new Point(point.X + size.Height, point.Y + size.Width);
				point4 = point;
				break;
			}
			if (attributes == null)
			{
				graphics.DrawImage(arrowImage, new Point[3] { point2, point3, point4 });
			}
			else
			{
				graphics.DrawImage(arrowImage, new Point[3] { point2, point3, point4 }, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, arrowImage.Size), GraphicsUnit.Pixel, attributes);
			}
		}

		private void DrawCenterPortionAlphaMap(Graphics graphics, DockTarget currentDockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			Point centerPortionOffset = GetCenterPortionOffset(portion);
			using Region region = GetCenterPortionRegion(portion);
			region.Translate(centerPortionOffset.X, centerPortionOffset.Y);
			if (IsCenterPortionActive(portion, currentDockTarget))
			{
				graphics.FillRegion(Brushes.Black, region);
				return;
			}
			using Brush brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(191, Color.Black));
			graphics.FillRegion(brush, region);
		}

		private void DrawCenterPortionIndicator(Graphics graphics, DockTarget currentDockTarget, DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			bool flag = IsCenterPortionActive(portion, currentDockTarget);
			Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(portion, flag);
			Point centerPortionOffset = GetCenterPortionOffset(portion);
			using ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
			int num = (flag ? 255 : 191);
			ColorMatrix colorMatrix = new ColorMatrix();
			colorMatrix.Matrix33 = (float)num / 255f;
			imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(colorMatrix);
			graphics.DrawImage(displayImage, new Rectangle(centerPortionOffset, displayImage.Size), 0, 0, displayImage.Width, displayImage.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			if (portion != DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed)
			{
				DrawArrowImage(GetCorrespondingPosition(portion), graphics, centerPortionOffset, imageAttributes);
			}
		}

		private static Point GetCenterPortionOffset(DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			return portion switch
			{
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft => centerLeftPosition, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight => centerRightPosition, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom => centerBottomPosition, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop => centerTopPosition, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed => centerTabbedPosition, 
				_ => Point.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private Region GetCenterPortionRegion(DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			return ImageManager.CreateBitmapRegion(GetDisplayImage(portion), Color.Empty);
		}

		private DockingIndicatorPosition GetCorrespondingPosition(DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			switch (portion)
			{
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Left:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Left;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Right:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Right;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Bottom:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Bottom;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.Top:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Top;
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Center;
			default:
				return DockingIndicatorPosition.Left;
			}
		}

		private bool IsCenterPortionActive(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, DockTarget currentDockTarget)
		{
			return portion switch
			{
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft => currentDockTarget == DockTarget.Left, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight => currentDockTarget == DockTarget.Right, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop => currentDockTarget == DockTarget.Top, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom => currentDockTarget == DockTarget.Bottom, 
				DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed => currentDockTarget == DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private bool IsOverCenterPortion(Point clientLocation, DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			Point centerPortionOffset = GetCenterPortionOffset(portion);
			using (Region region = GetCenterPortionRegion(portion))
			{
				Point point = clientLocation;
				point.Offset(-centerPortionOffset.X, -centerPortionOffset.Y);
				if (region.IsVisible(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnApplicationExit(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (arrowImage != null)
			{
				arrowImage.Dispose();
				arrowImage = null;
			}
		}

		private void UnionCenterPortionRegion(Region region, DockingIndicatorPortion portion)
		{
			Point centerPortionOffset = GetCenterPortionOffset(portion);
			using Region region2 = GetCenterPortionRegion(portion);
			region2.Translate(centerPortionOffset.X, centerPortionOffset.Y);
			region.Union(region2);
		}
	}
	internal class DockingIndicatorVS2008XPDefinition : DockingIndicatorVS2005Definition
	{
		private static readonly DockingIndicatorVS2008XPDefinition instance = new DockingIndicatorVS2008XPDefinition();

		protected override int CenterIndicatorHCenterPortionStart => 30;

		protected override int CenterIndicatorHImageEnd => 89;

		protected override int CenterIndicatorHRightPortionStart => 59;

		protected override int CenterIndicatorVBottomPortionStart => 59;

		protected override int CenterIndicatorVImageEnd => 89;

		protected override int CenterIndicatorVMiddlePortionStart => 30;

		public override bool SupportsTransparency => true;

		public new static DockingIndicatorVS2008XPDefinition Instance => instance;

		protected DockingIndicatorVS2008XPDefinition()
		{
		}

		protected override Bitmap CreateDisplayImage(DockingIndicatorPortion portion, bool isActive)
		{
			switch (portion)
			{
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterLeft:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterRight:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTop:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterBottom:
			case DockingIndicatorPortion.CenterTabbed:
				return Utilities.CreateImageFromResource("Graphics.DockingIndicator_Center_Normal_vs2008_XP.png");
			default:
				return base.CreateDisplayImage(portion, isActive);
			}
		}

		public override Region CreateIndicatorRegion(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form)
		{
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Bitmap displayImage = GetDisplayImage(form.Position);
			if (displayImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ImageManager.CreateBitmapRegion(displayImage, Color.Empty);
		}

		public override void DrawAlphaMap(DockingIndicatorFormUntrusted form, Graphics graphics)
		{
			DockTarget dockTarget = GetDockTarget(form);
			graphics.Clear(Color.FromArgb(191, Color.Black));
			if (form.Position != DockingIndicatorPosition.Center)
			{
				if (dockTarget != DockTarget.Floating)
				{
					graphics.Clear(Color.Black);
				}
				return;
			}
			switch (dockTarget)
			{
			case DockTarget.Left:
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Left, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle));
				break;
			case DockTarget.Right:
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Right, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle));
				break;
			case DockTarget.Top:
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Top));
				break;
			case DockTarget.Bottom:
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Bottom));
				break;
			case DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren:
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Left, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Top));
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Left, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Bottom));
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Right, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Top));
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Right, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Bottom));
				graphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Black, GetCenterIndictorPortionRect(CenterIndicatorHPortion.Center, CenterIndicatorVPortion.Middle));
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DragManager
	{
		private DragState dragState;

		private DockablePaneBase sourcePane;

		private DockablePaneBase dragPane;

		private DockControlBase dragPaneControl;

		private DragWindowStyle dragStyle;

		private Color dragColor = SystemColors.Highlight;

		private double dragOpacity = 0.5;

		private Form dragForm;

		private bool controlKeyDown;

		private bool lastRectWasTab;

		private Rectangle lastRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		private Location lastRectTabLocation;

		private Point initialMousePosition = Point.Empty;

		private decimal offsetX;

		private decimal offsetY;

		private DropLocation dropLocation;

		private DockableControlPane previousActivePane;

		private DockingIndicatorManager dockingIndicatorManager;

		private bool ignoreLostFocus;

		private bool? canUseReversibleFrame;

		internal bool IsDragging => dragState == DragState.Dragging;

		internal bool IsDragPending => dragState == DragState.Pending;

		private bool IsFloatingDragFormVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (dragPane is DockAreaPane { DockedState: DockedState.Floating } dockAreaPane)
				{
					return !GetFloatingDockAreaForm(dockAreaPane).AllowTransparency;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool CanDragLayeredWindow
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission permission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					Utilities.VerifyPermission(permission);
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase SourcePane => sourcePane;

		internal DockablePaneBase DragPane => dragPane;

		private Form DragForm
		{
			get
			{
				if (dragForm == null || dragForm.Disposing)
				{
					dragForm = new OutlineForm();
					dragForm.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
					dragForm.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;
					dragForm.ShowInTaskbar = false;
					InitializeDragForm();
					((OutlineForm)dragForm).ForceHandleCreation();
				}
				return dragForm;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsControlKeyDown => controlKeyDown;

		internal DockControlBase DragPaneControl => dragPaneControl;

		private UltraDockManager Manager
		{
			get
			{
				if (SourcePane != null)
				{
					return SourcePane.Manager;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal DockableControlPane PreviousActivePane => previousActivePane;

		internal DockingIndicatorManager DockingIndicatorManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockingIndicatorManager == null)
				{
					dockingIndicatorManager = new DockingIndicatorManager(Manager, this);
				}
				return dockingIndicatorManager;
			}
		}

		internal bool UseLayeredWindows
		{
			get
			{
				if (dragStyle != DragWindowStyle.LayeredWindow)
				{
					return dragStyle == DragWindowStyle.LayeredWindowWithIndicators;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool DragRepositionsFloatingForm => dragStyle == DragWindowStyle.LayeredWindowWithIndicators;

		internal bool CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag => DragRepositionsFloatingForm;

		internal bool UseReversibleFrame
		{
			get
			{
				if (UseLayeredWindows)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!canUseReversibleFrame.HasValue)
				{
					canUseReversibleFrame = !Utilities.IsWin10OrLater;
				}
				return canUseReversibleFrame.Value;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanDragPaneBeDockedAsTab
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0019: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (DragPane != null)
				{
					return (int)DragPane.SettingsResolved.AllowDockAsTab != 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanDragPaneDisplayAsMdiChild
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (Manager != null && !Manager.IsDesignMode && DragPane != null && Manager.CanCreateMdiChildForms)
				{
					return (int)DragPane.SettingsResolved.CanDisplayAsMdiChild == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDropLocationValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (dropLocation != null)
				{
					return dropLocation.IsValidDropLocation;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal event CancelEventHandler Dropping;

		internal event EventHandler Dropped;

		internal DragManager()
		{
		}

		private void ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (!(dragPane is DockAreaPane { DockedState: DockedState.Floating } dockAreaPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ignoreLostFocus;
			ignoreLostFocus = true;
			try
			{
				Form floatingDockAreaForm = GetFloatingDockAreaForm(dockAreaPane);
				if (visible)
				{
					floatingDockAreaForm.Opacity = 1.0;
					floatingDockAreaForm.AllowTransparency = false;
				}
				else
				{
					floatingDockAreaForm.AllowTransparency = true;
					floatingDockAreaForm.Opacity = Manager.DragWindowOpacity;
				}
				((IUltraControlElement)DragPaneControl).MainUIElement.CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)DragPaneControl).MainUIElement);
			}
			finally
			{
				ignoreLostFocus = flag;
			}
		}

		internal Form GetFloatingDockAreaForm(DockAreaPane dockArea)
		{
			if (dockArea != null && dockArea.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
			{
				return Utilities.FindForm((Control)(object)dockArea.Container);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InitializeDragForm()
		{
			if (dragForm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!UseLayeredWindows)
				{
					dragForm.Opacity = 1.0;
					dragForm.TransparencyKey = dragForm.BackColor;
					return;
				}
				dragForm.TransparencyKey = Color.Empty;
				if (dragOpacity < 1.0)
				{
					dragForm.Opacity = dragOpacity;
				}
				dragForm.BackColor = dragColor;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void DisposeDragForm()
		{
			if (dragForm != null)
			{
				dragForm.Dispose();
				dragForm = null;
			}
		}

		private DockablePaneBase PaneFromElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return element.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;
		}

		private void ShowForm(Rectangle rect)
		{
			ShowForm(rect, topmost: true);
		}

		private void ShowForm(Rectangle rect, bool topmost)
		{
			if (dragForm != null && (!dragForm.Visible || !(dragForm.Bounds == rect)))
			{
				ShowForm(rect, topmost, dragForm);
				if (Manager != null && Manager.ShowDockingIndicators)
				{
					DockingIndicatorManager.ReshowDockingIndicators();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowForm(Point pt, bool topmost, Form form)
		{
			ShowForm(new Rectangle(pt, form.Size), topmost, form);
		}

		internal void ShowForm(Rectangle rect, bool topmost, Form form)
		{
			bool flag = ignoreLostFocus;
			ignoreLostFocus = true;
			try
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.ShowNoActivate(form, rect, topmost);
				if (dragPaneControl != null && !((Control)(object)dragPaneControl).Focused)
				{
					Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)dragPaneControl);
				}
				if (dragPaneControl != null && !((Control)(object)dragPaneControl).Capture)
				{
					dragPaneControl.StartDrag();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ignoreLostFocus = flag;
			}
		}

		private void ShowDragOutline(Rectangle rect, bool tab, Location tabLocation, bool clear)
		{
			if (!UseReversibleFrame)
			{
				Form form = DragForm;
				if (!clear)
				{
					ShowForm(rect);
				}
				else
				{
					form.Hide();
				}
				if (!clear)
				{
					if (UseLayeredWindows)
					{
						if (tab)
						{
							if (rect != lastRect || !lastRectWasTab || tabLocation != lastRectTabLocation)
							{
								bool rightToLeft = Manager?.IsHostRightToLeft ?? false;
								Region tabRegion = NativeWindowMethods.GetTabRegion(rect, tabLocation, rightToLeft);
								Region region = form.Region;
								try
								{
									form.Region = tabRegion;
								}
								catch (SecurityException)
								{
								}
								region?.Dispose();
							}
						}
						else if (form.Region != null)
						{
							try
							{
								form.Region = null;
							}
							catch (SecurityException)
							{
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						using Graphics graphics = form.CreateGraphics();
						if (rect.Size != lastRect.Size || tab != lastRectWasTab || tabLocation != lastRectTabLocation)
						{
							graphics.Clear(form.BackColor);
						}
						int width = SystemInformation.FrameBorderSize.Width;
						using Brush brush = new HatchBrush(HatchStyle.Percent50, Color.White, Color.Black);
						Rectangle[] rects = (tab ? NativeWindowMethods.GetTabRects(form.ClientRectangle, width, tabLocation) : NativeWindowMethods.GetRects(form.ClientRectangle, width));
						graphics.FillRectangles(brush, rects);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!clear && rect == lastRect && tab == lastRectWasTab && tabLocation == lastRectTabLocation)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (clear)
				{
					if (!lastRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (lastRectWasTab)
						{
							NativeWindowMethods.DrawTabRectFrame(lastRect, lastRectTabLocation);
						}
						else
						{
							NativeWindowMethods.DrawReversibleFrame(lastRect);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (lastRectWasTab)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.DrawTabRectFrame(lastRect, lastRectTabLocation);
					}
					else if (!lastRectWasTab && tab && !lastRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.DrawReversibleFrame(lastRect);
					}
					if (tab)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.DrawTabRectFrame(rect, tabLocation);
					}
					else if (clear || lastRectWasTab || lastRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.DrawReversibleFrame(rect);
					}
					else
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.DrawReversibleFrame(rect, lastRect);
					}
				}
			}
			if (clear)
			{
				lastRect = Rectangle.Empty;
				lastRectWasTab = false;
				lastRectTabLocation = Location.Default;
			}
			else
			{
				lastRect = rect;
				lastRectWasTab = tab;
				lastRectTabLocation = tabLocation;
			}
		}

		private bool InitiateDrag()
		{
			UltraDockManager manager = Manager;
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CancelablePaneEventArgs e = new CancelablePaneEventArgs(dragPane);
			manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforeDockChangeStart, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dragState == DragState.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DragPaneControl.StartDrag())
			{
				dragState = DragState.Dragging;
				dragStyle = manager.DragWindowStyleResolved;
				dragColor = manager.DragWindowColor;
				dragOpacity = manager.DragWindowOpacity;
				if (!UseReversibleFrame)
				{
					if (!CanDragLayeredWindow)
					{
						if (manager.ShowDockingIndicators)
						{
							dragStyle = DragWindowStyle.OutlineWithIndicators;
						}
						else
						{
							dragStyle = DragWindowStyle.Outline;
						}
						canUseReversibleFrame = true;
					}
					else
					{
						InitializeDragForm();
					}
				}
				dropLocation = new DropLocation(DragPane, offsetX, offsetY);
				((Control)(object)DragPaneControl).Update();
				UpdateDropPoint();
				return true;
			}
			CancelDrag();
			return false;
		}

		internal DockAreaPane TransferDragToFloatingPane(Rectangle initialBounds)
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = dragPane as DockableControlPane;
			if (dockableControlPane == null)
			{
				dockableControlPane = FindFirstVisibleControlPane(dragPane as DockableGroupPane);
			}
			bool flag = ignoreLostFocus;
			ignoreLostFocus = true;
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)Manager).IsUpdating;
			DockControlBase container = dockableControlPane.DockAreaPane.Container;
			try
			{
				dragPaneControl.EndDrag();
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)Manager).BeginUpdate();
				}
				Manager.SuspendLayout();
				Manager.FloatPane(dragPane, toggleState: false, initialBounds);
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = (DockAreaPane)(sourcePane = (dragPane = dockableControlPane.DockAreaPane));
				dragPaneControl = dockAreaPane.Container;
				dragPaneControl.PotentialStartDrag(this);
				dragPaneControl.StartDrag();
				dropLocation.ResetDragPane(dragPane);
				if (Manager.IsDesignMode && ((Component)(object)Manager).Site != null)
				{
					((!(((Component)(object)Manager).Site.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)) ? null : (designerHost.GetDesigner((IComponent)dragPaneControl) as IDockableControlDesignerBase))?.StartDrag();
				}
				return dockAreaPane;
			}
			finally
			{
				Manager.ResumeLayout();
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)Manager).EndUpdate();
				}
				ignoreLostFocus = flag;
			}
		}

		private DockableControlPane FindFirstVisibleControlPane(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableControlPane && pane.IsVisible)
				{
					return pane as DockableControlPane;
				}
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane && pane.IsVisible)
				{
					return FindFirstVisibleControlPane(pane as DockableGroupPane);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateDragOutline()
		{
			if (UseReversibleFrame)
			{
				ShowDragOutline(lastRect, lastRectWasTab, lastRectTabLocation, clear: true);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDropPoint()
		{
			DropLocation dropLocation = this.dropLocation;
			if (dropLocation == null || !dropLocation.HitTest() || !IsDragging)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dropLocation.IsValidDropLocation)
			{
				Rectangle displayRect = dropLocation.DisplayRect;
				Location tabLocation = dropLocation.TabLocation;
				bool tab = tabLocation != Location.Default;
				if (DragRepositionsFloatingForm)
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = dragPane as DockAreaPane;
					if (dropLocation.DropDockLocation == DockedLocation.Floating && dropLocation.ChangeType != DockChangeType.NewGroup && dropLocation.ChangeType != DockChangeType.NewSiblingPane)
					{
						ShowDragOutline(Rectangle.Empty, tab: false, Location.Default, clear: true);
						if (dockAreaPane == null || dockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
						{
							dockAreaPane = TransferDragToFloatingPane(displayRect);
						}
						else if (dropLocation.ChangeType == DockChangeType.FloatingWindowReposition)
						{
							Form floatingDockAreaForm = GetFloatingDockAreaForm(dockAreaPane);
							floatingDockAreaForm.Location = displayRect.Location;
						}
						Manager.UpdateHostAndOwnedForms();
						if (CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag)
						{
							ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(visible: true);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag && dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && IsFloatingDragFormVisible)
						{
							if (UseReversibleFrame)
							{
								ShowDragOutline(Rectangle.Empty, tab: false, Location.Default, clear: true);
							}
							ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(visible: false);
							Manager.UpdateHostAndOwnedForms();
						}
						ShowDragOutline(displayRect, tab, tabLocation, clear: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ShowDragOutline(displayRect, tab, tabLocation, clear: false);
				}
				if (Cursor.Current != Cursors.Default)
				{
					Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
					UltraDockManager.ResetCursorPosition();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ShowDragOutline(Rectangle.Empty, tab: false, Location.Default, clear: true);
				if (DragRepositionsFloatingForm && CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag)
				{
					ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(visible: true);
				}
				if (Cursor.Current != Cursors.No)
				{
					Cursor.Current = Cursors.No;
					UltraDockManager.ResetCursorPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeControlKeyState()
		{
			controlKeyDown = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != 0;
		}

		internal bool ProcessMouseDown(UIElement element, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsDragPending || IsDragging)
			{
				CancelDrag(activatePreviousPane: false);
			}
			if (e.Clicks > 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = PaneFromElement(element);
			if (dockablePaneBase == null || dockablePaneBase.IsUnpinned)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)dockablePaneBase.SettingsResolved.AllowDragging != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockControlBase dockControlBase = null;
			dockControlBase = ((!dockablePaneBase.Manager.IsDesignMode) ? dockablePaneBase.ContainingControl : (element.Control as DockControlBase));
			dragState = DragState.Pending;
			previousActivePane = dockablePaneBase.Manager.ActivePane;
			if (dockControlBase == null || ((Control)(object)dockControlBase).IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!dockControlBase.PotentialStartDrag(this, preventPaneSelectionOnFocus: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			dragState = DragState.None;
			InitializeControlKeyState();
			dragPane = GetDragPane(dockablePaneBase, element);
			initialMousePosition = (dockablePaneBase.Manager.IsDesignMode ? Control.MousePosition : element.Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y)));
			dragPaneControl = dockControlBase;
			sourcePane = dockablePaneBase;
			UIElement ancestor = element.GetAncestor(typeof(PaneUIElement));
			Rectangle rectangle = ancestor.Control.RectangleToScreen(ancestor.Rect);
			offsetX = (decimal)(initialMousePosition.X - rectangle.Left) / (decimal)Math.Max(rectangle.Width, 1);
			offsetY = (decimal)(initialMousePosition.Y - rectangle.Top) / (decimal)Math.Max(rectangle.Height, 1);
			if (!IsControlKeyDown)
			{
				dragState = DragState.Pending;
				return false;
			}
			if (!InitiateDrag())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Size GetFloatingPaneSize(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			DockablePaneBase parentFloating = pane.ParentFloating;
			return parentFloating.DisplaySize;
		}

		private DockablePaneBase GetDragPane(DockablePaneBase pane, UIElement element)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			DockableGroupPane parent = pane.Parent;
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				dockablePaneBase = pane;
			}
			else if (element is TabItemUIElement || element is TabItemButtonUIElement || element.GetContext(typeof(ITabItem), false) == pane)
			{
				dockablePaneBase = pane;
			}
			else if (element is PaneCaptionUIElement)
			{
				if ((int)pane.SettingsResolved.ShowCaption == 1)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = ((pane.Parent == null || pane.Parent.ChildPaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup || (int)pane.Parent.SettingsResolved.ShowCaption != 2) ? pane : parent);
				}
				else
				{
					switch (pane.PaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
					case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
						dockablePaneBase = pane;
						break;
					case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
						dockablePaneBase = parent;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (element is PaneSlidingGroupUIElement)
			{
				dockablePaneBase = pane;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && !(dockablePaneBase is DockAreaPane))
			{
				int num = ((!(dockablePaneBase is DockableGroupPane)) ? 1 : ((DockableGroupPane)dockablePaneBase).GetVisibleControlPaneCount());
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = dockablePaneBase.DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane.GetVisibleControlPaneCount() == num)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = dockAreaPane;
				}
			}
			return dockablePaneBase;
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseMove()
		{
			if (IsDragging && (Control.MouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				CancelDrag(DragPaneControl != null && ((Control)(object)DragPaneControl).Focused);
			}
			if (IsDragPending && !NativeWindowMethods.IsLeftButtonDown())
			{
				CancelDrag(DragPaneControl != null && ((Control)(object)DragPaneControl).Focused);
			}
			switch (dragState)
			{
			case DragState.None:
				return;
			case DragState.Pending:
				if ((!IsControlKeyDown && IsOutsideDragRect()) || !InitiateDrag())
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			UpdateDropPoint();
			if (Manager != null && Manager.ShowDockingIndicators)
			{
				DockingIndicatorManager.ProcessMouseMove();
			}
		}

		private bool IsOutsideDragRect()
		{
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			Size dragSize = ScaledSystemInformation.GetDragSize((Control)(object)DragPaneControl);
			return new Rectangle(mousePosition.X - dragSize.Width, mousePosition.Y - dragSize.Height, dragSize.Width * 2, dragSize.Height * 2).Contains(initialMousePosition);
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) != 0;
			switch (dragState)
			{
			case DragState.None:
				break;
			case DragState.Pending:
				if (flag)
				{
					CancelDrag(DragPaneControl != null && ((Control)(object)DragPaneControl).Focused);
				}
				break;
			case DragState.Dragging:
				if (flag)
				{
					EndDrag();
				}
				else
				{
					DragPaneControl.DelayedMouseCapture();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDropping(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Dropping != null)
			{
				this.Dropping(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void OnDropped(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Dropped != null)
			{
				this.Dropped(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void EndDrag()
		{
			switch (dragState)
			{
			case DragState.None:
				return;
			case DragState.Pending:
				CancelDrag(DragPaneControl != null && ((Control)(object)DragPaneControl).Focused);
				return;
			}
			UltraDockManager manager = Manager;
			ShowDragOutline(lastRect, lastRectWasTab, lastRectTabLocation, clear: true);
			if (CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag && DragRepositionsFloatingForm)
			{
				ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(visible: true);
			}
			if (manager != null && manager.ShowDockingIndicators && DockingIndicatorManager.IsDisplayingIndicators())
			{
				DockingIndicatorManager.DestroyDockingIndicators();
			}
			dragState = DragState.None;
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = sourcePane;
			DropLocation dropLocation = this.dropLocation;
			if (DragPaneControl != null)
			{
				DragPaneControl.EndDrag();
			}
			Reset();
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			OnDropping(e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)manager).IsUpdating;
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)manager).BeginUpdate();
				}
				try
				{
					manager.SuspendIsInViewEvents();
					dropLocation.ProcessDrop();
				}
				finally
				{
					manager.ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
				}
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)manager).EndUpdate();
				}
				if (previousActivePane != null)
				{
					manager.ActivatePane(previousActivePane, force: true);
				}
				else if (dockablePaneBase != null)
				{
					if (dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane)
					{
						manager.ActivatePane(dockablePaneBase as DockableControlPane, force: true);
					}
					else
					{
						dockablePaneBase.Activate();
					}
				}
				OnDropped(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			if (manager != null)
			{
				manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				manager.AfterDragChange();
			}
			if (UseReversibleFrame)
			{
				manager?.RefreshHostAndOwnedForms();
			}
		}

		internal void CancelDrag()
		{
			CancelDrag(activatePreviousPane: true);
		}

		internal void CancelDrag(bool activatePreviousPane)
		{
			if (IsDragging)
			{
				if (CanHideFloatingFormDuringDrag && DragRepositionsFloatingForm)
				{
					ChangeFloatingDragPaneVisible(visible: true);
				}
				ShowDragOutline(lastRect, lastRectWasTab, lastRectTabLocation, clear: true);
				if (Manager.ShowDockingIndicators)
				{
					DockingIndicatorManager.DestroyDockingIndicators();
				}
			}
			DragState dragState = this.dragState;
			this.dragState = DragState.None;
			UltraDockManager manager = Manager;
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = previousActivePane;
			previousActivePane = null;
			if (DragPaneControl != null)
			{
				DragPaneControl.EndDrag();
			}
			Reset();
			if (activatePreviousPane && manager != null && dockableControlPane != null && !dockableControlPane.Disposed && dockableControlPane.IsVisible)
			{
				manager.ActivatePane(dockableControlPane, force: true);
			}
			if (UseReversibleFrame && manager != null && dragState == DragState.Dragging)
			{
				manager.RefreshHostAndOwnedForms();
			}
			if (manager != null)
			{
				manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				if (DragRepositionsFloatingForm)
				{
					manager.AfterDragChange();
				}
			}
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			controlKeyDown = false;
			dragColor = Color.Empty;
			DisposeDragForm();
			dragOpacity = 0.5;
			dragPane = null;
			dragPaneControl = null;
			dragState = DragState.None;
			dragStyle = DragWindowStyle.Outline;
			lastRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			lastRectTabLocation = Location.Bottom;
			lastRectWasTab = false;
			sourcePane = null;
			initialMousePosition = Point.Empty;
			offsetX = default(decimal);
			offsetY = default(decimal);
			dropLocation = null;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			UltraDockManager.ResetCursorPosition();
		}

		internal void KeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.KeyCode)
			{
			case Keys.Escape:
				CancelDrag();
				break;
			case Keys.ControlKey:
				if (!IsDragging && !InitiateDrag())
				{
					CancelDrag();
				}
				controlKeyDown = true;
				ProcessMouseMove();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void KeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Keys keyCode = e.KeyCode;
			if (keyCode == Keys.ControlKey)
			{
				controlKeyDown = false;
			}
		}

		internal void LostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ignoreLostFocus)
			{
				CancelDrag(activatePreviousPane: false);
			}
		}

		internal void MouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void MouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseMove();
		}

		internal void MouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseUp(e);
		}

		internal void Click()
		{
			if ((Control.MouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) == 0)
			{
				EndDrag();
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum DragState
	{
		None,
		Pending,
		Dragging
	}
	internal class OutlineForm : Form
	{
		internal OutlineForm()
		{
		}

		internal void ForceHandleCreation()
		{
			CreateHandle();
		}
	}
	internal struct DropInfo
	{
		private DockedLocation dockLocation;

		public bool IsValidLocation;

		public DockChangeType DockType;

		public DockableGroupPane NewParent;

		public DockablePaneBase NewSibling;

		public Point Location;

		public int PaneIndex;

		public ChildPaneStyle PaneStyle;

		public DockedState DockState
		{
			get
			{
				if (dockLocation != DockedLocation.Floating)
				{
					return DockedState.Docked;
				}
				return DockedState.Floating;
			}
		}

		public DockedLocation DockLocation
		{
			get
			{
				return dockLocation;
			}
			set
			{
				dockLocation = value;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			DockLocation = DockedLocation.Floating;
			IsValidLocation = false;
			DockType = DockChangeType.NewDockArea;
			NewParent = null;
			NewSibling = null;
			PaneIndex = 0;
			PaneStyle = ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit;
		}
	}
	internal class DropLocation
	{
		private static bool OutputDebug;

		private DockablePaneBase dragPane;

		private decimal offsetX;

		private decimal offsetY;

		private UltraDockManager dockManager;

		private DropInfo dropInfo;

		private Rectangle dropRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		private Location tabLocation;

		private bool wasControlKeyDown;

		internal bool IsValidDropLocation => dropInfo.IsValidLocation;

		internal DockablePaneBase DragPane => dragPane;

		private bool IsControlKeyDown => (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != 0;

		private UltraDockManager DockManager => dockManager;

		private int CurrentDockAreaIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (DockManager != null && DragPane != null)
				{
					return DockManager.DockAreas.IndexOf(DragPane.DockAreaPane);
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private bool IsFloating => DragPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating;

		internal DropLocation(DockablePaneBase dragPane, decimal offsetX, decimal offsetY)
		{
			this.dragPane = dragPane;
			dockManager = dragPane.Manager;
			this.offsetX = offsetX;
			this.offsetY = offsetY;
		}

		private void InitializeNewDockAreaDropInfo(DockedLocation newLocation, int newIndex)
		{
			dropInfo.DockLocation = newLocation;
			dropInfo.PaneIndex = newIndex;
			if (IsFloating && newLocation == DockedLocation.Floating && DragPane is DockAreaPane)
			{
				dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.FloatingWindowReposition;
			}
			else
			{
				dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.NewDockArea;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeNewGroupPane(DockableGroupPane parent, ChildPaneStyle paneStyleParent, DockablePaneBase siblingPane, bool beforeSibling)
		{
			if (parent != null && paneStyleParent == siblingPane.PaneStyle)
			{
				int num = parent.Panes.IndexOf(siblingPane);
				if (!beforeSibling)
				{
					num++;
				}
				InitializeNewChildPane(parent, num);
				return;
			}
			dropInfo.DockLocation = siblingPane.DockAreaPane.DockedLocation;
			dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.NewGroup;
			dropInfo.NewSibling = siblingPane;
			dropInfo.PaneStyle = paneStyleParent;
			dropInfo.NewParent = parent;
			if (beforeSibling)
			{
				dropInfo.PaneIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				dropInfo.PaneIndex = 1;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeNewChildPane(DockableGroupPane parent, int newIndex)
		{
			dropInfo.DockLocation = parent.DockAreaPane.DockedLocation;
			dropInfo.NewParent = parent;
			dropInfo.PaneIndex = newIndex;
			dropInfo.PaneStyle = parent.ChildPaneStyle;
			if (dragPane.Parent == parent)
			{
				dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.SiblingPaneReposition;
			}
			else
			{
				dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.NewSiblingPane;
			}
		}

		internal bool HitTest()
		{

			}
			if (flag)

				if (DockManager != null && DockManager.ShowDockingIndicators && DockingIndicatorManager.IsDisplayingIndicators())
				{
					DockingIndicatorManager.HideDockingIndicators();
				}
			}
			else if (flag2 && DockManager.ShowDockingIndicators)
			{
				DockingIndicators dockingIndicators = DockingIndicatorManager.DockingIndicatorsToDisplay;
				if (dockingIndicators == DockingIndicators.None)

					if (DockingIndicatorManager.IsDisplayingIndicators())
					{
						DockingIndicatorManager.HideDockingIndicators();
					}

						bool flag4 = DockingIndicatorManager.IsDisplayingIndicators(DockingIndicators.Global);
						if (flag3 && flag4)
						{

						}
						DockingIndicators dockingIndicators2 = dockingIndicators;
						if (flag4 && !flag3)

							dockingIndicators2 |= DockingIndicators.Global;

						bool flag6 = DockingIndicatorManager.IsDisplayingIndicators(DockingIndicators.Central);
						if (flag5 && flag6)
						{
							dockingIndicators2 |= DockingIndicators.Central;
						}
						DockingIndicatorManager.HideDockingIndicators(dockingIndicators2);
						DockingIndicatorManager.ShowDockingIndicators(dockingIndicators);

							{
								if (activeIndicatorInfo.DockTarget == DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren)
								{

								}

								{
									InitializeNewDockAreaDropInfo(activeIndicatorInfo.DockedLocation, DockManager.DockAreas.Count);
									if (activeIndicatorInfo.DockTarget == DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren)
									{

							else
							{
								if (activeIndicatorInfo.DockTarget != DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren && dockablePaneBase.HasParent && dockablePaneBase.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup)

								{
								case DockTarget.Top:
									InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: true);
									break;
								case DockTarget.Bottom:
									InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: false);
									break;
								case DockTarget.Left:
									InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: true);
									break;
								case DockTarget.Right:
									InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: false);
									break;
								case DockTarget.TabbedOrMdiChildren:
									if (DragManager.CanDragPaneBeDockedAsTab)
									{

						}
					}
					else if (IsFloating && DragPane is DockAreaPane)
					{
						dropInfo.DockType = DockChangeType.FloatingWindowReposition;
					}
					else
					{

					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UIElement val2 = ElementFromPoint(mousePosition, ignoreControlPane: false);
				if (val2 == null || DockManager.IsInheritedDesignComponent(val2.Control))
				{
					int dockAreaIndex;
					DockedLocation newLocation = LocationFromPoint(mousePosition, out dockAreaIndex);
					InitializeNewDockAreaDropInfo(newLocation, dockAreaIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					UIElement knownDropElement2 = GetKnownDropElement(val2, dragPane);

					{
						UIElement val3 = ElementFromPoint(mousePosition, ignoreControlPane: false);

						knownDropElement2 = GetKnownDropElement(val3, dragPane);
					}

					{

								}
								knownDropElement3 = GetKnownDropElement(knownDropElement3.Parent, dragPane);
							}
							if (!flag7)
							{
								dropInfo.IsValidLocation = false;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						InitializeNewDockAreaDropInfo(DockedLocation.Floating, DockManager.DockAreas.Count);
					}
				}
			}
			dropRect = GetRect(dropInfo, mousePosition);
			if (dropInfo.IsValidLocation)
			{
				switch (dropInfo.DockType)
				{
				case DockChangeType.DisplayAsMdiChildren:
					dropInfo.IsValidLocation = DragManager.CanDragPaneDisplayAsMdiChild;
					break;
				default:
				{
					DockedLocation dockedLocation = dragPane.DockAreaPane.DockedLocation;

							break;

				DockManager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforeDockChange, e);

		private bool HitTestPaneUIElement(UIElement element, Point pt)
		{
			if (element is PaneUIElement)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = element.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;
				while (dockablePaneBase != null && (dockablePaneBase.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup || dockablePaneBase.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup))
				{
					dockablePaneBase = dockablePaneBase.Parent;
					if (dockablePaneBase != null)
					{
						element = (UIElement)(object)dockablePaneBase.Element;
					}
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase == null || element == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Rectangle rect = element.Control.RectangleToScreen(element.Rect);
				DockedLocation location = DockedLocationFromPoint(rect, pt, -28, 0);
				location = AdjustLocationForRightToLeft(location);
				switch (location)
				{
				case DockedLocation.Floating:
					InitializeNewDockAreaDropInfo(location, DockManager.DockAreas.Count);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
					InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: true);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
					InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: false);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
					InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: false);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
					InitializeNewGroupPane(dockablePaneBase.Parent, ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit, dockablePaneBase, beforeSibling: true);
					break;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ProcessDrop()
		{
			//IL_05f0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_05f6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!IsValidDropLocation)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockManager.SuspendLayout();
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
			switch (dropInfo.DockType)
			{
			case DockChangeType.FloatingWindowReposition:
				dragPane.DockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = dropRect.Location;
				break;
			case DockChangeType.NewDockArea:
				switch (dropInfo.DockLocation)
				{
				case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
					dockablePaneBase = DockManager.DockPane(dragPane, DockedSide.Bottom, dropInfo.PaneIndex, dropRect.Size);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
					dockablePaneBase = DockManager.DockPane(dragPane, DockedSide.Left, dropInfo.PaneIndex, dropRect.Size);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
					dockablePaneBase = DockManager.DockPane(dragPane, DockedSide.Right, dropInfo.PaneIndex, dropRect.Size);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
					dockablePaneBase = DockManager.DockPane(dragPane, DockedSide.Top, dropInfo.PaneIndex, dropRect.Size);
					break;
				case DockedLocation.Floating:
					DockManager.FloatPane(dragPane, toggleState: false, dropRect);
					break;
				}
				break;
			case DockChangeType.NewGroup:
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = null;
				bool flag = false;
				Size size = Size.Empty;
				if (dragPane is DockAreaPane)
				{
					size = ((DockAreaPane)dragPane).Panes[0].DisplaySize;
				}
				if (dropInfo.NewParent != null)
				{
					dockableGroupPane = new DockableGroupPane();
					dockableGroupPane.ChildPaneStyle = dropInfo.PaneStyle;
					if (dropInfo.NewSibling.Parent == dragPane.Parent && dropInfo.NewParent.Panes.Count == 2)
					{
						dockableGroupPane.Size = dropInfo.NewParent.DisplaySize;
					}
					else
					{
						dockableGroupPane.Size = dropInfo.NewSibling.Size;
					}
					int index = dropInfo.NewParent.Panes.IndexOf(dropInfo.NewSibling);
					SetDragPaneSize(dropInfo.NewSibling.Parent);
					dropInfo.NewParent.Panes.Insert(dockableGroupPane, index);
				}
				else
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = new DockAreaPane(dropInfo.DockLocation);
					dockAreaPane.ChildPaneStyle = dropInfo.PaneStyle;
					dockAreaPane.Size = dropInfo.NewSibling.Size;
					dragPane.Size = dropRect.Size;
					int index2;
					if (dropInfo.NewSibling is DockAreaPane)
					{
						index2 = DockManager.DockAreas.IndexOf(dropInfo.NewSibling);
						DockAreaPane dockAreaPane2 = (DockAreaPane)dropInfo.NewSibling;
						dockAreaPane.UnfilledSize = dockAreaPane2.UnfilledSize;
						if (dockAreaPane2.IsFillPane)
						{
							dockAreaPane.Size = dockAreaPane.UnfilledSize;
							flag = true;
						}
						dockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = dockAreaPane2.FloatingLocation;
					}
					else
					{
						index2 = DockManager.DockAreas.Count;
						dockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = dropRect.Location;
					}
					DockManager.DockAreas.Insert(dockAreaPane, index2);
					dockableGroupPane = dockAreaPane;
				}
				bool flag2 = dropInfo.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup || dropInfo.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup;
				dockablePaneBase = DockManager.RepositionPane(DragPane, dockableGroupPane, 0, flag2, removeUnused: true, includeHiddenPanes: false);
				if (!size.IsEmpty)
				{
					DragPane.Size = size;
				}
				bool flatten = false;
				if (flag2 && dropInfo.NewSibling is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane2 && dockableGroupPane2.Panes.Count == 1)
				{
					flatten = true;
				}
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane3 = DockManager.RepositionPane(dropInfo.NewSibling, dockableGroupPane, (dropInfo.PaneIndex == 0) ? dockableGroupPane.Panes.Count : 0, flatten, removeUnused: false, includeHiddenPanes: true);
				if (!flag2 && flag)
				{
					Size size2 = dockableGroupPane.Size;
					dockableGroupPane3.Size = ((dropInfo.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit) ? new Size(size2.Width - dropRect.Width, size2.Height) : new Size(size2.Width, size2.Height - dropRect.Height));
				}
				if (dropInfo.NewSibling is DockableGroupPane && dockableGroupPane3 != dropInfo.NewSibling)
				{
					string key = dropInfo.NewSibling.Key;
					dropInfo.NewSibling.Key = null;
