		private UIElement GetKnownDropElement(UIElement element, DockablePaneBase paneToIgnore)
		{
			UIElement val = element;
			DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = paneToIgnore as DockableGroupPane;
			while (val != null)
			{
				if (val is TabItemUIElement || val is TabItemButtonUIElement)
				{
					return val;
				}
				if ((val is WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement || val is PaneCaptionUIElement || val is PaneSlidingGroupUIElement || val is PaneSplitterUIElement || val is TabRowUIElement || val is TabGroupUIElement || val is PaneUIElement) && val.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase && paneToIgnore != dockablePaneBase && (dockableGroupPane == null || !dockableGroupPane.Contains(dockablePaneBase, recursive: true)))
				{
					return val;
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DockedLocation DockedLocationFromPoint(Rectangle rect, Point pt, int minDelta, int maxDelta)
		{
			int num = rect.Left - pt.X;
			int num2 = rect.Top - pt.Y;
			int num3 = pt.Y - rect.Bottom;
			int num4 = pt.X - rect.Right;
			bool flag = num <= maxDelta && num >= minDelta;
			bool flag2 = num4 <= maxDelta && num4 >= minDelta;
			bool flag3 = num2 <= maxDelta && num2 >= minDelta;
			bool flag4 = num3 <= maxDelta && num3 >= minDelta;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				if (num < num4)
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag3 && flag4)
			{
				if (num2 < num3)
				{
					flag4 = false;
				}
				else
				{
					flag3 = false;
				}
			}
			if ((flag3 || flag4) && (flag || flag2))
			{
				int value = (flag3 ? num2 : num3);
				int value2 = (flag ? num : num4);
				if (Math.Abs(value2) < Math.Abs(value))
				{
					flag3 = (flag4 = false);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = (flag2 = false);
				}
			}
			else if (flag3 || flag4)
			{
				if (pt.X < rect.Left || pt.X > rect.Right)
				{
					flag3 = (flag4 = false);
				}
			}
			else if ((flag || flag2) && (pt.Y < rect.Top || pt.Y > rect.Bottom))
			{
				flag = (flag2 = false);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return DockedLocation.DockedLeft;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return DockedLocation.DockedRight;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				return DockedLocation.DockedTop;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				return DockedLocation.DockedBottom;
			}
			return DockedLocation.Floating;
		}

		private DockedLocation LocationFromPoint(Point pt, out int dockAreaIndex)
		{
			Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = dockManager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
			innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = dockManager.RectangleToScreen(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds);
			DockedLocation location;

			{
				dockAreaIndex = DockManager.DockAreas.Count;
				Rectangle innerDockAreaBounds = DockManager.InnerDockAreaBounds;
				innerDockAreaBounds = DockManager.RectangleToScreen(innerDockAreaBounds);
				location = DockedLocationFromPoint(innerDockAreaBounds, pt, -11, 0);
				return AdjustLocationForRightToLeft(location);
			}
			location = DockedLocationFromPoint(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds, pt, 0, 24);
			location = AdjustLocationForRightToLeft(location);
			dockAreaIndex = 0;
			return location;
		}

		private void SetDragPaneSize(DockableGroupPane newParent)
		{
			if (dropInfo.PaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit && dropInfo.PaneStyle != ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = dropInfo.PaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit;
			Size displaySize = newParent.DisplaySize;
			int splitterBarWidthResolved = DockManager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
			int num = 0;
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = newParent.Panes[0];
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in newParent.Panes)
			{
				if (!pane.IsVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					displaySize.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					if (num < pane.Size.Width)
					{
						num = pane.Size.Width;
						dockablePaneBase = pane;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					displaySize.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					if (num < pane.Size.Height)
					{
						num = pane.Size.Height;
						dockablePaneBase = pane;
					}
				}
			}
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase2 = dragPane;
			if (dragPane is DockAreaPane dockAreaPane && dockAreaPane.Panes.Count == 1)
			{
				dockablePaneBase2 = dockAreaPane.Panes[0];
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				int dragPaneExtent = GetDragPaneExtent(displaySize.Width, dropRect.Width, dockablePaneBase.DisplaySize.Width, dockablePaneBase.Size.Width);
				dockablePaneBase2.Size = new Size(dragPaneExtent, dockablePaneBase2.Size.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				int dragPaneExtent2 = GetDragPaneExtent(displaySize.Height, dropRect.Height, dockablePaneBase.DisplaySize.Height, dockablePaneBase.Size.Height);
				dockablePaneBase2.Size = new Size(dockablePaneBase2.Size.Width, dragPaneExtent2);
			}
		}

		private static int GetDragPaneExtent(int parentDisplayExtent, int dragPaneDisplayExtent, int siblingPaneDisplayExtent, int siblingPaneExtent)
		{
			int val = parentDisplayExtent / 2;
			dragPaneDisplayExtent = Math.Min(dragPaneDisplayExtent, val);
			double num = (double)siblingPaneDisplayExtent / (double)parentDisplayExtent;
			int num2 = (int)(num * (double)(parentDisplayExtent - dragPaneDisplayExtent));
			return dragPaneDisplayExtent * siblingPaneExtent / num2;
		}

			get
			{
				return includeUnpinnedTabAreas;
			}
			set
			{
				includeUnpinnedTabAreas = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IncludeSplitterBars
		{
			get
			{
				return includeSplitterBars;
			}
			set
			{
				includeSplitterBars = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCursorOverSplitterBar => isCursorOverSplitterBar;

		internal DockablePaneBase Pane => locatedPane;

		internal UIElement Element => locatedElement;

		private UltraDockManager.FindElementHandler FindPaneHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (findPaneHandler == null)
				{
					findPaneHandler = FindPaneElement;
				}
				return findPaneHandler;
			}
		}

		internal PaneLocator(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			this.manager = manager;
		}

		internal void FindPaneElement(Point pt, Control controlToIgnore, DockablePaneBase paneToIgnore)
		{
			locatedPane = null;
			locatedElement = null;
			this.controlToIgnore = controlToIgnore;
			this.paneToIgnore = paneToIgnore;
			manager.ElementFromPoint(pt, FindPaneHandler);
		}

		private bool FindPaneElement(Control control, UIElement element, Point pt)
		{
			if (!IncludeSplitterBars && element is PaneSplitterUIElementBase)
			{
				isCursorOverSplitterBar = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (control == controlToIgnore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!includeAutoHide && control is AutoHideControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!includeFloating && control is FloatingWindowContainer)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!includeControlPanes && control is DockableWindow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IncludeUnpinnedTabAreas && control is UnpinnedTabArea)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase == paneToIgnore && element.GetAncestor(typeof(TabItemUIElement)) == null && element.GetAncestor(typeof(TabItemButtonUIElement)) == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase.IsUnpinned && !includeAutoHide)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockablePaneBase is DockAreaPane && dockablePaneBase.DockAreaPane.GetVisibleControlPaneCount() == 1 && dockablePaneBase.DockAreaPane.Contains(paneToIgnore, recursive: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (paneToIgnore is DockableGroupPane && ((DockableGroupPane)paneToIgnore).Contains(dockablePaneBase, recursive: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!includeFloating && dockablePaneBase.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!includeControlPanes && dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane)
			{
				return false;
			}
			locatedElement = element;
			locatedPane = dockablePaneBase;
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class DockEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		private UltraDockManager manager;

		private static int[] beforeEventIndexes;

		private static int[] afterEventIndexes;

		public UltraDockManager DockManager => manager;

		protected int[] AfterEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (afterEventIndexes == null)
				{
					afterEventIndexes = new int[5] { 2, 3, 4, 14, 16 };
				}
				return afterEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		protected int[] BeforeEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (beforeEventIndexes == null)
				{
					beforeEventIndexes = new int[6] { 5, 6, 7, 12, 13, 15 };
				}
				return beforeEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		public DockEventManager(UltraDockManager manager)
			: base(Enum.GetValues(typeof(DockManagerEventIds)).Length)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_29"));
			}
			this.manager = manager;
		}

		public bool InProgress(DockManagerEventIds eventid)
		{
			return InProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(DockManagerEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled((int)eventid);
		}

		public void SetEnabled(DockManagerEventIds eventid, bool enabled)
		{
			SetEnabled((int)eventid, enabled);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(DockManagerEventGroups group)
		{
			return group switch
			{
				DockManagerEventGroups.AllEvents => base.AllEventsEnabled, 
				DockManagerEventGroups.BeforeEvents => IsEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes), 
				DockManagerEventGroups.AfterEvents => IsEnabled(AfterEventIndexes), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public void SetEnabled(DockManagerEventGroups group, bool enabled)
		{
			switch (group)
			{
			case DockManagerEventGroups.AllEvents:
				base.AllEventsEnabled = enabled;
				break;
			case DockManagerEventGroups.BeforeEvents:
				SetEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			case DockManagerEventGroups.AfterEvents:
				SetEnabled(AfterEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void IncrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds eventid)
		{
			IncrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal void DecrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds eventid)
		{
			DecrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal bool CanFireEvent(DockManagerEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled(eventid);
		}
	}

	public class FloatingWindowContainerUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private FormResizeData resizeData;

		public DockAreaPane DockAreaPane => ((FloatingWindowContainer)((UIElement)this).Control).DockAreaPane;

		public override bool Adjustable
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane != null)
				{
					return (int)dockAreaPane.SettingsResolved.AllowResize == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle RectInsideBorders => ((UIElement)this).Control.DisplayRectangle;

		private FormResizeData ResizeData
		{
			get
			{
				if (resizeData == null)
				{
					resizeData = new FormResizeData((Form)((UIElement)this).Control);
				}
				return resizeData;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)6;

		public override RightToLeft RightToLeft => ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;

		public FloatingWindowContainerUIElement(FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow, UltraDockManager manager)
			: base((Control)floatingWindow, (IUltraControl)(object)manager)
		{
		}

		private BorderEdge GetAdjustableAreaFromPoint(Point pt)
		{
			if (!((UIElement)this).Adjustable)
			{
				return BorderEdge.None;
			}
			Size frameBorderSize = SystemInformation.FrameBorderSize;
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			bool flag = pt.Y <= rect.Y + frameBorderSize.Height;
			bool flag2 = pt.Y >= rect.Bottom - frameBorderSize.Height;
			bool flag3 = pt.X <= rect.X + frameBorderSize.Width;
			bool flag4 = pt.X >= rect.Right - frameBorderSize.Height;
			if ((flag2 || flag) && !(flag3 || flag4))
			{
				Size toolWindowCaptionButtonSize = SystemInformation.ToolWindowCaptionButtonSize;
				flag3 = pt.X <= rect.X + frameBorderSize.Width + toolWindowCaptionButtonSize.Width;
				flag4 = pt.X >= rect.Right - frameBorderSize.Height - toolWindowCaptionButtonSize.Width;
			}
			else if ((flag3 || flag4) && !(flag || flag2))
			{
				Size toolWindowCaptionButtonSize2 = SystemInformation.ToolWindowCaptionButtonSize;
				flag = pt.Y <= rect.Y + frameBorderSize.Height + toolWindowCaptionButtonSize2.Height;
				flag2 = pt.Y >= rect.Bottom - frameBorderSize.Height - toolWindowCaptionButtonSize2.Height;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					return BorderEdge.TopLeft;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					return BorderEdge.TopRight;
				}
				return BorderEdge.Top;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					return BorderEdge.BottomLeft;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					return BorderEdge.BottomRight;
				}
				return BorderEdge.Bottom;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				return BorderEdge.Left;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				return BorderEdge.Right;
			}
			return BorderEdge.None;
		}

		public override Cursor GetAdjustableCursor(Point point)
		{
			if (!((UIElement)this).Adjustable)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (GetAdjustableAreaFromPoint(point))
			{
			case BorderEdge.Top:
			case BorderEdge.Bottom:
				return Cursors.SizeNS;
			case BorderEdge.TopLeft:
			case BorderEdge.BottomRight:
				return Cursors.SizeNWSE;
			case BorderEdge.TopRight:
			case BorderEdge.BottomLeft:
				return Cursors.SizeNESW;
			case BorderEdge.Left:
			case BorderEdge.Right:
				return Cursors.SizeWE;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override bool PointInAdjustableArea(Point point)
		{
			if (!((UIElement)this).Adjustable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return GetAdjustableAreaFromPoint(point) != BorderEdge.None;
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			((UIElement)this).DrawBorders(ref drawParams);
		}

		public override UIElementBorderWidths GetBorderWidths(UIElementBorderStyle style, Border3DSide sides)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementBorderWidths result = default(UIElementBorderWidths);
			Size frameBorderSize = SystemInformation.FrameBorderSize;
			int left = (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Right = frameBorderSize.Width);
			((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Left = left;
			left = (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Bottom = frameBorderSize.Height);
			((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref result)).Top = left;
			return result;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) == 4)
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Control.Focused)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ActiveBorder;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.InactiveBorder;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control != null && !((UIElement)this).Control.IsDisposed && !((UIElement)this).Control.Disposing && ((UIElement)this).HasCapture)
			{
				ResizeData.ProcessMouseMove(((UIElement)this).Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y)));
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control == null || ((UIElement)this).Control.IsDisposed || ((UIElement)this).Control.Disposing)
			{
				ResizeData.EndResize(Point.Empty, canceled: true);
			}
			else
			{
				ResizeData.EndResize(((UIElement)this).Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y)), canceled: false);
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			ResizeData.EndResize(Point.Empty, canceled: true);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).OnCaptureAborted();
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!adjustableArea || (e.Button & MouseButtons.Left) != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			if (((UIElement)this).Control == null || ((UIElement)this).Control.IsDisposed || ((UIElement)this).Control.Disposing)
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			BorderEdge adjustableAreaFromPoint = GetAdjustableAreaFromPoint(point);
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane != null && (int)dockAreaPane.SettingsResolved.AllowResize != 2)
			{
				Size minimumSizeResolved = dockAreaPane.MinimumSizeResolved;
				Size maximumSizeResolved = dockAreaPane.MaximumSizeResolved;
				Size size = new Size(((UIElement)this).Control.Size.Width - ((UIElement)this).Control.DisplayRectangle.Width, ((UIElement)this).Control.Size.Height - ((UIElement)this).Control.DisplayRectangle.Height);
				if (minimumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
				{
					minimumSizeResolved.Width += size.Width;
				}
				if (minimumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					minimumSizeResolved.Height += size.Height;
				}
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
				{
					maximumSizeResolved.Width += size.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					maximumSizeResolved.Width = SystemInformation.MaxWindowTrackSize.Width;
				}
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					maximumSizeResolved.Height += size.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					maximumSizeResolved.Height = SystemInformation.MaxWindowTrackSize.Height;
				}
				dockAreaPane.Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				((UIElement)this).Control.Update();
				if (ResizeData.StartResize(((UIElement)this).Control.PointToScreen(point), adjustableAreaFromPoint, minimumSizeResolved, maximumSizeResolved))
				{
					captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override bool DrawTheme(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0114: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindowContainer = (FloatingWindowContainer)((UIElement)this).Control;
			bool flag = floatingWindowContainer.DockAreaPane != null && floatingWindowContainer.DockAreaPane.IsActive;
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			UIElementBorderWidths borderWidths = ((UIElement)this).GetBorderWidths(((UIElement)this).BorderStyle, Border3DSide.All);
			rect.Width = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Left;
			if (!XPThemes.Window.DrawWindowFrame(true, (FramePart)0, flag, ref drawParams, rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			rect.X = rect.Right - ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Right;
			rect.Width = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Right;
			XPThemes.Window.DrawWindowFrame(true, (FramePart)1, flag, ref drawParams, rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
			rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			rect.Y = rect.Bottom - ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Bottom;
			rect.Height = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Bottom;
			XPThemes.Window.DrawWindowFrame(true, (FramePart)2, flag, ref drawParams, rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
			rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			rect.Height = ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Top;
			WindowEnabledState val = ((!((UIElement)this).Enabled) ? ((WindowEnabledState)2) : ((!flag) ? ((WindowEnabledState)1) : ((WindowEnabledState)0)));
			XPThemes.Window.DrawWindowCaption(true, (WindowState)0, val, ref drawParams, rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal enum BorderEdge
	{
		None,
		Top,
		Left,
		Bottom,
		Right,
		TopLeft,
		TopRight,
		BottomLeft,
		BottomRight
	}
	internal class FormResizeData
	{
		private Rectangle rectOriginalRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		private Point lastPoint = Point.Empty;

		private Point previousPoint = Point.Empty;

		private Rectangle lastRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		private BorderEdge edge;

		private bool resizeWhileDragging = SystemInformation.DragFullWindows;

		private Form frm;

		private bool resizeInProgress;

		private Size minSize = SystemInformation.MinWindowTrackSize;

		private Size maxSize = SystemInformation.MaxWindowTrackSize;

		private IAsyncResult lastAsyncResult;

		internal FormResizeData(Form frm)
		{
			if (frm == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_30"));
			}
			this.frm = frm;
		}

		private void DrawReversibleFrame(Rectangle oldRect, Rectangle newRect)
		{
			if (!resizeWhileDragging)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.DrawReversibleFrame(newRect, 4, oldRect);
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateNewRect(Point pt)
		{
			if (previousPoint == pt)
			{
				previousPoint = lastPoint;
				return lastRect;
			}
			int num = pt.X - lastPoint.X;
			int num2 = pt.Y - lastPoint.Y;
			Rectangle result = lastRect;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
			{
				return lastRect;
			}
			switch (edge)
			{
			case BorderEdge.Bottom:
			case BorderEdge.BottomLeft:
			case BorderEdge.BottomRight:
				flag = true;
				result.Height += num2;
				break;
			case BorderEdge.Top:
			case BorderEdge.TopLeft:
			case BorderEdge.TopRight:
				result.Y += num2;
				result.Height -= num2;
				break;
			}
			switch (edge)
			{
			case BorderEdge.Left:
			case BorderEdge.TopLeft:
			case BorderEdge.BottomLeft:
				result.X += num;
				result.Width -= num;
				break;
			case BorderEdge.Right:
			case BorderEdge.TopRight:
			case BorderEdge.BottomRight:
				flag2 = true;
				result.Width += num;
				break;
			}
			Size size = minSize;
			Size size2 = maxSize;
			if (size.Width < frm.MinimumSize.Width)
			{
				size.Width = frm.MinimumSize.Width;
			}
			if (size.Height < frm.MinimumSize.Height)
			{
				size.Height = frm.MinimumSize.Height;
			}
			if (size2.Height > frm.MaximumSize.Height && frm.MaximumSize.Height > 0)
			{
				size2.Height = frm.MaximumSize.Height;
			}
			if (size2.Width > frm.MaximumSize.Width && frm.MaximumSize.Width > 0)
			{
				size2.Width = frm.MaximumSize.Width;
			}
			if (size2.Width < size.Width && size2.Height > 0)
			{
				size2.Width = size.Width;
			}
			if (size2.Height < size.Height && size2.Height > 0)
			{
				size2.Height = size.Height;
			}
			if (result.Height < size.Height)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					pt.Y += size.Height - result.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					pt.Y -= size.Height - result.Height;
					result.Y -= size.Height - result.Height;
				}
				result.Height = size.Height;
			}
			else if (result.Height > size2.Height && size2.Height > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					pt.Y += size2.Height - result.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					pt.Y -= size2.Height - result.Height;
					result.Y -= size2.Height - result.Height;
				}
				result.Height = size2.Height;
			}
			if (result.Width < size.Width)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					pt.X += size.Width - result.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					pt.X -= size.Width - result.Width;
					result.X -= size.Width - result.Width;
				}
				result.Width = size.Width;
			}
			else if (result.Width > size2.Width && size2.Width > 0)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					pt.X += size2.Width - result.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					pt.X -= size2.Width - result.Width;
					result.X -= size2.Width - result.Width;
				}
				result.Width = size2.Width;
			}
			previousPoint = lastPoint;
			lastPoint = pt;
			return result;
		}

		internal bool StartResize(Point pt, BorderEdge edge, Size minSize, Size maxSize)
		{
			if (resizeInProgress)
			{
				EndResize(pt, canceled: true);
			}
			if (edge == BorderEdge.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			resizeInProgress = true;
			this.edge = edge;
			lastRect = (rectOriginalRect = frm.Bounds);
			previousPoint = (lastPoint = pt);
			this.maxSize = maxSize;
			this.minSize = minSize;
			resizeWhileDragging = SystemInformation.DragFullWindows;
			DrawReversibleFrame(Rectangle.Empty, rectOriginalRect);
			return true;
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseMove(Point pt)
		{
			if (resizeInProgress)
			{
				Rectangle newRect = CalculateNewRect(pt);
				DrawReversibleFrame(lastRect, newRect);
				lastRect = newRect;
				if (resizeWhileDragging && (lastAsyncResult == null || lastAsyncResult.IsCompleted))
				{
					lastAsyncResult = frm.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(UpdateBounds));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBounds()
		{
			if (frm != null && resizeInProgress)
			{
				frm.Bounds = lastRect;
				frm.Update();
				Application.DoEvents();
			}
		}

		internal void EndResize(Point pt, bool canceled)
		{
			if (resizeInProgress)
			{
				DrawReversibleFrame(lastRect, Rectangle.Empty);
				resizeInProgress = false;
				if (canceled)
				{
					frm.Bounds = rectOriginalRect;
					frm.Update();
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle bounds = CalculateNewRect(pt);
					frm.Bounds = bounds;
					frm.Update();
				}
			}
		}

		[Conditional("OUTPUT_RESIZE_DATA")]
		private void Output(string message, params object[] variables)
		{
		}
	}

		internal FloatingWindowContainer()

		internal void Initialize(DockAreaPane dockArea)
		{
			UninstallHooks();
			this.dockArea = dockArea;
			manager = dockArea.Manager;
			SynchronizeDockAreaProperties();
			this.dockArea.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InstallHooks();
		}

		internal void SynchronizeDockAreaProperties()
		{
			if (dockArea == null || base.IsDisposed || base.Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			SynchronizeBounds(initialize: true);
			bool flag = Manager.IsFloatingWindowVisible(this);
			bool visible = base.Visible;
			if (visible && !flag && Manager.ActivePane != null && DockAreaPane != null && DockAreaPane.Contains(Manager.ActivePane, recursive: true))
			{
				try
				{
					Form owner = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
					if (owner != null && owner.CanSelect)
					{
						Utilities.ActivateForm(owner);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			base.Visible = flag;
			if (flag && !visible)
			{
				BringToFront();
			}
			base.Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)Manager).Enabled;
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			this.AutoScaleBaseSize = new System.Drawing.Size(5, 13);
			base.FormBorderStyle = System.Windows.Forms.FormBorderStyle.None;
			base.MaximizeBox = false;
			base.MinimizeBox = false;
			base.ControlBox = false;
			base.Name = "FloatingWindowContainer";
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			this.Text = "";
		}

		private void OnKeyHookMessage(object sender, KeyHookEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.EventType == KeyEventType.KeyDown && ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				ControlUIElement.ProcessKeyDown((KeyEventArgs)e);
			}
		}

		private void InstallHooks()
		{
			if (!hooksInstalled)
			{
				Form owner = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
				if (owner != null)
				{
					owner.FormClosed += FormClosedHandler;
				}
				if (Manager != null && Manager.IsDesignMode)
				{
					hooksInstalled = true;
					AddHook();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddHook()
		{
			KeyboardHookManager.KeyHook += OnKeyHookMessage;
		}

		private void RemoveHook()
		{
			KeyboardHookManager.KeyHook -= OnKeyHookMessage;
		}

		private void UninstallHooks()
		{
			Form owner = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.FormClosed -= FormClosedHandler;
			}
			if (hooksInstalled)
			{
				hooksInstalled = false;
				RemoveHook();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ControlUIElement != null && manager != null && !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)manager).IsUpdating)
			{
				SuspendLayout();
				((UIElement)ControlUIElement).Draw(pe.Graphics, pe.ClipRectangle, !GetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer), ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)manager).AlphaBlendMode);
				ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
			base.OnPaint(pe);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			UninstallHooks();
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		internal void EnsureCaptionIsVisible()
		{
			if (Manager == null || Manager.DragManager.IsDragging || !base.IsHandleCreated || !base.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			PaneCaptionUIElement mainCaptionElement = GetMainCaptionElement();
			if (mainCaptionElement == null || ((UIElement)mainCaptionElement).Control == null || ((UIElement)mainCaptionElement).Control.Left == -10000)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)mainCaptionElement).Rect, ((UIElement)mainCaptionElement).Control);
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle deskTopWorkArea = UIElement.GetDeskTopWorkArea(rectangle);
			if (!deskTopWorkArea.IntersectsWith(rectangle))
			{
				Rectangle bounds = base.Bounds;
				if (rectangle.Top < deskTopWorkArea.Top)
				{
					base.Top = deskTopWorkArea.Top;
				}
				else if (rectangle.Top >= deskTopWorkArea.Bottom)
				{
					base.Top = deskTopWorkArea.Bottom - bounds.Height;
				}
				else if (rectangle.Left < deskTopWorkArea.Left)
				{
					base.Left = deskTopWorkArea.Left;
				}
				else if (rectangle.Left >= deskTopWorkArea.Right)
				{
					base.Left = deskTopWorkArea.Right - bounds.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		private PaneCaptionUIElement GetMainCaptionElement()
		{
			if (DockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DockControlBase containingControl = DockAreaPane.ContainingControl;
			PaneCaptionUIElement captionElement = GetCaptionElement(containingControl);
			if (captionElement != null)
			{
				return captionElement;
			}
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
			DockablePaneBaseEnumerator dockablePaneBaseEnumerator = dockAreaPane.Panes.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (dockablePaneBaseEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DockablePaneBase current = dockablePaneBaseEnumerator.Current;
					switch (dockAreaPane.ChildPaneStyle)
					{
					case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
					{
						DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = dockAreaPane.SelectedTabPane;
						if (selectedTabPane == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return GetCaptionElement(selectedTabPane.ContainingControl);
					}
					case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
						return null;
					default:
						if (current is DockableControlPane)
						{
							if (!((Control)(object)containingControl).Contains((Control)(object)current.ContainingControl))
							{
								return null;
							}
							return GetCaptionElement(current.ContainingControl);
						}
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = dockablePaneBaseEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private PaneCaptionUIElement GetCaptionElement(DockControlBase control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!manager.IsLayoutSuspended && mainUIElement.ChildElementsDirty)
			{
				if (mainUIElement.Rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					mainUIElement.Rect = ((Control)(object)control).ClientRectangle;
				}
				mainUIElement.VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
			return mainUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(PaneCaptionUIElement)) as PaneCaptionUIElement;
		}

		protected override void OnLocationChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (DockAreaPane != null)
			{
				if (!synchronizing)
				{
					synchronizing = true;
					EnsureCaptionIsVisible();
					DockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = base.Location;
					synchronizing = false;
				}
				else
				{
					DockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = base.Location;
				}
			}
			base.OnLocationChanged(e);
		}

		private Size AddFrameSize(Size size)
		{
			Size frameSize = FrameSize;
			size.Width += frameSize.Width * 2;
			size.Height += frameSize.Height * 2;
			return size;
		}

		private Size RemoveFrameSize(Size size)
		{
			Size frameSize = FrameSize;
			size.Width -= frameSize.Width * 2;
			size.Height -= frameSize.Height * 2;
			return size;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateBounds()
		{
			if (DockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return base.Bounds;
			}
			Size size = DockAreaPane.Size;
			size = AddFrameSize(size);
			return new Rectangle(base.Location, size);
		}

		private void SynchronizeBounds(bool initialize)
		{
			if (synchronizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			synchronizing = true;
			Point floatingLocation = DockAreaPane.FloatingLocation;
			if (initialize)
			{
				if (floatingLocation == DockAreaPane.FloatingLocationDefault)
				{
					base.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.WindowsDefaultLocation;
				}
				else
				{
					base.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
				}
			}
			Size size = DockAreaPane.Size;
			size = AddFrameSize(size);
			bool flag = floatingLocation != base.Location;
			bool flag2 = base.Size != size;
			if (!DockAreaPane.HasVisibleChildControlPane)
			{
				flag = (flag2 = false);
			}
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(floatingLocation, size);
				if (base.Bounds != base.ClientRectangle && (base.IsRestrictedWindow || base.IsHandleCreated || base.FormBorderStyle != FormBorderStyle.None))
				{
					bounds.Width += base.Width - base.ClientSize.Width;
					bounds.Height += base.Height - base.ClientSize.Height;
				}
				base.Bounds = bounds;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				base.Location = floatingLocation;
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				base.ClientSize = size;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				EnsureCaptionIsVisible();
			}
			synchronizing = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			SynchronizeDockAreaProperties();
		}

		protected override void OnSizeChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSizeChanged(e);
			if (!synchronizing && DockAreaPane != null && !creatingHandle)
			{
				Size frameSize = FrameSize;
				Size size = base.Size;
				size.Width -= frameSize.Width * 2;
				size.Height -= frameSize.Height * 2;
				if (size.Width < 0)
				{
					size.Width = 0;
				}
				if (size.Height < 0)
				{
					size.Height = 0;
				}
				DockAreaPane.Size = size;
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateHandle()
		{
			Rectangle bounds = CalculateBounds();
			bool flag = synchronizing;
			synchronizing = true;
			creatingHandle = true;
			try
			{
				SuspendLayout();
				base.CreateHandle();
				ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Bounds = bounds;
				synchronizing = flag;
				creatingHandle = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnActivated(e);
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
			EnsureCaptionIsVisible();
			if (ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)ControlUIElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDeactivate(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnDeactivate(e);
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
			if (ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)ControlUIElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == (Keys.F4 | Keys.Alt))
			{
				Form form = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
				if (form != null)
				{
					Form mdiParent = Utilities.GetMdiParent(form);
					if (mdiParent != null)
					{
						form = mdiParent;
					}
					NativeWindowMethods.CloseForm(form);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}

		private static Rectangle RectangleToScreen(Rectangle controlRect, Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Point location = controlRect.Location;
				while (control != null)
				{
					location.X += control.Left;
					location.Y += control.Top;
					control = control.Parent;
				}
				controlRect.Location = location;
				return controlRect;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return control.RectangleToScreen(controlRect);
			}
		}

		private void OnParentFormClosed(object sender, FormClosedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.TriggerSaveComponentSettings();
			}
		}

		void IReceiveMouseMessage.MouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseDown(e);
		}

		void IReceiveMouseMessage.MouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		void IReceiveMouseMessage.MouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		void IReceiveMouseMessage.DoubleClick(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnDoubleClick(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnHandleCreated(e);
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.ResetTreeToolTips(this);
			}
		}

	internal class FloatingWindowContainerEx : FloatingWindowContainer
	{
		protected override bool IsFullTrust => true;

		internal FloatingWindowContainerEx()
		{
		}

		protected override void WndProc(ref Message message)
		{
			if (message.Msg == 36)
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
				NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO mINMAXINFO = (NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(message.LParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO));
				Size captionButtonSize = SystemInformation.CaptionButtonSize;
				mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT(captionButtonSize.Width, captionButtonSize.Height);
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)mINMAXINFO, message.LParam, fDeleteOld: true);
				message.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			else if (message.Msg == 33)
			{
				Form owner = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
				if (owner != null && owner.IsMdiChild)
				{
					owner.Activate();
				}
			}
			else if (message.Msg == 28)
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
				if (base.Manager != null)
				{
					base.Manager.SyncFloatingPaneVisibilityWithFormActive();
				}
			}
			else if (message.Msg == 262)
			{
				Form owner2 = Utilities.GetOwner(this);
				if (owner2 != null && message.WParam.ToInt32() == 32)
				{
					owner2.Activate();
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(owner2.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(61696), message.WParam);
				}
				else
				{
					base.WndProc(ref message);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
			}
		}
	}

		public object Clone()
		{
			GroupSettings groupSettings = new GroupSettings();
			groupSettings.InitializeFrom(this);
			return groupSettings;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeTabAreaAppearance()
		{
			if (HasTabAreaAppearance)
			{
				return tabAreaAppearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetTabAreaAppearance()
		{
			if (HasTabAreaAppearance)
			{
				tabAreaAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.TabAreaAppearance);
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCloseButtonLocation()
		{
			return CloseButtonLocation != CloseButtonLocation.Default;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetCloseButtonLocation()
		{
			CloseButtonLocation = CloseButtonLocation.Default;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CaptionLocation == Location.Default && CloseButtonBehavior == CloseButtonBehavior.Default && PinButtonBehavior == PinButtonBehavior.Default && (int)SlidingGroupButtonStyle == 0 && TabLocation == Location.Default && (int)TabSizing == 0 && !ShouldSerializeTabAreaAppearance() && SlidingGroupOrientation == DefaultableOrientation.Default && (int)TabStyle == 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeCloseButtonLocation();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetTabAreaAppearance();
			ResetTag();
			CaptionLocation = Location.Default;
			CloseButtonBehavior = CloseButtonBehavior.Default;
			PinButtonBehavior = PinButtonBehavior.Default;
			SlidingGroupButtonStyle = (UIElementButtonStyle)0;
			SlidingGroupOrientation = DefaultableOrientation.Default;
			TabLocation = Location.Default;
			TabSizing = (TabSizing)0;
			TabStyle = (TabStyle)0;
			ResetCloseButtonLocation();
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraDockManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != this.manager)
			{
				this.manager = manager;
			}
		}

		protected internal void InitializeFrom(GroupSettings source)
		{
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Reset();
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (source.HasTabAreaAppearance)
				{
					AppearanceBase tabAreaAppearance = TabAreaAppearance;
					tabAreaAppearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(source.tabAreaAppearanceHolder);
				}
				else if (HasTabAreaAppearance)
				{
					tabAreaAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				}
				captionLocation = source.CaptionLocation;
				closeButtonBehavior = source.CloseButtonBehavior;
				closeButtonLocation = source.CloseButtonLocation;
				pinButtonBehavior = source.PinButtonBehavior;
				slidingGroupButtonStyle = source.SlidingGroupButtonStyle;
				slidingGroupOrientation = source.SlidingGroupOrientation;
				tabLocation = source.TabLocation;
				tabSizing = source.TabSizing;
				tabStyle = source.TabStyle;
				if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
				{
					tagValue = source.Tag;
				}
			}
		}

					((UltraComponentBase)manager).PropertyChanged -= new PropertyChangedEventHandler(OnDockManagerPropertyChanged);
					manager.OnMdiChildDisposed(this);
				}
				if (pane != null)
				{
					pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= OnSubObjectPropChanged;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (pane != null && isUserClosingForm)
			{
				isUserClosingForm = false;
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.AfterPaneButtonClick, new PaneButtonEventArgs(Pane, PaneButton.Close));
				}
			}
		}

		void ICustomMdiTab.InitializeMenu(ContextMenuManager menu)
		{
			//IL_015a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0160: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (dockableMenuItem == null)
			{
				dockableMenuItem = ((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(string.Empty, (EventHandler)OnMenuItemDockableClicked);
			}
			else if (!((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems).Contains((object)dockableMenuItem))
			{
				((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(dockableMenuItem);
			}
			dockableMenuItem.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuDockable");
			if (hideMenuItem == null)
			{
				hideMenuItem = ((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(string.Empty, (EventHandler)OnMenuItemHideClicked);
			}
			else if (!((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems).Contains((object)hideMenuItem))
			{
				((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(hideMenuItem);
			}
			hideMenuItem.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuHide");
			hideMenuItem.Enabled = Pane.IsButtonEnabled(PaneButton.Close);
			if (floatingMenuItem == null)
			{
				floatingMenuItem = ((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(string.Empty, (EventHandler)OnMenuItemFloatingClicked);
			}
			else if (!((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems).Contains((object)floatingMenuItem))
			{
				((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.Add(floatingMenuItem);
			}
			floatingMenuItem.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuFloating");
			floatingMenuItem.Enabled = (int)Pane.SettingsResolved.AllowFloating == 1;
			((ContextMenuItemBase)menu).MenuItems.AddSeparator();
		}

	public class MdiChildForm : MdiChildFormBase
	{
		protected override bool IsFullTrust => true;

		internal MdiChildForm(DockableControlPane pane, UltraDockManager manager)
			: base(pane, manager)
		{
		}

		protected override void WndProc(ref Message message)
		{
			if (message.Msg == 165)
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
				if (ContextMenuManager.HasWindowsFormsContextMenu((Control)this) && !base.Disposing && !base.IsDisposed)
				{
					int num = message.LParam.ToInt32();
					int num2 = num & 0xFFFF;
					int num3 = num >> 16;
					Point point = PointToClient(new Point(num2, num3));
					if (base.Manager != null)
					{
						base.Manager.ContextMenu.Show((Control)this, point);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (message.Msg == 36)
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
				Size actualMinimumSize = base.Pane.ActualMinimumSize;
				Size actualMaximumSize = base.Pane.ActualMaximumSize;
				if (actualMinimumSize.IsEmpty && actualMaximumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					message.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
					return;
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO mINMAXINFO = (NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(message.LParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.MINMAXINFO));
				int dwStyle = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(base.Handle, -16).ToInt64();
				int dwExStyle = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(base.Handle, -20).ToInt64();
				bool bMenu = ContextMenuManager.HasWindowsFormsMainMenu((Form)this);
				if (!actualMinimumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect = NativeWindowMethods.RECT.FromLTWH(0, 0, actualMinimumSize.Width, actualMinimumSize.Height);
					NativeWindowMethods.AdjustWindowRectEx(ref lpRect, dwStyle, bMenu, dwExStyle);
					mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT((actualMinimumSize.Width == 0) ? mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize.X : (lpRect.Right - lpRect.Left), (actualMinimumSize.Height == 0) ? mINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize.Y : (lpRect.Bottom - lpRect.Top));
				}
				if (!actualMaximumSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect2 = NativeWindowMethods.RECT.FromLTWH(0, 0, actualMaximumSize.Width, actualMaximumSize.Height);
					NativeWindowMethods.AdjustWindowRectEx(ref lpRect2, dwStyle, bMenu, dwExStyle);
					mINMAXINFO.ptMaxTrackSize = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT((actualMaximumSize.Width == 0) ? mINMAXINFO.ptMaxTrackSize.X : (lpRect2.Right - lpRect2.Left), (actualMaximumSize.Height == 0) ? mINMAXINFO.ptMaxTrackSize.Y : (lpRect2.Bottom - lpRect2.Top));
				}
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)mINMAXINFO, message.LParam, fDeleteOld: true);
				message.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			else
			{
				base.WndProc(ref message);
			}
		}
	}

			internal RECT rectProposed;

			internal RECT rectClientBeforeMove;

			internal IntPtr ptrWindowPos;
		}

		internal struct POINT
		{
			internal int X;

			internal int Y;

			internal Point Point => new Point(X, Y);

			internal POINT(int x, int y)
			{
				X = x;
				Y = y;
			}

			internal static POINT FromPoint(Point point)
			{
				return new POINT(point.X, point.Y);
			}
		}

		internal struct RECT
		{
			internal int Left;

			internal int Top;

			internal int Right;

			internal int Bottom;

			internal Rectangle ToRectangle()
			{
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(Left, Top, Right, Bottom);
			}

			internal static RECT FromLTRB(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
			{
				return new RECT
				{
					Left = left,
					Top = top,
					Right = right,
					Bottom = bottom
				};
			}

			internal static RECT FromLTWH(int left, int top, int width, int height)
			{
				return new RECT
				{
					Left = left,
					Top = top,
					Right = left + width,
					Bottom = top + height
				};
			}

			public static RECT FromRectangle(Rectangle rect)
			{
				return FromLTRB(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Right, rect.Bottom);
			}
		}

		private static IntPtr PatternBrush
		{
			get
			{
				if (patternBrush == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Application.ApplicationExit += OnApplicationExit;
					IntPtr intPtr = CreateBitmap(8, 8, 1, 1, new short[8] { 85, 170, 85, 170, 85, 170, 85, 170 });
					patternBrush = CreatePatternBrush(intPtr);
					DeleteObject(intPtr);
				}
				return patternBrush;
			}
		}

		internal static Color ActiveCaptionGradient
		{
			get
			{
				if (!supportsGradientCaption)
				{
					return Color.Empty;
				}
				return GetSystemColor(27);
			}
		}

		internal static Color InactiveCaptionGradient
		{
			get
			{
				if (!supportsGradientCaption)
				{
					return Color.Empty;
				}
				return GetSystemColor(28);
			}
		}

		static NativeWindowMethods()
		{

			supportsGradientCaption = false;
			HWND_TOP = new IntPtr(0);
			HWND_BOTTOM = new IntPtr(1);
			HWND_TOPMOST = new IntPtr(-1);
			HWND_NOTOPMOST = new IntPtr(-2);
			OperatingSystem oSVersion = Environment.OSVersion;
			if (oSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32Windows)
			{
				supportsGradientCaption = oSVersion.Version.Major >= 4;
			}
			else if (oSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				supportsGradientCaption = oSVersion.Version.Major >= 5;
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		internal static void DrawReversibleFrame(Rectangle rect, int width, Rectangle previousRect, Control parentControl)
		{
			if (width == 0 || rect == previousRect)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Rectangle[] rects;
				if (rect.IsEmpty || previousRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					rects = (rect.IsEmpty ? GetRects(previousRect, width) : GetRects(rect, width));
				}
				else
				{
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(GetRects(rect, width));
					ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList(GetRects(previousRect, width));
					for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
					{
						Rectangle rect2 = (Rectangle)arrayList[i];
						for (int j = 0; j < arrayList2.Count; j++)
						{
							if (TryGetDifferences(rect2, (Rectangle)arrayList2[j], out var differenceRects))
							{
								arrayList.AddRange(differenceRects);
								arrayList.RemoveAt(i);
								i--;
								arrayList2.RemoveAt(j);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					arrayList.AddRange(arrayList2);
					rects = (Rectangle[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(Rectangle));
				}
				DrawReversibleFrameAPI(rects, parentControl);
			}
			catch
			{
				if (!previousRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rectangle[] rects2 = GetRects(previousRect, width);
					Rectangle[] array = rects2;
					foreach (Rectangle rectangle in array)
					{
						ControlPaint.FillReversibleRectangle(rectangle, SystemColors.Control);
					}
				}
				if (!rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rectangle[] rects3 = GetRects(rect, width);
					Rectangle[] array2 = rects3;
					foreach (Rectangle rectangle2 in array2)
					{
						ControlPaint.FillReversibleRectangle(rectangle2, SystemColors.Control);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Region GetTabRegion(Rectangle screenRect, int width, Location location, bool rightToLeft)
		{
			screenRect.Location = Point.Empty;
			Rectangle[] tabRects = GetTabRects(screenRect, width, location);
			if (tabRects.Length < 4)
			{
				return new Region(screenRect);
			}
			if (rightToLeft)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < tabRects.Length; i++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = tabRects[i];
					UIElementDrawParams.MirrorRect(screenRect, ref rectangle, false);
					tabRects[i] = rectangle;
				}
			}
			Rectangle rectangle2 = tabRects[0];
			for (int j = 1; j < 4; j++)
			{
				Rectangle b = tabRects[j];
				rectangle2 = Rectangle.Union(rectangle2, b);
			}
			Region region = new Region(rectangle2);
			if (tabRects.Length < 5)
			{
				return region;
			}
			rectangle2 = tabRects[5];
			for (int k = 6; k < tabRects.Length; k++)
			{
				Rectangle b2 = tabRects[k];
				rectangle2 = Rectangle.Union(rectangle2, b2);
			}
			region.Union(rectangle2);
			return region;
		}

		internal static void CloseForm(Form form)
		{
			if (form != null && form.IsHandleCreated && !form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed)
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				try
				{
					securityPermission.Demand();
				}
				catch
				{
					form.Close();
					return;
				}
				SendMessageApi(form.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(61536), IntPtr.Zero);
			}
		}

		internal static bool SetRedraw(Control control, bool newValue, bool redraw)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!control.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				IntPtr handle = control.Handle;
				if (!newValue && !IsWindowVisibleApi(handle))
				{
					return false;
				}
				SendMessageApi(handle, 11, newValue ? new IntPtr(1) : IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
				if (newValue && redraw)
				{
					RECT rectUpdate = RECT.FromRectangle(control.ClientRectangle);
					RedrawWindowApi(handle, ref rectUpdate, IntPtr.Zero, 1671u);
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsLeftButtonDown()
		{
			try
			{
				int vKey = ((!SystemInformation.MouseButtonsSwapped) ? 1 : 2);
				return (GetAsyncKeyStateApi(vKey) & 0x10000) != 0;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return (Control.MouseButtons & MouseButtons.Left) == MouseButtons.Left;
			}
		}

		internal static IntPtr AddBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToRemove)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() | bitsToRemove);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() | (uint)bitsToRemove);
		}

		internal static bool AreBitsPresent(IntPtr ptr, int bits)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return (ptr.ToInt32() & bits) != 0;
			}
			return (ptr.ToInt64() & bits) != 0;
		}

		internal static IntPtr RemoveBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToRemove)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() & ~bitsToRemove);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() & ~bitsToRemove);
		}

		}

		internal static Rectangle[] GetTabRects(Rectangle rect, int lineWidth, Location location)
		{
			if (lineWidth <= 0)
			{
				return GetRects(rect, lineWidth);
			}
			int height = rect.Height;
			int width = rect.Width;
			int num = 18;
			int num2 = 44;
			int num3 = lineWidth * 2;
			bool flag = location == Location.Left || location == Location.Right;
			if (flag)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(44, height - num3);
				num = width - (num3 + 2);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(44, width - num3);
				num = height - (num3 + 2);
			}
			if ((flag ? height : width) - num2 < num3 * 2)
			{
				num2 = Math.Max(num3 + 1, num2 - (num2 - lineWidth) / 2);
			}
			if (num >= lineWidth + 10)
			{
				num = lineWidth + 10;
			}
			else if (num >= (flag ? width : height) - (num + lineWidth))
			{
				num -= (num - lineWidth) / 2;
			}
			if (num <= 0 || num2 <= num3 || num2 >= (flag ? height : width) - num3)
			{
				return GetRects(rect, lineWidth);
			}
			Rectangle[] array = new Rectangle[8];
			int num4 = 0;
			switch (location)
			{
			case Location.Left:
				array[0] = new Rectangle(rect.X + num, rect.Y, rect.Width - num, lineWidth);
				array[1] = new Rectangle(rect.Right - lineWidth, rect.Y + lineWidth, lineWidth, rect.Height - num3);
				array[2] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth + num, rect.Bottom - lineWidth, rect.Width - (lineWidth + num), lineWidth);
				array[3] = new Rectangle(array[0].X, array[0].Y + lineWidth, lineWidth, lineWidth);
				num4 = num3 + num2;
				if (height - num4 > 0)
				{
					array[4] = new Rectangle(array[3].X, array[3].Bottom + num2, lineWidth, height - num4);
				}
				array[5] = new Rectangle(rect.X, array[3].Bottom, num + lineWidth, lineWidth);
				array[6] = new Rectangle(rect.X, array[5].Bottom, lineWidth, num2 - num3);
				array[7] = new Rectangle(rect.X, array[6].Bottom, num + lineWidth, lineWidth);
				break;
			case Location.Right:
				array[0] = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, lineWidth, rect.Height);
				array[1] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Y, rect.Width - (num + lineWidth), lineWidth);
				array[2] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Bottom - lineWidth, rect.Width - (num3 + num), lineWidth);
				array[3] = new Rectangle(rect.Right - (num + lineWidth), rect.Top + lineWidth, lineWidth, lineWidth);
				num4 = num3 + num2;
				if (height - num4 > 0)
				{
					array[4] = new Rectangle(array[3].X, array[3].Bottom + num2, lineWidth, height - num4);
				}
				array[5] = new Rectangle(array[3].X, array[3].Bottom, num + lineWidth, lineWidth);
				array[6] = new Rectangle(rect.Right - lineWidth, array[5].Bottom, lineWidth, num2 - num3);
				array[7] = new Rectangle(array[3].X, array[6].Bottom, num + lineWidth, lineWidth);
				break;
			case Location.Top:
				array[0] = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y + num, lineWidth, rect.Height - num);
				array[1] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Bottom - lineWidth, rect.Width - lineWidth, lineWidth);
				array[2] = new Rectangle(rect.Right - lineWidth, rect.Y + num + lineWidth, lineWidth, rect.Height - (num + num3));
				array[3] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Y + num, lineWidth, lineWidth);
				num4 = num3 + num2;
				if (width - num4 > 0)
				{
					array[4] = new Rectangle(rect.X + num4, array[3].Y, width - num4, lineWidth);
				}
				array[5] = new Rectangle(rect.X + num3, rect.Y, lineWidth, num + lineWidth);
				array[6] = new Rectangle(array[5].Right, array[5].Top, num2 - num3, lineWidth);
				array[7] = new Rectangle(array[6].Right, array[5].Top, lineWidth, num + lineWidth);
				break;
			default:
				array[0] = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, lineWidth, rect.Height - num);
				array[1] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Y, rect.Width - lineWidth, lineWidth);
				array[2] = new Rectangle(rect.Right - lineWidth, rect.Y + lineWidth, lineWidth, rect.Height - (num + num3));
				array[3] = new Rectangle(rect.X + lineWidth, rect.Bottom - (num + lineWidth), lineWidth, lineWidth);
				num4 = num3 + num2;
				if (width - num4 > 0)
				{
					array[4] = new Rectangle(rect.X + num4, array[3].Y, width - num4, lineWidth);
				}
				array[5] = new Rectangle(rect.X + num3, array[3].Y, lineWidth, num + lineWidth);
				array[6] = new Rectangle(array[5].Right, array[5].Bottom - lineWidth, num2 - num3, lineWidth);
				array[7] = new Rectangle(array[6].Right, array[3].Y, lineWidth, num + lineWidth);
				break;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static Rectangle[] GetRects(Rectangle rect, int width)
		{
			if (rect.Width <= width * 2 || rect.Height <= width * 2)
			{
				return new Rectangle[1] { rect };
			}
			return new Rectangle[4]
			{
				new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, width),
				new Rectangle(rect.Right - width, rect.Y + width, width, rect.Height - width * 2),
				new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Bottom - width, rect.Width, width),
				new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y + width, width, rect.Height - width * 2)
			};
		}

		private static bool DrawReversibleFrameAPI(Rectangle[] rects, Control parentControl)
		{
			if (rects == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IntPtr hwnd = parentControl?.Handle ?? IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr hObject = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dCEx = GetDCEx(hwnd, IntPtr.Zero, 1026);
			if (dCEx == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			try
			{
				hObject = SelectObject(dCEx, PatternBrush);
				foreach (Rectangle rectangle in rects)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = parentControl?.RectangleToClient(rectangle) ?? rectangle;
					PatBlt(dCEx, rectangle2.X, rectangle2.Y, rectangle2.Width, rectangle2.Height, 5898313);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				SelectObject(dCEx, hObject);
				ReleaseDC(hwnd, dCEx);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void DrawReversibleFrameAPI(Rectangle rect, int width, Control parentControl)
		{
			Rectangle[] rects = GetRects(rect, width);
			DrawReversibleFrameAPI(rects, parentControl);
		}

		private static void ResetTreeToolTipsAPI(TreeView tree)
		{
			IntPtr handle = tree.Handle;
			IntPtr windowLong = GetWindowLong(handle, -16);
			if (!AreBitsPresent(windowLong, 128))
			{
				SetWindowLong(handle, -16, AddBits(windowLong, 128));
				SetWindowLong(handle, -16, RemoveBits(windowLong, 128));
			}
		}

		private static bool TryGetDifferences(Rectangle rect1, Rectangle rect2, out Rectangle[] differenceRects)
		{
			if (rect1.Equals(rect2))
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[0];
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Left == rect2.Left && rect1.Top == rect2.Top && rect1.Right == rect2.Right)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[1]
				{
					new Rectangle(rect1.X, Math.Min(rect1.Bottom, rect2.Bottom), rect1.Width, Math.Abs(rect1.Height - rect2.Height))
				};
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Left == rect2.Left && rect1.Top == rect2.Top && rect1.Bottom == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[1]
				{
					new Rectangle(Math.Min(rect1.Right, rect2.Right), rect1.Y, Math.Abs(rect1.Width - rect2.Width), rect1.Height)
				};
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Left == rect2.Left && rect1.Right == rect2.Right && rect1.Bottom == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[1]
				{
					new Rectangle(rect1.X, Math.Min(rect1.Top, rect2.Top), rect1.Width, Math.Abs(rect1.Height - rect2.Height))
				};
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Top == rect2.Top && rect1.Right == rect2.Right && rect1.Bottom == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[1]
				{
					new Rectangle(Math.Min(rect1.Left, rect2.Left), rect1.Y, Math.Abs(rect1.Width - rect2.Width), rect1.Height)
				};
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Left == rect2.Left && rect1.Right == rect2.Right)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[2]
				{
					new Rectangle(rect1.X, Math.Min(rect1.Top, rect2.Top), rect1.Width, Math.Abs(rect1.Top - rect2.Top)),
					new Rectangle(rect1.X, Math.Min(rect1.Bottom, rect2.Bottom), rect1.Width, Math.Abs(rect1.Bottom - rect2.Bottom))
				};
				return true;
			}
			if (rect1.Top == rect2.Top && rect1.Bottom == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				differenceRects = new Rectangle[2]
				{
					new Rectangle(Math.Min(rect1.Right, rect2.Right), rect1.Y, Math.Abs(rect1.Right - rect2.Right), rect1.Height),
					new Rectangle(Math.Min(rect1.Left, rect2.Left), rect1.Y, Math.Abs(rect1.Left - rect2.Left), rect1.Height)
				};
				return true;
			}
			differenceRects = new Rectangle[0];
			return false;
		}
	}
