				BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(CloseFormHelper));
			}
			else
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnHandleCreated(e);
			SetRoundedBorderRegion();
			BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(SetInitialSelectedIndexAsync));
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			if (requireCtrlKeyDown && (e.KeyData & Keys.Control) != Keys.Control)
			{
				FireSelectedItemActivated();
				Close();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPaint(e);
			((UIElement)ControlElement).Rect = base.ClientRectangle;
			((UIElement)ControlElement).Draw(e.Graphics, e.ClipRectangle, true, (AlphaBlendMode)2);
		}

		protected override void OnShown(EventArgs e)
		{
			shadowManager.Show();
			base.OnShown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnSizeChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSizeChanged(e);
			SetRoundedBorderRegion();
		}

		private Size CalculateFormSize(bool constrained)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MaxValue;
			int num3 = int.MinValue;
			int num4 = int.MinValue;
			foreach (Control control in ((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls)
			{
				if (!(control is NavigatorDescriptionBox) && !(control is NavigatorPreviewPanel) && control != listHeaderLabelPanel)
				{
					if (control.Left < num)
					{
						num = control.Left;
					}
					if (control.Top < num2)
					{
						num2 = control.Top;
					}
					if (control.Right > num3)
					{
						num3 = control.Right;
					}
					if (control.Bottom > num4)
					{
						num4 = control.Bottom;
					}
				}
			}
			if (listHeaderLabelPanel != null)
			{
				num4 += listHeaderLabelPanel.Height;
			}
			if (HasDescriptionBox)
			{
				num4 += ((Control)(object)descriptionBox).Height;
			}
			if (footerPanel != null)
			{
				num4 += ((Control)(object)footerPanel).Height;
			}
			if (headerPanel != null)
			{
				num4 += ((Control)(object)headerPanel).Height;
			}
			if (previewPanel != null)
			{
				int num5 = 210;
				if (descriptionBox != null)
				{
					num5 += ((Control)(object)descriptionBox).Height;
				}
				if (footerPanel != null)
				{
					num5 += ((Control)(object)footerPanel).Height;
				}
				if (headerPanel != null)
				{
					num5 += ((Control)(object)headerPanel).Height;
				}
				if (listHeaderLabelPanel != null)
				{
					num5 += listHeaderLabelPanel.Height;
				}
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, num2 + num5);
				num3 += previewPanel.Width;
			}
			Rectangle b = Rectangle.FromLTRB(num, num2, num3, num4);
			b.Inflate(1, 1);
			if (!constrained)
			{
				return b.Size;
			}
			Rectangle bounds = Utilities.ScreenFromRectangle(base.DesktopBounds).Bounds;
			return Rectangle.Intersect(bounds, b).Size;
		}

		private void CloseFormHelper()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposed && !base.Disposing)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		private NavigatorDescriptionBox CreateDescriptionBox()
		{
			NavigatorDescriptionBox navigatorDescriptionBox = new NavigatorDescriptionBox(this);
			((Control)(object)navigatorDescriptionBox).Height = GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Header) + GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Body) + GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Body2) + 60;
			return navigatorDescriptionBox;
		}

		private NavigatorPanel CreateFooterPanel()
		{
			NavigatorPanel navigatorPanel = new NavigatorPanel(this, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorDialogFooter);
			((Control)(object)navigatorPanel).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
			((Control)(object)navigatorPanel).Height = GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Body2) + 16;
			return navigatorPanel;
		}

		private NavigatorLabel CreateHeaderLabel(string caption, bool bold)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			NavigatorLabel navigatorLabel = new NavigatorLabel(dockManager, caption);
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			if (navigatorLabel != null)
			{
				navigatorLabel.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				Font font = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(Font);
				bool flag = font != null;
				if (!flag)
				{
					font = Font;
				}
				((Control)(object)navigatorLabel).Height = font.Height + 6;
				if (flag)
				{
					font.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return navigatorLabel;
		}

		private NavigatorPanel CreateHeaderPanel()
		{
			NavigatorPanel navigatorPanel = new NavigatorPanel(this, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorDialogHeader);
			((Control)(object)navigatorPanel).Dock = DockStyle.Top;
			((Control)(object)navigatorPanel).Height = GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Header) + GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType.Body) + 30;
			return navigatorPanel;
		}

		private NavigatorList CreateNavigatorList(ValueList items, int maxColumns, int maxItemsPerColumn)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			NavigatorList navigatorList = new NavigatorList(this, maxColumns, maxItemsPerColumn);
			object[] all = ((SubObjectsCollectionBase)(object)items.ValueListItems).All;
			items.ValueListItems.Clear();
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ValueListItem val = (ValueListItem)array[i];
				navigatorList.Items.ValueListItems.Add(val);
			}
			((Control)(object)navigatorList).Size = new Size(9999, 9999);
			((Control)(object)navigatorList).KeyDown += OnNavigatorListKeyDown;
			navigatorList.SelectedIndexChanged += OnNavigatorListSelectedIndexChanged;
			navigatorList.SelectedItemActivated += OnNavigatorListSelectedItemActivated;
			return navigatorList;
		}

		internal static StyleUtils.Role DescriptionTypeToStyleRole(NavigatorDescriptionType descriptionType)
		{
			return descriptionType switch
			{
				NavigatorDescriptionType.Body2 => StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorItemDescBody2, 
				NavigatorDescriptionType.Header => StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorItemDescHeader, 
				_ => StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorItemDescBody, 
			};
		}

		private void FireSelectedIndexChanged()
		{
			if (this.SelectedIndexChanged != null)
			{
				this.SelectedIndexChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void FireSelectedItemActivated()
		{
			if (this.SelectedItemActivated != null)
			{
				this.SelectedItemActivated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private int GetItemDescriptionFontHeight(NavigatorDescriptionType descriptionType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveItemDescriptionAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, descriptionType);
			Font font = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(Font);
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				if (font == null)
				{
					font = Font;
					flag = false;
				}
				return font.Height;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					font.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetItemIndexFromMdiChild(Form mdiChild)
		{
			if (HasMdiList)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < navListMdi.ItemCount; i++)
				{
					if (navListMdi.Items.ValueListItems[i].DataValue == mdiChild)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetItemIndexFromPane(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (HasPaneList)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < navListPanes.ItemCount; i++)
				{
					if (navListPanes.Items.ValueListItems[i].DataValue == pane)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private NavigatorList GetNavigatorListFromItem(ValueListItem item)
		{
			if (navListMdi != null && navListMdi.Items == item.ValueList)
			{
				return navListMdi;
			}
			if (navListPanes != null && navListPanes.Items == item.ValueList)
			{
				return navListPanes;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void LoadControls(ValueList panes, ValueList mdiChildren, NavigatorSettings navSettings)
		{
			mainAreaPanel = new NavigatorPanel(this, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorDialog);
			((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel);
			listHeaderLabelPanel = new Panel();
			listHeaderLabelPanel.Dock = DockStyle.Top;
			listHeaderLabelPanel.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
			((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls.Add(listHeaderLabelPanel);
			if (panes != null && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)panes.ValueListItems).Count > 0)
			{
				navListPanes = CreateNavigatorList(panes, navSettings.PaneListMaxColumns, navSettings.MaxItemsPerColumn);
				((Control)(object)navListPanes).Name = "Panes NavigatorList";
				((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls.Add((Control)(object)navListPanes);
				headerLabelPane = CreateHeaderLabel(navSettings.PaneListCaption, bold: true);
				listHeaderLabelPanel.Controls.Add((Control)(object)headerLabelPane);
			}
			if (mdiChildren != null && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)mdiChildren.ValueListItems).Count > 0)
			{
				navListMdi = CreateNavigatorList(mdiChildren, navSettings.MdiListMaxColumns, navSettings.MaxItemsPerColumn);
				((Control)(object)navListMdi).Name = "MDI Children NavigatorList";
				((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls.Add((Control)(object)navListMdi);
				headerLabelMdi = CreateHeaderLabel(navSettings.MdiListCaption, bold: true);
				listHeaderLabelPanel.Controls.Add((Control)(object)headerLabelMdi);
			}
			if (!HasMdiList && !HasPaneList)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Math.Max((headerLabelPane != null) ? ((Control)(object)headerLabelPane).Height : 0, (headerLabelMdi != null) ? ((Control)(object)headerLabelMdi).Height : 0);
			listHeaderLabelPanel.Height = num;
			if (navSettings.IsPreviewVisibleResolved)
			{
				previewPanel = new NavigatorPreviewPanel(this);
				previewPanel.Dock = DockStyle.Right;
				previewPanel.Width = 213;
				((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls.Add(previewPanel);
				previewPanel.BringToFront();
			}
			switch (navSettings.ItemDescriptionLocationResolved)
			{
			case NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.BelowLists:
				descriptionBox = CreateDescriptionBox();
				((Control)(object)descriptionBox).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
				((Control)(object)descriptionBox).Name = "Description Box";
				((Control)(object)mainAreaPanel).Controls.Add((Control)(object)descriptionBox);
				break;
			case NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.HeaderAndFooter:
				footerPanel = CreateFooterPanel();
				base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)footerPanel);
				headerPanel = CreateHeaderPanel();
				base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)headerPanel);
				break;
			}
			base.DesktopBounds = Utilities.ScreenFromRectangle(base.DesktopBounds).Bounds;
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			Point location = empty;
			location.Offset(0, listHeaderLabelPanel.Height);
			if (HasPaneList)
			{
				((Control)(object)navListPanes).Location = location;
				location.Offset(navListPanes.AutoFit().Width, 0);
				((Control)(object)headerLabelPane).Location = empty;
				((Control)(object)headerLabelPane).Width = ((Control)(object)navListPanes).Width;
				empty.Offset(((Control)(object)headerLabelPane).Width, 0);
			}
			if (HasMdiList)
			{
				((Control)(object)navListMdi).Location = location;
				navListMdi.AutoFit();
				((Control)(object)headerLabelMdi).Location = empty;
				((Control)(object)headerLabelMdi).Width = ((Control)(object)navListMdi).Width;
			}
			MinimumSize = new Size(1, 1);
			Size size = CalculateFormSize(constrained: false);
			Size size2 = CalculateFormSize(constrained: true);
			int num2 = size.Width - size2.Width;
			if (0 < num2)
			{
				if (HasMdiList)
				{
					((Control)(object)navListMdi).Width -= num2;
					navListMdi.AutoFit(constrained: true);
					((Control)(object)headerLabelMdi).Width = ((Control)(object)navListMdi).Width;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)navListPanes).Width -= num2;
					navListPanes.AutoFit(constrained: true);
					((Control)(object)headerLabelPane).Width = ((Control)(object)navListPanes).Width;
				}
			}
			base.Size = CalculateFormSize(constrained: true);
			if (navListPanes != null && navListMdi != null && ((Control)(object)navListPanes).Height != ((Control)(object)navListMdi).Height)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)navListPanes).Height < ((Control)(object)navListMdi).Height)
				{
					((Control)(object)navListPanes).Height = ((Control)(object)navListMdi).Height;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)navListMdi).Height = ((Control)(object)navListPanes).Height;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNavigatorListKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyCode != Keys.Up && e.KeyCode != Keys.Down && e.KeyCode != Keys.Left && e.KeyCode != Keys.Right && e.KeyCode != Keys.Return && e.KeyCode != Keys.ShiftKey && e.KeyCode != Keys.Tab)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		private void OnNavigatorListSelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NavigatorList navigatorList = sender as NavigatorList;
			if (navigatorList.SelectedIndex >= 0)
			{
				FireSelectedIndexChanged();
				Update();
			}
		}

		private void OnNavigatorListSelectedItemActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FireSelectedItemActivated();
		}

		internal void ResolveItemDescriptionAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, NavigatorDescriptionType descriptionType)
		{
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d4: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			bool flag = descriptionType == NavigatorDescriptionType.Header;
			NavigatorSettings navigatorSettings = NavigatorSettings;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(DockManager, DescriptionTypeToStyleRole(descriptionType), out resOrder);
			UIRole role2 = StyleUtils.GetRole(DockManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorItemDescArea);
			UIRole role3 = StyleUtils.GetRole(DockManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorDialogFooter);
			UIRole role4 = StyleUtils.GetRole(DockManager, StyleUtils.Role.NavigatorDialogHeader);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionHeaderAppearance != null)
					{
						navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionHeaderAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
				}
				else if (navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionBodyAppearance != null)
				{
					navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionBodyAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			AppearancePropFlags val = (AppearancePropFlags)((long)requestedProps & 0x14001001L);
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEBFFEFFEuL);
			if (navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionLocationResolved == NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.HeaderAndFooter)
			{
				switch (descriptionType)
				{
				case NavigatorDescriptionType.Header:
				case NavigatorDescriptionType.Body:
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
					{
						role4.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
					}
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo && navigatorSettings.HasHeaderAreaAppearance)
					{
						navigatorSettings.HeaderAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
					{
						role4.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
					}
					break;
				case NavigatorDescriptionType.Body2:
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
					{
						role3.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
					}
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo && navigatorSettings.HasFooterAreaAppearance)
					{
						navigatorSettings.FooterAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					}
					if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
					{
						role3.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore)
			{
				role2.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionAreaAppearance != null)
				{
					navigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionAreaAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (navigatorSettings.Appearance != null)
				{
					navigatorSettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				role2.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)(requestedProps | val);
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)536870912))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextTrimming = (TextTrimming)3;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFDFFFFFFFuL);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x20uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x200000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2097152))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).FontData.Bold = (DefaultableBoolean)(flag ? 1 : 2);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFDFFFFFuL);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2) && flag && NavigatorSettings.ItemDescriptionLocationResolved == NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.HeaderAndFooter && NavigatorSettings.IsVisualStudio2008StyleDialog)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = Color.White;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if ((long)((ulong)requestedProps & 0x4000000uL) > 0L && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)67108864))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor2 = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		private void SetInitialSelectedIndexAsync()
		{
			if (activePane != null && HasPaneList)
			{
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListPanes);
				navListPanes.SelectedIndex = GetItemIndexFromPane(activePane);
			}
			else if (activeMdiChild != null && HasMdiList)
			{
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListMdi);
				int selectedIndex = 0;
				int count = ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)navListMdi.Items.ValueListItems).Count;
				if (!wasShiftKeyDownInitially)
				{
					if (count >= 2)
					{
						selectedIndex = 1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					selectedIndex = count - 1;
				}
				navListMdi.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
			}
			else if (HasPaneList)
			{
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListPanes);
				navListPanes.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (HasMdiList)
			{
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListMdi);
				navListMdi.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void SetRoundedBorderRegion()
		{
			if (!base.IsHandleCreated || base.ClientRectangle.Equals(currentRegionRect) || !NavigatorSettings.IsVisualStudio2008StyleDialog)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Region region = base.Region;
				base.Region = DrawUtility.CreateBorderRegion(currentRegionRect = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, base.Size), (UIElementBorderStyle)12);
				if (region != null && region != base.Region)
				{
					region.Dispose();
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		public void DeactivateList(NavigatorList navList, Keys lastNonInputKey)
		{
			if (navList == navListMdi)
			{
				if (navListPanes == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListPanes);
				switch (lastNonInputKey)
				{
				case Keys.Up:
					navListPanes.SelectedIndex = navListPanes.ItemCount - 1;
					break;
				case Keys.Down:
					navListPanes.SelectedIndex = 0;
					break;
				case Keys.Left:
					if (HasMdiList)
					{
						int selectedItemVisibleIndex2 = navListMdi.SelectedItemVisibleIndex;
						navListPanes.SetSelectedIndexFromVisibleIndex(selectedItemVisibleIndex2, firstColumn: false);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					if (HasMdiList)
					{
						int selectedItemVisibleIndex = navListMdi.SelectedItemVisibleIndex;
						navListPanes.SetSelectedIndexFromVisibleIndex(selectedItemVisibleIndex, firstColumn: true);
					}
					break;
				}
				navListMdi.SelectedIndex = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				if (navListMdi == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)navListMdi);
				switch (lastNonInputKey)
				{
				case Keys.Up:
					navListMdi.SelectedIndex = navListMdi.ItemCount - 1;
					break;
				case Keys.Down:
					navListMdi.SelectedIndex = 0;
					break;
				case Keys.Left:
					if (HasPaneList)
					{
						int selectedItemVisibleIndex4 = navListPanes.SelectedItemVisibleIndex;
						navListMdi.SetSelectedIndexFromVisibleIndex(selectedItemVisibleIndex4, firstColumn: false);
					}
					break;
				case Keys.Right:
					if (HasPaneList)
					{
						int selectedItemVisibleIndex3 = navListPanes.SelectedItemVisibleIndex;
						navListMdi.SetSelectedIndexFromVisibleIndex(selectedItemVisibleIndex3, firstColumn: true);
					}
					break;
				}

		internal void PerformKeyboardNavigation(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Keys keys = e.KeyData & ~Keys.Control;
			if (Keys.Up == e.KeyCode)
			{
				if (SelectedIndex > 0)
				{
					SelectedIndex--;
				}
				else if (navigatorForm.NavigatorListCount == 1)
				{
					SelectedIndex = ItemCount - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					navigatorForm.DeactivateList(this, e.KeyCode);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (Keys.Down == e.KeyCode)
			{
				if (SelectedIndex < ItemCount - 1)
				{
					SelectedIndex++;
				}
				else if (navigatorForm.NavigatorListCount == 1)
				{
					SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					navigatorForm.DeactivateList(this, e.KeyCode);
				}
				return;
			}
			switch (keys)
			{
			case Keys.Tab:
			{
				if (SelectedIndex == ItemCount - 1)
				{
					SelectedIndex = 0;
					return;
				}
				int num = SelectedIndex + 1;
				SelectedIndex = num;
				return;
			}
			case Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift:
			{
				if (SelectedIndex == 0)
				{
					SelectedIndex = ItemCount - 1;
					return;
				}
				int num = SelectedIndex - 1;
				SelectedIndex = num;
				return;
			}
			}
			if (Keys.Left == e.KeyCode)
			{
				NavigatorListColumnUIElement firstColumn = UIElement.FirstColumn;
				if (firstColumn != null && firstColumn.ContainsItem(SelectedIndex))
				{
					if (navigatorForm.NavigatorListCount == 1)
					{
						int visibleIndexFromListIndex = firstColumn.GetVisibleIndexFromListIndex(SelectedIndex);
						NavigatorListColumnUIElement lastColumn = UIElement.LastColumn;
						if (lastColumn != null)
						{
							SelectedIndex = lastColumn.GetIndexOfItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndexFromListIndex);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						navigatorForm.DeactivateList(this, e.KeyCode);
					}
				}
				else if (-1 < SelectedIndex)
				{
					SelectedIndex = GetEquivalentItemIndex(nextColumn: false);
				}
			}
			else if (Keys.Right == e.KeyCode)
			{
				NavigatorListColumnUIElement lastColumn2 = UIElement.LastColumn;
				if (lastColumn2 != null && lastColumn2.ContainsItem(SelectedIndex))
				{
					if (navigatorForm.NavigatorListCount == 1)
					{
						int visibleIndexFromListIndex2 = UIElement.LastColumn.GetVisibleIndexFromListIndex(SelectedIndex);
						NavigatorListColumnUIElement firstColumn2 = UIElement.FirstColumn;
						if (firstColumn2 != null)
						{
							SelectedIndex = firstColumn2.GetIndexOfItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndexFromListIndex2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						navigatorForm.DeactivateList(this, e.KeyCode);
					}
				}
				else if (-1 < SelectedIndex)
				{
					SelectedIndex = GetEquivalentItemIndex(nextColumn: true);
				}
			}
			else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Return && SelectedItem != null)
			{
				ActivateSelectedItem();
			}
		}

		private void PerformPostResizeFirstVisibleItemIndexAdjustment()
		{
			int num = UIElement.ColumnCount - prevColumnCount;
			if (0 < num && !wasScrollButtonDownRequired && !Metrics.ScrollButtonDownRequired)
			{
				int num2 = FirstVisibleItemIndex - MaxItemsPerColumnResolved * num;
				if (num2 == 1)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				FirstVisibleItemIndex = num2;
			}
		}

			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0377: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0276: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_03cd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal void Scroll(bool scrollUp)
		{
			Scroll(scrollUp, ensureSelectedItemIsVisible: false);
		}

		internal void Scroll(bool scrollUp, bool ensureSelectedItemIsVisible)
		{
			if (MaxItemsPerColumnResolved == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (scrollUp)
			{
				if (ensureSelectedItemIsVisible)
				{
					FirstVisibleItemIndex = ((SelectedIndex != 1) ? SelectedIndex : 0);
					return;
				}
				if (FirstVisibleItemIndex == 2)
				{
					FirstVisibleItemIndex = 0;
					return;
				}
				int num = FirstVisibleItemIndex - 1;
				FirstVisibleItemIndex = num;
			}
			else if (ensureSelectedItemIsVisible)
			{
				LastVisibleItemIndex = SelectedIndex;
			}
			else if (FirstVisibleItemIndex == 0)
			{
				FirstVisibleItemIndex = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				int num = LastVisibleItemIndex + 1;
				LastVisibleItemIndex = num;
			}
		}

		public void SetSelectedIndexFromVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, bool firstColumn)
		{
			if (controlUIElement != null && UIElement.FirstColumn != null)
			{
				if (firstColumn)
				{
					SelectedIndex = UIElement.FirstColumn.GetIndexOfItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedIndex = UIElement.LastColumn.GetIndexOfItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}

	internal class NavigatorListColumnUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private readonly int index;

		internal int FirstItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int maxItemsPerColumnResolved = NavigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved;
				int num = NavigatorList.FirstVisibleItemIndex + maxItemsPerColumnResolved * index;
				if (index > 0 && maxItemsPerColumnResolved > 1 && NavigatorList.Metrics.ScrollButtonUpRequired)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasScrollDownButton
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsLastColumn || !NavigatorList.Metrics.ScrollButtonDownRequired)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ItemCount == 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasScrollUpButton
		{
			get
			{
				if (Index != 0 || !NavigatorList.Metrics.ScrollButtonUpRequired)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ItemCount == 1 && ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(NavigatorListScrollButtonUIElement)) == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal int Index => index;

		internal int ItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				((UIElement)this).VerifyChildElements();
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Count; i++)
				{
					if (((UIElement)this).ChildElements[i] is NavigatorListItemUIElement)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstColumn => this == NavigatorList.UIElement.FirstColumn;

		internal bool IsLastColumn => this == NavigatorList.UIElement.LastColumn;

		private int LastItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int num = ((IsLastColumn && !HasScrollDownButton) ? (NavigatorList.ItemCount - FirstItemIndex) : NavigatorList.Metrics.NumItemsInFirstColumn);
				if (HasScrollUpButton || HasScrollDownButton)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return FirstItemIndex + (num - 1);
			}
		}

		private Point FirstItemLocation
		{
			get
			{
				Point location = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Location;
				location.Offset(NavigatorList.Metrics.HorizontalItemPadding, NavigatorList.Metrics.VerticalItemPadding);
				return location;
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{

			Size itemSize = NavigatorList.Metrics.ItemSize;
			int dy = itemSize.Height + NavigatorList.Metrics.InterItemSpacing;
			int firstItemIndex = FirstItemIndex;
			int lastVisibleItemIndex = NavigatorList.LastVisibleItemIndex;
			int num = NavigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved;
			bool hasScrollUpButton = HasScrollUpButton;
			bool flag = HasScrollDownButton && num > 1;
			if (hasScrollUpButton || flag)
			{
				num--;
			}
			ValueListItemsCollection valueListItems = NavigatorList.Items.ValueListItems;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(2);

		internal bool ContainsItem(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex < FirstItemIndex && IsFirstColumn)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (LastItemIndex < itemIndex && IsLastColumn)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FirstItemIndex <= itemIndex)
			{
				return itemIndex <= LastItemIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfItemAtVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{

					bool flag2 = (visibleIndex == 0 && navigatorListItemUIElement.VisibleIndex == 1) || (visibleIndex < 0 && navigatorListItemUIElement.VisibleIndex == 0) || (visibleIndex == 1 && ItemCount == 1);
					if (flag || flag2)
					{
						return navigatorListItemUIElement.Index;
					}
				}
			}
			return LastItemIndex;
		}

		internal int GetVisibleIndexFromListIndex(int listIndex)
		{

			if (HasScrollUpButton)
			{

			}

	internal class NavigatorListMetrics
	{
		private readonly NavigatorList navigatorList;

		private int horizontalItemPadding = 4;

		private int innerItemPadding = 4;

		private int interColumnSpacing = 8;

		private int interItemSpacing = 2;

		private bool isItemSizeDirty = true;

		private Size itemSize = new Size(161, 20);

		private Size outerColumnPadding = new Size(2, 2);

		private int verticalItemPadding = 2;

		internal Size ColumnSize
		{
			get
			{
				int num = PaddedItemHeight * NumItemsInFirstColumn - InterItemSpacing;
				int height = VerticalItemPadding * 2 + num;
				return new Size(PreferredColumnWidth, height);
			}
		}

		internal int HorizontalItemPadding => horizontalItemPadding;

		internal int InterColumnSpacing => interColumnSpacing;

		internal int InterItemSpacing => interItemSpacing;

		internal Size ItemSize
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (isItemSizeDirty && navigatorList.ItemCount > 0)
				{

					navigatorList.ResolveItemAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, 0);

					int height = font.Height + innerItemPadding * 2;

					}
					itemSize = ((ControlUIElementBase)navigatorList.UIElement).AdjustForTouchMode(itemSize);
					isItemSizeDirty = false;
				}
				return itemSize;
			}
		}

		internal int MaxVisibleItems => navigatorList.MaxColumnsResolved * navigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved;

		internal int MaxVisibleItemsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int num = MaxVisibleItems;
				if (ScrollButtonUpRequired)
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (ScrollButtonDownRequired)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int NumItemsInFirstColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigatorList.ItemCount >= navigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved)
				{
					return navigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved;
				}
				return navigatorList.ItemCount;
			}
		}

		internal Size OuterColumnPadding => outerColumnPadding;

		internal int PaddedColumnWidth => ColumnSize.Width + InterColumnSpacing;

		internal int PaddedItemHeight => ItemSize.Height + InterItemSpacing;

		internal int PreferredColumnWidth => 170;

		internal bool ScrollButtonDownRequired
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ScrollButtonsRequired)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = MaxVisibleItems;
				if (ScrollButtonUpRequired)
				{
					num--;
				}
				int num2 = navigatorList.ItemCount - num;
				return navigatorList.FirstVisibleItemIndex < num2;
			}
		}

		internal bool ScrollButtonsRequired
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigatorList.ItemCount <= MaxVisibleItems)
				{
					return 0 < navigatorList.FirstVisibleItemIndex;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool ScrollButtonUpRequired => navigatorList.FirstVisibleItemIndex > 0;

		internal int VerticalItemPadding => verticalItemPadding;

		public NavigatorListMetrics(NavigatorList navigatorList)
		{
			this.navigatorList = navigatorList;
		}

		internal void DirtyItemSizeCache()
		{
			isItemSizeDirty = true;
		}

		public int GetNumColumns(bool constrained)
		{
			if (navigatorList == null || ((Control)(object)navigatorList).IsDisposed)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int maxItemsPerColumnResolved = navigatorList.MaxItemsPerColumnResolved;
			int itemCount = navigatorList.ItemCount;
			if (maxItemsPerColumnResolved < 1 || itemCount == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = itemCount / maxItemsPerColumnResolved;
			int num2 = itemCount % maxItemsPerColumnResolved;
			int val = num + ((num2 > 0) ? 1 : 0);
			if (!constrained)
			{
				return Math.Min(val, navigatorList.MaxColumns);
			}
			return Math.Min(val, navigatorList.MaxColumnsResolved);
		}

		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole val = StyleUtils.GetRole(dockManager, role, out resOrder);

			{
				val.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);

					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter)

			}
			ResolveAppearanceDefaults(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, dockManager, role);

				{

		private static Bitmap GetFormPreviewImage(Form form)
		{
			if (!form.IsHandleCreated)

				return null;
			}

			Size size = form.ClientSize;
			if (size.Height == 0 || size.Width == 0)

				graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, size), new Rectangle(clientAreaOffset, size), GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
			}
			return bitmap2;
		}

		private void PaintSelectedItemPreview(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (navigatorForm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueListItem selectedItem = navigatorForm.SelectedItem;
			if (selectedItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = selectedItem.DataValue as DockableControlPane;
			Form form = selectedItem.DataValue as Form;
			Bitmap bitmap = null;
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				bitmap = GetPanePreviewImage(dockableControlPane);
			}
			else if (form != null)
			{
				bitmap = GetFormPreviewImage(form);
			}
			if (bitmap == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				int num = base.Height - 5 - 5;
				int num2 = Math.Min(200, num);
				int num3 = base.Width - 5 - 7;
				float num4 = Math.Min(1f, (float)num3 / (float)bitmap.Width);
				if ((float)bitmap.Height * num4 < (float)num2)
				{
					num4 = Math.Min(1f, (float)num2 / (float)bitmap.Height);
				}
				int num5 = Math.Min(num, (int)Math.Round((float)bitmap.Height * num4, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
				int num6 = Math.Min(num3, (int)Math.Round((float)bitmap.Width * num4, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(num3 - num6, 0, num6, num5);
				Rectangle srcRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, (int)Math.Round((float)num6 / num4, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero), (int)Math.Round((float)num5 / num4, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
				DrawUtility.DrawBorderShadow(e.Graphics, e.ClipRectangle, rectangle, Color.Black, (byte)70, (byte)0, (byte)5);
				e.Graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, rectangle, srcRect, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
			}
			finally
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public NavigatorStyle NavigatorStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigatorStyle != NavigatorStyle.Default)
				{
					return navigatorStyle;
				}
				if (manager == null)
				{
					return NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2005;
				}
				switch (manager.WindowStyleResolved)
				{
				default:
					return NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2005;
				case WindowStyle.VisualStudio2008:
					if (UltraDockManager.IsVistaOS)
					{
						return NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2008Vista;
					}
					return NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2008XP;
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Obsolete("ShowDescriptionArea has been superseded by ItemDescriptionLocation.")]
		public bool ShowDescriptionArea
		{
			get
			{
				return ItemDescriptionLocation != NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.None;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ShowDescriptionArea != value)
				{
					if (!value)
					{
						ItemDescriptionLocation = NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.None;
					}
					else
					{
						ItemDescriptionLocation = NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.BelowLists;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NavigatorShowDescriptionArea);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsVisualStudio2008StyleDialog
		{
			get
			{
				NavigatorStyle navigatorStyleResolved = NavigatorStyleResolved;
				if (navigatorStyleResolved != NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2008XP)
				{
					return navigatorStyleResolved == NavigatorStyle.VisualStudio2008Vista;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearance", appearanceHolder);
			}
			if (!Enabled)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFooterAreaAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FooterAreaAppearance", footerAreaAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHeaderAreaAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HeaderAreaAppearance", headerAreaAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeHotTrackedItemAreaAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HotTrackedItemAreaAppearance", hotTrackedItemAreaAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if ((int)IsItemIconVisibleInHeader != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsItemIconVisibleInHeader", isItemIconVisibleInHeader);
			}
			if ((int)IsPreviewVisible != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsPreviewVisible", isPreviewVisible);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemAppearance", itemAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemDescriptionAreaAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemDescriptionAreaAppearance", itemDescriptionAreaAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemDescriptionBodyAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemDescriptionBodyAppearance", itemDescriptionBodyAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeItemDescriptionHeaderAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemDescriptionHeaderAppearance", itemDescriptionHeaderAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ItemDescriptionLocation != NavigatorItemDescriptionLocation.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ItemDescriptionLocation", itemDescriptionLocation);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeListHeaderAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ListHeaderAppearance", listHeaderAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (MaxItemsPerColumn != 15)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxItemsPerColumn", maxItemsPerColumn);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMdiListCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MdiListCaption", mdiListCaption);
			}
			if (MdiListMaxColumns != 4)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MdiListMaxColumns", mdiListMaxColumns);
			}
			if (NavigatorStyle != NavigatorStyle.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NavigatorStyle", navigatorStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializePaneListCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaneListCaption", paneListCaption);
			}
			if (PaneListMaxColumns != 4)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PaneListMaxColumns", paneListMaxColumns);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSelectedItemAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SelectedItemAppearance", selectedItemAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (!ShowDescriptionArea)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowDescriptionArea", ShowDescriptionArea);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (footerAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				footerAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (headerAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				headerAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (hotTrackedItemAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				hotTrackedItemAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (itemAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				itemAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (itemDescriptionAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
			{

	public class PaneCaptionButtonUIElement : ButtonUIElementBase
	{
		private PaneButton paneButton = PaneButton.Close;

		private ImageUIElementBase imageElement;

		private DockablePaneBase Pane => ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;

		internal PaneButton PaneButton
		{
			get
			{
				return paneButton;
			}
			set
			{
				if (paneButton != value)
				{
					paneButton = value;
					((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = value;
					if (!((UIElement)this).IsDrawing)
					{
						((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private UltraDockManager UltraDockManager => ((UIElement)this).ControlElement.UltraControl as UltraDockManager;

		public override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => UltraDockManager?.CaptionButtonStyleResolved ?? ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonStyle;

		protected override bool WantsMouseHoverNotification => true;

		public override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)this).Enabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Pane?.IsButtonEnabled(PaneButton) ?? false;
			}
		}

		private ImageUIElementBase ImageElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (imageElement == null)
				{
					imageElement = (ImageUIElementBase)(object)new CaptionButtonImageUIElement(this);
				}
				return imageElement;
			}
		}

		public PaneButton PaneButtonType => paneButton;

		public override UIRole UIRole => UltraDockManager?.GetPaneButtonRole(PaneButton, Pane);

		private string ToolTipText
		{
			get
			{
				DockablePaneBase pane = Pane;
				if (pane == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				switch (PaneButton)
				{
				case PaneButton.Close:
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipClose");
				case PaneButton.Minimize:
					if (pane.MinimizedResolved)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipRestoreUp");
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipMinimize");
				case PaneButton.Maximize:
					if (pane.MaximizedResolved)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipRestoreDown");
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipMaximize");
				case PaneButton.Pin:
					if (pane.IsUnpinned)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipPin");
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipUnpin");
				case PaneButton.Menu:
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PaneButtonToolTipMenu");
				default:
					return string.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		public PaneCaptionButtonUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override bool DrawTheme(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0154: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0122: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (PaneButton != PaneButton.Pin)
			{
				SystemButtonType val = (SystemButtonType)(PaneButton switch
				{
					PaneButton.Maximize => (!Pane.MaximizedResolved) ? 2 : 3, 
					PaneButton.Minimize => (!Pane.MinimizedResolved) ? 1 : 3, 
					_ => 5, 
				});
				CaptionStyle captionStyle = ((UltraDockManager != null) ? UltraDockManager.CaptionStyleResolved : CaptionStyle.Default);
				Rectangle rectangle = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				if (Pane != null && UltraDockManager != null && Pane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && (captionStyle == CaptionStyle.VisualStudio2005 || captionStyle == CaptionStyle.VisualStudio2008))
				{
					rectangle = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.Location, new Size(13, 13));
					if (((UIElement)this).AreTouchMetricsEnabled)
					{
						rectangle = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
					}
					switch (Pane.CaptionLocation)
					{
					case Location.Default:
					case Location.Top:
					case Location.Bottom:
						DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rectangle, ((UIElement)this).Rect);
						break;
					case Location.Left:
					case Location.Right:
						DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rectangle, ((UIElement)this).Rect);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (PaneButton != PaneButton.Menu)
				{
					return XPThemes.Window.DrawButton(val, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState, false, ref drawParams, rectangle, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
				}
				return DrawThemedMenuButton(ref drawParams);
			}
			return XPThemes.Explorer.DrawPinButton(!Pane.IsUnpinned, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState, ref drawParams, ((UIElement)this).Rect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect, true);
		}

		private bool DrawThemedMenuButton(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_00f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0100: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				Rectangle elementDrawingRect = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ElementDrawingRect;
				int num = elementDrawingRect.Width / 3;
				int num2 = elementDrawingRect.Height / 3;
				elementDrawingRect.Location = new Point(elementDrawingRect.X + num / 2, elementDrawingRect.Y + 1);
				elementDrawingRect.Inflate(-num + 1, -num2 + 1);
				Point[] points = new Point[6]
				{
					elementDrawingRect.Location,
					new Point(elementDrawingRect.Left + elementDrawingRect.Width / 2, elementDrawingRect.Bottom - 1),
					new Point(elementDrawingRect.Left + elementDrawingRect.Width / 2 + 1, elementDrawingRect.Bottom - 1),
					new Point(elementDrawingRect.Right, elementDrawingRect.Top),
					new Point(elementDrawingRect.Right - 1, elementDrawingRect.Top),
					elementDrawingRect.Location
				};
				Color empty = Color.Empty;
				UIElementButtonState buttonState = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState;
				switch (buttonState - 2)
				{
				case 2:
					empty = ((ThemeItemBase)XPThemes.Window).GetThemeSystemColor((SystemColor)3);
					empty = DrawUtility.Dark(empty);
					break;
				case 1:
					empty = ((VisualStudioBaseColorTable)VisualStudio2005ColorTable.Colors).ToolboxItemHotTrackingBackColor;
					empty = DrawUtility.Light(empty);
					break;
				case 0:
					empty = ((VisualStudioBaseColorTable)VisualStudio2005ColorTable.Colors).ToolboxItemHotTrackingBackColor;
					break;
				default:
					empty = ((ThemeItemBase)XPThemes.Window).GetThemeSystemColor((SystemColor)16);
					empty = XPItemColor.ColorFromHLS(empty.GetHue(), empty.GetBrightness() * 1.2f, empty.GetSaturation());
					break;
				}
				using (Brush brush = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).CreateSolidBrush(empty))
				{
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, points);
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLines(Pens.Black, points);
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			UltraDockManager?.ShowToolTip((UIElement)(object)this, ToolTipText, showAlways: true);
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (base.leftButtonDown && ((UIElement)this).Enabled)
			{
				DockablePaneBase pane = Pane;
				if (pane != null && pane.Manager != null)
				{
					pane.ProcessButtonClick(PaneButton, this);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnClick();

				DrawGrabHandleStyleOffice2003(drawParams);
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (pane != null)
			{
				pane.SettingsResolved.ResolveCaptionGrabHandleAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		private void DrawGrabHandleStyleOffice2003(UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle elementDrawingRectInsideBorders = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ElementDrawingRectInsideBorders;
			Brush brush = Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(Office2003Colors.GrabHandleDarkSquare);
			Brush white = Brushes.White;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = elementDrawingRectInsideBorders.X;
			int y = elementDrawingRectInsideBorders.Y;
			if (((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).RightToLeft)
			{
				num2 = elementDrawingRectInsideBorders.Right - 1;
			}
			if (isVertical)
			{
				y += num;
				num2 += 4;
				do
				{
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(white, num2 + 1, y + 1, 2, 2);
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, num2, y, 2, 2);
					num2 += 4;
				}
				while (num2 <= elementDrawingRectInsideBorders.Right - 5);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += num;
				y += 4;
				do
				{
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(white, num2 + 1, y + 1, 2, 2);
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, num2, y, 2, 2);
					y += 4;
				}
				while (y <= elementDrawingRectInsideBorders.Bottom - 5);
			}
			brush.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class PaneControlAreaUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private DockablePaneBase Pane => ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)(((??)Pane?.SettingsResolved.BorderStylePane) ?? 1);

		public override UIRole UIRole => Pane?.UIRoleContentArea;

		public PaneControlAreaUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			DockablePaneBase pane = Pane;
			pane?.SettingsResolved.ResolvePaneAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, pane.IsActive);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			base.childElementsCollection = null;
			DockablePaneBase pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null && pane.Manager != null)
			{
				Rectangle drawingRectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).DrawingRectInsideBorders;
				PaneSettingsResolved settingsResolved = pane.SettingsResolved;
				int paddingLeft = settingsResolved.PaddingLeft;
				int paddingRight = settingsResolved.PaddingRight;
				int paddingBottom = settingsResolved.PaddingBottom;
				int paddingTop = settingsResolved.PaddingTop;
				drawingRectInsideBorders.Width -= paddingLeft + paddingRight;
				drawingRectInsideBorders.Height -= paddingTop + paddingBottom;
				drawingRectInsideBorders.X += paddingLeft;
				drawingRectInsideBorders.Y += paddingTop;
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					PositionChildPanes(drawingRectInsideBorders, (DockableGroupPane)pane, childElements);
				}
				else if (pane is DockableControlPane)
				{
					PositionChildControl(drawingRectInsideBorders, (DockableControlPane)pane);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PositionChildControl(Rectangle workRect, DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (pane.Control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!((UIElement)this).Control.Contains(pane.Control) || Utilities.GetParent(pane.Control) != ((UIElement)this).Control)
			{
				pane.Manager.ReparentControl(pane.Control, ((UIElement)this).Control);
			}
			if (!pane.Control.IsHandleCreated || pane.Control.IsDisposed || pane.Control.Disposing || !pane.Control.Created)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				pane.Control.Bounds = workRect;
				pane.Manager.DelayInvalidateOverlayControl();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void PositionChildPanes(Rectangle workRect, DockableGroupPane group, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			switch (group.ChildPaneStyle)
			{
			case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
				PositionSplitPanes(workRect, group, verticalSplit: false, oldElements);
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
				PositionSplitPanes(workRect, group, verticalSplit: true, oldElements);
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
				PositionTabPanes(workRect, group, oldElements);
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
				PositionSlidingGroupPanes(workRect, group, oldElements);
				break;
			}
		}

		private TabLocation GetTabLocation(Location location)
		{
			return (TabLocation)(location switch
			{
				Location.Left => 2, 
				Location.Right => 3, 
				Location.Top => 0, 
				_ => 1, 
			});
		}

		private void PositionTabPanes(Rectangle workRect, DockableGroupPane group, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (group.Panes.GetVisibleCount() > 1)
			{
				object obj = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(TabGroupUIElement), true);
				UIElement val = (UIElement)((obj is UIElement) ? obj : null);
				if (val == null || (val is TabGroupUIElement && (object)((TabGroupUIElement)val).TabManager != group.TabInfo))
				{
					val = ((TabManager)group.TabInfo).CreateTabAreaUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				Location tabLocation = group.GroupSettingsResolved.TabLocation;
				bool isVerticalTab = group.GroupSettingsResolved.IsVerticalTab;
				group.TabInfo.AvailableSize = workRect.Size;
				int val2 = (isVerticalTab ? ((TabManager)group.TabInfo).TabAreaSize.Width : ((TabManager)group.TabInfo).TabAreaSize.Height);
				Size size = ((!isVerticalTab) ? new Size(workRect.Width, Math.Min(val2, workRect.Height)) : new Size(Math.Min(val2, workRect.Width), workRect.Height));
				switch (tabLocation)
				{
				case Location.Left:
					val.Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.X, workRect.Y, size.Width, size.Height);
					workRect.Width -= size.Width;
					workRect.X += size.Width;
					break;
				case Location.Top:
					val.Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.X, workRect.Y, size.Width, size.Height);
					workRect.Height -= size.Height;
					workRect.Y += size.Height;
					break;
				case Location.Right:
					val.Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.Right - size.Width, workRect.Y, size.Width, size.Height);
					workRect.Width -= size.Width;
					break;
				case Location.Bottom:
					val.Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.X, workRect.Bottom - size.Height, size.Width, size.Height);
					workRect.Height -= size.Height;
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add(val);
			}
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
			if (workRect.Width > 0 && workRect.Height > 0)
			{
				dockablePaneBase = group.SelectedTabPane;
				if (dockablePaneBase == null)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = group.FirstVisiblePane;
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane)
				{
					DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement), true) as DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement;
					if (dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement == null)
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = new DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement((DockableControlPane)dockablePaneBase, (UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					else
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement.Initialize((DockableControlPane)dockablePaneBase);
					}
					((UIElement)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement).Rect = workRect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement);
				}
				else
				{
					PaneUIElement paneUIElement = null;
					if (paneUIElement == null)
					{
						paneUIElement = new PaneUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					paneUIElement.Initialize(dockablePaneBase);
					((UIElement)paneUIElement).Rect = workRect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)paneUIElement);
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).VerifyChildElements(true);
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (pane.IsVisible && pane != dockablePaneBase)
				{
					pane.HideControls();
				}
			}
		}

		private void PositionSlidingGroupPanes(Rectangle workRect, DockableGroupPane group, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			bool flag = group.GroupSettingsResolved.SlidingGroupOrientation == DefaultableOrientation.Vertical;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (!pane.IsVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (workRect.Width <= 0 || workRect.Height <= 0)
				{
					pane.HideControls();
					continue;
				}
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(workRect.Location, pane.DisplaySize);
				if (rect.Width > workRect.Width || !flag)
				{
					rect.Width = workRect.Width;
				}
				if (rect.Height > workRect.Height || flag)
				{
					rect.Height = workRect.Height;
				}
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					PaneUIElement paneUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(PaneUIElement), true) as PaneUIElement;
					if (paneUIElement == null)
					{
						paneUIElement = new PaneUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					paneUIElement.Initialize(pane);
					((UIElement)paneUIElement).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)paneUIElement);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(pane is DockableControlPane))
					{
						continue;
					}
					DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement), true) as DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement;
					if (dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement == null)
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = new DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement((DockableControlPane)pane, (UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					else
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement.Initialize((DockableControlPane)pane);
					}
					((UIElement)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					workRect.X += rect.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					workRect.Y += rect.Height;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PositionSplitPanes(Rectangle workRect, DockableGroupPane group, bool verticalSplit, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control.Controls.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = group.Panes.GetVisibleCount();
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (!pane.IsVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (workRect.Height <= 0 || workRect.Width <= 0)
				{
					pane.HideControls();
					continue;
				}
				num--;
				if (dockablePaneBase != null)
				{
					PositionSplitterBar(ref workRect, dockablePaneBase, pane, verticalSplit, oldElements);
				}
				if (workRect.Height <= 0 || workRect.Width <= 0)
				{
					pane.HideControls();
					continue;
				}
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(workRect.Location, Size.Empty);
				Size displaySize = pane.DisplaySize;
				if (verticalSplit)
				{
					rect.Height = workRect.Height;
					if (num == 0 || displaySize.Width > workRect.Width)
					{
						rect.Width = workRect.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Width = displaySize.Width;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Width = workRect.Width;
					if (num == 0 || displaySize.Height > workRect.Height)
					{
						rect.Height = workRect.Height;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Height = displaySize.Height;
					}
				}
				if (pane is DockableControlPane)
				{
					DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement), true) as DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement;
					if (dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement == null)
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement = new DockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement((DockableControlPane)pane, (UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					else
					{
						dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement.Initialize((DockableControlPane)pane);
					}
					((UIElement)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)dockableWindowPlaceholderUIElement);
				}
				else
				{
					PaneUIElement paneUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(PaneUIElement), true) as PaneUIElement;
					if (paneUIElement == null)
					{
						paneUIElement = new PaneUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
					}
					paneUIElement.Initialize(pane);
					((UIElement)paneUIElement).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)paneUIElement);
				}
				if (verticalSplit)
				{
					workRect.X += rect.Width;
					workRect.Width -= rect.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					workRect.Y += rect.Height;
					workRect.Height -= rect.Height;
				}
				dockablePaneBase = pane;
			}
		}

		private void PositionSplitterBar(ref Rectangle workRect, DockablePaneBase paneBefore, DockablePaneBase paneAfter, bool verticalSplitter, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			PaneSplitterUIElement paneSplitterUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(PaneSplitterUIElement), true) as PaneSplitterUIElement;
			if (paneSplitterUIElement == null || paneSplitterUIElement.IsVerticalSplitterBar != verticalSplitter)
			{
				paneSplitterUIElement = new PaneSplitterUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, verticalSplitter, paneBefore, paneAfter);
			}
			else
			{
				paneSplitterUIElement.Initialize(paneBefore, paneAfter);
			}
			int width = (verticalSplitter ? paneBefore.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved : workRect.Width);
			int height = (verticalSplitter ? workRect.Height : paneBefore.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved);
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(workRect.X, workRect.Y, width, height);
			if (verticalSplitter)
			{
				workRect.X += rect.Width;
				workRect.Width -= rect.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				workRect.Y += rect.Height;
				workRect.Height -= rect.Height;
			}
			((UIElement)paneSplitterUIElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)paneSplitterUIElement);
		}
	}

					object[] array2 = array;
					foreach (object obj in array2)
					{
						if (!(obj is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase))

							Trace.WriteLine($"Invalid 'DockablePaneBase' entry in the Tabs collection of '{base.Group}'");
						}
						else if (!base.Tabs.Contains(dockablePaneBase))
						{
							string format = "TabItem '{0}' was removed from the Tabs collection during the calculation of the VisibleTabsCount of '{1}'.\r\n{2}";

							Trace.WriteLine(message);
						}
						else if (dockablePaneBase.IsVisibleInDockArea && ((ITabItem)dockablePaneBase).Visible)

							num++;
						}
					}
					return num;

					Trace.WriteLine($"Error: {ex.Message}\r\n{Environment.StackTrace}");

		internal override bool CheckCloseButtonVisibilityFlags(CloseButtonLocation cbl, bool selected)
		{
			if (!selected)
			{
				return cbl.HasFlag(Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.CloseButtonLocation.TabGroup);
			}
			return cbl.HasFlag(Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.CloseButtonLocation.TabGroupSelectedTab);
		}

		protected override void MouseHoverTab(UIElement element, ITabItem tab, bool isAllTextRendered)
		{
			UltraDockManager manager = base.Manager;
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (element is TabCloseButtonUIElement)
			{
				base.MouseHoverTab(element, tab, isAllTextRendered);
				return;
			}
			DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = tab as DockablePaneBase;
			string text = dockablePaneBase.ToolTipTab;
			if ((text == null || text.Length == 0) && !isAllTextRendered)
			{
				text = dockablePaneBase.TextTabResolved;
				if (text != null && text.Length > 2)
				{
					text = Utilities.StripMnemonics(text);
				}
			}
			manager.ShowToolTip(element, text, showAlways: false);
		}

		protected override void AutoSelectTab(ITabItem tab)
		{
			((TabManager)this).AutoSelectTab(tab);
			((TabManager)this).TabClick(tab);
		}

		protected override void TabClick(ITabItem tab)
		{
			((TabManager)this).TabClick(tab);
			if (tab is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase)
			{
				base.Group.SelectedTabPane = dockablePaneBase;
				if (base.Group.SelectedTabPane == dockablePaneBase)
				{
					dockablePaneBase.Activate();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DoubleClickTab(UIElement element, ITabItem tab)
		{
			((TabManager)this).DoubleClickTab(element, tab);
			if (tab is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase && lastMouseDownButton == MouseButtons.Left && dockablePaneBase.SettingsResolved.DoubleClickAction == PaneDoubleClickAction.ToggleDockedState)
			{
				dockablePaneBase.ToggleDockState();
			}
		}

		protected override bool AfterMouseDownTab(UIElement element, ITabItem tab, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			lastMouseDownButton = e.Button;
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = tab as DockablePaneBase;
				if (element is TabItemUIElement && !dockablePaneBase.IsActive)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Manager.DragManager.ProcessMouseDown(element, e))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override UIRole GetRole(TabRole role)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			StyleUtils.Role role2;
			switch ((int)role)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				TabOrientation tabOrientationResolved = ((TabManager)this).TabOrientationResolved;
				switch (tabOrientationResolved - 1)
				{
				default:
					role2 = StyleUtils.Role.GroupPaneTabAreaHorzTop;
					break;
				case 2:
				case 3:
					role2 = StyleUtils.Role.GroupPaneTabAreaHorzBottom;
					break;
				case 4:
				case 5:
					role2 = StyleUtils.Role.GroupPaneTabAreaVertLeft;
					break;
				case 6:

					role2 = StyleUtils.Role.GroupPaneTabAreaVertRight;

	public class UnpinnedTabManager : TabManagerBase, ITabProvider
	{
		bool ITabProvider.AutoSelect
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Manager == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.Manager.UnpinnedTabHoverAction != UnpinnedTabHoverAction.None;
			}
		}

		TabStyle ITabProvider.Style
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				TabStyle result = (TabStyle)5;
				if (base.Manager != null)
				{
					result = base.Manager.UnpinnedTabStyleResolved;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		TabLayoutStyle ITabProvider.TabLayoutStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Manager != null && !base.Manager.CompressUnpinnedTabs)
				{
					return (TabLayoutStyle)0;
				}
				return (TabLayoutStyle)4;
			}
		}

		TabOrientation ITabProvider.TabOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = base.Group.DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane == null)
				{
					return (TabOrientation)0;
				}
				return (TabOrientation)(dockAreaPane.DockedLocation switch
				{
					DockedLocation.DockedTop => 3, 
					DockedLocation.DockedLeft => 7, 
					DockedLocation.DockedRight => 6, 
					_ => 1, 
				});
			}
		}

		int ITabProvider.VisibleTabsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase tab in base.Tabs)
				{
					if (!tab.Closed && ((ITabItem)tab).Visible)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected override ITabItem DefaultSelectedTabItem => ((TabManager)this).FirstVisibleTabItem;

		TextOrientation ITabProvider.TextOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = base.Group.DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.DockedLocation == DockedLocation.DockedRight)
				{
					return (TextOrientation)6;
				}
				return (TextOrientation)0;
			}
		}

		internal override StyleUtils.Role DefaultTabItemRole
		{

		private class MessageFilterManager : IMessageFilter
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static MessageFilterManager instance;

			private List<WeakReference> managerList;

			private bool isMessageFilterActive;

			private static MessageFilterManager Instance
			{
				get
				{
					if (instance == null)
					{
						instance = new MessageFilterManager();
					}
					return instance;
				}
			}

			internal static void AddManager(UltraDockManager manager)
			{
				Instance.AddDockManager(manager);
			}

			internal static void RemoveManager(UltraDockManager manager)
			{
				Instance.RemoveDockManager(manager);
			}

			private MessageFilterManager()
			{
			}

			private void AddDockManager(UltraDockManager manager)
			{
				if (managerList == null)
				{
					managerList = new List<WeakReference>();
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = (UltraDockManager)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
					if (ultraDockManager == null)
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (((object)ultraDockManager).Equals((object)manager))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					managerList.Add(new WeakReference(manager));
				}
				if (isMessageFilterActive)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					Utilities.AddMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
					isMessageFilterActive = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			private void RemoveDockManager(UltraDockManager manager)
			{
				if (managerList == null || managerList.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = (UltraDockManager)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
					if (ultraDockManager == null)
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (((object)ultraDockManager).Equals((object)manager))
					{
						managerList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				if (!isMessageFilterActive || managerList.Count != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					Utilities.RemoveMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)this);
					isMessageFilterActive = false;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			bool IMessageFilter.PreFilterMessage(ref Message msg)
			{
				if (managerList == null || managerList.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != 0;
				if (256 == msg.Msg && 9 == (int)msg.WParam && flag)
				{
					UltraDockManager ultraDockManager = null;
					bool flag2 = false;
					for (int num = managerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						ultraDockManager = (UltraDockManager)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[num]);
						if (ultraDockManager == null)
						{
							managerList.RemoveAt(num);
						}
						else if (ultraDockManager.isShowingNavigator)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < managerList.Count; i++)
					{
						ultraDockManager = (UltraDockManager)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(managerList[i]);
						if (ultraDockManager != null && ultraDockManager.CanShowNavigator)
						{
							bool isShiftKeyDown = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != 0;
							ultraDockManager.ShowNavigatorInternal(userRequested: true, isShiftKeyDown);
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class MdiTabStopHelper
		{
			private Form mdiForm;

			private Hashtable oldTabStops;

			private MdiTabStopHelper(Form mdiForm)
			{
				this.mdiForm = mdiForm;
				Form[] mdiChildren = mdiForm.MdiChildren;
				oldTabStops = new Hashtable(mdiChildren.Length);
				foreach (Form form in mdiChildren)
				{
					if (form != mdiForm.ActiveMdiChild)
					{
						oldTabStops.Add(form, form.TabStop);
						form.TabStop = false;
					}
				}
			}

			internal static MdiTabStopHelper PrepareTabStops(Form mdiForm)
			{
				if (mdiForm != null && mdiForm.IsMdiContainer)
				{
					return new MdiTabStopHelper(mdiForm);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public void Restore()
			{
				IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = oldTabStops.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Form form = (Form)enumerator.Key;
					bool tabStop = (bool)enumerator.Value;
					if (!form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed)
					{
						form.TabStop = tabStop;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyleSplitterDefault
		{
			get
			{
				switch (WindowStyleResolved)
				{
				case WindowStyle.Office2007:
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)4;
				case WindowStyle.Office2003:
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)4;
				case WindowStyle.VisualStudio2005:
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)8;
				case WindowStyle.VC6:
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)8;
				case WindowStyle.VisualStudio2008:
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)8;
				default:
					if (!IsDesignMode)
					{
						return (UIElementBorderStyle)1;
					}
					return (UIElementBorderStyle)2;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public ContainerControl HostControl
		{
			get
			{
				return hostControl;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == hostControl)
				{
					return;
				}
				UninitializeComponent();
				if (hostControl != null)
				{
					DockingAreaManager.UnregisterDockingAreaParent((Control)hostControl);
				}
				RemoveMessageFilter();
				hostControl = value;
				if (hostControl != null)
				{
					DockingAreaManager.RegisterDockingAreaParent((Control)hostControl);
					if (IsInitialized)
					{
						InitializeComponent();
					}
					if (hostControl is Form)
					{
						AddMessageFilter();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UIElementButtonStyle CaptionButtonStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ButtonStyleCaptionButton, out var val))
				{
					UIElementButtonStyle resolveVal;
					switch (CaptionStyleResolved)
					{
					case CaptionStyle.Windows:
					case CaptionStyle.VC6:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)13;
						break;
					case CaptionStyle.Office2003:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)15;
						break;
					case CaptionStyle.Office2007:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)17;
						break;
					case CaptionStyle.VisualStudio2005:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)8;
						break;
					case CaptionStyle.VisualStudio2008:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)4;
						break;
					default:
						resolveVal = (UIElementButtonStyle)6;
						break;
					}
					val = StyleUtils.CacheButtonStylePropertyValue(this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ButtonStyleCaptionButton, StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButton, captionButtonStyle, resolveVal);
				}
				return DrawUtility.AdjustedButtonStyle((UIElementButtonStyle)val, ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).UseFlatModeResolved);
