		internal bool IsDropDownOpen
		{
			get
			{
				Control currentDropDownControl = DropDownManager.GetCurrentDropDownControl((Control)null);
				if (currentDropDownControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Control parent = HostControl;
				while (parent != null && currentDropDownControl != parent)
				{
					parent = Utilities.GetParent(parent);
				}
				return currentDropDownControl != parent;
			}
		}

		private bool IsHostControlVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HostControl.Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!HostControl.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					IntPtr intPtr = HostControl.Handle;
					while (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						if (!Utilities.IsWindowVisible(intPtr))
						{
							return false;
						}
						intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetParentApi(intPtr);
					}
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					return HostControl.TopLevelControl != null;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool IsWithinClosingNestedHostDesigner
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HostControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					Control parent = HostControl;
					if (parent == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					while (parent != null)
					{
						if (parent.Site != null && parent.Site.DesignMode)
						{
							IDesignerHost designerHost = parent.Site.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) as IDesignerHost;
							DesignerCollection designerCollection = ((!(parent.Site.GetService(typeof(IDesignerEventService)) is IDesignerEventService designerEventService)) ? null : designerEventService.Designers);
							bool flag = false;
							if (designerCollection != null)
							{
								foreach (IDesignerHost item in (IEnumerable)designerCollection)
								{
									if (item == designerHost)
									{
										flag = true;
										break;
									}
								}
							}
							return !flag;
						}
						parent = parent.Parent;
					}
					return false;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

					settings = new UltraDockManagerApplicationSettings((IComponent)this, settingsKey);

				return settings;
			}
		}

		internal DockAreaPane FillPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (LayoutStyle == DockAreaLayoutStyle.Standard)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (DoesHostControlHaveFilledControl)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int num = DockAreas.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreas[num];
					if (dockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating && dockAreaPane.IsVisible)
					{
						return dockAreaPane;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool DoesHostControlHaveFilledControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (HostControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HostControl is Form && ((Form)HostControl).IsMdiContainer)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (Control control in HostControl.Controls)
				{
					if (!(control is DockControlBase) && control.Dock == DockStyle.Fill)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle InnerDockedControlsBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (HostControl == null)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				ContainerControl containerControl = HostControl;
				Rectangle displayRectangle = containerControl.DisplayRectangle;
				int num2;
				int num3;
				int num4;
				int num = (num2 = (num3 = (num4 = -1)));
				foreach (Control control in containerControl.Controls)
				{
					if (!control.Visible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (control.Dock)
					{
					case DockStyle.Left:
						if (num == -1 || control.Right > num)
						{
							num = control.Right;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Right:
						if (num2 == -1 || control.Left < num2)
						{
							num2 = control.Left;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Top:
						if (num3 == -1 || control.Bottom > num3)
						{
							num3 = control.Bottom;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Bottom:
						if (num4 == -1 || control.Top < num4)
						{
							num4 = control.Top;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num == -1)
				{
					num = displayRectangle.Left;
				}
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = displayRectangle.Right;
				}
				if (num3 == -1)
				{
					num3 = displayRectangle.Top;
				}
				if (num4 == -1)
				{
					num4 = displayRectangle.Bottom;
				}
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(num, num3, num2, num4);
			}
		}

		internal ContextMenuManager ContextMenu
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (contextMenuManager == null)
				{
					contextMenuManager = new ContextMenuManager();
					((ContextMenuItemBase)contextMenuManager).Popup += OnMenuPopup;
				}
				contextMenuManager.TouchMetricsEnabled = AreTouchMetricsEnabled;
				switch (WindowStyleResolved)
				{
				case WindowStyle.Office2003:
					contextMenuManager.Style = (MenuStyle)3;
					break;
				case WindowStyle.VisualStudio2005:
					contextMenuManager.Style = (MenuStyle)4;
					break;
				case WindowStyle.Office2007:
					contextMenuManager.Style = (MenuStyle)6;
					break;
				case WindowStyle.VisualStudio2008:
					contextMenuManager.Style = (MenuStyle)8;
					break;
				default:
					contextMenuManager.Style = (MenuStyle)2;
					break;
				}
				contextMenuManager.RightToLeft = (IsHostRightToLeft ? RightToLeft.Yes : RightToLeft.No);
				return contextMenuManager;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				int num = SplitterBarWidth;
				if (AreTouchMetricsEnabled && num > 0)
				{
					return Math.Max(num, TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize((Control)HostControl, (TouchElementSizes)1).Width);
				}
				return num;
			}

		private bool LoadComponentSettingsFromXml()
		{
			bool result = false;
			string xmlData = Settings.XmlData;
			if (xmlData != null && xmlData.Length != 0)
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(memoryStream);
				streamWriter.Write(xmlData);
				streamWriter.Flush();
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				try
				{
					LoadFromXML(memoryStream);
					result = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void SaveAsXML(Stream stream)
		{
			SaveAsXmlHelper(stream);
		}

		public void SaveAsXML(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
			try
			{
				SaveAsXmlHelper(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void SaveAsXmlHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_44"));
			}
			IFormatter soapFormatter = GetSoapFormatter();
			soapFormatter.Serialize(stream, this);
		}

		public void LoadFromXML(Stream stream)
		{
			LoadFromXmlHelper(stream);
		}

		public void LoadFromXML(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				LoadFromXmlHelper(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void LoadFromXmlHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			IFormatter soapFormatter = GetSoapFormatter();
			LoadHelper(stream, soapFormatter);
		}

		private IFormatter GetSoapFormatter()
		{
			SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter();
			soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			return soapFormatter;
		}

		internal UIElementBorderStyle GetBorderStyleSplitterResolved(StyleUtils.SplitterRole roleId)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			StyleUtils.CachedProperty prop;
			switch (roleId)
			{
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.DockAreaSplitterVert:
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.DockAreaSplitterHorz:
				prop = StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderDockAreaSplitter;
				break;
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterVert:
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterHorz:
				prop = StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderFlyoutSplitter;
				break;
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.GroupPaneSplitterVert:
			case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.GroupPaneSplitterHorz:
				prop = StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderGroupPaneSplitter;
				break;
			default:
				return BorderStyleSplitterBarsResolved;
			}
			if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(this, prop, out var val))
			{
				StyleUtils.Role role;
				UIElementBorderStyle resolveVal;
				switch (roleId)
				{
				default:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.DockAreaSplitter;
					resolveVal = BorderStyleSplitterDefault;
					break;
				case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterVert:
				case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.FlyoutPaneSplitterHorz:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.FlyoutPaneSplitter;
					resolveVal = (UIElementBorderStyle)6;
					break;
				case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.GroupPaneSplitterVert:
				case StyleUtils.SplitterRole.GroupPaneSplitterHorz:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.GroupPaneSplitter;
					resolveVal = BorderStyleSplitterDefault;
					break;
				}
				val = StyleUtils.CacheBorderStylePropertyValue(this, prop, role, borderStyleSplitterBars, resolveVal);
			}
			return DrawUtility.AdjustBorderStyle((UIElementBorderStyle)val, ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).UseFlatModeResolved);
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void OutputPaneTree()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
			{
				OutputPaneTree(dockArea, stringBuilder, 1);
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			}
		}

		private static void OutputPaneTree(DockablePaneBase pane, StringBuilder sb, int indent)
		{
			sb.Append(new string('\t', indent));
			sb.Append(pane.ToString());
			sb.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			if (!(pane is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
			{
				OutputPaneTree(pane2, sb, indent + 1);
			}
		}

		private void LoadFromBinaryHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			IFormatter binaryFormatter = GetBinaryFormatter();
			LoadHelper(stream, binaryFormatter);
		}

		private void LoadHelper(Stream stream, IFormatter formatter)
		{
			if (AutoHideControl != null && AutoHideControl.FlyoutPane != null)
			{
				AutoHideControl.HideFlyoutPane(slide: false);
			}
			IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
			formatter.Binder = (SerializationBinder)(object)new Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.Serialization.Binder();
			UltraDockManager source = formatter.Deserialize(stream) as UltraDockManager;
			isLoadingFromStream = true;
			bool flag = false;
			if (!IsDesignMode && HostControl != null && HostControl.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				flag = NativeWindowMethods.SetRedraw(HostControl, newValue: false, redraw: false);
			}
			int num = layoutSuspendCount;
			layoutSuspendCount = 0;
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				InitializeFrom(source);
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
				if (HostControl != null)
				{
					InvalidateAutoHideControl(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: false);
					InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: false);
					InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: true, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: true);
					if (serializedUnpinnedInfo != null)
					{
						UnpinnedTabAreaInfo[] array = serializedUnpinnedInfo;
						foreach (UnpinnedTabAreaInfo unpinnedTabAreaInfo in array)
						{
							if (unpinnedTabAreaInfo != null)
							{
								GetTabArea(unpinnedTabAreaInfo.TabAreaSide)?.TabGroups.SortGroupsAndItems(unpinnedTabAreaInfo);
							}
						}
						serializedUnpinnedInfo = null;
					}
				}
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea.VerifyTabInfoCollection();
				}
				VerifyFillPane(reset: true);
				CheckDragDropAllowed();
				InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
				ControlPanes.SortSerializedControlPanes();
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					UIElement controlElement = (UIElement)(object)windowDockingArea.ControlElement;
					if (controlElement != null)
					{
						controlElement.VerifyChildElements();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isLoadingFromStream = false;
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea2 in DockAreas)
				{
					if (dockArea2.IsVisible && dockArea2.Container != null)
					{
						dockArea2.Container.SynchronizePaneDisplaySize();
					}
				}
				layoutSuspendCount = num;
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
			if (!IsDesignMode && isHostFormActive && hookedHostControlForm != null)
			{
				if (hookedHostControlForm.IsMdiChild)
				{
					if (hookedHostFormParent != null && hookedHostFormParent.ActiveMdiChild == hookedHostControlForm && hookedHostControlForm.CanSelect)
					{
						hookedHostFormParent.BringToFront();
					}
				}
				else if (hookedHostControlForm.CanSelect)
				{
					hookedHostControlForm.BringToFront();
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetRedraw(HostControl, newValue: true, redraw: true);
			}
			OnLayoutLoaded();
		}

		private IFormatter GetBinaryFormatter()
		{
			BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter();
			binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			return binaryFormatter;
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase PaneFromPosition(Point pt, bool ignoreFloatingWindows, bool ignoreControlPane, bool ignoreAutoHideControl)
		{
			return PaneFromPosition(pt, ignoreFloatingWindows, ignoreControlPane, ignoreAutoHideControl, null);
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase PaneFromPosition(Point pt, bool ignoreFloatingWindows, bool ignoreControlPane, bool ignoreAutoHideControl, WindowDockingArea dockingAreaToIgnore)
		{
			if (!ignoreFloatingWindows)
			{
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					WindowDockingArea dockingArea = floatingWindow.DockingArea;
					if (dockingArea != dockingAreaToIgnore)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = ((Control)(object)dockingArea).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)dockingArea).ClientRectangle);
						if (floatingWindow.Visible && rectangle.Contains(pt))
						{
							return PaneFromPosition(pt, (Control)(object)dockingArea, ignoreControlPane);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!ignoreAutoHideControl && AutoHideControl != null && ((Control)(object)AutoHideControl).Visible)
			{
				DockableControlPane flyoutPane = AutoHideControl.FlyoutPane;
				if (flyoutPane != null && ((Control)(object)flyoutPane.Container).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)flyoutPane.Container).DisplayRectangle).Contains(pt))
				{
					return flyoutPane;
				}
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Visible && windowDockingArea.DockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating && windowDockingArea != dockingAreaToIgnore && ((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).ClientRectangle).Contains(pt))
				{
					return PaneFromPosition(pt, (Control)(object)windowDockingArea, ignoreControlPane);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DockablePaneBase PaneFromPosition(Point pt, Control container, bool ignoreChildControls)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (container == null || container.IsDisposed || container.Disposing)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Point point = container.PointToClient(pt);
			if (!ignoreChildControls)
			{
				Control childAtPoint = container.GetChildAtPoint(point, GetChildAtPointSkip.Invisible);
				if (childAtPoint is DockableWindow)
				{
					return ((DockableWindow)(object)childAtPoint).ControlPane;
				}
			}
			if (!(container is WindowDockingArea))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = ((IUltraControlElement)container).MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)mainUIElement).ElementFromPoint(point, false);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool SuspendLayout()
		{
			if (isResuming)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isLayoutSuspended = IsLayoutSuspended;
			layoutSuspendCount++;
			return isLayoutSuspended;
		}

		public void ResumeLayout()
		{
			if (!IsLayoutSuspended || isResuming)
			{
				return;
			}
			layoutSuspendCount--;
			if (IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			isResuming = true;
			try
			{
				IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
				UpdatePanesCollection();
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea.ResumeLayout();
					VerifyPaneControlElements((Control)(object)dockArea.Container);
				}
				if (HostControl != null && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed && !IsDisposing)
				{
					ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(IsHostControlVisible);
				}
				SetTabOrder();
			}
			finally
			{
				isResuming = false;
			}
		}

		public void ShowAll()
		{
			ShowAll(pinUnpinnedPanes: false);
		}

		public void ShowAll(bool pinUnpinnedPanes)
		{
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea.ShowChildPanes(pinUnpinnedPanes);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		public void HideAll()
		{
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea.Close(closeChildPanes: true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		public void PinAll()
		{
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					if (dockArea.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
					{
						dockArea.Pin();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		public void UnpinAll()
		{
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					if (dockArea.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
					{
						dockArea.Unpin();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		public UIElement ElementFromPoint(Point pt)
		{
			elementFromPoint = null;
			ElementFromPoint(pt, DefaultFindElement);
			UIElement result = elementFromPoint;
			elementFromPoint = null;
			return result;
		}

		internal void ElementFromPoint(Point pt, FindElementHandler handler)
		{
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer item in GetOrderedFloatingWindowsByZOrder())
			{
				if (InvokeProcessElement(pt, handler, item))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (AutoHideControl != null && InvokeProcessElement(pt, handler, (Control)(object)AutoHideControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				if (windowDockingArea.DockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating && InvokeProcessElement(pt, handler, (Control)(object)windowDockingArea))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea control in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (InvokeProcessElement(pt, handler, (Control)(object)control))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool InvokeProcessElement(Point pt, FindElementHandler handler, Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!control.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control.IsDisposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point point = control.PointToClient(pt);
			Control control2 = null;
			control2 = control.GetChildAtPoint(point, GetChildAtPointSkip.Invisible);
			if (control2 is DockControlBase && (object)((ManagedContainerControlBase)(DockControlBase)(object)control2).Owner != this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (InvokeProcessElement(pt, handler, control2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			IUltraControlElement val = (IUltraControlElement)(object)((control is IUltraControlElement) ? control : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)val.MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement element = mainUIElement.ElementFromPoint(point);
			return InvokeHandler(element, handler, control, pt);
		}

		private bool InvokeHandler(UIElement element, FindElementHandler handler, Control control, Point pt)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (handler(control, element, pt))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return InvokeHandler(element.Parent, handler, control, pt);
		}

		private bool DefaultFindElement(Control control, UIElement element, Point pt)
		{
			if (control != null && !(control is FloatingWindowContainer) && !(control is DockControlBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			elementFromPoint = element;
			return true;
		}

		public void FlyIn()
		{
			FlyIn(AnimationEnabled);
		}

		public void FlyIn(bool slide)
		{
			if (AutoHideControl != null)
			{
				AutoHideControl.HideFlyoutPane(slide, force: true);
			}
		}

		public DockAreaPane DockControls(Control[] controls, DockedLocation location, ChildPaneStyle paneStyle)
		{
			if (controls == null || controls.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Controls cannot be docked if the 'HostControl' has not been assigned.");
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ChildPaneStyle), paneStyle))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("paneStyle", (int)paneStyle, typeof(ChildPaneStyle));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DockedLocation), location))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("location", (int)location, typeof(DockedLocation));
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Control control in controls)
			{
				if (control != null)
				{
					if (ControlPanes.Contains(control))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("The 'CreateDockArea' method is only used with controls that are not already docked.");
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			DockableControlPane[] array = new DockableControlPane[num];
			foreach (Control control2 in controls)
			{
				if (control2 != null)
				{
					array[num2] = new DockableControlPane(null, control2.Name, control2);
					num2++;
				}
			}
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = new DockAreaPane(location);
			dockAreaPane.ChildPaneStyle = paneStyle;
			dockAreaPane.Panes.AddRange(array);
			DockAreas.Add(dockAreaPane);
			return dockAreaPane;
		}

		internal DockablePaneBase PaneFromId(Guid id)
		{
			return FindPaneWithCriteria(id.ToString(), DoesPaneIdMatch);
		}

		internal void PaneAdded(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing && !pane.IsBeingRepositioned)
			{
				UpdatePanesCollection();
				bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
				}
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				try
				{
					SuspendHostControlLayout();
					SetupPaneControl(pane);
					ResumeHostControlLayout();
				}
				finally
				{
					ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
				}
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
				if (!pane.IsPromotingToParentGroup)
				{
					EnsurePaneContainerHasActiveControl(pane);
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsurePaneContainerHasActiveControl(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			Control containingControl = (Control)(object)pane.ContainingControl;
			if (containingControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Form form = containingControl.FindForm();
				IContainerControl containerControl = containingControl.GetContainerControl();
				if (containerControl != null && form == Form.ActiveForm && containerControl.ActiveControl == null)
				{
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
					pane.Activate();
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		internal void PaneRemoved(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing && !pane.IsBeingRepositioned)
			{
				UpdatePanesCollection();
				InternalPaneRemoved(pane);
				if (!(pane is DockableControlPane) || !ControlPanes.Contains(pane))
				{
					pane.InitControl(null);
					ResetControlPaneManager();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetControlPaneManager()
		{
			foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in ControlPanes)
			{
				controlPane.InitControl(this);
			}
		}

		private void InternalPaneRemoved(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = (DockableGroupPane)pane;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
				{

					{
						pane2.SetParentFloating(null);
					}
					else
					{
						pane2.SetParentDocked(null);
					}
					InternalPaneRemoved(pane2);
				}
				bool isBeingRepositioned = dockableGroupPane.IsBeingRepositioned;
				dockableGroupPane.IsBeingRepositioned = true;

				dockableGroupPane.IsBeingRepositioned = isBeingRepositioned;
				if (pane is DockAreaPane)

				{

				}
			}
		}

		internal void ControlPaneRemoved(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing && !initializingCollections)
			{
				if (pane.IsUnpinned)
				{
					pane.Pin();
				}
				if (pane.IsMdiChild)
				{
					pane.IsMdiChild = false;
				}
				if (pane.Parent != null)
				{
					pane.Parent.Panes.Remove(pane);
				}
				RemoveControlPaneContainer(pane);
				pane.SetParentDocked(null);
				pane.SetParentFloating(null);
				pane.InitControl(null);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowFlyoutPane(DockableControlPane pane, bool forceFocus, bool slide, DefaultableBoolean honorActiveState)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pane == null)

			if (forceFocus && IsFlyoutPane(pane))

		}

		internal void ShowFlyoutPane(DockableControlPane pane, bool forceFocus, bool slide)

		}

		internal bool IsFlyoutPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (AutoHideControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return AutoHideControl.IsPaneDisplayed(pane);
		}

		internal void HideFlyoutPane(bool slide)

				AutoHideControl.HideFlyoutPane(slide && AnimationEnabled);
			}
		}

		internal void PinPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (!pane.IsUnpinned)
			{
				return;
			}
			isPinning = true;
			MdiTabStopHelper mdiTabStopHelper = MdiTabStopHelper.PrepareTabStops(HostControl as Form);
			try
			{
				HideFlyoutPane(slide: false);
				ReparentControl((Control)(object)pane.Container, (Control)(object)pane.Parent.ContainingControl);
				if (pane.Container != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)pane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.None;
					((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = pane.IsVisible;
				}
				UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedAreaForPane = GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(pane);
				unpinnedAreaForPane.RemoveUnpinnedPane(pane);
			}
			finally
			{
				isPinning = false;
				mdiTabStopHelper?.Restore();
			}
		}

		internal void UnpinPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (pane.IsUnpinned)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_45"));
			}
			isUnpinning = true;
			MdiTabStopHelper mdiTabStopHelper = MdiTabStopHelper.PrepareTabStops(HostControl as Form);
			bool flag = pane.IsUnpinning;
			pane.IsUnpinning = true;
			try
			{
				UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedAreaForPane = GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(pane);
				unpinnedAreaForPane.AddUnpinnedPane(pane);
				if (pane.Container == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool isActive = pane.IsActive;
				((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = false;
				ReparentControl((Control)(object)pane.Container, (Control)(object)AutoHideControl);
				if (!pane.Closed)
				{
					if (pane == unpinnedPaneToDisplay || unpinnedPaneToDisplay == null)
					{
						ShowFlyoutPane(pane, forceFocus: false, slide: false);
					}
					else if (FlyoutPane != unpinnedPaneToDisplay)
					{
						HideFlyoutPane(slide: false);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				pane.IsUnpinning = flag;
				isUnpinning = false;
				mdiTabStopHelper?.Restore();
			}
		}

		internal void BeginGroupUnpin(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (groupBeingUnpinned != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SuspendHostControlLayout();
			groupBeingUnpinned = group;
			if (group.IsActive)
			{
				unpinnedPaneToDisplay = ActivePane;
				return;
			}
			DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = group.SelectedTabPane;
			while (selectedTabPane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				selectedTabPane = ((DockableGroupPane)selectedTabPane).SelectedTabPane;
			}
			unpinnedPaneToDisplay = selectedTabPane as DockableControlPane;
		}

		internal void EndGroupUnpin(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (groupBeingUnpinned == group)
			{
				((unpinnedPaneToDisplay == null) ? null : GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(unpinnedPaneToDisplay))?.VerifyPaneIsSelected(unpinnedPaneToDisplay);
				groupBeingUnpinned = null;
				unpinnedPaneToDisplay = null;
				ResumeHostControlLayout();
			}
		}

		internal void BeginGroupPin(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (groupBeingPinned == null)
			{
				SuspendHostControlLayout();
				groupBeingPinned = group;
				pinnedPaneToDisplay = FlyoutPane;
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
			}
		}

		internal void EndGroupPin(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (groupBeingPinned == group)
			{
				if (pinnedPaneToDisplay != null && pinnedPaneToDisplay.IsVisible)
				{
					pinnedPaneToDisplay.Activate();
				}
				groupBeingPinned = null;
				pinnedPaneToDisplay = null;
				ResumeHostControlLayout();
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		private UIElement CustomGetDescendant(UIElement element, Type type, object context)
		{

				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Image GetPaneButtonImage(PaneButton button, DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			string name;
			PaneButtonImage paneButtonImage;
			switch (button)
			{
			case PaneButton.Maximize:
				if (pane.MaximizedResolved)
				{
					if (IsVCStyleCaption)
					{
						name = "ExpandButtonVC.ico";
						paneButtonImage = ((!pane.HasVerticalCaption) ? PaneButtonImage.VCExpandDown : PaneButtonImage.VCExpandRight);
					}
					else
					{
						paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Restore;
						name = "RestoreButton.ico";
					}
				}
				else if (IsVCStyleCaption)
				{
					name = "ExpandButtonVC.ico";
					paneButtonImage = ((!pane.HasVerticalCaption) ? PaneButtonImage.VCExpandUp : PaneButtonImage.VCExpandLeft);
				}
				else
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Maximize;
					name = "MaximizeButton.ico";
				}
				break;
			case PaneButton.Minimize:
				if (IsVCStyleCaption)
				{
					name = "ExpandButtonVC.ico";
					paneButtonImage = ((!pane.HasVerticalCaption) ? PaneButtonImage.VCExpandUp : PaneButtonImage.VCExpandLeft);
				}
				else if (pane.Minimized)
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Restore;
					name = "RestoreButton.ico";
				}
				else
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Minimize;
					name = "MinimizeButton.ico";
				}
				break;
			case PaneButton.Pin:
				if (pane.IsUnpinned)
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Unpin;
					name = "UnpinButton.ico";
				}
				else
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Pin;
					name = "PinButton.ico";
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (IsVCStyleCaption)
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.VCClose;
					name = "CloseButtonVC.ico";
				}
				else
				{
					paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Close;
					name = ((!isXP || !XPThemes.ThemesSupported || !XPThemes.AppControlsThemeThemed || !XPThemes.IsThemeActive) ? "CloseButton.ico" : "CloseButtonXP.ico");
				}
				break;
			case PaneButton.Menu:
				paneButtonImage = PaneButtonImage.Menu;
				name = "MenuButton.ico";
				break;
			}
			int num = (int)paneButtonImage;
			if (paneButtonImages == null)
			{
				int length = Enum.GetValues(typeof(PaneButtonImage)).Length;
				paneButtonImages = new Image[length];
				paneButtonImageStreams = new Stream[length];
			}
			if (paneButtonImages[num] == null)
			{
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraDockManager).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraDockManager), name);
				paneButtonImageStreams[num] = manifestResourceStream;
				paneButtonImages[num] = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
				switch (paneButtonImage)
				{
				case PaneButtonImage.VCExpandDown:
					paneButtonImages[num].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX);
					break;
				case PaneButtonImage.VCExpandLeft:
					paneButtonImages[num].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipX);
					break;
				case PaneButtonImage.VCExpandRight:
					paneButtonImages[num].RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
					break;
				}
			}
			return paneButtonImages[num];
		}

		internal UIRole GetPaneButtonRole(PaneButton button, DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			return StyleUtils.GetRole(this, button switch
			{
				PaneButton.Maximize => (!pane.MaximizedResolved) ? StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonMax : StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonRestore, 
				PaneButton.Minimize => (!pane.Minimized) ? StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonMin : StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonRestore, 
				PaneButton.Pin => (!pane.IsUnpinned) ? StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonPin : StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonUnpin, 
				PaneButton.Menu => StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonMenu, 
				_ => StyleUtils.Role.PaneCaptionButtonClose, 
			});
		}

		internal DockableGroupPane RepositionPane(DockablePaneBase paneToReposition, DockableGroupPane newParent, int index, bool flatten, bool removeUnused, bool includeHiddenPanes)
		{
			if (paneToReposition is DockAreaPane && !flatten)
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = new DockableGroupPane();
				dockableGroupPane.InitializeFrom(paneToReposition, PropertyCategories.All);
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = (DockAreaPane)paneToReposition;
				newParent.Panes.Insert(dockableGroupPane, index);
				for (int num = dockAreaPane.Panes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DockablePaneBase pane = dockAreaPane.Panes[num];
					MovePanes(pane, dockableGroupPane, 0, flatten, includeHiddenPanes);
				}
				newParent = dockableGroupPane;
			}
			else
			{
				newParent = MovePanes(paneToReposition, newParent, index, flatten, includeHiddenPanes);
			}
			if (removeUnused)
			{
				RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
			}
			return newParent;
		}

		internal DockableGroupPane MovePanes(DockablePaneBase pane, DockableGroupPane newParent, int index, bool flatten)
		{

		}

		private DockableGroupPane MovePanes(DockablePaneBase pane, DockableGroupPane newParent, int index, bool flatten, bool includeHiddenPanes)
		{
			DockableGroupPane result = newParent;
			if (!includeHiddenPanes && (pane.Closed || pane.IsUnpinned))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!includeHiddenPanes && pane is DockableControlPane && ((DockableControlPane)pane).IsMdiChild)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Size displaySize = pane.DisplaySize;
			bool flag = pane.DockAreaPane != null && pane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating;
			DockableGroupPane parentFloating = pane.ParentFloating;
			if (pane.Parent != null && pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				pane.IsBeingRepositioned = true;
				if (index == -1)
				{
					index = pane.Parent.Panes.IndexOf(pane);
				}
				pane.Parent.Panes.Remove(pane);
				pane.IsBeingRepositioned = false;
			}
			if (index == -1)
			{
				index = 0;
			}
			if (pane is DockableControlPane)

		internal void RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas()
		{

		private void RemoveUnreferencedDockAreasHelper()
		{
			if (IsUnhooking || IsLayoutSuspended || (IsDesignMode && IsDisposing))
			{
				return;
			}

			{
				while (RemoveUnreferencedGroupPanes())

				}
			}
			IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
			DoesPaneMeetCriteria criteriaCheck = DoesDockAreaHaveControlPaneReferenced;
			for (int num = DockAreas.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreas[num];
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = null;
				if (dockAreaPane.Manager != null)
				{
					dockablePaneBase = FindPaneWithCriteria(dockAreaPane, criteriaCheck);
				}
				if (dockablePaneBase == null)
				{
					DockAreas.Remove(dockAreaPane);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool DoesDockAreaHaveControlPaneReferenced(DockablePaneBase pane, object dockArea)
		{
			if (pane is DockAreaPane)
			{
				return false;
			}

			{
				return true;

			if ((pane.ParentDocked != null && pane.ParentDocked.DockAreaPane == dockAreaPane) || (pane.ParentFloating != null && pane.ParentFloating.DockAreaPane == dockAreaPane))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

				return false;
			}
			if (CaptionStyleResolved == CaptionStyle.VC6)
			{
				return IsFloatingDockAreaCaption(pane);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsFloatingDockAreaCaption(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (pane is DockAreaPane && pane.DockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = pane.DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Docked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)dockAreaPane.SettingsResolved.ShowCaption == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockAreaPane.FirstVisiblePane == pane)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsFirstVisiblePaneWithCaption(dockAreaPane, pane))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsFirstVisiblePaneWithCaption(DockableGroupPane group, DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = group.ChildPaneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup;
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in group.Panes)
			{
				if (pane.IsVisible && (!flag || pane2 == group.SelectedTabPane))
				{
					if ((int)pane2.SettingsResolved.ShowCaption == 1)
					{
						return pane2 == pane;
					}
					if (pane2 is DockableGroupPane && IsFirstVisiblePaneWithCaption((DockableGroupPane)pane2, pane))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal ColorMap[] GetImageColorMapTable(object appearanceImage)
		{
			Color transparentColor = ImageTransparentColor;
			if (ImageList != null && ImageList.TransparentColor != Color.Transparent && appearanceImage != null && !(appearanceImage is Image))
			{
				transparentColor = ImageList.TransparentColor;
			}
			if (transparentColor == Color.Transparent || transparentColor == Color.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
			colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
			colorMap.OldColor = transparentColor;
			return new ColorMap[1] { colorMap };
		}

		internal TabManagerBase GetOwningTabInfo(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane is DockableControlPane && (pane.IsUnpinned || isPinning || isUnpinning))
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = ((pane is DockableControlPane dockableControlPane) ? dockableControlPane.DockAreaPane : null);
				if (dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Docked)
				{
					DockableGroupPane parent = pane.Parent;
					if (parent.TemporaryUnpinnedTabInfo != null)
					{
						return parent.TemporaryUnpinnedTabInfo;
					}
					UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
					foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
					{
						if (unpinnedTabArea != null && unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups != null)
						{
							TabManagerBase tabManagerBase = unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups.TabInfoFromPane(parent);
							if (tabManagerBase != null && tabManagerBase.Tabs.Contains(pane))
							{
								return tabManagerBase;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (pane.Parent != null)
			{
				return pane.Parent.TabInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool ToggleMdiChildState(DockableControlPane pane, bool newState)
		{
			bool flag = isTogglingMdiChildState;
			isTogglingMdiChildState = true;
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				if (newState)
				{
					bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
					if (!isUpdating)
					{
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
					}
					if (pane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
					{
						pane.Dock(maintainPreviousState: true);
					}
					SetupMdiChildPane(pane);
					if (!isUpdating)
					{
						((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
					}
					return true;
				}
				Form form = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)pane.Container) as MdiChildFormBase;
				ReparentControl((Control)(object)pane.Container, (Control)(object)pane.Parent.ContainingControl);
				if (pane.Container != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)pane.Container).Dock = DockStyle.None;
					((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = pane.IsVisible;
				}
				if (form != null)
				{
					MdiChildForms.Remove(form);
					form.Dispose();
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				isTogglingMdiChildState = flag;
				pane.VerifyIsInViewState();
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateControlPaneVisibility(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = pane as DockableControlPane;
				if (dockableControlPane.IsMdiChild)
				{
					SetupMdiChildPane(dockableControlPane);
				}
				else
				{
					dockableControlPane.DirtyUIElement();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(pane is DockableGroupPane))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in ((DockableGroupPane)pane).Panes)
				{
					UpdateControlPaneVisibility(pane2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSplitterBarRequired(DockAreaPane dockArea)
		{
			if (IsFillPane(dockArea))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dockArea.DockedLocation != DockedLocation.Floating;
		}

		internal bool IsFillPane(DockAreaPane dockArea)
		{
			return FillPane == dockArea;
		}

		internal void VerifyFillPane(bool reset)
		{
			if (IsDisposing || (!reset && LayoutStyle == DockAreaLayoutStyle.Standard))
			{
				return;
			}
			DockAreaPane fillPane = FillPane;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = DockAreas.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DockStyle dockStyle = DockStyle.Fill;
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreas[num];
				if (dockAreaPane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating)
				{
					dockStyle = ((dockAreaPane != fillPane) ? DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(dockAreaPane.DockedLocation) : DockStyle.Fill);
					if (dockAreaPane.Container != null && !((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).Disposing && ((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).Dock != dockStyle)
					{
						flag = true;
						if (dockStyle == DockStyle.Fill && !InitializingComponent)
						{
							dockAreaPane.UnfilledSize = ((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).Size;
						}
						((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).Dock = dockStyle;
						if (dockStyle != DockStyle.Fill)
						{
							((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container).Size = dockAreaPane.UnfilledSize;
							dockAreaPane.ResetUnfilledSize();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: true, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: false);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyPaneControlElements(Control control)
		{
			VerifyPaneControlElements(control, forceControlElementCreation: false);
		}

		internal void VerifyPaneControlElements(Control control, bool forceControlElementCreation)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(control is DockControlBase) || control.IsDisposed || (!forceControlElementCreation && !((DockControlBase)(object)control).HasControlUIElement) || !control.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			((UIElement)((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement).Rect = control.ClientRectangle;
			((UIElement)((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
			{
				VerifyPaneControlElements(control2);
			}
		}

		internal void OnFlyoutSizeChanged(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (pane != null && pane == FlyoutPane && !IsInitializing && !IsLoadingFromStream && !IsLayoutSuspended && !IsDisposing && autoHideControl != null)

			}
		}

		internal void SuspendHostControlLayout()
		{
			Control control = HostControl;
			if (control != null)
			{
				hostControlLayoutCount++;
				control.SuspendLayout();
			}
		}

		internal void ResumeHostControlLayout()
		{
			ResumeHostControlLayout((DefaultableBoolean)0);
		}

		internal void ResumeHostControlLayout(bool performLayout)
		{
			ResumeHostControlLayout((DefaultableBoolean)(performLayout ? 1 : 2));
		}

		private void ResumeHostControlLayout(DefaultableBoolean performLayout)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Control control = HostControl;
			if (control != null)
			{
				hostControlLayoutCount--;
				if ((int)performLayout == 0)
				{
					control.ResumeLayout();
				}
				else
				{
					control.ResumeLayout((int)performLayout == 1);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateOverlayControl()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			Type type = Type.GetType("System.Windows.Forms.Design.ISelectionUIService, System.Design");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object service = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(type);
			if (service == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("SyncSelection");
				if (method != null)
				{
					method.Invoke(service, new object[0]);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void DelayInvalidateOverlayControl()
		{
			if ((delayedOverlayInvalidation == null || delayedOverlayInvalidation.IsCompleted) && HostControl != null && HostControl.IsHandleCreated && IsDesignMode && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed && !IsDisposing)
			{
				HostControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(InvalidateOverlayControl));
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshHostAndOwnedForms()
		{
			if (HostControl != null && HostControl.IsHandleCreated && !HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				HostControl.Refresh();
			}
			if (hookedHostControlForm == null || !hookedHostControlForm.IsHandleCreated || hookedHostControlForm.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form[] ownedForms = hookedHostControlForm.OwnedForms;
			foreach (Form form in ownedForms)
			{
				if (form != null && form.IsHandleCreated && !form.IsDisposed)
				{
					form.Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateHostAndOwnedForms()
		{
			if (HostControl != null && HostControl.IsHandleCreated && !HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				HostControl.Update();
			}
			if (hookedHostControlForm == null || !hookedHostControlForm.IsHandleCreated || hookedHostControlForm.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Form[] ownedForms = hookedHostControlForm.OwnedForms;
			foreach (Form form in ownedForms)
			{
				if (form != null && form.IsHandleCreated && !form.IsDisposed)
				{
					form.Update();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BeginGroupClose(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			SuspendIsInViewEvents();
			if (activeGroupBeingClosed == null && group != null && group.IsActive)
			{
				activeGroupBeingClosed = group;
			}
		}

		internal void EndGroupClose(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			try
			{
				if (activeGroupBeingClosed != group || group == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				activeGroupBeingClosed = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
			ChangeActivePaneIfHidden();
		}

		internal void OnPaneClosed(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (activeGroupBeingClosed == null)
			{
				ChangeActivePaneIfHidden();
			}
		}

		private void ChangeActivePaneIfHidden()
		{
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = ActivePane;
			if (dockableControlPane == null || (!dockableControlPane.Closed && !dockableControlPane.IsAncestorClosed))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag;
			if (dockableControlPane.IsUnpinned)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (dockableControlPane.IsMdiChild)
			{
				flag = false;
				Form form = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container) as MdiChildForm;
				if (form != null)
				{
					Utilities.SetActiveControl(form, null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
				DockableGroupPane parent = dockableControlPane.Parent;
				DockablePaneBase pane = dockableControlPane;
				while (parent != null)
				{
					if (!parent.Closed)
					{
						DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = parent.GetNextVisiblePane(pane);
						if (dockablePaneBase == null)
						{
							dockablePaneBase = parent.GetPreviousVisiblePane(pane);
						}
						if (dockablePaneBase != null)
						{
							dockablePaneBase.Activate();
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					pane = parent;
					parent = parent.Parent;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dockableControlPane.Container != null)
			{
				MdiTabStopHelper mdiTabStopHelper = MdiTabStopHelper.PrepareTabStops(HostControl as Form);
				try
				{
					HostControl.SelectNextControl((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container, forward: true, tabStopOnly: true, nested: true, wrap: true);
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					mdiTabStopHelper?.Restore();
				}
			}
			Utilities.SetActiveControl(HostControl, null);
		}

		internal void SetControlVisibility(Control control, bool isVisible)
		{
			MdiTabStopHelper mdiTabStopHelper = MdiTabStopHelper.PrepareTabStops(HostControl as Form);
			try
			{
				if (isVisible && Utilities.GetParent(control) is FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindowContainer)
				{
					floatingWindowContainer.SynchronizeDockAreaProperties();
				}
				control.Visible = isVisible;
			}
			finally
			{
				mdiTabStopHelper?.Restore();
			}
		}

		internal void OnAppStyleChanged()
		{
			if (!IsInitializing)
			{
				Utilities.TabManagerChangeType changeType = Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate | Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.Font;
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
				DirtyUnpinnedTabManagers(changeType);
				DirtyTabManagers(changeType);
				InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
				InvalidateAutoHideControl(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: true, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: true);
			}
		}

		internal void SyncFloatingPaneVisibilityWithFormActive()
		{
			if (HideFloatingPanesWhenDeactivated && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				Form form = null;
				if (HostControl != null)
				{
					form = Utilities.FindForm(HostControl);
				}
				bool show = Utilities.IsFormOrOwnedFormActive(form, (IEnumerable)floatingWindows);
				ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(show);
			}
		}

		internal void TriggerSaveComponentSettings()
		{
			if (saveSettings && !((Component)this).DesignMode && !saveComponentSettingsAlreadyTriggered)
			{
				saveComponentSettingsAlreadyTriggered = true;
				SaveComponentSettings();
			}
		}

		protected override void ChangeControlsVisibleState()
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdatePanesCollection();
			bool visible = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible;
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = tabAreas[i];
					unpinnedTabArea.UpdateSize();
				}
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					if (!visible || windowDockingArea.DockAreaPane == null)
					{
						((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Visible = false;
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Visible = windowDockingArea.DockAreaPane.IsVisible;
					}
				}
				ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(visible);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
				VerifyIsInViewState();
			}
		}

		protected override void ChangeControlsEnabledState()
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdatePanesCollection();
			bool enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = tabAreas[i];
					((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Enabled = enabled;
				}
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Enabled = enabled;
				}
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					floatingWindow.Enabled = enabled;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
		}

		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.ControlPaneRemoved || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ControlPaneClear)
				{
					RemoveUnreferencedDockAreas();
				}
			}
			Enum propId = propChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null).PropId;
			if (propId is PropertyIds && (PropertyIds)(object)propId == PropertyIds.Pinned)
			{
				InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
			}
			if (propId is PropertyIds && !IsLayoutSuspended && (PropertyIds)(object)propId == PropertyIds.ShowCaption)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					if (dockArea.Container != null && !((Control)(object)dockArea.Container).IsDisposed)
					{
						VerifyPaneControlElements((Control)(object)dockArea.Container);
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDesignMode && propId is PropertyIds && (PropertyIds)(object)propId == PropertyIds.Size)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HasSplitterBarAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == splitterBarAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				InvalidateAutoHideControl(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: false);
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: false, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: false);
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.SplitterBarAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasUnpinnedTabAreaAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == unpinnedTabAreaAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: false);
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.UnpinnedTabAreaAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == controlPanes)
			{
				if (propChangeInfo.Trigger == null)
				{
					IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
				}
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ControlPanes, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == appearances)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearances, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == dockAreas)
			{
				IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DockAreas, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == defaultGroupSettings)
			{
				if ((PropertyIds)(object)propId == PropertyIds.CloseButtonLocation)
				{
					InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
				}
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: true, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: true);
				DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.DefaultGroupSettings, propChangeInfo));
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea2 in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea2.ResumeLayout();
				}
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DefaultGroupSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == defaultPaneSettings)
			{
				InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: true, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: true);
				DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings, propChangeInfo));
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea3 in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea3.ResumeLayout();
				}
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == navigatorSettings)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.NavigatorSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				TriggerSaveComponentSettings();
				HostControl = null;
				if (tooltip != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)tooltip).Dispose();
					tooltip = null;
				}
				if (unpinnedTabAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					unpinnedTabAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					unpinnedTabAreaAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					unpinnedTabAreaAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (splitterBarAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					splitterBarAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					splitterBarAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					splitterBarAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (appearances != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Disposed)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)appearances).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)appearances).Dispose();
					appearances = null;
				}
				if (dockAreas != null && !dockAreas.Disposed)
				{
					dockAreas.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					dockAreas.Dispose();
					dockAreas = null;
				}
				if (controlPanes != null && !controlPanes.Disposed)
				{
					controlPanes.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					controlPanes.Dispose();
					controlPanes = null;
				}
				if (defaultGroupSettings != null && !defaultGroupSettings.Disposed)
				{
					defaultGroupSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					defaultGroupSettings.Dispose();
					defaultGroupSettings = null;
				}
				if (defaultPaneSettings != null && !defaultPaneSettings.Disposed)
				{
					defaultPaneSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					defaultPaneSettings.Dispose();
					defaultPaneSettings = null;
				}
				if (paneButtonImages != null)
				{
					Image[] array = paneButtonImages;
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						array[i]?.Dispose();
					}
					Stream[] array2 = paneButtonImageStreams;
					for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
					{
						array2[j]?.Close();
					}
					paneButtonImages = null;
					paneButtonImageStreams = null;
				}
				if (contextMenuManager != null)
				{
					((ContextMenuItemBase)contextMenuManager).Popup -= OnMenuPopup;
					((DisposableObject)(object)contextMenuManager).Dispose();
					contextMenuManager = null;
				}
				DeleteSavedManagerSettings();
				if (parentManager != null)
				{
					parentManager.Clear();
				}
				Office2007ColorTable.ColorSchemeChanged -= OnOffice2007ColorSchemeChanged;
			}
			((UltraStylableComponent)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void SetupMdiChildPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockableWindow paneContainer = GetPaneContainer(pane);
			((Control)(object)paneContainer).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			MdiChildFormBase mdiChildFormBase = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)paneContainer) as MdiChildFormBase;
			Form form = HostControl as Form;
			if (mdiChildFormBase == null)
			{
				mdiChildFormBase = CreateMdiChildForm(pane);
				mdiChildFormBase.MdiParent = form;
			}
			ReparentControl((Control)(object)pane.Container, mdiChildFormBase);
			ReparentControl(pane.Control, (Control)(object)pane.Container);
			pane.InitializePinnedState(pinnedState: true);
			bool visible = (((Control)(object)paneContainer).Visible = IsMdiChildVisible(mdiChildFormBase));
			if (form != null && !form.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				if (hookedMdiParent == null)
				{
					hookedMdiParent = form;
					hookedMdiParent.Load += OnMdiParentLoad;
					hookedMdiParent.Disposed += OnMdiParentDisposed;
					childFormsToShow = new List<MdiChildFormBase>();
				}
				childFormsToShow.Add(mdiChildFormBase);
			}
			else
			{
				mdiChildFormBase.Visible = visible;
			}
			pane.VerifyIsInViewState();
		}

		private void SetupPaneControl(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea = null;
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = pane.DockAreaPane;
			windowDockingArea = CreateDockAreaContainer(dockAreaPane);
			((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).SuspendLayout();
			if (pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = (DockableControlPane)pane;
				if (!ControlPanes.Contains(pane))
				{
					ControlPanes.Add(dockableControlPane);
				}
				if (CanCreateMdiChildForms && dockableControlPane.IsMdiChild)
				{
					if (IsDesignMode || IsInheritedDesignComponent((Component)(object)this))
					{
						CreatePaneContainer(dockableControlPane, windowDockingArea);
						((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container).Visible = false;
						ReparentControl((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container, (Control)(object)AutoHideControl);
					}
					SetupMdiChildPane(dockableControlPane);
				}
				else
				{
					CreatePaneContainer(dockableControlPane, windowDockingArea);
					if (pane.IsUnpinned)
					{
						UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedAreaForPane = GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(dockableControlPane);
						unpinnedAreaForPane.AddUnpinnedPane(dockableControlPane);
						ReparentControl((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container, (Control)(object)AutoHideControl);
					}
					else
					{
						ReparentControl((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.Container, (Control)(object)windowDockingArea);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = (DockableGroupPane)pane;
				if (dockableGroupPane.HasChildPanes())
				{
					foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
					{
						SetupPaneControl(pane2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Dock != DockStyle.Fill || FillPane != dockAreaPane)
			{
				((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Dock = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(dockAreaPane.DockedLocation);
			}
			VerifyFillPane(reset: false);
			((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			if (!pane.IsInitialized)
			{
				OnInitializePane(new InitializePaneEventArgs(pane, pane.AutomaticallyGenerated));
			}
		}

		private void InitializePaneControls()
		{
			for (int num = DockableWindows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Control control = DockableWindows[num] as Control;
				if (!control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
				{
					UnusedDockableWindows.Add(control);
					DockableWindows.Remove(control);
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = WindowDockingAreas.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				Control control2 = WindowDockingAreas[num2] as Control;
				if (!control2.IsDisposed && !control2.Disposing)
				{
					UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Add(control2);
					WindowDockingAreas.Remove(control2);
				}
			}
			DockAreas.InitControl(this);
			ControlPanes.InitControl(this);
			InitializeUnpinnedTabAreas();
			ReparentControl((Control)(object)AutoHideControl, HostControl);
			IncrementPanesCollectionVersion();
			UpdatePanesCollection();
			for (int num3 = ControlPanes.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = ControlPanes[num3];
				if (dockableControlPane.Control == null)
				{
					ControlPanes.Remove(dockableControlPane);
				}
			}
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
			{
				PaneAdded(dockArea);
				dockArea.ResumeLayout();
			}
			try
			{
				if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					foreach (WindowDockingArea unusedWindowDockingArea in UnusedWindowDockingAreas)
					{
						DestroyControl((Control)(object)unusedWindowDockingArea);
					}
					foreach (DockableWindow unusedDockableWindow in UnusedDockableWindows)
					{
						DestroyControl((Control)(object)unusedDockableWindow);
					}
				}
				UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Clear();
				UnusedDockableWindows.Clear();
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea2 in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Add(windowDockingArea2);
				}
				WindowDockingAreas.Clear();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea2 in DockAreas)
				{
					if (UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Contains(dockArea2.Container))
					{
						UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Remove(dockArea2.Container);
					}
					WindowDockingAreas.Add(dockArea2.Container);
				}
				foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow2 in DockableWindows)
				{
					UnusedDockableWindows.Add(dockableWindow2);
				}
				DockableWindows.Clear();
				foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in ControlPanes)
				{
					if (controlPane.Container != null)
					{
						if (UnusedDockableWindows.Contains(controlPane.Container))
						{
							UnusedDockableWindows.Remove(controlPane.Container);
						}
						DockableWindows.Add(controlPane.Container);
					}
				}
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					UnusedFloatingWindows.Add(floatingWindow);
				}
				FloatingWindows.Clear();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea3 in DockAreas)
				{
					if (dockArea3.DockedState == DockedState.Docked || dockArea3.Container == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)dockArea3.Container);
					if (parent != null)
					{
						if (UnusedFloatingWindows.Contains(parent))
						{
							UnusedFloatingWindows.Remove(parent);
						}
						FloatingWindows.Add(parent);
					}
				}
				foreach (DockableWindow unusedDockableWindow2 in UnusedDockableWindows)
				{
					unusedDockableWindow2.ControlPane = null;
					DestroyControl((Control)(object)unusedDockableWindow2);
				}
				foreach (WindowDockingArea unusedWindowDockingArea2 in UnusedWindowDockingAreas)
				{
					unusedWindowDockingArea2.DockAreaPane = null;
					DestroyControl((Control)(object)unusedWindowDockingArea2);
				}
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer unusedFloatingWindow in UnusedFloatingWindows)
				{
					DestroyControl(unusedFloatingWindow);
				}
				UnusedFloatingWindows.Clear();
				RemoveDisposedControls(UnusedDockableWindows);
				RemoveDisposedControls(UnusedWindowDockingAreas);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea4 in DockAreas)
			{
				PaneAdded(dockArea4);
				dockArea4.ResumeLayout();
			}
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in panesCollection)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = item.Value as DockablePaneBase;
				if (!dockablePaneBase.IsInitialized)
				{
					OnInitializePane(new InitializePaneEventArgs(dockablePaneBase, createdAutomatically: false));
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDisposedControls(ArrayList controlList)
		{
			for (int num = controlList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (controlList[num] is Control { IsDisposed: not false })
				{
					controlList.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsContainedPaneBeingRepositioned(DockAreaPane dockArea)
		{
			if (dockArea == null || IsDisposing || !DockAreas.Contains(dockArea) || dockArea.Disposed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return FindPaneWithCriteria(dockArea, ContainsPaneBeingReparented) != null;
		}

		private bool ContainsPaneBeingReparented(DockablePaneBase pane, object criteria)
		{
			if (!pane.IsBeingRepositioned)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = criteria as DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Docked && pane.ParentDocked != null && (dockAreaPane == pane.ParentDocked || dockAreaPane.Contains(pane.ParentDocked, recursive: true)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && pane.ParentFloating != null && (dockAreaPane.Contains(pane.ParentFloating, recursive: true) || dockAreaPane == pane.ParentFloating))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsFloatingWindowVisible(FloatingWindowContainer floater)
		{
			if (floater.DockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible || !ShowFloatingWindows)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HideFloatingWindowsAtDesignTime && IsDesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HostControl == null || !HostControl.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsContainedPaneBeingRepositioned(floater.DockAreaPane))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return floater.DockAreaPane.IsVisible;
		}

		internal bool IsMdiChildVisible(MdiChildFormBase mdiChild)
		{
			if (mdiChild.Pane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible || mdiChild.Pane.Closed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsWindowDockingAreaVisible(WindowDockingArea dockingArea)
		{
			if (dockingArea.DockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockingArea.DockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && IsContainedPaneBeingRepositioned(dockingArea.DockAreaPane))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return dockingArea.DockAreaPane.IsVisible;
		}

		private WindowDockingArea CreateDockAreaContainer(DockAreaPane pane)
		{
			bool flag = pane.DockedLocation == DockedLocation.Floating;
			WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea = pane.Container;
			if (windowDockingArea == null || ((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Disposing || ((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).IsDisposed)
			{
				windowDockingArea = CreateDockingArea(IsInheritedPane(pane), alwaysCreateNew: false);
				windowDockingArea.DockAreaPane = pane;
				pane.Container = windowDockingArea;
				((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Size = pane.Size;
				if (flag)
				{
					FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindowContainer = CreateFloatingWindow();
					ReparentControl((Control)(object)windowDockingArea, floatingWindowContainer);
					floatingWindowContainer.Owner = hookedHostControlForm;
					floatingWindowContainer.Initialize(pane);
					InitializeFloatingWindowContainer(floatingWindowContainer);
				}
				else
				{
					ReparentControl((Control)(object)windowDockingArea, HostControl);
				}
			}
			else if (UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Contains(windowDockingArea))
			{
				UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Remove(windowDockingArea);
			}
			if (((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Dock != DockStyle.Fill || FillPane != pane)
			{
				((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Dock = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(pane.DockedLocation);
			}
			return windowDockingArea;
		}

		private bool DoesControlPaneExist(DockablePaneBase pane, object collection)
		{
			if (pane is DockableControlPane && collection is DockableControlPanesCollection dockableControlPanesCollection && !dockableControlPanesCollection.Contains(pane))
			{
				dockableControlPanesCollection.Add((DockableControlPane)pane);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool DoesPaneIdMatch(DockablePaneBase pane, object id)
		{
			return string.Compare(id as string, pane.InternalIdString, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
		}

		private bool DoesPaneKeyMatch(DockablePaneBase pane, object key)
		{
			return string.Compare(key as string, pane.Key, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
		}

		private DockablePaneBase FindPaneWithCriteria(object criteria, DoesPaneMeetCriteria criteriaCheck)
		{
			if (criteriaCheck == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_48"));
			}
			UpdatePanesCollection();
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in panesCollection)
			{
				if (item.Value is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase && criteriaCheck(dockablePaneBase, criteria))
				{
					return dockablePaneBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnOffice2007ColorSchemeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = HostControl;
			if (control != null && control.InvokeRequired)
			{
				try
				{
					control.Invoke(new EventHandler(OnOffice2007ColorSchemeChanged));
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (WindowStyleResolved == WindowStyle.Office2007)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void SetTabOrder()
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (HostControl != null)
			{
				foreach (Control control in HostControl.Controls)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, control.TabIndex);
				}
			}
			int nextControlPaneTabIndex = num + 1;
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
			{
				SetTabOrder(dockArea, ref nextControlPaneTabIndex);
			}
		}

		private void SetTabOrder(DockablePaneBase pane, ref int nextControlPaneTabIndex)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pane is DockableControlPane dockableControlPane)
			{
				if (dockableControlPane.ContainingControl != null)
				{
					if (nextControlPaneTabIndex < 0)
					{
						nextControlPaneTabIndex = 0;
					}
					((Control)(object)dockableControlPane.ContainingControl).TabIndex = nextControlPaneTabIndex++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(pane is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
				{
					SetTabOrder(pane2, ref nextControlPaneTabIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnMdiChildDisposed(MdiChildFormBase mdiChild)
		{
			if (!isUnhooking)
			{
				MdiChildForms.Remove(mdiChild);
			}
		}

		private DockableWindow GetPaneContainer(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			DockableWindow dockableWindow = pane.Container;
			if (dockableWindow == null || ((Control)(object)dockableWindow).Disposing || ((Control)(object)dockableWindow).IsDisposed)
			{
				dockableWindow = CreateDockableWindow(IsInheritedPane(pane), alwaysCreateNew: false);
				dockableWindow.ControlPane = pane;
				pane.Container = dockableWindow;
			}
			else if (UnusedDockableWindows.Contains(dockableWindow))
			{
				UnusedDockableWindows.Remove(dockableWindow);
			}
			((Control)(object)dockableWindow).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
			return dockableWindow;
		}

		private List<FloatingWindowContainer> GetOrderedFloatingWindowsByZOrder()
		{
			List<FloatingWindowContainer> list = new List<FloatingWindowContainer>(floatingWindows.Count);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(floatingWindows);
			try
			{
				GetOrderedFloatingWindowsByZOrderUnsafe(list, arrayList);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer item in arrayList)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<FloatingWindowContainer> GetOrderedFloatingWindowsByZOrderUnsafe(List<FloatingWindowContainer> orderedFloatingWindows, ArrayList floatingWindowsNotOrdered)
		{
			Form form = FindHostForm();
			if (form != null && form.IsMdiChild)
			{
				form = form.MdiParent;
			}
			if (form == null)
			{
				return orderedFloatingWindows;
			}
			if (!form.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return orderedFloatingWindows;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = form.Handle;
			while (floatingWindowsNotOrdered.Count > 0)
			{
				intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindow(intPtr, 3u);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!(Control.FromHandle(intPtr) is FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindowContainer))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = floatingWindowsNotOrdered.IndexOf(floatingWindowContainer);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					orderedFloatingWindows.Insert(0, floatingWindowContainer);
					floatingWindowsNotOrdered.RemoveAt(num);
					if (floatingWindowsNotOrdered.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return orderedFloatingWindows;
		}

		private void OnMdiParentDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookMdiParentForm();
		}

		private void OnMdiParentLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookMdiParentForm();
			if (childFormsToShow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<MdiChildFormBase> list = new List<MdiChildFormBase>(childFormsToShow);
			childFormsToShow = null;
			foreach (MdiChildFormBase item in list)
			{
				item.Visible = IsMdiChildVisible(item);
			}
		}

		private void UnhookMdiParentForm()
		{
			if (hookedMdiParent != null)
			{
				hookedMdiParent.Disposed -= OnMdiParentDisposed;
				hookedMdiParent.Load -= OnMdiParentLoad;
				hookedMdiParent = null;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (loadingBaseClassSettings)
			{
				return;
			}
			SuspendLayout();
			initializing = true;
			initializingComponent = true;
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			}
			SuspendIsInViewEvents();
			try
			{
				if (HostControl != null)
				{
					CreateManagedControls();
					initializing = false;
					InitializePaneControls();
					initializing = true;
					InitializeContextMenus();
					InitializeControlFonts();
					InitializeControlRightToLeft();
				}
				if (autoHideControl != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)autoHideControl).Visible = false;
				}
				HookHostControl();
				activePane = null;
				InitializeHostFormActivationState();
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					dockArea.VerifyTabInfoCollection();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			InitializeAllowDrop(AllowDrop);
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
			}
			initializing = false;
			initializingComponent = false;
			ResumeLayout();
		}

		private void UninitializeComponent()
		{
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
