			bool isUpdating = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).IsUpdating;
			bool flag = SuspendLayout();
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			}
			try
			{
				isUnhooking = true;
				isUnhookingDuringDispose = isDisposing && hookedHostControlForm != null && (hookedHostControlForm.IsDisposed || hookedHostControlForm.Disposing);
				UnhookHostControl();
				foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in ControlPanes)
				{
					controlPane.IsBeingRepositioned = true;
					RemoveControlPaneContainer(controlPane);
					controlPane.IsBeingRepositioned = false;
				}
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					RemoveDockAreaContainer(dockArea);
				}
				foreach (MdiChildFormBase mdiChildForm in MdiChildForms)
				{
					RemoveContextMenu(mdiChildForm);
					mdiChildForm.Dispose();
				}
				DestroyManagedControls();
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				isUnhookingDuringDispose = false;
				isUnhooking = false;
			}
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				ResumeLayout();
			}
		}

		private void DestroyManagedControls()
		{
			if (loadingBaseClassSettings)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			UnpinnedTabArea[] array = tabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in array)
			{
				RemoveContextMenu((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea);
				if (unpinnedTabArea != null && IsLoadingFromStream)
				{
					unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups.Clear();
				}
				DestroyControl((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea);
				if (!IsDisposing)
				{
					tabAreas[num] = null;
				}
				num++;
			}
			if (autoHideControl != null)
			{
				DestroyControl((Control)(object)autoHideControl);
				if (IsLoadingFromStream)
				{
					autoHideControl.Reset();
				}
				else
				{
					autoHideControl = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DestroyControl(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null || control is DockControlBase { skipDestroyComponent: not false })
			{
				return;
			}
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			bool flag = control is DockableWindow || control is WindowDockingArea || control is AutoHideControl;
			if (flag)
			{
				flag = !IsDisposing || IsDesignMode;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				foreach (Control control4 in control.Controls)
				{
					if (control4 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (control4 is DockableWindow)
					{
						foreach (Control control5 in control4.Controls)
						{
							if (control5 != null && !control5.Disposing && !control5.IsDisposed)
							{
								ReparentControl(control5, HostControl);
							}
						}
					}
					if (!control4.Disposing && !control4.IsDisposed)
					{
						ReparentControl(control4, HostControl);
					}
				}
			}
			if (control.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsInheritedDesignComponent(control) || IsLoadingFromStream || initializingCollections)
			{
				control.Visible = false;
				if (IsDisposing)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (control is DockableWindow)
				{
					((DockableWindow)(object)control).ControlPane = null;
					if (!UnusedDockableWindows.Contains(control))
					{
						UnusedDockableWindows.Add(control);
					}
				}
				else if (control is WindowDockingArea)
				{
					((WindowDockingArea)(object)control).DockAreaPane = null;
					if (!UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Contains(control))
					{
						UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Add(control);
					}
				}
				else if (control is UnpinnedTabArea)
				{
					((UnpinnedTabArea)(object)control).TabGroups.Clear();
					if (!UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas.Contains(control))
					{
						UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas.Add(control);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ = control is AutoHideControl;
				}
				ReparentControl(control, HostControl);
				return;
			}
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				try
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (!(control is DockableWindow))
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(control);
						if (parent == null || Utilities.GetParent(parent) != null)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						designerHost.DestroyComponent(control);
					}
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!control.Disposing)
			{
				if (HostControl.ActiveControl == control)
				{
					Utilities.SetActiveControl(HostControl, null);
				}
				ReparentControl(control, null);
				if (Utilities.GetParent(control) == null || !IsWithinClosingNestedHostDesigner)
				{
					control.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInheritedDesignComponent(Component component)
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (designerHost.GetDesigner(component) is IDockableControlDesignerBase dockableControlDesignerBase)
			{
				return dockableControlDesignerBase.IsInheritedControl;
			}
			if (!(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IInheritanceService)) is IInheritanceService inheritanceService))
			{
				return false;
			}
			InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = inheritanceService.GetInheritanceAttribute(component);
			if (inheritanceAttribute != InheritanceAttribute.Inherited)
			{
				return inheritanceAttribute == InheritanceAttribute.InheritedReadOnly;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Control CreateControl(Type type, string name)
		{
			if (type == null || !type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Control)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				foreach (IComponent component in designerHost.Container.Components)
				{
					if (component.Site.Name != name || component.GetType() != type)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (type == typeof(UnpinnedTabArea))
					{
						if (component is UnpinnedTabArea { Manager: null } unpinnedTabArea)
						{
							return (Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea;
						}
					}
					else if (type == typeof(AutoHideControl) && component is AutoHideControl { Manager: null } autoHideControl)
					{
						return (Control)(object)autoHideControl;
					}
				}
				return designerHost.CreateComponent(type, name) as Control;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string GetUnpinnedTabAreaName(DockedSide side)
		{
			string name = HostControl.Name;
			return $"_{name}UnpinnedTabArea{side.ToString()}";
		}

		private void CreateUnpinnedTabArea(DockedSide side)
		{
			UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = null;
			if (UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas.Count > 0)
			{
				DockStyle dockStyle = DockedSideToDockStyle(side);
				foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unusedUnpinnedTabArea in UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas)
				{
					if (((Control)(object)unusedUnpinnedTabArea).Dock == dockStyle && !((Control)(object)unusedUnpinnedTabArea).IsDisposed)
					{
						unpinnedTabArea = unusedUnpinnedTabArea;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (unpinnedTabArea != null)
				{
					UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas.Remove(unpinnedTabArea);
					SetTabArea(unpinnedTabArea);
					return;
				}
			}
			string unpinnedTabAreaName = GetUnpinnedTabAreaName(side);
			unpinnedTabArea = CreateControl(typeof(UnpinnedTabArea), unpinnedTabAreaName) as UnpinnedTabArea;
			if (unpinnedTabArea == null)
			{
				unpinnedTabArea = new UnpinnedTabArea();
				((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Name = unpinnedTabAreaName;
			}
			((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Dock = DockedSideToDockStyle(side);
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)unpinnedTabArea).Owner = (UltraComponentControlManagerBase)(object)this;
			SetTabArea(unpinnedTabArea);
			ReparentControl((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea, HostControl);
		}

		internal void ReparentControl(Control control, Control newParent)
		{
			if (control == null || (DesignerHost != null && DesignerHost.RootComponent == null) || control.Disposing || control.IsDisposed || (newParent != null && (newParent.IsDisposed || newParent.Disposing)) || isUnhookingDuringDispose)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(control);
			if (parent == newParent || IsWithinClosingNestedHostDesigner)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = IsOnActiveForm(control);
			bool flag2 = IsOnActiveForm(newParent);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				Form form = Utilities.FindForm(parent);
				if (!IsDesignMode && form != null && ContainsActiveControl(control, form))
				{
					try
					{
						Control parent2 = Utilities.GetParent(control);
						if (parent2 != form)
						{
							Utilities.SetActiveControl(form, parent2);
						}
						IContainerControl containerControl = Utilities.GetContainerControl(control);
						if (containerControl != null && containerControl != form && ContainsActiveControl(control))
						{
							Utilities.SetActiveControl(containerControl, null);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				if (newParent == null)
				{
					parent.Controls.Remove(control);
				}
				else if (control is DockControlBase dockControlBase)
				{
					dockControlBase.suspendOnFontChanged = true;
				}
				control.Parent = null;
			}
			if (newParent != null)
			{
				newParent.SuspendLayout();
				Form form2 = Utilities.FindForm(newParent);
				form2?.SuspendLayout();
				try
				{
					newParent.Controls.Add(control);
					if (!newParent.Created && newParent.IsHandleCreated && !control.IsHandleCreated && control.Visible && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						control.CreateControl();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (form2 != null)
					{
						newParent.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
						form2.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
						if (!IsDesignMode && (flag || flag2) && Utilities.ActiveForm != null)
						{
							Utilities.ActivateForm(form2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						newParent.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
					}
				}
				if (control is DockControlBase dockControlBase2)
				{
					dockControlBase2.suspendOnFontChanged = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				control.Parent = null;
			}
			ResetTreeToolTips(control);
			if (control is TextBox { IsHandleCreated: not false, ScrollBars: var scrollBars } textBox)
			{
				if (scrollBars == ScrollBars.None)
				{
					textBox.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Both;
				}
				else
				{
					textBox.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.None;
				}
				textBox.ScrollBars = scrollBars;
			}
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode && HostControl is UserControl)
			{
				RecreateControlHandles(control);
			}
		}

		private void RecreateControlHandles(Control control)
		{
			if (IsHandleRecreationNeeded(control) && !ForceRecreateHandle(control))
			{
				ForceRecreateHandleManually(control);
			}
		}

		private static void ForceRecreateHandleManually(Control control)
		{
			if (control is TextBox)
			{
				if (control is TextBox { ScrollBars: var scrollBars } textBox)
				{
					if (scrollBars == ScrollBars.None)
					{
						textBox.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Both;
					}
					else
					{
						textBox.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.None;
					}
					textBox.ScrollBars = scrollBars;
				}
			}
			else if (control is TreeView)
			{
				((TreeView)control).CheckBoxes = !((TreeView)control).CheckBoxes;
				((TreeView)control).CheckBoxes = !((TreeView)control).CheckBoxes;
			}
			else if (control is TrackBar)
			{
				TickStyle tickStyle = ((TrackBar)control).TickStyle;
				if (tickStyle == TickStyle.None)
				{
					((TrackBar)control).TickStyle = TickStyle.Both;
				}
				else
				{
					((TrackBar)control).TickStyle = TickStyle.None;
				}
				((TrackBar)control).TickStyle = tickStyle;
			}
			else if (control is MonthCalendar)
			{
				((MonthCalendar)control).MonthlyBoldedDates = ((MonthCalendar)control).MonthlyBoldedDates;
			}
			else if (control is ListView)
			{
				((ListView)control).Scrollable = !((ListView)control).Scrollable;
				((ListView)control).Scrollable = !((ListView)control).Scrollable;
			}
			else if (control is DateTimePicker)
			{
				((DateTimePicker)control).ShowCheckBox = !((DateTimePicker)control).ShowCheckBox;
				((DateTimePicker)control).ShowCheckBox = !((DateTimePicker)control).ShowCheckBox;
			}
			else if (control is RichTextBox)
			{
				if (control is RichTextBox { ScrollBars: var scrollBars2 } richTextBox)
				{
					if (scrollBars2 == RichTextBoxScrollBars.None)
					{
						richTextBox.ScrollBars = RichTextBoxScrollBars.Both;
					}
					else
					{
						richTextBox.ScrollBars = RichTextBoxScrollBars.None;
					}
					richTextBox.ScrollBars = scrollBars2;
				}
			}
			else if (ContextMenuManager.IsWindowsFormsToolBar(control))
			{
				ContextMenuManager.ToggleDividerProperty(control);
			}
			else if (control is StatusStrip)
			{
				((StatusStrip)control).SizingGrip = !((StatusStrip)control).SizingGrip;
				((StatusStrip)control).SizingGrip = !((StatusStrip)control).SizingGrip;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsHandleRecreationNeeded(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null || !control.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(control is TextBox) && !(control is TrackBar) && !(control is MonthCalendar) && !(control is ListView) && !(control is RichTextBox) && !(control is DateTimePicker) && !(control is StatusStrip) && !ContextMenuManager.IsWindowsFormsToolBar(control))
			{
				return control is TreeView;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ForceRecreateHandle(Control control)
		{
			ReflectionPermission reflectionPermission = new ReflectionPermission(ReflectionPermissionFlag.MemberAccess);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					reflectionPermission.Assert();
				}
				BindingFlags invokeAttr = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.InvokeMethod;
				control.GetType().InvokeMember("RecreateHandle", invokeAttr, null, control, null);
				return true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			catch (MissingMethodException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ContainsActiveControl(Control control, ContainerControl container)
		{
			if (control == null || container == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Control activeControl = container.ActiveControl;
			if (control == activeControl || control.Contains(activeControl))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (activeControl is ContainerControl)
			{
				return ContainsActiveControl(control, activeControl as ContainerControl);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ContainsActiveControl(Control control)
		{
			IContainerControl containerControl = Utilities.GetContainerControl(control);
			if (containerControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (Control control2 = containerControl.ActiveControl; control2 != null; control2 = Utilities.GetParent(control2))
			{
				if (control2 == control)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetTreeToolTips(Control control)
		{
			if (!control.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (control is TreeView)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.ResetTreeTooltips(control as TreeView);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
			{
				ResetTreeToolTips(control2);
			}
		}

		private bool IsOnActiveForm(Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Form activeForm = Form.ActiveForm;
				while (control != null)
				{
					if (activeForm == control)
					{
						return true;
					}
					control = control.Parent;
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal string GetAutoHideControlName()
		{
			string name = HostControl.Name;
			return $"_{name}AutoHideControl";
		}

		private void CreateAutoHideControl()
		{
			if (AutoHideControl == null || ((Control)(object)AutoHideControl).IsDisposed)
			{
				string autoHideControlName = GetAutoHideControlName();
				autoHideControl = CreateControl(typeof(AutoHideControl), autoHideControlName) as AutoHideControl;
				if (autoHideControl == null)
				{
					autoHideControl = new AutoHideControl();
					((Control)(object)autoHideControl).Name = autoHideControlName;
				}
				((ManagedContainerControlBase)autoHideControl).Owner = (UltraComponentControlManagerBase)(object)this;
				((Control)(object)autoHideControl).AllowDrop = AllowDrop;
				ReparentControl((Control)(object)autoHideControl, HostControl);
			}
		}

		private void CreateManagedControls()
		{
			if (!HasUnpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				CreateUnpinnedTabArea(DockedSide.Left);
				CreateUnpinnedTabArea(DockedSide.Right);
				CreateUnpinnedTabArea(DockedSide.Top);
				CreateUnpinnedTabArea(DockedSide.Bottom);
			}
			CreateAutoHideControl();
		}

		private WindowDockingArea CreateDockingArea(bool inherited, bool alwaysCreateNew)
		{
			WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea = null;
			if (!alwaysCreateNew && UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Count > 0)
			{
				windowDockingArea = GetControl(UnusedWindowDockingAreas, inherited) as WindowDockingArea;
				if (windowDockingArea == null || ((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Disposing)
				{
					windowDockingArea = CreateDockingArea(inherited, alwaysCreateNew: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
				windowDockingArea = ((designerHost == null) ? new WindowDockingArea() : (designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(WindowDockingArea)) as WindowDockingArea));
			}
			InitializeContextMenu((Control)(object)windowDockingArea);
			if (CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				InitializeAllowDrop((Control)(object)windowDockingArea, AllowDrop);
			}
			if (HostControl != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Font = HostControl.Font;
			}
			WindowDockingAreas.Add(windowDockingArea);
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)windowDockingArea).Owner = (UltraComponentControlManagerBase)(object)this;
			return windowDockingArea;
		}

		private FloatingWindowContainer CreateUnmanagedFloatingWindowContainer()
		{
			return new FloatingWindowContainerEx();
		}

		private FloatingWindowContainer CreateFloatingWindow()
		{
			FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindowContainer = null;
			if (UnusedFloatingWindows.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = UnusedFloatingWindows.Count - 1;
				floatingWindowContainer = UnusedFloatingWindows[index] as FloatingWindowContainer;
				UnusedFloatingWindows.RemoveAt(index);
			}
			else
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				try
				{
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					floatingWindowContainer = CreateUnmanagedFloatingWindowContainer();
				}
				catch
				{
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.SafeTopLevelWindows);
					try
					{
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						uIPermission.Demand();
					}
					catch
					{
						return null;
					}
					floatingWindowContainer = new FloatingWindowContainer();
				}
			}
			if (CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				InitializeAllowDrop(floatingWindowContainer, AllowDrop);
			}
			FloatingWindows.Add(floatingWindowContainer);
			return floatingWindowContainer;
		}

		private DockableWindow CreateDockableWindow(bool inherited, bool alwaysCreateNew)
		{
			DockableWindow dockableWindow = null;
			if (!alwaysCreateNew && UnusedDockableWindows.Count > 0)
			{
				dockableWindow = GetControl(UnusedDockableWindows, inherited) as DockableWindow;
				if (dockableWindow == null || ((Control)(object)dockableWindow).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)dockableWindow).Disposing)
				{
					dockableWindow = CreateDockableWindow(inherited, alwaysCreateNew: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
				dockableWindow = ((designerHost == null) ? new DockableWindow() : (designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(DockableWindow)) as DockableWindow));
			}
			InitializeContextMenu((Control)(object)dockableWindow);
			if (CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				InitializeAllowDrop((Control)(object)dockableWindow, AllowDrop);
			}
			DockableWindows.Add(dockableWindow);
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)dockableWindow).Owner = (UltraComponentControlManagerBase)(object)this;
			if (HostControl != null && !IsDesignMode)
			{
				((Control)(object)dockableWindow).BindingContext = HostControl.BindingContext;
			}
			return dockableWindow;
		}

		private void CreatePaneContainer(DockableControlPane pane, WindowDockingArea dockingArea)
		{
			DockableWindow paneContainer = GetPaneContainer(pane);
			((Control)(object)paneContainer).Dock = DockStyle.None;
			((Control)(object)paneContainer).Visible = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible && pane.IsVisible;
			ReparentControl((Control)(object)pane.Container, (Control)(object)dockingArea);
			ReparentControl(pane.Control, (Control)(object)pane.Container);
		}

		private MdiChildFormBase CreateUnmanagedMdiChildForm(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			return new MdiChildForm(pane, this);
		}

		private MdiChildFormBase CreateMdiChildForm(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			MdiChildFormBase mdiChildFormBase = null;
			SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
			try
			{
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				mdiChildFormBase = CreateUnmanagedMdiChildForm(pane);
			}
			catch
			{
				CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.SafeTopLevelWindows);
				try
				{
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					uIPermission.Demand();
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
				mdiChildFormBase = new MdiChildFormBase(pane, this);
			}
			InitializeContextMenu(mdiChildFormBase);
			if (CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				InitializeAllowDrop(mdiChildFormBase, AllowDrop);
			}
			MdiChildForms.Add(mdiChildFormBase);
			return mdiChildFormBase;
		}

		protected override void ManagedControlInitialized(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (control is UnpinnedTabArea)
			{
				if (control.Dock == DockStyle.None)
				{
					UnusedUnpinnedTabAreas.Add(control);
				}
				else
				{
					SetTabArea((UnpinnedTabArea)(object)control);
				}
			}
			else if (control is WindowDockingArea)
			{
				if (!WindowDockingAreas.Contains(control) && !UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Contains(control))
				{
					UnusedWindowDockingAreas.Add(control);
					control.Dock = DockStyle.None;
				}
			}
			else if (control is DockableWindow)
			{
				if (!DockableWindows.Contains(control) && !UnusedDockableWindows.Contains(control))
				{
					UnusedDockableWindows.Add(control);
				}
			}
			else if (control is AutoHideControl)
			{
				autoHideControl = (AutoHideControl)(object)control;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeControlPanesCollection()
		{
			FindPaneWithCriteria(ControlPanes, DoesControlPaneExist);
		}

		private void InitializeUnpinnedTabAreas()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = tabAreas[i];
				((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled;
				((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Visible = IsUnpinnedTabAreaVisible(unpinnedTabArea);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsUnpinnedTabAreaVisible(UnpinnedTabArea tabArea)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (tabArea == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)ShowUnpinnedTabAreas == 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible)
			{
				if ((int)ShowUnpinnedTabAreasResolved != 1)
				{
					return tabArea.TabGroups.Count > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal UnpinnedTabArea GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = pane.DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DockStyle dockStyle = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(dockAreaPane.DockedLocation);
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Dock == dockStyle)
				{
					return unpinnedTabArea;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ResetUnpinnedTabAreaVisibility()
		{
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (unpinnedTabArea != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Visible = IsUnpinnedTabAreaVisible(unpinnedTabArea);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(bool show)
		{
			try
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				bool flag = false;
				if (hookedHostControlForm != null && hookedHostControlForm.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (hookedHostFormParent != null && hookedHostFormParent.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					if (floatingWindow != null && !floatingWindow.IsDisposed && !floatingWindow.Disposing)
					{
						if (!show || floatingWindow.DockAreaPane == null || flag || !floatingWindow.DockAreaPane.IsVisible)
						{
							floatingWindow.Visible = false;
						}
						else if (IsDesignMode)
						{
							floatingWindow.Visible = show && ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible && ShowFloatingWindows && !HideFloatingWindowsAtDesignTime;
						}
						else
						{
							floatingWindow.Visible = show && ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible && ShowFloatingWindows;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle ContainingRect(int lowestDockAreaValue)
		{
			Control control = HostControl;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(6);
			Rectangle displayRectangle = control.DisplayRectangle;
			for (int i = 0; i < control.Controls.Count; i++)
			{
				Control control2 = control.Controls[i];
				if (!control2.Visible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int priorityLevel = DockingAreaManager.GetPriorityLevel(control2);
				if (priorityLevel >= lowestDockAreaValue)
				{
					Rectangle bounds = control2.Bounds;
					switch (control2.Dock)
					{
					case DockStyle.Left:
						displayRectangle.Width -= bounds.Width;
						displayRectangle.X += bounds.Width;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Right:
						displayRectangle.Width -= bounds.Width;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Top:
						displayRectangle.Height -= bounds.Height;
						displayRectangle.Y += bounds.Height;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Bottom:
						displayRectangle.Height -= bounds.Height;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return displayRectangle;
		}

		internal UnpinnedTabArea GetTabArea(DockedSide side)
		{
			return tabAreas[(int)side];
		}

		private void SetTabArea(UnpinnedTabArea tabArea)
		{
			DockedSide dockedSide = DockStyleToDockedSide(((Control)(object)tabArea).Dock);
			int num = (int)dockedSide;
			tabAreas[num] = tabArea;
		}

		private Control GetControl(IList list, bool inherited)
		{
			foreach (Control item in list)
			{
				if (!IsDesignMode || IsInheritedDesignComponent(item) == inherited)
				{
					list.Remove(item);
					if (item.IsDisposed || item.Disposing)
					{
						return GetControl(list, inherited);
					}
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Control GetControlFromName(string name, bool allowInternal)
		{
			Control control = FindControlWithName(name, skipNestedUserControls: true);
			if (control == null)
			{
				control = FindControlWithName(name, skipNestedUserControls: false);
			}
			if (allowInternal || control == null)
			{
				return control;
			}
			if (control is WindowDockingArea || control is FloatingWindowContainer || control is AutoHideControl || control is DockableWindow || control is UnpinnedTabArea)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return control;
		}

		private Control FindControlWithName(string name, bool skipNestedUserControls)
		{
			if (hostControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Control control = FindControlWithName(hostControl, name, skipNestedUserControls);
			if (control != null)
			{
				return control;
			}
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				control = FindControlWithName(floatingWindow, name, skipNestedUserControls);
				if (control != null)
				{
					return control;
				}
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				control = FindControlWithName((Control)(object)windowDockingArea, name, skipNestedUserControls);
				if (control != null)
				{
					return control;
				}
			}
			return FindControlWithName((Control)(object)AutoHideControl, name, skipNestedUserControls);
		}

		private Control FindControlWithName(Control control, string name, bool skipNestedUserControls)
		{
			foreach (Control control4 in control.Controls)
			{
				if (control4 == null || control4.Disposing || control4.IsDisposed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (control4.Name == name)
				{
					return control4;
				}
				if (control4.Site != null && control4.Site.Name == name)
				{
					return control4;
				}
				if (!(control4 is UserControl && skipNestedUserControls))
				{
					Control control3 = FindControlWithName(control4, name, skipNestedUserControls);
					if (control3 != null)
					{
						return control3;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static DockStyle DockedSideToDockStyle(DockedSide side)
		{
			return side switch
			{
				DockedSide.Left => DockStyle.Left, 
				DockedSide.Right => DockStyle.Right, 
				DockedSide.Top => DockStyle.Top, 
				DockedSide.Bottom => DockStyle.Bottom, 
				_ => DockStyle.None, 
			};
		}

		internal static DockedSide DockStyleToDockedSide(DockStyle dock)
		{
			return dock switch
			{
				DockStyle.Left => DockedSide.Left, 
				DockStyle.Right => DockedSide.Right, 
				DockStyle.Top => DockedSide.Top, 
				DockStyle.Bottom => DockedSide.Bottom, 
				_ => DockedSide.Left, 
			};
		}

		internal static void ResetCursorPosition()
		{
			Utilities.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
		}

		internal void DesignerActivated()
		{
			ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(show: true);
		}

		internal void DesignerDeactivated()
		{
			ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(show: false);
		}

		internal bool IsActivePane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			bool flag = VerifyActivePane(pane);
			if (pane == activePane && !flag)
			{
				activePane = null;
				if (pane != null)
				{
					ControlPaneEventArgs e = new ControlPaneEventArgs(pane);
					FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.PaneDeactivate, e);
				}
				InvalidatePaneAndAncestors(pane);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool VerifyActivePane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (IsInitializing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DragManager.IsDragging || DragManager.IsDragPending)
			{
				if (DragManager.DragPane == pane)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (DragManager.SourcePane == pane)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (DragManager.PreviousActivePane == pane)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return ContainsDesignTimeSelectedControl(pane);
			}
			if (DragManager.DragPane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				return pane == activePane;
			}
			if (DragManager.IsDragging && DragManager.DragPane != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pane.Container == null || pane.Control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsPaneOnActiveWindow(pane);
		}

		private bool ContainsDesignTimeSelectedControl(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode || pane.Container == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(ISelectionService)) is ISelectionService selectionService))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ICollection selectedComponents = selectionService.GetSelectedComponents();
			if (selectedComponents == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (object item in selectedComponents)
			{
				if (item is Control control && (((Control)(object)pane.Container).Contains(control) || (object)pane.Container == control))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void DesignTimeSelectionChanged()
		{
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
		}

		private void InvalidatePaneAndAncestors(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement paneUIElement = (UIElement)(object)GetPaneUIElement(pane, ignoreControlPaneContainer: false);
			if (paneUIElement != null)
			{
				paneUIElement.Invalidate();
			}
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = pane.DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.Container != null)
			{
				Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)dockAreaPane.Container);
				if (parent is FloatingWindowContainer)
				{
					parent.Invalidate();
				}
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)dockAreaPane.Container, dirtyChildElements: true, recursive: true, invalidateChildControls: true);
			}
			if (pane.IsUnpinned)
			{
				TabManagerBase owningTabInfo = GetOwningTabInfo(pane);
				if (owningTabInfo != null)
				{
					((TabManager)owningTabInfo).InvalidateTabItem((ITabItem)(object)pane);
				}
			}
			InvalidateAutoHideControl(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: false);
		}

		internal void NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange()
		{
			SyncFloatingPaneVisibilityWithFormActive();
			if (isActivatingPane && !Utilities.IsClr1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				InvalidatePaneControls(dirtyChildElements: false, invalidateChildControls: false, includeDockableWindows: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (isCheckingActivePane)
				{
					return;
				}
				isCheckingActivePane = true;
				try
				{
					if (activePane != null)
					{
						DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = activePane;
						if (dockableControlPane.IsActive)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (activePane != null)
						{
							ControlPaneEventArgs e = new ControlPaneEventArgs(dockableControlPane);
							FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.PaneDeactivate, e);
							InvalidatePaneAndAncestors(dockableControlPane);
							activePane = null;
						}
					}
					activePane = FindPaneWithCriteria(null, IsControlPaneActive) as DockableControlPane;
					if (activePane == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					for (DockablePaneBase parent = activePane; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
					{
						ChildPaneStyle paneStyle = parent.PaneStyle;
						if (paneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup || paneStyle == ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup)
						{
							parent.IsSelectedTab = true;
						}
					}
					InvalidatePaneAndAncestors(activePane);
					ControlPaneEventArgs e2 = new ControlPaneEventArgs(activePane);
					FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.PaneActivate, e2);
				}
				finally
				{
					isCheckingActivePane = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsControlPaneActive(DockablePaneBase pane, object criteria)
		{
			if (pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				return ((DockableControlPane)pane).IsActive;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InitializeHostFormActivationState()
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				isHostFormActive = ((HostControl == null) ? null : HostControl.FindForm())?.ContainsFocus ?? false;
			}
			catch
			{
				isHostFormActive = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnHostParentChainChanged(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			if (HostControl != null && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed && !IsDisposing)
			{
				HookHostControlForm();
				ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(IsHostControlVisible);
				NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			}
		}

		private void HookHostControl()
		{
			HookHostControlForm();
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParentManager.Initialize(HostControl);
			HostControl.FontChanged += OnHostControlFontChanged;
			foreach (Control control in HostControl.Controls)
			{
				if (!(control is DockControlBase))
				{
					control.DockChanged += OnHostChildDockChanged;
				}
			}
			HostControl.ControlAdded += OnHostControlControlAdded;
			HostControl.ControlRemoved += OnHostControlControlRemoved;
			HostControl.VisibleChanged += OnHostVisibleChanged;
			HostControl.BindingContextChanged += OnHostBindingContextChanged;
			HostControl.RightToLeftChanged += OnHostControlRightToLeftChanged;
			if (HostControl is Form form)
			{
				form.RightToLeftLayoutChanged += OnHostControlRightToLeftChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnhookHostControl()
		{
			UnhookHostControlForm();
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParentManager.Clear();
			HostControl.FontChanged -= OnHostControlFontChanged;
			foreach (Control control in HostControl.Controls)
			{
				control.DockChanged -= OnHostChildDockChanged;
			}
			HostControl.ControlAdded -= OnHostControlControlAdded;
			HostControl.ControlRemoved -= OnHostControlControlRemoved;
			HostControl.VisibleChanged -= OnHostVisibleChanged;
			HostControl.BindingContextChanged -= OnHostBindingContextChanged;
			HostControl.RightToLeftChanged -= OnHostControlRightToLeftChanged;
			if (HostControl is Form form)
			{
				form.RightToLeftLayoutChanged -= OnHostControlRightToLeftChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnHostBindingContextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is Control) || IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			BindingContext bindingContext = ((Control)sender).BindingContext;
			foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow in DockableWindows)
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)dockableWindow).Disposing && !((Control)(object)dockableWindow).IsDisposed)
				{
					((Control)(object)dockableWindow).BindingContext = bindingContext;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHostParentActivationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncFloatingPaneVisibilityWithFormActive();
		}

		private void OnHostParentVisibleChanged(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Control.Visible)
			{
				OnHostVisibleChanged(e.Control, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnHostVisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (HostControl == null || IsDisposing || HostControl.Disposing || HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(IsHostControlVisible);
			if (!((Control)sender).Visible || hookedHostControlForm == null || !hookedHostControlForm.IsMdiChild || HostControl == null || !HostControl.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				floatingWindow.Owner = null;
				floatingWindow.Owner = hookedHostControlForm;
			}
		}

		private void OnHostControlControlAdded(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Control is DockControlBase))
			{
				e.Control.DockChanged += OnHostChildDockChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnHostControlControlRemoved(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Control.DockChanged -= OnHostChildDockChanged;
		}

		private void OnHostChildDockChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyFillPane(reset: false);
		}

		private void OnHostFormHandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeFloatingWindowOwnerForm();
		}

		private void InitializeFloatingWindowOwnerForm()
		{
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				Form owner = Utilities.GetOwner(floatingWindow);
				if (owner != null)
				{
					owner.FormClosed -= floatingWindow.FormClosedHandler;
				}
				floatingWindow.Owner = hookedHostControlForm;
			}
		}

		private void HookHostControlForm()
		{
			UnhookHostControlForm();
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Form form = Utilities.FindForm(HostControl);
				if (form != null)
				{
					hookedHostControlForm = form;
					form.Activated += FormActivateHandler;
					form.Deactivate += FormDeactivateHandler;
					form.ParentChanged += OnFormParentChanged;
					form.VisibleChanged += OnHostVisibleChanged;
					form.SizeChanged += OnFormSizeChanged;
					if (!form.Created)
					{
						form.Load += FormLoadHandler;
					}
					else if (form.Modal)
					{
						ResetOwnedFloatingWindows();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ = ((Component)this).DesignMode;
				}
				if (hookedHostControlForm != null && !hookedHostControlForm.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					hookedHostControlForm.HandleCreated += OnHostFormHandleCreated;
				}
				else
				{
					InitializeFloatingWindowOwnerForm();
				}
				HookHostFormParent();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void UnhookHostControlForm()
		{
			if (hookedHostControlForm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnhookHostFormParent();
			try
			{
				Form form = hookedHostControlForm;
				if (form != null)
				{
					hookedHostControlForm = null;
					form.Activated -= FormActivateHandler;
					form.Deactivate -= FormDeactivateHandler;
					form.ParentChanged -= OnFormParentChanged;
					form.VisibleChanged -= OnHostVisibleChanged;
					form.SizeChanged -= OnFormSizeChanged;
					form.Load -= FormLoadHandler;
					form.HandleCreated -= OnHostFormHandleCreated;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void DelayedHostFormHook()
		{
			HookHostControlForm();
		}

		private void OnFormParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
			HookHostFormParent();
		}

		private void OnFormMdiChildActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
		}

		private void OnFormSizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (HostControl != null && !IsDisposing && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				if (HostControl.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					HostControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(DelayResetFloatingWindowVisibility));
				}
				else
				{
					ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(IsHostControlVisible);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DelayResetFloatingWindowVisibility()
		{
			if (HostControl != null && !IsDisposing && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				ResetFloatingWindowVisibility(IsHostControlVisible);
			}
		}

		private void HookHostFormParent()
		{
			UnhookHostFormParent();
			if (hookedHostControlForm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				Control parent = hookedHostControlForm.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					Form form = parent.FindForm();
					if (form != null)
					{
						hookedHostFormParent = form;
						hookedHostFormParent.Activated += FormActivateHandler;
						hookedHostFormParent.Deactivate += FormDeactivateHandler;
						hookedHostFormParent.MdiChildActivate += OnFormMdiChildActivated;
						hookedHostFormParent.VisibleChanged += OnHostVisibleChanged;
						hookedHostFormParent.SizeChanged += OnFormSizeChanged;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void UnhookHostFormParent()
		{
			if (hookedHostFormParent != null)
			{
				hookedHostFormParent.Activated -= FormActivateHandler;
				hookedHostFormParent.Deactivate -= FormDeactivateHandler;
				hookedHostFormParent.MdiChildActivate -= OnFormMdiChildActivated;
				hookedHostFormParent.VisibleChanged -= OnHostVisibleChanged;
				hookedHostFormParent.SizeChanged -= OnFormSizeChanged;
				hookedHostFormParent = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnFormDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isHostFormActive = false;
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
		}

		private void OnFormActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isHostFormActive = true;
			NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
		}

		private void ResetOwnedFloatingWindows()
		{
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				floatingWindow.Enabled = false;
				floatingWindow.Enabled = true;
			}
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).EndUpdate();
		}

		private void OnFormLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is Form { Modal: false }) && HostControl != null && !HostControl.Disposing && !HostControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				if (!HostControl.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					HostControl.HandleCreated += OnHostHandleCreatedAfterLoad;
					HostControl.Disposed += OnHostDisposedAfterLoad;
				}
				else
				{
					HostControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ResetOwnedFloatingWindows));
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHostHandleCreatedAfterLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			control.HandleCreated -= OnHostHandleCreatedAfterLoad;
			control.Disposed -= OnHostDisposedAfterLoad;
			if ((!(control is Form) || !((Form)control).Modal) && control == HostControl)
			{
				control.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ResetOwnedFloatingWindows));
			}
		}

		private void OnHostDisposedAfterLoad(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			control.HandleCreated -= OnHostHandleCreatedAfterLoad;
			control.Disposed -= OnHostDisposedAfterLoad;
		}

		private static Control GetContainedSelectableControl(Control container)
		{
			Control nextControl = container.GetNextControl(container, forward: true);
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				while (nextControl != null && (!nextControl.CanSelect || !nextControl.TabStop) && nextControl.Parent != null)
				{
					nextControl = nextControl.Parent.GetNextControl(nextControl, forward: true);
				}
				if (nextControl != null)
				{
					for (Control control = nextControl; control != null; control = control.Parent)
					{
						if (control == container)
						{
							return nextControl;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool ActivatePane(DockableControlPane pane, bool force)
		{
			if (pane.Control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pane.Closed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pane.IsMdiChild && !pane.IsVisibleInMdiChild)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!pane.IsMdiChild && !pane.IsUnpinned && pane.IsAncestorClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pane.IsActive && !force)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				ISelectionService selectionService = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(ISelectionService)) as ISelectionService;
				selectionService.SetSelectedComponents(new Component[1] { pane.Control }, SelectionTypes.Replace);
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = isActivatingPane;
			try
			{
				isActivatingPane = true;
				if (pane.IsUnpinned)
				{
					if (!IsFlyoutPane(pane))
					{
						ShowFlyoutPane(pane, forceFocus: true, slide: true);
					}
				}
				else if (!pane.IsMdiChild)
				{
					DockableGroupPane parent = pane.Parent;
					DockablePaneBase selectedTabPane = pane;
					while (parent != null)
					{
						parent.SelectedTabPane = selectedTabPane;
						selectedTabPane = parent;
						parent = parent.Parent;
					}
				}
				Control containedSelectableControl = GetContainedSelectableControl((Control)(object)pane.Container);
				Control control = null;
				control = ((containedSelectableControl == null) ? pane.Control : containedSelectableControl);
				Form form = Utilities.FindForm((Control)(object)pane.Container);
				if (form != null)
				{
					if (form.IsMdiChild)
					{
						Utilities.ActivateForm(form);
					}
					if (form != control)
					{
						Utilities.SetActiveControl(form, control);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					IContainerControl containerControl = Utilities.GetContainerControl((Control)(object)pane.Container);
					if (containerControl != null)
					{
						Utilities.SetActiveControl(containerControl, control);
					}
					else
					{
						Utilities.SetActiveControl((IContainerControl)pane.Container, control);
					}
				}
				((Control)(object)pane.Container).Visible = true;
				Utilities.FocusControl(control);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				isActivatingPane = flag;
				if (!Utilities.IsClr1)
				{
					NotifyPossibleActivePaneChange();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHostControlFontChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeControlFonts();
			DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.Font);
		}

		private void InitializeControlFonts()
		{
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Font font = HostControl.Font;
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (unpinnedTabArea != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).Font = font;
				}
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				if (windowDockingArea != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).Font = font;
				}
			}
			if (AutoHideControl != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)AutoHideControl).Font = font;
			}
		}

		internal static bool ContainsOwnedForm(Control potentialOwner)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (potentialOwner != null)
			{
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					Form activeForm = Form.ActiveForm;
					if (activeForm != null)
					{
						for (Control control = GetActiveControlResolved(activeForm); control != null; control = ((!(control is IOwnedForm)) ? control.Parent : ((IOwnedForm)control).Owner))
						{
							if (control == potentialOwner)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Control GetActiveControlResolved(Control parent)
		{
			if (parent is IContainerControl { ActiveControl: not null } containerControl)
			{
				return GetActiveControlResolved(containerControl.ActiveControl);
			}
			return parent;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsPaneOnActiveWindow(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			Form form = null;
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				form = pane.Control.FindForm();
				if (form != null && form == pane.Control)
				{
					form = form.ParentForm;
				}
				while (form != null && !form.TopLevel)
				{
					form = form.ParentForm;
				}
				if (form == null || !form.ContainsFocus)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Form activeForm = Form.ActiveForm;
				if (form.IsMdiChild)
				{
					Form mdiParent = form.MdiParent;
					if (mdiParent != activeForm || mdiParent.ActiveMdiChild != form)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (form != activeForm)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Control activeControl = form.ActiveControl;
				if (activeControl == null && activeForm is FloatingWindowContainerEx && ((FloatingWindowContainerEx)activeForm).Manager == this && ((FloatingWindowContainerEx)activeForm).DockAreaPane.FirstVisibleControlPane == pane)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (Control control = activeControl; control != null; control = control.Parent)
				{
					if ((object)pane.Container == control || ((Control)(object)pane.Container).Contains(control))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				while (activeControl != null)
				{
					if ((object)activeControl == pane.Container)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (((Control)(object)pane.Container).Contains(activeControl))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!(activeControl is IContainerControl))
					{
						return false;
					}
					activeControl = ((IContainerControl)activeControl).ActiveControl;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsHotTracking(DockablePaneBase pane, HotTrackPaneArea area)
		{
			if (!CanHotTrack)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pane == hotTrackingPane)
			{
				return area == hotTrackingArea;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InternalMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			lastEnteredElement = e.Element;
			UIElement element = e.Element;
			if (element is PaneCaptionUIElement || element is TabItemUIElement || element is PaneSlidingGroupUIElement)
			{
				hotTrackingPane = element.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) as DockablePaneBase;
				if (element is PaneCaptionUIElement)
				{
					hotTrackingArea = HotTrackPaneArea.Caption;
				}
				else if (element is TabItemUIElement)
				{
					hotTrackingArea = HotTrackPaneArea.Tab;
				}
				else if (element is PaneSlidingGroupUIElement)
				{
					hotTrackingArea = HotTrackPaneArea.SlidingGroup;
				}
				if (CanHotTrack)
				{
					element.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			lastEnteredElement = null;
			UIElement element = e.Element;
			if (element is PaneCaptionUIElement || element is TabItemUIElement || element is PaneSlidingGroupUIElement)
			{
				hotTrackingPane = null;
				hotTrackingArea = HotTrackPaneArea.None;
				if (CanHotTrack)
				{
					element.Invalidate();
				}
				HideToolTip();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateUIElements(IUltraControlElement provider, bool dirtyChildElements, bool recursive, bool invalidateChildControls)
		{
			if (provider == null || (provider is DockControlBase && !((DockControlBase)(object)provider).HasControlUIElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = provider.MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dirtyChildElements)
			{
				((UIElement)mainUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			((UIElement)mainUIElement).Control.Invalidate();
			if (!recursive)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Control control in ((UIElement)mainUIElement).Control.Controls)
			{
				if (control is IUltraControlElement && control is DockControlBase)
				{
					InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)((control is IUltraControlElement) ? control : null), dirtyChildElements, recursive, invalidateChildControls);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateAutoHideControl(bool dirtyChildElements, bool recalculateSize)
		{
			if (AutoHideControl != null)
			{
				if (recalculateSize)
				{
					AutoHideControl.SyncControlBounds();
				}
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)AutoHideControl, dirtyChildElements, recursive: false, invalidateChildControls: true);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(bool dirtyChildElements, bool recalculateSize)
		{
			if (IsInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (recalculateSize)
				{
					if (unpinnedTabArea == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups)
					{
						((TabManager)item).Dirty(true, false, true);
					}
					unpinnedTabArea.UpdateSize();
				}
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)unpinnedTabArea, dirtyChildElements, recursive: false, invalidateChildControls: false);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidatePaneControls(bool dirtyChildElements, bool invalidateChildControls, bool includeDockableWindows)
		{
			if (IsInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)windowDockingArea, dirtyChildElements, recursive: false, invalidateChildControls);
			}
			foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
			{
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)floatingWindow, dirtyChildElements, recursive: false, invalidateChildControls);
			}
			if (!includeDockableWindows)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow in DockableWindows)
			{
				InvalidateUIElements((IUltraControlElement)(object)dockableWindow, dirtyChildElements, recursive: false, invalidateChildControls);
			}
		}

		private void IncrementPanesCollectionVersion()
		{
			if (panesCollectionVersion == int.MaxValue)
			{
				panesCollectionVersion = int.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				panesCollectionVersion++;
			}
			if (panesCollection != null)
			{
				panesCollection.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePanesCollection()
		{
			if (IsUnhooking || lastCheckedPanesCollectionVersion == panesCollectionVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			panesCollectionVersion = lastCheckedPanesCollectionVersion;
			if (panesCollection == null)
			{
				panesCollection = new HybridDictionary(10, caseInsensitive: false);
			}
			else
			{
				panesCollection.Clear();
			}
			if (dockAreas != null)
			{
				foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
				{
					panesCollection.Add(dockArea.InternalIdString, dockArea);
					if (dockArea.HasChildPanes())
					{
						AddChildPanes(dockArea);
					}
				}
			}
			if (controlPanes != null)
			{
				foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in controlPanes)
				{
					if (!panesCollection.Contains(controlPane.InternalIdString))
					{
						panesCollection.Add(controlPane.InternalIdString, controlPane);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in panesCollection)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = item.Value as DockablePaneBase;
				if (dockablePaneBase is DockAreaPane)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = dockablePaneBase.DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (dockAreaPane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating)
				{
					if (dockablePaneBase.ParentDockedId != Guid.Empty && !panesCollection.Contains(dockablePaneBase.ParentDockedId.ToString()))
					{
						dockablePaneBase.SetParentDocked(null);
					}
				}
				else if (dockablePaneBase.ParentFloatingId != Guid.Empty && !panesCollection.Contains(dockablePaneBase.ParentFloatingId.ToString()))
				{
					dockablePaneBase.SetParentFloating(null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddChildPanes(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				panesCollection.Add(pane.InternalIdString, pane);
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
				{
					AddChildPanes((DockableGroupPane)pane);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowUnpinnedToolTip(DockableControlPane pane, string tooltip)
		{
			if (pane != null && pane.IsUnpinned)
			{
				UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedAreaForPane = GetUnpinnedAreaForPane(pane);
				if (unpinnedAreaForPane != null)
				{
					ShowToolTip((Control)(object)unpinnedAreaForPane, tooltip, showAlways: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowToolTip(UIElement element, string tooltip, bool showAlways)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_49"));
			}
			ShowToolTip((element == null) ? null : element.Control, tooltip, showAlways);
		}

		internal void ShowToolTip(Control control, string tooltip, bool showAlways)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsDesignMode || control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HideToolTip();
			if (!ShowToolTips || tooltip == null || tooltip.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (showAlways)
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				try
				{
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					if (Form.ActiveForm == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (this.tooltip == null)
			{
				this.tooltip = new ToolTip(control, ((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole);
			}
			this.tooltip.ToolTipText = tooltip;
			this.tooltip.Show();
			ResetCursorPosition();
		}

		internal void HideToolTip()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode && tooltip != null)
			{
				tooltip.Hide();
				((DisposableObject)(object)tooltip).Dispose();
				tooltip = null;
			}
		}

		private void AddContextMenu(Control control)
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode && control != null)
			{
				ContextMenu.ApplyToControl(control);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveContextMenu(Control control)
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode && control != null)
			{
				ContextMenu.RemoveFromControlIfNeeded(control);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenu(Control control)
		{
			if (useDefaultContextMenus)
			{
				AddContextMenu(control);
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveContextMenu(control);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenus()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = useDefaultContextMenus;
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea control in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				InitializeContextMenu((Control)(object)control);
			}
			foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow in DockableWindows)
			{
				InitializeContextMenu((Control)(object)dockableWindow);
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				InitializeContextMenu((Control)(object)windowDockingArea);
			}
			foreach (MdiChildFormBase mdiChildForm in MdiChildForms)
			{
				InitializeContextMenu(mdiChildForm);
			}
		}

		private void OnMenuItemClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ContextMenuItem val = (ContextMenuItem)((sender is ContextMenuItem) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				SuspendIsInViewEvents();
				MenuItemInfo menuItemInfo = (MenuItemInfo)((SubObjectBase)(object)val).Tag;
				DockablePaneBase pane = menuItemInfo.pane;
				switch (menuItemInfo.action)
				{
				case MenuItemAction.MdiChild:
					if (pane is DockableControlPane dockableControlPane2)
					{
						dockableControlPane2.IsMdiChild = !dockableControlPane2.IsMdiChild;
					}
					break;
				case MenuItemAction.Activate:
					if (pane is DockableControlPane { IsUnpinned: not false } dockableControlPane)
					{
						dockableControlPane.Flyout(slide: true, activate: true);
					}
					else
					{
						pane.Activate();
					}
					break;
				case MenuItemAction.AutoHide:
					pane.ProcessButtonClick(PaneButton.Pin, null);
					break;
				case MenuItemAction.Float:
					pane.ToggleDockState();
					break;
				case MenuItemAction.Hide:
					pane.ProcessButtonClick(PaneButton.Close, null);
					break;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnMenuPopup(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0273: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cf: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0397: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_039d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0433: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0439: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			Control sourceControl = ContextMenu.SourceControl;
			((ContextMenuItemBase)ContextMenu).MenuItems.Clear();
			if (sourceControl == null || sourceControl.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (sourceControl is MdiChildFormBase)
			{
				DockableControlPane pane = ((MdiChildFormBase)sourceControl).Pane;
				ContextMenuItem val = ((ContextMenuItemBase)ContextMenu).MenuItems.Add();
				ContextMenuItem val2 = ((ContextMenuItemBase)ContextMenu).MenuItems.Add();
				ContextMenuItem val3 = ((ContextMenuItemBase)ContextMenu).MenuItems.Add();
				val.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuHide");
				val2.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuFloating");
				val3.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ContextMenuDockable");
				val.Click += MenuItemClickHandler;
				val2.Click += MenuItemClickHandler;
				val3.Click += MenuItemClickHandler;
				((SubObjectBase)(object)val).Tag = new MenuItemInfo(pane, MenuItemAction.Hide);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)val2).Tag = new MenuItemInfo(pane, MenuItemAction.Float);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)val3).Tag = new MenuItemInfo(pane, MenuItemAction.MdiChild);
				val.Enabled = pane.IsButtonEnabled(PaneButton.Close);
				val2.Enabled = (int)pane.SettingsResolved.AllowFloating == 1;
				return;
			}
			mousePosition = sourceControl.PointToClient(mousePosition);
			if (sourceControl.ClientRectangle.Contains(mousePosition))
			{
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyleUnpinnedTabArea:
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyleSplitterBars:
				case PropertyIds.CaptionButtonStyle:
				case PropertyIds.WindowStyle:
				case PropertyIds.CaptionStyle:
				case PropertyIds.UnpinnedTabStyle:
				case PropertyIds.VerticalCaptionGrabHandleHeight:
				case PropertyIds.HorizontalCaptionGrabHandleWidth:
				case PropertyIds.DragIndicatorStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ShowCloseButton:
					DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds.ShowCloseButton));
					break;
				}
			}
			if ((!IsDesignMode || !initializingComponent) && !IsDisposing && !isLoadingFromStream)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode, Control control)
		{
			//IL_00f0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (control == null || !control.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Enabled || !((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control is AutoHideControl)
			{
				foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in ControlPanes)
				{
					if (controlPane.DockAreaPane != null && controlPane.IsUnpinned && controlPane.IsMnemonic(charCode))
					{
						return controlPane.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (control is DockableWindow)
				{
					DockableWindow dockableWindow = (DockableWindow)(object)control;
					return dockableWindow.Pane?.ProcessMnemonic(charCode) ?? false;
				}
				if (control is UnpinnedTabArea)
				{
					UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea = (UnpinnedTabArea)(object)control;
					foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups)
					{
						foreach (ITabItem tab in item.Tabs)
						{
							ITabItem val = tab;
							if (val is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase && dockablePaneBase.IsMnemonic(charCode))
							{
								return dockablePaneBase.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (control is WindowDockingArea)
				{
					WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea = (WindowDockingArea)(object)control;
					return ProcessMnemonic(charCode, windowDockingArea.Pane);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode, DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (DockablePaneBase pane in group.Panes)
			{
				if (pane is DockableGroupPane && ProcessMnemonic(charCode, (DockableGroupPane)pane))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (pane.IsMnemonic(charCode))
				{
					return pane.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
				}
			}
			return group.ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
		}

		private void InitializeAllowDrop(bool value)
		{
			if (!IsInitialized || !CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionClipboard.AllClipboard);
				uIPermission.Demand();
				UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
				foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
				{
					((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).AllowDrop = value;
				}
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).AllowDrop = value;
				}
				foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow in DockableWindows)
				{
					((Control)(object)dockableWindow).AllowDrop = value;
				}
				foreach (FloatingWindowContainer floatingWindow in FloatingWindows)
				{
					floatingWindow.AllowDrop = value;
				}
				if (AutoHideControl != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)AutoHideControl).AllowDrop = value;
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void InitializeAllowDrop(Control control, bool value)
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionClipboard.AllClipboard);
				uIPermission.Demand();
				control.AllowDrop = value;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ProcessDragDropAction(DockControlBase control, DragEventArgs e, DragDropAction action)
		{
			if (action == DragDropAction.DragLeave || action == DragDropAction.DragDrop)
			{
				dragOverElement = null;
			}
			else
			{
				if ((!(control is UnpinnedTabArea) && !(control is WindowDockingArea) && !(control is DockableWindow)) || control == null || ((Control)(object)control).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)control).Disposing)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (control == null || ((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = ((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement;
				Point p = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				p = ((Control)(object)control).PointToClient(p);
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)mainUIElement).ElementFromPoint(p);
				if (val == dragOverElement)
				{
					return;
				}
				dragOverElement = val;
				if (val != null && (val.GetAncestor(typeof(TabItemButtonUIElement)) != null || val.GetAncestor(typeof(TabItemUIElement)) != null || val.GetAncestor(typeof(PaneSlidingGroupUIElement)) != null) && val.GetContext(typeof(DockablePaneBase), true) is DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase)
				{
					if (dockablePaneBase.IsUnpinned && dockablePaneBase is DockableControlPane)
					{
						ShowFlyoutPane((DockableControlPane)dockablePaneBase, forceFocus: false, slide: true, (DefaultableBoolean)2);
					}
					else
					{
						dockablePaneBase.IsSelectedTab = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = tabManager.Tabs.Count;
			TabState[] array = (TabState[])(object)new TabState[4]
			{
				default(TabState),
				(TabState)5,
				(TabState)2,
				(TabState)7
			};
			int num = array.Length;
			AppearanceData[] array2 = (AppearanceData[])(object)new AppearanceData[count * num];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = tabManager.Tabs[i] as DockablePaneBase;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					int num2 = i * num + j;
					array2[num2] = default(AppearanceData);
					if (dockablePaneBase != null)
					{
						AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
						dockablePaneBase.SettingsResolved.ResolveTabAppearance(ref array2[num2], ref requestedProps, array[j], resolveDefaults: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return Utilities.CreateLargestFont(array2, HostControl.Font, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UltraComponentBase)(object)this));
		}

		internal void DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType changeType)
		{
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in DockAreas)
			{
				dockArea.DirtyTabInfo(changeType, recursive: true);
			}
			DirtyUnpinnedTabManagers(changeType);
		}

		private void DirtyUnpinnedTabManagers(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType changeType)
		{
			if (UnpinnedTabAreas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (unpinnedTabArea == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)unpinnedTabArea.TabGroups)
				{
					item.DirtyTabInfo(changeType);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyValidateChildren(bool beforeValidate)
		{
			if (validateChildrenCount == 0 && beforeValidate)
			{
				validateChildrenList = new List<DockControlBase>();
				if (autoHideControl != null)
				{
					validateChildrenList.Add(autoHideControl);
				}
				foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
				{
					validateChildrenList.Add(windowDockingArea);
				}
				foreach (DockableWindow dockableWindow in DockableWindows)
				{
					validateChildrenList.Add(dockableWindow);
				}
				foreach (DockControlBase validateChildren in validateChildrenList)
				{
					if (!((Control)(object)validateChildren).Disposing && !((Control)(object)validateChildren).IsDisposed)
					{
						validateChildren.SetContainerControlState(setOn: true);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (validateChildrenCount == 1 && !beforeValidate)
			{
				foreach (DockControlBase validateChildren2 in validateChildrenList)
				{
					if (!((Control)(object)validateChildren2).Disposing && !((Control)(object)validateChildren2).IsDisposed)
					{
						validateChildren2.SetContainerControlState(setOn: false);
					}
				}
			}
			validateChildrenCount += (beforeValidate ? 1 : (-1));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ValidateChildren()
		{
			return ValidateChildren(ValidationSource.HostControl, ValidationConstraints.Selectable);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ValidateChildren(ValidationConstraints validationConstraints)
		{
			return ValidateChildren(ValidationSource.HostControl, validationConstraints);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ValidateChildren(ValidationSource validationSource)
		{
			return ValidateChildren(validationSource, ValidationConstraints.Selectable);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ValidateChildren(ValidationSource validationSource, ValidationConstraints validationConstraints)
		{
			NotifyValidateChildren(beforeValidate: true);
			try
			{
				switch (validationSource)
				{
				case ValidationSource.HostControl:
					return hostControl == null || hostControl.ValidateChildren(validationConstraints);
				case ValidationSource.AllDockAreas:
				{
					bool result = true;
					WindowDockingArea[] array = (WindowDockingArea[])WindowDockingAreas.ToArray(typeof(WindowDockingArea));
					WindowDockingArea[] array2 = array;
					foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in array2)
					{
						if (!((ContainerControl)(object)windowDockingArea).ValidateChildren(validationConstraints))
						{
							result = false;
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				NotifyValidateChildren(beforeValidate: false);
			}
		}
