		internal void SuspendIsInViewEvents()
		{
			isInViewEventsSuspendedCount++;
		}

		internal void ResumeIsInViewEvents(bool verifyState)
		{
			if (isInViewEventsSuspendedCount > 0)
			{
				if (isInViewEventsSuspendedCount == 1 && verifyState)
				{
					VerifyIsInViewState();
				}
				isInViewEventsSuspendedCount--;
				if (isInViewEventsSuspendedCount == 0)
				{
					FirePendingIsInViewEvents();
				}
			}
		}

		private void FirePendingIsInViewEvents()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < DockAreas.Count; i++)
			{
				FirePendingIsInViewEvents(DockAreas[i]);
			}
		}

		private void FirePendingIsInViewEvents(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				((DockableControlPane)pane).FireIsInViewEventIfNecessary();
			}
			else if (pane is DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dockableGroupPane.Panes.Count; i++)
				{
					FirePendingIsInViewEvents(dockableGroupPane.Panes[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyIsInViewState()
		{
			SuspendIsInViewEvents();
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < DockAreas.Count; i++)
				{
					DockAreas[i].VerifyIsInViewState(recursive: true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeIsInViewEvents(verifyState: false);
			}
		}

		internal void FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DockManagerEventIds), id))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterDockChange:
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterPaneButtonClick:
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterSplitterDrag:
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterToggleDockState:
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeShowFlyout:
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterHideFlyout:
					DelayInvalidateOverlayControl();
					break;
				}
				switch (id)
				{
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterDockChange:
					OnAfterDockChange(e as PaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterPaneButtonClick:
					OnAfterPaneButtonClick(e as PaneButtonEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterSplitterDrag:
					OnAfterSplitterDrag(e as PanesEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeDockChange:
					OnBeforeDockChange(e as BeforeDockChangeEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeDockChangeStart:
					OnBeforeDockChangeStart(e as CancelablePaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforePaneButtonClick:
					OnBeforePaneButtonClick(e as CancelablePaneButtonEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeSplitterDrag:
					OnBeforeSplitterDrag(e as CancelablePanesEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.DoubleClickSplitterBar:
					OnDoubleClickSplitterBar(e as PanesEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.InitializePane:
					OnInitializePane(e as InitializePaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.PaneActivate:
					OnPaneActivate(e as ControlPaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.PaneDeactivate:
					OnPaneDeactivate(e as ControlPaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeToggleDockState:
					OnBeforeToggleDockState(e as CancelablePaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterToggleDockState:
					OnAfterToggleDockState(e as PaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeShowFlyout:
					OnBeforeShowFlyout(e as CancelableControlPaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterHideFlyout:
					OnAfterHideFlyout(e as ControlPaneEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.BeforeNavigatorDisplayed:
					OnBeforeNavigatorDisplayed(e as BeforeNavigatorDisplayedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.AfterNavigatorClosed:
					OnAfterNavigatorClosed(e as AfterNavigatorClosedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.InitializeNavigatorItem:
					OnInitializeNavigatorItem(e as InitializeNavigatorItemEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.InitializeNavigatorItemDescription:
					OnInitializeNavigatorItemDescription(e as InitializeNavigatorItemDescriptionEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.PaneDisplayed:
					OnPaneDisplayed(e as PaneDisplayedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DockManagerEventIds.PaneHidden:
					OnPaneHidden(e as PaneHiddenEventArgs);
					break;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			InternalMouseEnterElement(e);
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.MouseEnterElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_50"));
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
			try
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseEnterElement(e);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
			}
		}

				return;
			}
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_50"));
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
			try
			{
				((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).OnMouseLeaveElement(e);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(DockManagerEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInheritedPane(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			if (inheritedPaneIds == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsInheritedDesignComponent((Component)(object)this))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return inheritedPaneIds.Contains(pane.InternalIdString);
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
				bool flag = IsInheritedDesignComponent((Component)(object)this);
				TimeSpan timeSpan = DateTime.Now - timeOfPrevBeginInit;
				timeOfPrevBeginInit = DateTime.Now;
				bool flag2 = timeSpan.TotalSeconds > 2.0;
				if (designerHost != null && !designerHost.Loading && flag2)
				{
					initializingCollections = true;
					DockAreas.Clear();
					ControlPanes.Clear();
					if (tabAreas != null)
					{
						UnpinnedTabArea[] array = tabAreas;
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							array[i]?.TabGroups.Clear();
						}
					}
					initializingCollections = false;
					if (flag)
					{
						loadingBaseClassSettings = true;
						try
						{
							LoadManagerSettings();
						}
						finally
						{
							loadingBaseClassSettings = false;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			initializing = true;
			initializingComponent = true;
			OnBeginInit();
		}

		private void SaveManagerSettings()
		{
			DeleteSavedManagerSettings();
			msDockManager = new MemoryStream();
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				SaveAsBinary(msDockManager);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void LoadManagerSettings()
		{
			if (msDockManager != null)
			{
				msDockManager.Position = 0L;
				LoadFromBinary(msDockManager);
			}
		}

		private void DeleteSavedManagerSettings()
		{
			if (msDockManager != null)
			{
				msDockManager.Close();
				msDockManager = null;
			}
		}

		private void CheckDragDropAllowed()
		{
			if ((checkDragDropInvoke == null || checkDragDropInvoke.IsCompleted) && HostControl != null)
			{
				if (!HostControl.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					HostControl.HandleCreated += HostControlHandleCreated;
				}
				else
				{
					checkDragDropInvoke = HostControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(CheckDragDropCallBack));
				}
			}
		}

		private void HostControlHandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is Control control)
			{
				control.HandleCreated -= HostControlHandleCreated;
			}
			checkDragDropInvoke = HostControl.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(CheckDragDropCallBack));
		}

		private void CheckDragDropCallBack()
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode || IsDisposing || !AllowDrop || CanSetAllowDrop)
			{
				if (!((Component)this).DesignMode && !IsDisposing)
				{
					InitializeAllowDrop(AllowDrop);
				}
				return;
			}
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AllowDropErrorMessageTitle");
			string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AllowDropErrorMessage");
			if (!STAThreadWarningSuspended)
			{
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)HostControl, text2, text, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				try
				{
					InitializeComponent();
				}
				finally
				{
					DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
				}
				try
				{
					if (LicenseManager.CurrentContext.UsageMode == LicenseUsageMode.Designtime)
					{
						SaveManagerSettings();
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				UpdatePanesCollection();
				if (inheritedPaneIds == null)
				{
					inheritedPaneIds = new ArrayList(panesCollection.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					inheritedPaneIds.Clear();
				}
				foreach (DockablePaneBase value in panesCollection.Values)
				{
					inheritedPaneIds.Add(value.InternalIdString);
				}
				CheckDragDropAllowed();
				if (HostControl is Form)
				{
					AddMessageFilter();
				}
			}
			OnEndInit();
		}

		private bool LoadComponentSettingsFromBinary()
		{
			bool result = false;
			byte[] binaryData = Settings.BinaryData;
			if (binaryData != null && binaryData.Length != 0)
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				memoryStream.Write(binaryData, 0, binaryData.Length);
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				try
				{
					LoadFromBinary(memoryStream);
					result = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void DisposeFormIconImagesAndStreams()
		{
			if (iconImagesAndStreamsList == null)

				IconImagesAndStreamsList.Remove(obj);

			}
		}

		private static MdiClient GetMdiClient(Form form)
		{
			if (form == null)

				{
					return control as MdiClient;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ProcessNavigatorItemActivationAsync(ValueListItem selectedItem, bool isSelectedItemInPaneList)
		{
			if (selectedItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isSelectedItemInPaneList)
			{

				if (ControlPanes.Contains(dockablePaneBase))
				{
					dockablePaneBase.Activate();
				}
				return;
			}
			Form form = selectedItem.DataValue as Form;
			MdiClient mdiClient = GetMdiClient(HostControl as Form);
			if (mdiClient == null || !mdiClient.Controls.Contains(form))
			{
				return;
			}
			Utilities.ActivateForm(form);
			if (HostControl is Form form2)
			{
				Utilities.SetActiveControl(form2, form);
				Form activeForm = Form.ActiveForm;
				if (activeForm != null && activeForm != form2 && Utilities.GetOwner(activeForm) == form2)
				{
					Utilities.ActivateForm(form2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ShowNavigatorInternal(bool userRequested, bool isShiftKeyDown)
		{
			if (isShowingNavigator)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (navigatorForm != null)
			{
				DestroyNavigatorForm();
			}
			BeforeNavigatorDisplayedEventArgs e = new BeforeNavigatorDisplayedEventArgs();
			FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.BeforeNavigatorDisplayed, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				navigatorForm = CreateNavigatorForm(userRequested, isShiftKeyDown);
				if (navigatorForm != null)
				{
					navigatorForm.Show();
					isShowingNavigator = true;
				}
			}
		}

			InvalidateUnpinnedTabAreas(dirtyChildElements: true, recalculateSize: true);

			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		internal DockedLocation AdjustLocationForRightToLeftLayout(DockedLocation location)
		{
			if (!IsHostRightToLeftLayoutResolved)
			{
				return location;
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
				location = DockedLocation.DockedRight;
				break;
			case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
				location = DockedLocation.DockedLeft;
				break;
			}
			return location;
		}

		private void OnHostControlRightToLeftChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeControlRightToLeft();
			DirtyTabManagers(Utilities.TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics);
			((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)this).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		private void InitializeControlRightToLeft()
		{
			if (HostControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RightToLeft rightToLeft = HostControl.RightToLeft;
			UnpinnedTabArea[] unpinnedTabAreas = UnpinnedTabAreas;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabArea unpinnedTabArea in unpinnedTabAreas)
			{
				if (unpinnedTabArea != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)unpinnedTabArea).RightToLeft = rightToLeft;
				}
			}
			foreach (WindowDockingArea windowDockingArea in WindowDockingAreas)
			{
				if (windowDockingArea != null)
				{
					((Control)(object)windowDockingArea).RightToLeft = rightToLeft;
				}
			}
			if (AutoHideControl != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)AutoHideControl).RightToLeft = rightToLeft;
			}
		}

	internal class ControlParentManager
	{
		private Stack parentChain = new Stack(5);

		internal event EventHandler ParentChainActivationChanged;

		internal event ControlEventHandler ParentChainChanged;

		internal event ControlEventHandler ParentChainVisibleChanged;

		internal ControlParentManager(Control rootControl)
		{
			Push(rootControl);
		}

		internal ControlParentManager()
		{
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			Pop(null);
		}

		private void FireParentChainActivationChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ParentChainActivationChanged != null)
			{
				this.ParentChainActivationChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(Control rootControl)
		{
			Clear();
			Push(rootControl);
		}

		private void OnParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			Pop(control);
			Push(control);
			if (this.ParentChainChanged != null)
			{
				this.ParentChainChanged(this, new ControlEventArgs(control));
			}
		}

		private void OnParentDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			Pop(control);
			Push(Pop());
			if (this.ParentChainChanged != null)
			{
				this.ParentChainChanged(this, new ControlEventArgs(control));
			}
		}

		private void OnParentFormActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FireParentChainActivationChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnParentFormDeactivate(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FireParentChainActivationChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnParentVisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ParentChainVisibleChanged != null)
			{
				this.ParentChainVisibleChanged(this, new ControlEventArgs(sender as Control));
			}
		}

		private void Push(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (ctrl != null)
			{
				PushHelper(ctrl);
			}
		}

		private void PushHelper(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (ctrl != null)
			{
				ctrl.ParentChanged += OnParentChanged;
				ctrl.Disposed += OnParentDisposed;
				ctrl.VisibleChanged += OnParentVisibleChanged;
				if (ctrl is Form form)
				{
					form.Activated += OnParentFormActivated;
					form.Deactivate += OnParentFormDeactivate;
				}
				parentChain.Push(ctrl);
				PushHelper(Utilities.GetParent(ctrl));
			}
		}

		private void Pop(Control parent)
		{
			Control control = Pop();
			while (control != null && control != parent)
			{
				control = Pop();
			}
		}

		private Control Pop()
		{
			if (parentChain.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Control control = parentChain.Pop() as Control;
			control.ParentChanged -= OnParentChanged;
			control.Disposed -= OnParentDisposed;
			control.VisibleChanged -= OnParentVisibleChanged;
			if (control is Form form)
			{
				form.Activated -= OnParentFormActivated;
				form.Deactivate -= OnParentFormDeactivate;
			}
			return control;
		}
	}

		internal void AddUnpinnedPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (!pane.IsPromotingToParentGroup)
			{
				DockableGroupPane parent = pane.Parent;
				UnpinnedTabManager unpinnedTabManager = TabGroups.TabInfoFromPane(parent);
				if (unpinnedTabManager == null)
				{
					unpinnedTabManager = new UnpinnedTabManager(parent);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)unpinnedTabManager).SubObjectPropChanged += ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					TabGroups.Add(unpinnedTabManager);
				}
				parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Remove(pane.Tab);
				pane.ResetTabItemTag();
				if (!unpinnedTabManager.Tabs.Contains(pane.Tab))
				{
					unpinnedTabManager.Tabs.Add(pane.Tab);
					pane.SubObjectPropChanged += ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)pane;
				if (((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).FirstVisibleTabItem != null)
				{
					((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).FirstDisplayedTabItem = ((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).FirstVisibleTabItem;
				}
				((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).Dirty(true, false, true);
				UpdateSize();
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveUnpinnedPane(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (!pane.IsPromotingToParentGroup)
			{
				DockableGroupPane parent = pane.Parent;
				UnpinnedTabManager unpinnedTabManager = TabGroups.TabInfoFromPane(parent);
				unpinnedTabManager.Tabs.Remove(pane.Tab);
				pane.ResetTabItemTag();
				if (unpinnedTabManager.Tabs.Count == 0)
				{
					TabGroups.Remove(unpinnedTabManager);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)unpinnedTabManager).SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)unpinnedTabManager).Dispose();
				}
				else
				{
					((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).Dirty(true, true, false);
				}
				pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				int visibleIndexOf = parent.GetVisibleIndexOf(pane);
				if (!parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Contains(pane.Tab))
				{
					parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Insert(Math.Min(visibleIndexOf, parent.TabInfo.Tabs.Count), pane.Tab);
				}
				UpdateSize();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSize()
		{
			//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (TabGroups.Count == 0)
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Width = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Height = 0;
				}
				((Control)(object)this).Visible = false;
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)TabGroups)
			{

				item.TabHeight = -1;
				num = Math.Max(((TabManager)item).GetRequiredExtent(), num);
			}
			foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item2 in (IEnumerable)TabGroups)

				item2.TabHeight = num;

			if (IsVertical)

				num += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
				((Control)(object)this).Height = num;
			}
			((Control)(object)this).Visible = Manager.IsUnpinnedTabAreaVisible(this);
			((UIElement)((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
		}

				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = unpinnedTabManager.Tabs[0] as DockablePaneBase;
				dockablePaneBase.Parent.TemporaryUnpinnedTabInfo = unpinnedTabManager;
				dockableControlPane = ((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).SelectedTabItem as DockableControlPane;
				dockablePaneBase.Parent.TemporaryUnpinnedTabInfo = null;
			}
			TabGroups.Remove(unpinnedTabManager);
			foreach (ITabItem tab in unpinnedTabManager.Tabs)
			{
				ITabItem val = tab;
				DockableControlPane dockableControlPane2 = val as DockableControlPane;
				dockableControlPane2.SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				AddUnpinnedPane(dockableControlPane2);
			}
			if (dockableControlPane != null)
			{
				VerifyPaneIsSelected(dockableControlPane);
			}
			((SubObjectBase)(object)unpinnedTabManager).SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			((DisposableObject)(object)unpinnedTabManager).Dispose();
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyPaneIsSelected(DockableControlPane pane)
		{
			if (pane != null && (pane.IsUnpinned || pane.IsUnpinning))
			{
				UnpinnedTabManager unpinnedTabManager = TabGroups.TabInfoFromPane(pane.Parent);
				if (unpinnedTabManager != null)
				{
					((TabManager)unpinnedTabManager).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)pane;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}

		}

		internal UnpinnedTabManager TabInfoFromPane(DockableGroupPane group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_55"));
			}
			foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Group == group)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SortGroupsAndItems(UnpinnedTabAreaInfo tabAreaInfo)
		{
			if (tabAreaInfo == null || Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List.Sort(new UnpinnedTabGroupSortComparer(tabAreaInfo));
			foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				UnpinnedTabGroupInfo unpinnedTabGroupInfo = tabAreaInfo.GetGroup(item.Group);
				if (unpinnedTabGroupInfo == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.Tabs.Sort(new UnpinnedTabItemSortComparer(unpinnedTabGroupInfo));
				foreach (DockablePaneBase tab in item.Tabs)
				{
					if (!(tab.InternalId != unpinnedTabGroupInfo.SelectedPaneId))
					{
						((TabManager)item).SelectedTabItem = (ITabItem)(object)tab;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	internal class UnpinnedTabGroupInfo
	{

		private Guid[] controlPaneOrder;

		private Guid selectedPaneId;

		internal Guid GroupId => groupPaneId;

		internal Guid SelectedPaneId => selectedPaneId;

		internal UnpinnedTabGroupInfo(UnpinnedTabManager tabGroup)
		{
			groupPaneId = tabGroup.Group.InternalId;
			controlPaneOrder = new Guid[tabGroup.Tabs.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < controlPaneOrder.Length; i++)
			{
				DockablePaneBase dockablePaneBase = (DockablePaneBase)tabGroup.Tabs[i];
				controlPaneOrder[i] = dockablePaneBase.InternalId;
			}
			if (((TabManager)tabGroup).SelectedTabItem != null)
			{
				selectedPaneId = ((DockablePaneBase)(object)((TabManager)tabGroup).SelectedTabItem).InternalId;
			}
			else if (tabGroup.Tabs.Count > 0)
			{
				selectedPaneId = ((DockablePaneBase)tabGroup.Tabs[0]).InternalId;
			}
		}

		private UnpinnedTabGroupInfo()
		{
		}

		internal int GetPaneIndex(DockablePaneBase pane)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < controlPaneOrder.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pane.InternalId == controlPaneOrder[i])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal class UnpinnedTabGroupSortComparer : IComparer
	{
		private UnpinnedTabAreaInfo tabAreaInfo;

		internal UnpinnedTabGroupSortComparer(UnpinnedTabAreaInfo tabAreaInfo)
		{
			this.tabAreaInfo = tabAreaInfo;
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			UnpinnedTabManager unpinnedTabManager = x as UnpinnedTabManager;
			UnpinnedTabManager unpinnedTabManager2 = y as UnpinnedTabManager;
			int groupIndex = tabAreaInfo.GetGroupIndex(unpinnedTabManager.Group);
			int groupIndex2 = tabAreaInfo.GetGroupIndex(unpinnedTabManager2.Group);
			if (groupIndex < groupIndex2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (groupIndex > groupIndex2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal class UnpinnedTabItemSortComparer : IComparer
	{
		private UnpinnedTabGroupInfo groupInfo;

		internal UnpinnedTabItemSortComparer(UnpinnedTabGroupInfo groupInfo)
		{
			this.groupInfo = groupInfo;
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			DockablePaneBase pane = x as DockablePaneBase;
			DockablePaneBase pane2 = y as DockablePaneBase;
			int paneIndex = groupInfo.GetPaneIndex(pane);
			int paneIndex2 = groupInfo.GetPaneIndex(pane2);
			if (paneIndex < paneIndex2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (paneIndex > paneIndex2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_013e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;

			{
				rectInsideBorders.Offset(2, 0);
			}
			else if (((Control)(object)TabArea).Dock == DockStyle.Bottom)
			{
				rectInsideBorders.Offset(0, 2);
			}
			bool isVertical = TabArea.IsVertical;
			Rectangle innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds = Manager.InnerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds;
			Point pos = ((!isVertical) ? new Point(innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Left - ((UIElement)this).Control.Left, 0) : new Point(0, innerUnpinnedTabAreaBounds.Top - ((UIElement)this).Control.Top));
			if (!pos.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectInsideBorders.Offset(pos);
				rectInsideBorders.Width -= pos.X;
				rectInsideBorders.Height -= pos.Y;
			}
			foreach (UnpinnedTabManager item in (IEnumerable)TabArea.TabGroups)
			{
				if (rectInsideBorders.Width <= 0 || rectInsideBorders.Height <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				object obj = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(TabGroupUIElement), true, (object)item);
				UIElement val = (UIElement)((obj is UIElement) ? obj : null);
				if (val == null || (val is TabGroupUIElement && (object)((TabGroupUIElement)val).TabManager != item))
				{
					val = ((TabManager)item).CreateTabAreaUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				Size size = (item.AvailableSize = ((TabManager)item).GetRequiredSize());
				val.Rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Location, size);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add(val);
				if (isVertical)
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Y += size.Height + 11;
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= size.Height + 11;
				}
				else
				{
					rectInsideBorders.X += size.Width + 11;
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= size.Width + 11;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void DrawMac9Lines(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, Color baseColor, bool vertical)
		{
			if (rect.Width == 0 || rect.Height == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Pen pen = new Pen(DrawUtility.LightLight(baseColor));
			Pen pen2 = new Pen(DrawUtility.DarkDark(baseColor));
			int num = (vertical ? rect.Left : rect.Top);
			int num2 = (vertical ? rect.Right : rect.Bottom);
			if ((num2 - num) % 2 != 0)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			int num3 = num % 2;
			for (int i = num; i < num2; i++)
			{
				bool flag = i % 2 != num3;
				Pen pen3 = (flag ? pen2 : pen);
				if (vertical)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						g.DrawLine(pen3, i, rect.Top + 1, i, rect.Bottom - 1);
					}
					else
					{
						g.DrawLine(pen3, i, rect.Top, i, rect.Bottom - 2);
					}
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					g.DrawLine(pen3, rect.Left + 1, i, rect.Right - 1, i);
				}
				else
				{
					g.DrawLine(pen3, rect.Left, i, rect.Right - 2, i);
				}
			}
			pen.Dispose();
			pen2.Dispose();
		}

		public static void DrawVC6Lines(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, Color baseColor, bool vertical)
		{
			if (rect.Width == 0 || rect.Height == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			rect.Width--;
			rect.Height--;
			if ((vertical || rect.Height >= 7) && (!vertical || rect.Width >= 7))
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ((!vertical) ? new Rectangle(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, 2) : new Rectangle(rect.Left, rect.Top, 2, rect.Height));
				int num = (vertical ? (rect.Left + rect.Width / 2) : (rect.Top + rect.Height / 2));
				if (vertical)
				{
					rectangle.X = num - 3;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle.Y = num - 3;
				}
				Pen pen = new Pen(DrawUtility.LightLight(baseColor));
				Pen pen2 = new Pen(DrawUtility.Dark(baseColor));
				g.DrawLine(pen, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
				g.DrawLine(pen2, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
				g.DrawLine(pen, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
				g.DrawLine(pen2, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
				if (vertical)
				{
					rectangle.X = num + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle.Y = num + 1;
				}
				g.DrawLine(pen, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
				g.DrawLine(pen2, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
				g.DrawLine(pen, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
				g.DrawLine(pen2, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
				pen.Dispose();
				pen2.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal static TabManagerChangeType GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds property)
		{
			switch (property)
			{
			case PropertyIds.ActiveTabAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.HotTrackingTabAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.TabAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.Appearance:
			case PropertyIds.SelectedTabAppearance:
				return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate | TabManagerChangeType.Font;
			case PropertyIds.Settings:
			case PropertyIds.DefaultPaneSettings:
			case PropertyIds.DefaultGroupSettings:
			case PropertyIds.GroupSettings:
				return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate | TabManagerChangeType.Font;
			case PropertyIds.TabAreaAppearance:
				return TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			case PropertyIds.TabLocation:
			case PropertyIds.TabSizing:
			case PropertyIds.Closed:
			case PropertyIds.ShowCloseButton:
			case PropertyIds.ChildPaneStyle:
			case PropertyIds.Text:
			case PropertyIds.TextTab:
			case PropertyIds.Size:
			case PropertyIds.TabStyle:
			case PropertyIds.WindowStyle:
			case PropertyIds.CaptionStyle:
			case PropertyIds.IsMdiChild:
			case PropertyIds.CompressUnpinnedTabs:
			case PropertyIds.UnpinnedTabStyle:
			case PropertyIds.CloseButtonLocation:
				return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			case PropertyIds.ToolTipTab:
				return TabManagerChangeType.None;
			case PropertyIds.IsSelectedTab:
				return TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			case PropertyIds.TabWidth:
			case PropertyIds.Pinned:
				return TabManagerChangeType.Collection | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			case PropertyIds.CaptionLocation:
				return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
			default:
				return TabManagerChangeType.None;
			}
		}

		internal static TabManagerChangeType GetTabChangeType(PropertyIds propertyChanged, PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChangeInfo == null)
			{
				return TabManagerChangeType.None;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is PaneSettings || propChangeInfo.Source is GroupSettings || propChangeInfo.Source is DockAreasCollection || propChangeInfo.Source is DockablePanesCollection)
			{
				if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds))
				{
					return TabManagerChangeType.None;
				}
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if (propChangeInfo.Trigger == null)
				{
					return GetTabChangeType(propertyIds);
				}
				return GetTabChangeType(propertyIds, propChangeInfo.Trigger);
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase)
			{
				switch (propertyChanged)
				{
				default:
					return GetTabChangeType(propertyChanged);
				case PropertyIds.ActiveTabAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.HotTrackingTabAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.TabAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.SelectedTabAppearance:
					if (IsFontDataChange(propChangeInfo))
					{
						return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate | TabManagerChangeType.Font;
					}
					if (propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds)
					{
						AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
						switch (val - 5)
						{
						default:
							if ((int)val != 1001)
							{
								break;
							}
							goto case 0;
						case 0:
						case 1:
						case 2:
						case 3:
						case 4:
							return TabManagerChangeType.AllMetrics | TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
						}
					}
					return TabManagerChangeType.Invalidate;
				}
			}
			return TabManagerChangeType.None;
		}

		private static bool IsFontDataChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChangeInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is FontDataPropIds)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase && propChangeInfo.Trigger != null)
			{
				return IsFontDataChange(propChangeInfo.Trigger);
			}
			if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
			if ((int)val != 4)
			{
				return (int)val == 1001;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			Control control = ControlFromHandle(hwnd);
			if (control != null)
			{
				if (!control.Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16);
				if (!NativeWindowMethods.AreBitsPresent(windowLong, 268435456))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void PositionDialogButtons(string buttonSizeResource, Button[] buttons)
		{
			Size size = (Size)Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetObject("DockControlsFormButtonSize");
			PositionDialogButtons(size, buttons);
		}

		internal static void PositionDialogButtons(Size size, Button[] buttons)
		{
			if (buttons == null || buttons.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			foreach (Button button in buttons)
			{
				if (button.Right > empty.X)
				{
					empty.X = button.Right;
				}
				if (button.Top > empty.Y)
				{
					empty.Y = button.Top;
				}
			}
			foreach (Button button2 in buttons)
			{
				button2.Size = size;
				empty.Offset(-size.Width, 0);
				button2.Location = empty;
			}
		}

		internal static void ActivateForm(Form form)
		{
			try
			{
				form.Activate();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				if (!form.Visible || !form.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (form.IsMdiChild)
				{
					if (!(GetParent(form) is MdiClient mdiClient))
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(mdiClient.Handle, 546, form.Handle, IntPtr.Zero);
						return;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetForegroundWindowApi(form.Handle);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool FocusControl(Control control)
		{

			{
				return control.Focus();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)

				{
					if (control.CanFocus)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SetFocusApi(control.Handle);

				catch (SecurityException)

		}

		internal static IContainerControl GetContainerControl(Control control)
		{
			try

		}

		internal static Point GetClientAreaOffset(Form form)
		{
			Point location = form.Bounds.Location;
			Point point = GetParent(form)?.PointToScreen(location) ?? location;
			Point point2 = form.PointToScreen(form.ClientRectangle.Location);
			return new Point(point2.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y);
		}

		internal static Bitmap CreateImageFromResource(string imageResourceName)
		{
			Bitmap result = null;
			Stream stream = null;
			try
			{
				stream = typeof(UltraDockManager).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraDockManager), imageResourceName);
				if (stream != null)
				{
					result = Image.FromStream(stream, useEmbeddedColorManagement: true) as Bitmap;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static HAlign ReverseHAlign(HAlign hAlign)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch ((int)hAlign)
			{
			case 3:
				return (HAlign)1;
			case 1:
				return (HAlign)3;
			case 0:
			case 2:
				return hAlign;
			default:
				return hAlign;
			}
		}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	[Designer("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.Design.WindowDockingAreaDesigner, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(IDesigner))]
	public class WindowDockingArea : DockControlBase, IDockingArea, IDockAreaContainer
	{

		public override Rectangle DisplayRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((ScrollableControl)(object)this).DisplayRectangle;
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.Manager != null)
				{
					int splitterBarWidthResolved = dockAreaPane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
					switch (GetDockResolvedForRightToLeft())
					{
					case DockStyle.Left:
						displayRectangle.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Right:
						displayRectangle.X += splitterBarWidthResolved;
						displayRectangle.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Top:
						displayRectangle.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					case DockStyle.Bottom:
						displayRectangle.Y += splitterBarWidthResolved;
						displayRectangle.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					}
				}
				return displayRectangle;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_WindowDockingArea_P_Pane")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DockAreaPane Pane => DockAreaPane;

		internal string DockAreaPaneId
		{

				return dockAreaId;
			}

				dockAreaId = value;
			}

		internal DockAreaPane DockAreaPane
		{
			get
			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == pane)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (pane != null)
				{
					pane.SubObjectPropChanged -= ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				pane = value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					dockAreaId = null;
				}
				else
				{
					dockAreaId = pane.InternalIdString;
				}
				if (Pane != null)
				{
					Pane.SubObjectPropChanged += ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (Pane.Manager != null && Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this) != null)
					{
						Size size = Pane.Size;
						if (!value.Manager.InitializingComponent && !value.Manager.IsInitializing)
						{
							switch (value.DockedLocation)
							{
							case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
							case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
							{
								Rectangle innerDockAreaBounds2 = value.Manager.InnerDockAreaBounds;
								if (!innerDockAreaBounds2.IsEmpty)
								{
									size.Width = (int)Math.Min(size.Width, (double)innerDockAreaBounds2.Width * 0.75);
								}
								break;
							}
							case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
							case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
							{
								Rectangle innerDockAreaBounds = value.Manager.InnerDockAreaBounds;
								if (!innerDockAreaBounds.IsEmpty)
								{
									size.Height = (int)Math.Min(size.Height, (double)innerDockAreaBounds.Height * 0.75);
								}
								break;
							}
							}
						}
						((Control)(object)this).Dock = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(Pane.DockedLocation);
						GetPaneDisplaySize(size, honorSplitterWidth: false);
						if (Pane.DockedState != DockedState.Floating && !Pane.Manager.IsHostLayoutSuspended)
						{
							Pane.Size = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)this).Dock = DockAreaPane.DockedLocationToDockStyle(Pane.DockedLocation);
					}
				}
				if (controlElement != null)
				{
					controlElement.Initialize(pane);
				}
				((Control)(object)this).Visible = DockManager.IsWindowDockingAreaVisible(this);
				((Control)(object)this).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)DockManager).Enabled;
			}
		}

		protected override ControlUIElementBase ControlUIElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (((Control)(object)this).Disposing || DockManager == null || DockManager.IsUnhooking)
				{

				if (controlElement == null && ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner != null)
				{
					controlElement = new WindowDockingAreaUIElement(this, ((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).Owner as UltraDockManager);
					controlElement.Initialize(DockAreaPane);
				}
				return (ControlUIElementBase)(object)controlElement;
			}
		}

				return false;
			}

		private Size AddSplitterSize(Size size)
		{
			if (DockManager == null)
			{
				return size;
			}
			switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
			{
			case DockStyle.Left:
			case DockStyle.Right:
				size.Width += Pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				break;
			case DockStyle.Top:
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
				size.Height += Pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				break;
			}
			return size;
		}

		private Size RemoveSplitterSize(Size size)
		{
			if (DockManager == null)
			{
				return size;
			}
			switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
			{
			case DockStyle.Left:
			case DockStyle.Right:
				size.Width -= DockManager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				break;
			case DockStyle.Top:
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
				size.Height -= DockManager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				break;
			}
			return size;
		}

		private void GetPaneDisplaySize(Size newSize, bool honorSplitterWidth)
		{
			if (Pane == null || DockManager == null || DockManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			adjustingSize = true;
			bool initializingComponent = DockManager.InitializingComponent;
			switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
			{
			case DockStyle.Left:
			case DockStyle.Right:
				if (honorSplitterWidth && DockManager.IsSplitterBarRequired(Pane))
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Width = newSize.Width + Pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Width = newSize.Width;
				}
				break;
			case DockStyle.Top:
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
				if (honorSplitterWidth && DockManager.IsSplitterBarRequired(Pane))
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Height = newSize.Height + Pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Height = newSize.Height;
				}
				break;
			case DockStyle.None:
				((Control)(object)this).ClientSize = newSize;
				break;
			}
			adjustingSize = false;
		}

		private void SetPaneDisplaySize()
		{
			if (creatingHandle || pane == null || (DockManager != null && DockManager.IsUnhooking) || !pane.IsInitialized || (DockManager.IsResumingLayout && !DockManager.IsRemovingUnreferencedDockAreas))
			{
				return;
			}
			Size size = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
			if (DockManager != null)
			{
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
				case DockStyle.Right:
					size.Width -= DockManager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					size.Height -= DockManager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				}
			}
			pane.Size = size;
		}

		internal void SynchronizePaneDisplaySize()
		{
			SetPaneDisplaySize();
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!adjustingSize)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					Form form = ((Control)(object)this).FindForm();
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
					if (form != null && form.WindowState == FormWindowState.Minimized)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (DockManager != null && !DockManager.InitializingComponent && !flag)
				{
					SetPaneDisplaySize();
				}
			}
			base.OnResize(e);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId != PropertyIds.FloatingLocation)
			{
				DockManager.SetControlVisibility((Control)(object)this, DockManager.IsWindowDockingAreaVisible(this));
			}
			((Control)(object)this).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)DockManager).Enabled;
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).SuspendLayout();
			((ManagedContainerControlBase)this).OnPaint(pe);
			((Control)(object)this).ResumeLayout();
		}

		protected override void OnParentVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnParentVisibleChanged(e);
			if (((Component)(object)this).DesignMode && DockManager != null)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Visible = DockManager.IsWindowDockingAreaVisible(this);
				((Control)(object)this).Enabled = ((UltraComponentControlManagerBase)DockManager).Enabled;
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateHandle()
		{
			creatingHandle = true;
			try
			{
				((Control)(object)this).CreateHandle();
			}
			finally
			{
				creatingHandle = false;
			}
		}

		void IDockAreaContainer.UpdateSize(Size newSize)
		{
			GetPaneDisplaySize(newSize, !DockManager.InitializingComponent);
		}

		private DockStyle GetDockResolvedForRightToLeft()
		{
			DockStyle result = ((Control)(object)this).Dock;
			if (((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
			{
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					result = DockStyle.Right;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					result = DockStyle.Left;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

	public class WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement : PaneSplitterUIElementBase
	{
		private WindowDockingArea DockingAreaControl => ((UIElement)this).Control as WindowDockingArea;

		private DockAreaPane Pane => DockingAreaControl?.DockAreaPane;

		protected override DockablePaneBase[] Panes => new DockablePaneBase[1] { Pane };

		internal override StyleUtils.SplitterRole Role
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
				{
					return StyleUtils.SplitterRole.DockAreaSplitterHorz;
				}
				return StyleUtils.SplitterRole.DockAreaSplitterVert;
			}
		}

		public WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement(UIElement parent, bool verticalSplit)
			: base(parent, verticalSplit)
		{
		}

		public override void GetAdjustmentRange(Point point, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range)
		{
			((SplitterUIElement)this).GetAdjustmentRange(point, ref range);
			if (((DisposableObject)(object)this).Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockAreaPane pane = Pane;
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			Rectangle innerDockedControlsBounds = base.UltraDockManager.InnerDockedControlsBounds;
			Size minimumSizeResolved = pane.MinimumSizeResolved;
			Size maximumSizeResolved = pane.MaximumSizeResolved;
			DockAreaPane fillPane = base.UltraDockManager.FillPane;
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			Size size2 = Size.Empty;
			Size size3 = Size.Empty;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (fillPane != null)
			{
				size = fillPane.MaximumSizeResolved;
				size2 = fillPane.MinimumSizeResolved;
				size3 = fillPane.DisplaySize;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			else if (base.UltraDockManager.HostControl != null)
			{
				foreach (Control control2 in base.UltraDockManager.HostControl.Controls)
				{
					if (control2.Visible && control2.Dock == DockStyle.Fill)
					{
						flag3 = true;
						size = control2.MaximumSize;
						size2 = control2.MinimumSize;
						size3 = control2.Size;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				switch (control.Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
				case DockStyle.Right:
					if (size2.Width > 0)
					{
						innerDockedControlsBounds.Width -= size2.Width;
					}
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					if (size2.Height > 0)
					{
						innerDockedControlsBounds.Height -= size2.Height;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (size.Width > 0)
				{
					empty.Width = Math.Max(0, size.Width - size3.Width);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (size.Height > 0)
				{
					empty.Height = Math.Max(0, size.Height - size3.Height);
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
			{
				range.leftRightAdjustmentBar.Width = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Width;
				if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Right)
				{
					range.maxDeltaLeft = -innerDockedControlsBounds.Width;
					if (maximumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
					{
						int num = -(maximumSizeResolved.Width - pane.Size.Width);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							range.maxDeltaLeft = 0;
						}
						else if (num > range.maxDeltaLeft)
						{
							range.maxDeltaLeft = num;
						}
					}
					if (minimumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
					{
						int num2 = pane.Size.Width - minimumSizeResolved.Width;
						if (num2 <= 0)
						{
							range.maxDeltaRight = 0;
						}
						else if (num2 < range.maxDeltaRight)
						{
							range.maxDeltaRight = num2;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Min(empty.Width, range.maxDeltaRight);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (control.Dock != DockStyle.Left)
					{
						return;
					}
					range.maxDeltaRight = innerDockedControlsBounds.Width;
					if (maximumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
					{
						int num3 = maximumSizeResolved.Width - pane.Size.Width;
						if (num3 <= 0)
						{
							range.maxDeltaRight = 0;
						}
						else if (num3 < range.maxDeltaRight)
						{
							range.maxDeltaRight = num3;
						}
					}
					if (minimumSizeResolved.Width > 0)
					{
						int num4 = -(pane.Size.Width - minimumSizeResolved.Width);
						if (num4 >= 0)
						{
							range.maxDeltaLeft = 0;
						}
						else if (num4 > range.maxDeltaLeft)
						{
							range.maxDeltaLeft = num4;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						range.maxDeltaLeft = Math.Max(-empty.Width, range.maxDeltaLeft);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			range.upDownAdjustmentBar.Height = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Height;
			if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Bottom)
			{
				range.maxDeltaUp = -innerDockedControlsBounds.Height;
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					int num5 = -(maximumSizeResolved.Height - pane.Size.Height);
					if (num5 >= 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaUp = 0;
					}
					else if (num5 > range.maxDeltaUp)
					{
						range.maxDeltaUp = num5;
					}
				}
				if (minimumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					int num6 = pane.Size.Height - minimumSizeResolved.Height;
					if (num6 <= 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaDown = 0;
					}
					else if (num6 < range.maxDeltaDown)
					{
						range.maxDeltaDown = num6;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Min(empty.Height, range.maxDeltaDown);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (control.Dock != DockStyle.Top)
				{
					return;
				}
				range.maxDeltaDown = innerDockedControlsBounds.Height;
				if (maximumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					int num7 = maximumSizeResolved.Height - pane.Size.Height;
					if (num7 <= 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaDown = 0;
					}
					else if (num7 < range.maxDeltaDown)
					{
						range.maxDeltaDown = num7;
					}
				}
				if (minimumSizeResolved.Height > 0)
				{
					int num8 = -(pane.Size.Height - minimumSizeResolved.Height);
					if (num8 >= 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaUp = 0;
					}
					else if (num8 > range.maxDeltaUp)
					{
						range.maxDeltaUp = num8;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Max(-empty.Height, range.maxDeltaUp);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			DockablePaneBase pane = Pane;
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if (control == null || pane.Manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(((UIElement)this).Control);
			parent?.SuspendLayout();
			if (base.IsVerticalSplitterBar)
			{
				if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Right)
				{
					control.Width -= delta.X;
				}
				else if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Left)
				{
					control.Width += delta.X;
				}
			}
			else if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Bottom)
			{
				control.Height -= delta.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				control.Height += delta.Y;
			}
			parent?.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			base.UltraDockManager.VerifyPaneControlElements(control);
			base.ApplyAdjustment(delta);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			DockAreaPane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null && pane.Manager != null)
			{
				PanesEventArgs e = new PanesEventArgs(new DockablePaneBase[1] { pane });
				pane.Manager.FireEvent(DockManagerEventIds.DoubleClickSplitterBar, e);
			}
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
		}
	}
	public class WindowDockingAreaUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private bool isBeingVerified;

		public DockAreaPane DockAreaPane => ((WindowDockingArea)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).DockAreaPane;

		internal bool IsBeingVerified => isBeingVerified;

		public override RightToLeft RightToLeft
		{
			get
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
				if (dockAreaPane == null)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;
				}
				UltraDockManager manager = dockAreaPane.Manager;
				if (manager == null)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Control.RightToLeft;
				}
				if (!manager.IsHostRightToLeftLayoutResolved)
				{
					return RightToLeft.No;
				}
				return RightToLeft.Yes;
			}
		}

		public WindowDockingAreaUIElement(WindowDockingArea control, UltraDockManager dockManager)
			: base((Control)(object)control, (IUltraControl)(object)dockManager)
		{
		}

		protected override void VerifyChildElements(ControlUIElementBase controlElement, bool recursive)
		{
			bool flag = isBeingVerified;
			isBeingVerified = true;
			((UIElement)this).VerifyChildElements(controlElement, recursive);
			EnsureChildrenControlElementsVerified();
			isBeingVerified = flag;
		}

		private void EnsureChildrenControlElementsVerified()
		{
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if (control is DockControlBase { IsVerifyChildElementsPending: not false })
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
			{
				if (!(control2 is DockControlBase dockControlBase2))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (dockControlBase2.HasControlUIElement && dockControlBase2.ControlElement.ElementsChanged)
				{
					((UIElement)dockControlBase2.ControlElement).Rect = ((Control)(object)dockControlBase2).ClientRectangle;
					((UIElement)dockControlBase2.ControlElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(DockAreaPane context)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = context;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = DockAreaPane;
			if (dockAreaPane != null && (!(((UIElement)this).Rect == Rectangle.Empty) || !(((UIElement)this).Control.Size != Size.Empty)) && dockAreaPane != null && dockAreaPane.Manager != null)
			{
				Rectangle workRect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				if (dockAreaPane.Manager.IsSplitterBarRequired(dockAreaPane))
				{
					PositionSplitterBar(ref workRect, dockAreaPane, childElements);
				}
				if (!PositionPaneElement(workRect, dockAreaPane, childElements))
				{
					dockAreaPane.HideControls();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool PositionPaneElement(Rectangle workRect, DockAreaPane pane, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			if (workRect.Width <= 0 || workRect.Height <= 0 || pane == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PaneUIElement paneUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(PaneUIElement), true) as PaneUIElement;
			if (paneUIElement == null)
			{
				paneUIElement = new PaneUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
			}
			paneUIElement.Initialize(pane);
			((UIElement)paneUIElement).Rect = workRect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)paneUIElement);
			return true;
		}

		private void PositionSplitterBar(ref Rectangle workRect, DockAreaPane pane, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			int splitterBarWidthResolved = pane.Manager.SplitterBarWidthResolved;
			if (splitterBarWidthResolved != 0)
			{
				bool flag = pane.DockedLocation == DockedLocation.DockedLeft || DockedLocation.DockedRight == pane.DockedLocation;
				WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement), true) as WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement;
				if (windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement == null || windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement.IsVerticalSplitterBar != flag)
				{
					windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement = new WindowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, flag);
				}
				Size size = new Size(splitterBarWidthResolved, splitterBarWidthResolved);
				Point location;
				switch (pane.DockedLocation)
				{
				case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
					location = workRect.Location;
					size.Width = workRect.Width;
					workRect.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					workRect.Y += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
					location = new Point(workRect.Right - splitterBarWidthResolved, workRect.Y);
					size.Height = workRect.Height;
					workRect.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
					location = workRect.Location;
					size.Height = workRect.Height;
					workRect.Width -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					workRect.X += splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				default:
					location = new Point(workRect.X, workRect.Bottom - splitterBarWidthResolved);
					size.Width = workRect.Width;
					workRect.Height -= splitterBarWidthResolved;
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(location, size);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)windowDockingAreaSplitterUIElement);
			}
		}
	}

		private EventHandler DestroyWindowHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (destroyWindowHandler == null)

		{
			get
			{
				if (menus == null)

					menus = new Hashtable(5);

		private ContextMenuPopupManager()
		{
		}

		private void OnDestroyWindow(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lock (typeof(ContextMenuPopupManager))
			{
				if (sender is ContextMenuPopup contextMenuPopup)
				{
					Menus.Remove(contextMenuPopup.Handle);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddItem(UltraContextMenuManager contextMenu, IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (NativeWindowMethods.IsWindow(hwnd))
			{
				ContextMenuPopup contextMenuPopup = manager.FindItem(hwnd);
				if (contextMenuPopup == null)
				{
					contextMenuPopup = new ContextMenuPopup(contextMenu, hwnd);
					Menus.Add(hwnd, contextMenuPopup);
					contextMenuPopup.DestroyWindow += DestroyWindowHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		private ContextMenuPopup FindItem(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (!Menus.ContainsKey(hwnd))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Menus[hwnd] as ContextMenuPopup;
		}

		private static ContextMenuPopupManager GetManager()
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				manager = new ContextMenuPopupManager();
			}
			return manager;
		}

		internal static void Subclass(UltraContextMenuManager contextMenu, IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			lock (typeof(ContextMenuPopupManager))
			{
				ContextMenuPopupManager contextMenuPopupManager = GetManager();
				contextMenuPopupManager.AddItem(contextMenu, hwnd);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			RemoveHook();
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (menu != null)
				{
					menu.Dispose();
					menu = null;
				}
				if (appearanceHolder != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					appearanceHolder.Reset();
					appearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (backgroundAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					backgroundAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					backgroundAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					backgroundAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (defaultItemAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					defaultItemAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					defaultItemAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					defaultItemAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (itemAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					itemAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					itemAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					itemAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (checkedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					checkedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					checkedAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					checkedAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (selectedAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					selectedAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					selectedAppearanceHolder.Reset();
					selectedAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo2.PropId is AppearancePropIds)
			{
				AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo2.PropId;
				if ((int)val == 4 || (int)val == 1001)
				{
					DirtyMenuItemSize();
				}
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo2.PropId is FontDataPropIds)
			{
				DirtyMenuItemSize();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyPropChange()
		{
			DirtyMenuItemSize();
		}

		protected internal virtual void DirtyMenuItemSize()
		{
			dirtyMenus = true;
		}

		{

				ResetOwnerDrawState(value: true, MenuItems);
			}
		}

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (HasBackgroundAppearance)
			{
				BackgroundAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				MenuStyle style = Style;
				if (style != MenuStyle.OfficeXP)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Menu;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Window;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)4) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 4uL) != 0L)
			{
				MenuStyle style = Style;
				if (style != MenuStyle.OfficeXP)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.MenuText;
				}
				else
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.WindowFrame;
				}
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}

		private bool InstallHook()
		{
			pendingMenuLoopInit = true;
			try
			{
				InstallHookUnsafe();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHook()
		{
			try
			{
				RemoveHookUnsafe();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void InstallHookUnsafe()
		{
			if (hookHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				RemoveHookUnsafe();
			}
			if (hookCallBack == null)
			{
				hookCallBack = HookProc;
			}
			hookHandle = NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowsHookEx(4, hookCallBack, IntPtr.Zero, AppDomain.GetCurrentThreadId());
		}

		private void RemoveHookUnsafe()
		{
			if (!(hookHandle == IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.UnhookWindowsHookEx(hookHandle);
				hookHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(int ncode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
		{
			NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT cWPSTRUCT = (NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.CWPSTRUCT));
			switch (cWPSTRUCT.msg)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(40);
				NativeWindowMethods.GetClassName(cWPSTRUCT.hWnd, stringBuilder, stringBuilder.Capacity);
				if (stringBuilder.ToString().Trim() == "#32768")
				{
					ContextMenuPopupManager.Subclass(this, cWPSTRUCT.hWnd);
				}
				break;
			}
			case 529:
				if (pendingMenuLoopInit)
				{
					pendingMenuLoopInit = false;
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveHook();
				}
				break;
			case 530:
				RemoveHook();
				break;
			}
			return NativeWindowMethods.CallNextHookEx(hookHandle, ncode, wParam, lParam);
		}

		public static void DrawBorders(Graphics gr, UIElementBorderStyle style, Border3DSide sides, Color borderColor, Color borderColor3DBase, Rectangle rect, Rectangle invalidRect, bool flatMode)
		{

		private void DrawDisabledImage(Graphics g, Image img, Point destination, Size imgSize)
		{

					graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image2);
					graphics.DrawImage(image, 0, 0, imgSize.Width, imgSize.Height);
					image = image2;
				}

			}
			finally

				graphics?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual Size GetImageAreaSize()
		{
			Size imageSize = GetImageSize();
			switch (Style)
			{
			case MenuStyle.Office2000:
				imageSize += new Size(2, 2);
				imageSize += new Size(1, 1);
				break;
			case MenuStyle.OfficeXP:
				imageSize += new Size(2, 2);
				imageSize += new Size(2, 2);
				imageSize.Width += 3;
				break;
			}
			return imageSize;
		}

		protected Size GetXPItemSize(MeasureItemEventArgs e, bool isBottomItem)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsSeparator)
			{
				return SeparatorSize;
			}
			Size imageAreaSize = GetImageAreaSize();
			Font font = SystemInformation.MenuFont;
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			ResolveAppearance(isSelected: false, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			Font font2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(font);
			if (font2 != null)
			{
				font = font2;
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = GetStringFormat(selected: false);
			Size size = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(e.Graphics, base.Text, font, new PointF(0f, 0f), stringFormat));
			if (ShowShortcutResolved)
			{
				string shortcutString = ShortcutString;
				Size size2 = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(e.Graphics, shortcutString, font, new PointF(0f, 0f), stringFormat));
				size.Width += size2.Width + 3;
				size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height);
			}
			int width = imageAreaSize.Width + PreTextSpace + size.Width + ArrowAreaWidth;
			int height = Math.Max(imageAreaSize.Height, size.Height);
			Size result = new Size(width, height);
			result += new Size(2, 2);
			result.Width += 2;
			if (!isBottomItem)
			{
				result.Height++;
			}
			stringFormat?.Dispose();
			font2?.Dispose();
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class ControlPaneControlConverter : ReferenceConverter
	{
		public ControlPaneControlConverter(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsValueAllowed(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(value is Control control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value is IDockingArea || value is DockControlBase || value is Form)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = context.Instance as DockableControlPane;
			if (dockableControlPane.Control == value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (dockableControlPane.Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockableControlPane.Manager.ControlPanes.Contains(control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control.Dock == DockStyle.Fill)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			StandardValuesCollection standardValues = base.GetStandardValues(context);
			object[] array = new object[standardValues.Count - 1];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in standardValues)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					array[num] = item;
					num++;
				}
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(array);
		}
	}
	public class ControlPanePropertyTab : PropertyTab
	{
		private class SurrogatePropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private PropertyDescriptor baseDescriptor;

			private object component;

			private object propComponent;

			public override Type ComponentType => component.GetType();

			public override bool IsReadOnly => baseDescriptor.IsReadOnly;

			public override Type PropertyType => baseDescriptor.PropertyType;

			public SurrogatePropertyDescriptor(object propComponent, object component, PropertyDescriptor baseDescriptor, Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(baseDescriptor.Name, attributes)
			{
				this.propComponent = propComponent;
				this.component = component;
				this.baseDescriptor = baseDescriptor;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return baseDescriptor.CanResetValue(propComponent);
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return baseDescriptor.GetValue(propComponent);
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				baseDescriptor.ResetValue(propComponent);
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				baseDescriptor.SetValue(propComponent, value);
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return baseDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(propComponent);
			}
		}

		private Bitmap bitmap;

		private IServiceProvider provider;

		private IDesignerHost DesignerHost
		{
			get
			{
				if (provider == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return provider.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) as IDesignerHost;
			}
		}

		private UltraDockManager DockManager
		{
			get
			{
				IDesignerHost designerHost = DesignerHost;
				if (designerHost == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (designerHost.Container == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				foreach (object component in designerHost.Container.Components)
				{
					if (component is UltraDockManager)
					{
						return (UltraDockManager)component;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override Bitmap Bitmap => bitmap;

		public override string TabName => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ControlPanePropertyTabName");

		public ControlPanePropertyTab(IServiceProvider provider)
			: this()
		{
			this.provider = provider;
		}

		public ControlPanePropertyTab()
		{
			bitmap = GetPropertyPageImage();
		}

		private Bitmap GetPropertyPageImage()
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraDockManager).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraDockManager), "ToolboxBitmaps.CLR2.UltraDockManager.png");
			return Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream) as Bitmap;
		}

		public override bool CanExtend(object extendee)
		{
			if (!(extendee is Control control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraDockManager dockManager = DockManager;
			if (dockManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dockManager.PaneFromControl(control) != null;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && bitmap != null)
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				bitmap = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(object component, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return GetProperties(null, component, attributes);
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object component, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			UltraDockManager dockManager = DockManager;
			DockableControlPane dockableControlPane = dockManager?.PaneFromControl(component as Control);
			if (dockManager == null || dockableControlPane == null)
			{
				if (component is Control)
				{
					return null;
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(component);
				if (converter != null)
				{
					return converter.GetProperties(context, component, attributes);
				}
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component, attributes);
			}
			if (dockManager.IsInheritedPane(dockableControlPane))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeConverter converter2 = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dockableControlPane);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = converter2.GetProperties(null, dockableControlPane, attributes);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (!(item.Name == "Control"))
				{
					AttributeCollection attributes2 = item.Attributes;
					Attribute[] array = new Attribute[attributes2.Count];
					attributes2.CopyTo(array, 0);
					SurrogatePropertyDescriptor value = new SurrogatePropertyDescriptor(dockableControlPane, component, item, array);
					arrayList.Add(value);
				}
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] properties2 = (PropertyDescriptor[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PropertyDescriptor));
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties2);
		}
	}

		{

			{
				get
				{
					if (pane is DockableGroupPane && !((DockableGroupPane)pane).IsVisible)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (pane is DockableControlPane && base.Parent is PaneTreeNode paneTreeNode)
					{
						_ = paneTreeNode.Pane;
						_ = pane.Parent;
						return false;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsReadOnly => pane.Manager.IsInheritedPane(pane);

			internal PaneTreeNode(DockablePaneBase pane, string text, int imageIndex)
				: base(text, imageIndex, imageIndex)

				this.pane.SubObjectPropChanged += OnSubObjectPropChange;

				base.Text = pane.ToString();

				{
					if (node is PaneTreeNode)
					{
						PaneTreeNode paneTreeNode = (PaneTreeNode)node;
						paneTreeNode.Reinitialize();
					}
				}
			}
		}
