		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (components != null)
				{
					components.Dispose();
				}
				imageListImages.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void LoadResourceImages(bool dithered)
		{
			if (dithered)
			{
				DitheredPaneTypeImageStartIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				PaneTypeImageStartIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count;
			}
			Image image = GetImage("PaneType.bmp");
			if (dithered)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image);
				Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				HatchBrush hatchBrush = new HatchBrush(HatchStyle.Percent50, Color.Transparent, SystemColors.Window);
				graphics.FillRectangle(hatchBrush, 0, 0, image.Width, image.Height);
				graphics.Dispose();
				hatchBrush.Dispose();
				imageListImages.Images.AddStrip(bitmap);
			}
			else
			{
				imageListImages.Images.AddStrip(image);
			}
			if (dithered)
			{
				DitheredPaneTypeImageEndIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				PaneTypeImageEndIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count - 1;
			}
			if (dithered)
			{
				DitheredWindowTypeImageStartIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				WindowTypeImageStartIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count;
			}
			Image image2 = GetImage("WindowType.bmp");
			if (dithered)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap2 = new Bitmap(image2);
				Graphics graphics2 = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap2);
				HatchBrush hatchBrush2 = new HatchBrush(HatchStyle.Percent50, Color.Transparent, SystemColors.Window);
				graphics2.FillRectangle(hatchBrush2, 0, 0, image2.Width, image2.Height);
				graphics2.Dispose();
				hatchBrush2.Dispose();
				imageListImages.Images.AddStrip(bitmap2);
			}
			else
			{
				imageListImages.Images.AddStrip(image2);
			}
			if (dithered)
			{
				DitheredWindowTypeImageEndIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				WindowTypeImageEndIndex = imageListImages.Images.Count - 1;
			}
		}

		public DockablePanesPropertyPage()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			imageListImages.ImageSize = new Size(16, 16);
			imageListImages.TransparentColor = Color.Magenta;
			treeViewDockedPanes.ImageList = imageListImages;
			treeViewFloatingPanes.ImageList = imageListImages;
			treeViewUndocked.ImageList = imageListImages;
			Bitmap value = new Bitmap(16, 16);
			imageListImages.Images.Add(value);
			LoadResourceImages(dithered: false);
			LoadResourceImages(dithered: true);
			WindowTypeSegmentSize = Enum.GetValues(typeof(WindowTypeImage)).Length;
			propertyGridMain.CommandsVisibleIfAvailable = false;
			treeViewDockedPanes.HideSelection = false;
			treeViewFloatingPanes.HideSelection = false;
			treeViewUndocked.HideSelection = false;
			InitializeLocalizedCaptions();
		}

		private void InitializeLocalizedCaptions()
		{
			labelDocked.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageDockedPanesText");
			toolTipPropPage.SetToolTip(labelDocked, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageDockedPanesToolTip"));
			labelFloating.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageFloatingPanesText");
			toolTipPropPage.SetToolTip(labelFloating, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageFloatingPanesToolTip"));
			labelUndocked.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageUndockedPanesText");
			toolTipPropPage.SetToolTip(labelUndocked, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PanePropPageUndockedPanesTooltip"));
		}

		private Image GetImage(string resourceName)
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraDockManager).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraDockManager), resourceName);
			return Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
		}

		public override void InitializeControl(object baseObject)
		{
			if (!(baseObject is UltraDockManager))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_0"));
			}
			manager = (UltraDockManager)baseObject;
			propertyGridMain.Initialize((IComponent)manager);
			PopulateDockedNodes(docked: true, treeViewDockedPanes);
			PopulateDockedNodes(docked: false, treeViewFloatingPanes);
			StoreCurrentState();
			HookPropertyChanged();
		}

		private void PopulateDockedNodes(bool docked, TreeView tree)
		{
			tree.Nodes.Clear();
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in manager.DockAreas)
			{
				if ((!docked || dockArea.DockedState != DockedState.Floating) && (docked || dockArea.DockedState != DockedState.Docked))
				{
					AddPaneNode(tree.Nodes, dockArea, includeAllControlPanes: true, dither: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PopulateDockedNodes(TreeView tree)
		{
			tree.Nodes.Clear();
			foreach (DockAreaPane dockArea in manager.DockAreas)
			{
				AddPaneNode(tree.Nodes, dockArea, includeAllControlPanes: false, dither: false);
			}
			tree.ExpandAll();
		}

		private int GetPaneImageIndex(DockablePaneBase pane, bool dithered)
		{
			if (pane is DockAreaPane)
			{
				DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = (DockAreaPane)pane;
				return GetDockAreaImageIndex(dockAreaPane.DockedLocation, dockAreaPane.ChildPaneStyle, dithered);
			}
			if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				ChildPaneStyle childPaneStyle = ((DockableGroupPane)pane).ChildPaneStyle;
				int num = (dithered ? DitheredPaneTypeImageStartIndex : PaneTypeImageStartIndex);
				switch (childPaneStyle)
				{
				case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
					num++;
					break;
				case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
					num += 2;
					break;
				case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
					num += 3;
					break;
				case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
					num += 4;
					break;
				}
				return num;
			}
			if (dithered)
			{
				return DitheredPaneTypeImageStartIndex;
			}
			return PaneTypeImageStartIndex;
		}

		private int GetDockAreaImageIndex(DockedLocation location, ChildPaneStyle style, bool dithered)
		{
			int num = (dithered ? DitheredWindowTypeImageStartIndex : WindowTypeImageStartIndex);
			switch (style)
			{
			case ChildPaneStyle.HorizontalSplit:
				num = num;
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit:
				num += WindowTypeSegmentSize;
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.TabGroup:
				num += WindowTypeSegmentSize * 3;
				break;
			case ChildPaneStyle.SlidingGroup:
				num += WindowTypeSegmentSize * 2;
				break;
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case DockedLocation.DockedLeft:
				num = num;
				break;
			case DockedLocation.DockedRight:
				num++;
				break;
			case DockedLocation.DockedTop:
				num += 3;
				break;
			case DockedLocation.DockedBottom:
				num += 2;
				break;
			case DockedLocation.Floating:
				num += 4;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void AddPaneNode(TreeNodeCollection nodes, DockablePaneBase pane, bool includeAllControlPanes, bool dither)
		{
			if (pane is DockableGroupPane && !((DockableGroupPane)pane).HasChildControlPane(recursive: true))
			{
				dither = true;
			}
			int paneImageIndex = GetPaneImageIndex(pane, dither);
			TreeNode treeNode = new PaneTreeNode(pane, pane.ToString(), paneImageIndex);
			treeNode.Tag = pane;
			if (dither)
			{
				treeNode.ForeColor = SystemColors.GrayText;
			}
			if (pane is DockableGroupPane)
			{
				DockableGroupPane dockableGroupPane = (DockableGroupPane)pane;
				foreach (DockablePaneBase pane2 in dockableGroupPane.Panes)
				{
					AddPaneNode(treeNode.Nodes, pane2, includeAllControlPanes, dither: false);
				}
				if (includeAllControlPanes)
				{
					foreach (DockableControlPane controlPane in manager.ControlPanes)
					{
						if (pane.DockedState != controlPane.DockedState)
						{
							if (pane.DockedState == DockedState.Floating && controlPane.ParentFloating == pane)
							{
								AddPaneNode(treeNode.Nodes, controlPane, includeAllControlPanes, dither: true);
							}
							else if (pane.DockedState == DockedState.Docked && controlPane.ParentDocked == pane)
							{
								AddPaneNode(treeNode.Nodes, controlPane, includeAllControlPanes, dither: true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				treeNode.Expand();
			}
			else if (pane is DockableControlPane)
			{
				AddControlNode(treeNode.Nodes, (DockableControlPane)pane, dither);
			}
			nodes.Add(treeNode);
		}

		private void AddControlNode(TreeNodeCollection nodes, DockableControlPane pane, bool dither)
		{
			if (pane.Control != null)
			{
				int controlImageIndex = GetControlImageIndex(pane.Control, dither);
				TreeNode treeNode = new PaneTreeNode(pane, pane.Control.Name, controlImageIndex);
				treeNode.Tag = pane.Control;
				if (dither)
				{
					treeNode.ForeColor = SystemColors.GrayText;
				}
				nodes.Add(treeNode);
			}
		}

		private int GetControlImageIndex(Control control, bool dither)
		{
			Type type = control.GetType();
			if (!dither && controlImageCollection.Contains(type))
			{
				return (int)controlImageCollection[type];
			}
			if (dither && ditheredControlImageCollection.Contains(type))
			{
				return (int)ditheredControlImageCollection[type];
			}
			Image toolboxBitmap = GetToolboxBitmap(type);
			if (toolboxBitmap == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (toolboxBitmap is Bitmap)
			{
				((Bitmap)toolboxBitmap).MakeTransparent();
			}
			if (dither)
			{
				Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(toolboxBitmap);
				HatchBrush hatchBrush = new HatchBrush(HatchStyle.Percent50, Color.Transparent, SystemColors.Window);
				graphics.FillRectangle(hatchBrush, 0, 0, toolboxBitmap.Width, toolboxBitmap.Height);
				hatchBrush.Dispose();
				graphics.Dispose();
			}
			imageListImages.Images.Add(toolboxBitmap);
			int num = imageListImages.Images.Count - 1;
			if (dither)
			{
				ditheredControlImageCollection.Add(type, num);
			}
			else
			{
				controlImageCollection.Add(type, num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private Image GetToolboxBitmap(Type type)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(ToolboxBitmapAttribute), inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0)
			{
				object[] array = customAttributes;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					ToolboxBitmapAttribute toolboxBitmapAttribute = (ToolboxBitmapAttribute)array[i];
					Image image = toolboxBitmapAttribute.GetImage(type);
					if (image != null)
					{
						return image;
					}
				}
			}
			string name = type.FullName + ".bmp";
			Stream manifestResourceStream = type.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			if (manifestResourceStream != null)
			{
				return Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void ApplyChanges()
		{
			Clean();
		}

		public override void CancelChanges()
		{
			base.CancelChanges();
		}

		private void StoreCurrentState()
		{
		}

		private void HookPropertyChanged()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (hookedManager != manager)
			{
				if (hookedManager != null)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)hookedManager).PropertyChanged -= new PropertyChangedEventHandler(OnManagerPropertyChanged);
				}
				if (manager != null)
				{
					((UltraComponentBase)manager).PropertyChanged += new PropertyChangedEventHandler(OnManagerPropertyChanged);
				}
				hookedManager = manager;
			}
		}

		private void OnManagerPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void OnDragTreeNode(object sender, ItemDragEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void OnSelectTreeNode(object sender, TreeViewEventArgs e)
		{
			TreeNode node = e.Node;
			if (node != null && node.Tag != null)
			{
				if (node is PaneTreeNode && ((PaneTreeNode)node).IsReadOnly && !(node.Tag is Control))
				{
					propertyGridMain.Enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					propertyGridMain.Enabled = true;
				}
				propertyGridMain.SelectedObject = node.Tag;
			}
		}
	}

		private void DockControlsForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeCombo(comboDockedLocation, DockedLocation.DockedLeft);
			InitializeCombo(comboChildPaneStyle, ChildPaneStyle.VerticalSplit);
			SortCombo(comboChildPaneStyle);
			SortCombo(comboDockedLocation);
		}

		private void SortCombo(ComboBox combo)
		{
			int selectedIndex = combo.SelectedIndex;
			combo.Sorted = true;
			combo.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
		}

		private void InitializeCombo(ComboBox cbo, Enum defaultEnum)
		{
			if (cbo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Type type = defaultEnum.GetType();
			cbo.Items.Clear();
			string[] names = Enum.GetNames(type);
			string[] array = names;
			foreach (string value in array)
			{
				object obj = Enum.Parse(type, value);
				int selectedIndex = cbo.Items.Add(obj);
				if (defaultEnum.Equals(obj))
				{
					cbo.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeListView(ICollection controls)
		{
			if (controls != null)
			{
				foreach (object control2 in controls)
				{
					if (control2 is Control control && !(control is DockControlBase))
					{
						ListViewItem listViewItem = new ListViewItem((control.Site != null) ? control.Site.Name : control.Name);
						listViewItem.Tag = control;
						listViewControls.Items.Add(listViewItem);
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateUpDownButtonStates();
			buttonOk.Enabled = listViewControls.Items.Count > 0 && manager != null;
		}

		private void buttonOk_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void ProcessDockRequest()
		{
			DockedLocation dockedLocation = (DockedLocation)comboDockedLocation.SelectedItem;
			DockAreaPane dockAreaPane = new DockAreaPane(dockedLocation);
			dockAreaPane.ChildPaneStyle = (ChildPaneStyle)comboChildPaneStyle.SelectedItem;
			foreach (ListViewItem item in listViewControls.Items)
			{
				DockableControlPane pane = new DockableControlPane(null, item.Text, item.Tag as Control);
				dockAreaPane.Panes.Add(pane);
			}
			if (dockedLocation == DockedLocation.Floating)
			{
				dockAreaPane.FloatingLocation = Control.MousePosition;
			}
			manager.DockAreas.Add(dockAreaPane);
		}

		private void listViewControls_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateUpDownButtonStates();
		}

		private void UpdateUpDownButtonStates()
		{
			if (listViewControls.SelectedIndices.Count == 0)
			{
				ButtonWithoutFocus buttonWithoutFocus = buttonUp;
				bool enabled = (buttonDown.Enabled = false);
				buttonWithoutFocus.Enabled = enabled;
			}
			else
			{
				int num = listViewControls.SelectedIndices[0];
				buttonUp.Enabled = num > 0;
				buttonDown.Enabled = num < listViewControls.Items.Count - 1;
			}
		}

		private void buttonUp_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MoveSelectedItem(listViewControls, up: true);
		}

		private void buttonDown_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MoveSelectedItem(listViewControls, up: false);
		}

		private void MoveSelectedItem(ListView listView, bool up)
		{
			if (listView != null && listView.SelectedItems.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = listView.SelectedIndices[0];
				ListViewItem item = listView.SelectedItems[0];
				num = ((!up) ? (num + 1) : (num - 1));
				num = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(num, listView.Items.Count - 1));
				listView.Items.Remove(item);
				listView.Items.Insert(num, item);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeLocalizedCaptions()
		{
			buttonCancel.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgCancel");
			buttonOk.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgOK");
			labelDockedLocation.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgDockedLocation");
			labelSelectedControls.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgSelectedControls");
			labelGroupType.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgGroupType");
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DockControlsDlgTitle");
		}
	}

		private void ActionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateEnabledState();
		}

		private void buttonFileName_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (radioActionLoad.Checked)
			{
				openFileDockManager.ShowDialog(this);
			}
			else
			{
				saveFileDockManager.ShowDialog(this);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateEnabledState()
		{
			bool flag = radioActionLoad.Checked || radioActionSave.Checked;
			bool flag2 = radioFormatBinary.Checked || radioFormatXML.Checked;
			buttonFileName.Enabled = flag;
			buttonOk.Enabled = flag && flag2 && textBoxFileName.Text.Length > 0;
		}

		private void LoadSaveDialog_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			textBoxFileName.BackColor = SystemColors.Window;
		}

		private void FormatChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateEnabledState();
		}

		private void saveFileDockManager_FileOk(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			textBoxFileName.Text = saveFileDockManager.FileName;
			UpdateEnabledState();
		}

		private void openFileDockManager_FileOk(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			textBoxFileName.Text = openFileDockManager.FileName;
			UpdateEnabledState();
		}

		private void buttonOk_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = null;
			string text = textBoxFileName.Text;
			bool flag = radioActionLoad.Checked;
			try
			{
				bool flag2 = radioFormatXML.Checked;
				if (flag)
				{
					fileStream = new FileStream(text, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
					if (flag2)
					{
						manager.LoadFromXML(fileStream);
					}
					else
					{
						manager.LoadFromBinary(fileStream);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					fileStream = new FileStream(text, FileMode.OpenOrCreate, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None);
					if (flag2)
					{
						manager.SaveAsXML(fileStream);
					}
					else
					{
						manager.SaveAsBinary(fileStream);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				base.DialogResult = DialogResult.None;
				string text2;
				string text3;
				if (flag)
				{
					text2 = $"An error occured while attempting to load the layout file ({text}). Exception Details:\n{ex.Message}";
					text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MsgLoadLayout");
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = $"An error occured while attempting to save the UltraDockManager layout to the specified file ({text}). Exception Details:\n{ex.Message}";
					text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MsgSaveLayout");
				}
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, text3, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream?.Close();
			}
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{

namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.Serialization
{
	public class Binder : Binder
	{
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		public override Type BindToType(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			if (assemblyName == null || !assemblyName.StartsWith("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock"))
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			Type type = null;
			try
			{
				assemblyName = typeof(UltraDockManager).Assembly.FullName;
			}
			catch
			{
				assemblyName = "Infragistics4.Win.UltraWinDock.v21.1";
			}
			type = Type.GetType($"{typeName}, {assemblyName}");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			return type;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Shared
{
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinDock.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Infragistics.Shared.SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new Infragistics.Shared.SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = global::ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				Infragistics.Shared.SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	{
		public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
			: base(category)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
		{
			return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		public override string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					base.DescriptionValue = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
				}
				return base.Description;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
			: base(description)
		{
		}
	}

	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDisplayNameAttribute : DisplayNameAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		private string resourceName;

		private string displayName;

		public override string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					displayName = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(null, resourceName);
				}
				return displayName;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDisplayNameAttribute(string resourceName)
		{
			this.resourceName = resourceName;
		}
	}
